2eac7c3dd77e953db943e61f8699b28aa2eba85f.source_text: [APT38](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0082) is a North Korean state-sponsored threat group that specializes in financial cyber operations; it has been attributed to the Reconnaissance General Bureau.(Citation: CISA AA20-239A BeagleBoyz August 2020) Active since at least 2014, [APT38](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0082) has targeted banks, financial institutions, casinos, cryptocurrency exchanges, SWIFT system endpoints, and ATMs in at least 38 countries worldwide. Significant operations include the 2016 Bank of Bangladesh heist, during which [APT38](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0082) stole $81 million, as well as attacks against Bancomext (Citation: FireEye APT38 Oct 2018) and Banco de Chile (Citation: FireEye APT38 Oct 2018); some of their attacks have been destructive.(Citation: CISA AA20-239A BeagleBoyz August 2020)(Citation: FireEye APT38 Oct 2018)(Citation: DOJ North Korea Indictment Feb 2021)(Citation: Kaspersky Lazarus Under The Hood Blog 2017) North Korean group definitions are known to have significant overlap, and some security researchers report all North Korean state-sponsored cyber activity under the name [Lazarus Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0032) instead of tracking clusters or subgroups.
2eac7c3dd77e953db943e61f8699b28aa2eba85f.zh: [APT38](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0082)是一个朝鲜国家资助的黑客组织，专注于金融网络行动；其被归因为侦察总局。(Citation: CISA AA20-239A BeagleBoyz August 2020) APT38自至少2014年以来活跃，已针对全球至少38个国家的银行、金融机构、赌场、加密货币交易所、SWIFT系统端点和自动取款机进行攻击。其重大行动包括2016年孟加拉国银行劫案，期间APT38窃取了8100万美元，以及对Bancomext（Citation: FireEye APT38 Oct 2018）和智利银行（Citation: FireEye APT38 Oct 2018）的攻击；部分攻击具有破坏性。(Citation: CISA AA20-239A BeagleBoyz August 2020)(Citation: FireEye APT38 Oct 2018)(Citation: DOJ North Korea Indictment Feb 2021)(Citation: Kaspersky Lazarus Under The Hood Blog 2017) 已知朝鲜黑客组织的定义存在显著重叠，一些安全研究人员将所有朝鲜国家资助的网络活动统称为[Lazarus Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0032)，而不是追踪集群或子组。

31af5e020dc0d7b44c680a3d085710e42e3b7e5f.source_text: Adversaries may communicate using application layer protocols associated with web traffic to avoid detection/network filtering by blending in with existing traffic. Commands to the remote system, and often the results of those commands, will be embedded within the protocol traffic between the client and server. Protocols such as HTTP/S(Citation: CrowdStrike Putter Panda) and WebSocket(Citation: Brazking-Websockets) that carry web traffic may be very common in environments. HTTP/S packets have many fields and headers in which data can be concealed. An adversary may abuse these protocols to communicate with systems under their control within a victim network while also mimicking normal, expected traffic.
31af5e020dc0d7b44c680a3d085710e42e3b7e5f.zh: adversaries 可能使用与应用层协议 associated with web traffic 来避免检测/网络过滤，通过融入现有流量。对远程系统的命令以及这些命令的结果通常会被嵌入到客户端和服务器之间的协议流量中。携带 Web 流量的协议如 HTTP/S（引用：CrowdStrike Putter Panda）和 WebSocket（引用：Brazking-Websockets）在环境中可能非常常见。HTTP/S 包具有许多可以隐藏数据的字段和头部。敌手可能会滥用这些协议与受害者网络中受其控制的系统通信，同时模仿正常、预期的流量。

2896dfc2bd5cbd99a1ccaf825d0c8fd43366eeac.source_text: [APT38](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0082) used a backdoor, QUICKRIDE, to communicate to the C2 server over HTTP and HTTPS.(Citation: FireEye APT38 Oct 2018)
2896dfc2bd5cbd99a1ccaf825d0c8fd43366eeac.zh: [APT38](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0082) 使用后门 QUICKRIDE 通过 HTTP 和 HTTPS 与 C2 服务器进行通信。(Citation: FireEye APT38 Oct 2018)

a26460e26cd8f00c98eecbb0f1bce38c8fcf35f3.source_text: Adversaries may transfer tools or other files from an external system into a compromised environment. Tools or files may be copied from an external adversary-controlled system to the victim network through the command and control channel or through alternate protocols such as [ftp](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0095). Once present, adversaries may also transfer/spread tools between victim devices within a compromised environment (i.e. [Lateral Tool Transfer](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1570)). On Windows, adversaries may use various utilities to download tools, such as `copy`, `finger`, [certutil](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0160), and [PowerShell](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1059/001) commands such as IEX(New-Object Net.WebClient).downloadString() and Invoke-WebRequest. On Linux and macOS systems, a variety of utilities also exist, such as `curl`, `scp`, `sftp`, `tftp`, `rsync`, `finger`, and `wget`.(Citation: t1105_lolbas) A number of these tools, such as `wget`, `curl`, and `scp`, also exist on ESXi. After downloading a file, a threat actor may attempt to verify its integrity by checking its hash value (e.g., via `certutil -hashfile`).(Citation: Google Cloud Threat Intelligence COSCMICENERGY 2023) Adversaries may also abuse installers and package managers, such as `yum` or `winget`, to download tools to victim hosts. Adversaries have also abused file application features, such as the Windows `search-ms` protocol handler, to deliver malicious files to victims through remote file searches invoked by [User Execution](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1204) (typically after interacting with [Phishing](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1566) lures).(Citation: T1105: Trellix_search-ms) Files can also be transferred using various [Web Service](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1102)s as well as native or otherwise present tools on the victim system.(Citation: PTSecurity Cobalt Dec 2016) In some cases, adversaries may be able to leverage services that sync between a web-based and an on-premises client, such as Dropbox or OneDrive, to transfer files onto victim systems. For example, by compromising a cloud account and logging into the service's web portal, an adversary may be able to trigger an automatic syncing process that transfers the file onto the victim's machine.(Citation: Dropbox Malware Sync)
a26460e26cd8f00c98eecbb0f1bce38c8fcf35f3.zh: 攻击者可能将工具或其他文件从外部系统传输到已受 compromising 的环境中。文件或工具可以通过命令与控制通道，或通过替代协议（如 [ftp](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0095)）从攻击者控制的外部系统复制到受害网络中。一旦存在，攻击者还可能在已受 compromising 环境中的受害设备之间传输/传播工具（即 [横向工具传输](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1570)）。在 Windows 上，攻击者可以使用各种实用程序下载工具，例如 `copy`、`finger`、[certutil](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0160)，以及像 IEX(New-Object Net.WebClient).downloadString() 和 Invoke-WebRequest 这样的 [PowerShell](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1059/001) 命令。在 Linux 和 macOS 系统上，也存在多种实用程序，如 `curl`、`scp`、`sftp`、`tftp`、`rsync`、`finger` 和 `wget`。（Citation: t1105_lolbas）许多这些工具，如 `wget`、`curl` 和 `scp`，也存在于 ESXi 上。下载文件后，威胁行为者可能会尝试通过检查其哈希值（例如，通过 `certutil -hashfile`）来验证其完整性。（Citation: Google Cloud Threat Intelligence COSCMICENERGY 2023）攻击者还可能滥用安装程序和包管理器，如 `yum` 或 `winget`，以将工具下载到受害主机上。攻击者还滥用了文件应用程序功能，例如 Windows `search-ms` 协议处理器，通过由 [用户执行](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1204)（通常在与 [网络钓鱼](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1566) 诱饵交互之后）引发的远程文件搜索将恶意文件传递给受害者。（Citation: T1105: Trellix_search-ms）文件也可以通过各种 [Web 服务](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1102) 以及受害系统上的原生或其他现有工具进行传输。（Citation: PTSecurity Cobalt Dec 2016）在某些情况下，攻击者可以利用在服务端和客户端之间同步的服务，如 Dropbox 或 OneDrive，将文件传输到受害系统上。例如，通过入侵云账户并登录服务的 Web 门户，攻击者可以触发自动同步过程，从而将文件传输到受害者的计算机上。（Citation: Dropbox Malware Sync）

35281a0901b708d023063a78c73aac44d3e649d4.source_text: [APT38](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0082) used a backdoor, NESTEGG, that has the capability to download and upload files to and from a victim’s machine.(Citation: FireEye APT38 Oct 2018) Additionally, [APT38](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0082) has downloaded other payloads onto a victim’s machine.(Citation: 1 - appv)
35281a0901b708d023063a78c73aac44d3e649d4.zh: [APT38](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0082) 使用了后门程序 NESTEGG，该后门具备从受害者机器上载和下载文件的能力。(Citation: FireEye APT38 Oct 2018) 此外，[APT38](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0082) 还在受害者机器上下载了其他有效载荷。(Citation: 1 - appv)

396b1208186d2538fdc3a8d2f455268c1d09628c.source_text: [Indrik Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0119) is a Russia-based cybercriminal group that has been active since at least 2014. [Indrik Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0119) initially started with the [Dridex](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0384) banking Trojan, and then by 2017 they began running ransomware operations using [BitPaymer](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0570), [WastedLocker](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0612), and Hades ransomware. Following U.S. sanctions and an indictment in 2019, [Indrik Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0119) changed their tactics and diversified their toolset.(Citation: Crowdstrike Indrik November 2018)(Citation: Crowdstrike EvilCorp March 2021)(Citation: Treasury EvilCorp Dec 2019)
396b1208186d2538fdc3a8d2f455268c1d09628c.zh: [Indrik Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0119) 是一个自2014年至少以来一直活跃的俄罗斯网络犯罪组织。[Indrik Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0119) 最初以 [Dridex](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0384) 银行木马开始，到2017年，他们开始使用 [BitPaymer](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0570)、[WastedLocker](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0612) 和 Hades 勒索软件开展勒索软件活动。(Citation: Crowdstrike Indrik November 2018)(Citation: Crowdstrike EvilCorp March 2021)(Citation: Treasury EvilCorp Dec 2019)

8bf49d85f7f82b82f83dbe78043c5845c8caccf5.source_text: [Indrik Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0119) has downloaded additional scripts, malware, and tools onto a compromised host.(Citation: Crowdstrike Indrik November 2018)(Citation: Symantec WastedLocker June 2020)(Citation: Mandiant_UNC2165)
8bf49d85f7f82b82f83dbe78043c5845c8caccf5.zh: [Indrik Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0119) 已将其他脚本、恶意软件和工具下载到受感染的计算机上。(Citation: Crowdstrike Indrik November 2018)(Citation: Symantec WastedLocker June 2020)(Citation: Mandiant_UNC2165)

3bf9f606e233c8d30d9531dca3ed5199bd38653c.source_text: [NEODYMIUM](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0055) is an activity group that conducted a campaign in May 2016 and has heavily targeted Turkish victims. The group has demonstrated similarity to another activity group called [PROMETHIUM](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0056) due to overlapping victim and campaign characteristics. (Citation: Microsoft NEODYMIUM Dec 2016) (Citation: Microsoft SIR Vol 21) [NEODYMIUM](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0055) is reportedly associated closely with [BlackOasis](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0063) operations, but evidence that the group names are aliases has not been identified. (Citation: CyberScoop BlackOasis Oct 2017)
3bf9f606e233c8d30d9531dca3ed5199bd38653c.zh: [NEODYMIUM](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0055) 是一个活动组织，该组织于2016年5月开展了一次行动，并主要针对土耳其受害者。由于受害者和行动特征存在重叠，该组与另一个名为[PROMETHIUM](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0056)的活动组织表现出相似性。（引用：Microsoft NEODYMIUM Dec 2016）（引用：Microsoft SIR Vol 21）据报，[NEODYMIUM](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0055) 与 [BlackOasis](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0063) 的行动关系密切，但尚未发现证据表明这两个组名是别名。（引用：CyberScoop BlackOasis Oct 2017）

77056bd71ef086e6d64578c724e41add2ed6765b.source_text: [BlackByte](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1043) is a ransomware threat actor operating since at least 2021. [BlackByte](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1043) is associated with several versions of ransomware also labeled [BlackByte Ransomware](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1180). [BlackByte](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1043) ransomware operations initially used a common encryption key allowing for the development of a universal decryptor, but subsequent versions such as [BlackByte 2.0 Ransomware](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1181) use more robust encryption mechanisms. [BlackByte](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1043) is notable for operations targeting critical infrastructure entities among other targets across North America.(Citation: FBI BlackByte 2022)(Citation: Picus BlackByte 2022)(Citation: Symantec BlackByte 2022)(Citation: Microsoft BlackByte 2023)(Citation: Cisco BlackByte 2024)
77056bd71ef086e6d64578c724e41add2ed6765b.zh: [BlackByte](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1043) 是一个自至少 2021 年以来一直运营的黑勒索软件威胁行为体。[BlackByte](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1043) 与几个版本的勒索软件有关联，这些勒索软件也被标记为 [BlackByte Ransomware](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1180)。[BlackByte](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1043) 的勒索软件操作最初使用了一个通用加密密钥，这使得开发通用的解密器成为可能，但后续版本如 [BlackByte 2.0 Ransomware](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1181) 使用了更强大的加密机制。[BlackByte](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1043) 因其针对北美地区包括关键基础设施实体在内的多个目标的操作而引人注目。(Citation: FBI BlackByte 2022)(Citation: Picus BlackByte 2022)(Citation: Symantec BlackByte 2022)(Citation: Microsoft BlackByte 2023)(Citation: Cisco BlackByte 2024)

6ba9b83e6f13cd74fcda38949661b14280a89cae.source_text: [BlackByte](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1043) has transferred tools such as [Cobalt Strike](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0154) to victim environments from file sharing and hosting websites.(Citation: Microsoft BlackByte 2023)
6ba9b83e6f13cd74fcda38949661b14280a89cae.zh: [BlackByte](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1043) 从文件共享和托管网站将 [Cobalt Strike](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0154) 等工具转移到受害者环境中。（来源：Microsoft BlackByte 2023）

c7d77098a9f1e40c0e0b28ac4f660b06a70b2a81.source_text: [BlackByte](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1043) collected victim device information then transmitted this via HTTP POST to command and control infrastructure.(Citation: Microsoft BlackByte 2023)
c7d77098a9f1e40c0e0b28ac4f660b06a70b2a81.zh: [BlackByte](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1043) 收集受害设备信息，然后通过 HTTP POST 将其传输到命令和控制基础设施。(Citation: Microsoft BlackByte 2023)

42057d12d12a8b7f0b136f69b6600cbba1f96c7c.source_text: An adversary may use legitimate remote access tools to establish an interactive command and control channel within a network. Remote access tools create a session between two trusted hosts through a graphical interface, a command line interaction, a protocol tunnel via development or management software, or hardware-level access such as KVM (Keyboard, Video, Mouse) over IP solutions. Desktop support software (usually graphical interface) and remote management software (typically command line interface) allow a user to control a computer remotely as if they are a local user inheriting the user or software permissions. This software is commonly used for troubleshooting, software installation, and system management.(Citation: Symantec Living off the Land)(Citation: CrowdStrike 2015 Global Threat Report)(Citation: CrySyS Blog TeamSpy) Adversaries may similarly abuse response features included in EDR and other defensive tools that enable remote access. Remote access tools may be installed and used post-compromise as an alternate communications channel for redundant access or to establish an interactive remote desktop session with the target system. It may also be used as a malware component to establish a reverse connection or back-connect to a service or adversary-controlled system. Installation of many remote access tools may also include persistence (e.g., the software's installation routine creates a [Windows Service](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1543/003)). Remote access modules/features may also exist as part of otherwise existing software (e.g., Google Chrome’s Remote Desktop).(Citation: Google Chrome Remote Desktop)(Citation: Chrome Remote Desktop)
42057d12d12a8b7f0b136f69b6600cbba1f96c7c.zh: 对手可能使用合法的远程访问工具在建立交互式命令与控制通道。远程访问工具通过图形界面、命令行交互、开发或管理软件中的协议隧道，或KVM（键盘、视频、鼠标）等硬件级IP解决方案等在两个受信任主机之间创建会话。桌面支持软件（通常为图形界面）和远程管理软件（通常为命令行界面）允许用户像本地用户那样控制计算机并继承用户或软件的权限。该软件通常用于故障排除、软件安装和系统管理。(引用：Symantec Living off the Land)(引用：CrowdStrike 2015 Global Threat Report)(引用：CrySyS Blog TeamSpy) 对手也可能滥用集成于EDR和其他防御工具中的响应功能，这些工具支持远程访问。远程访问工具可能在失陷后安装并使用，作为备用通信渠道以实现冗余访问，或与目标系统建立交互式远程桌面会话。它还可能作为恶意软件组件，以建立反向连接或对攻击者控制系统进行回连。许多远程访问工具的安装过程可能还包括持久化机制（例如，软件的安装程序会创建一个 [Windows服务](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1543/003)）。远程访问模块/功能也可能作为现有软件的一部分存在（例如Google Chrome的Remote Desktop）。(引用：Google Chrome Remote Desktop)(引用：Chrome Remote Desktop)

572e898dd3668d4bb2e674a6a41a05d59e3bb6ce.source_text: [BlackByte](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1043) has used tools such as AnyDesk in victim environments.(Citation: Picus BlackByte 2022)(Citation: Microsoft BlackByte 2023)
572e898dd3668d4bb2e674a6a41a05d59e3bb6ce.zh: [BlackByte](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1043) 曾在受害者环境中使用诸如 AnyDesk 之类的工具。（来源：Picus BlackByte 2022）（来源：Microsoft BlackByte 2023）

cc39d549422e192284972b29ab00eedab12c5770.source_text: [Elderwood](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0066) is a suspected Chinese cyber espionage group that was reportedly responsible for the 2009 Google intrusion known as Operation Aurora. (Citation: Security Affairs Elderwood Sept 2012) The group has targeted defense organizations, supply chain manufacturers, human rights and nongovernmental organizations (NGOs), and IT service providers. (Citation: Symantec Elderwood Sept 2012) (Citation: CSM Elderwood Sept 2012)
cc39d549422e192284972b29ab00eedab12c5770.zh: [Elderwood](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0066)是一个涉嫌为中国网络间谍活动的组织，据报道该组织负责了2009年被称为“极光行动”的Google入侵事件。（参考文献：Security Affairs Elderwood 2012年9月）该组织的目标包括国防机构、供应链制造商、人权组织和非政府组织（NGO），以及IT服务提供商。（参考文献：Symantec Elderwood 2012年9月）（参考文献：CSM Elderwood 2012年9月）

130eafbc16f91362ea7ea9fcef49439519f16dac.source_text: The Ritsol backdoor trojan used by [Elderwood](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0066) can download files onto a compromised host from a remote location.(Citation: Symantec Ristol May 2012)
130eafbc16f91362ea7ea9fcef49439519f16dac.zh: 由[Elderwood](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0066)使用的Ritsol后门木马可以从远程位置向受感染的主机下载文件。（引用：Symantec Ristol May 2012）

5e675c0e3e509f33ef43852bb15b11a9a0f629e1.source_text: [SideCopy](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1008) is a Pakistani threat group that has primarily targeted South Asian countries, including Indian and Afghani government personnel, since at least 2019. [SideCopy](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1008)'s name comes from its infection chain that tries to mimic that of [Sidewinder](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0121), a suspected Indian threat group.(Citation: MalwareBytes SideCopy Dec 2021)
5e675c0e3e509f33ef43852bb15b11a9a0f629e1.zh: [SideCopy](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1008) 是一个巴基斯坦威胁组织，自至少 2019 年以来主要针对南亚国家，包括印度和阿富汗的政府人员。[SideCopy](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1008) 的名称来源于其感染链，该感染链试图模仿 [Sidewinder](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0121)（一个涉嫌来自印度的威胁组织）的感染链。(Citation: MalwareBytes SideCopy Dec 2021)

a83287f5d9adaab07bc4e2ea70788ba69c458bf3.source_text: [SideCopy](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1008) has delivered trojanized executables via spearphishing emails that contacts actor-controlled servers to download malicious payloads.(Citation: MalwareBytes SideCopy Dec 2021)
a83287f5d9adaab07bc4e2ea70788ba69c458bf3.zh: [SideCopy](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1008) 通过钓鱼邮件投递了特洛伊木马可执行文件，这些文件会联系由攻击者控制的服务器以下载恶意载荷。(Citation: MalwareBytes SideCopy Dec 2021)

1a67c5a4caa2185b786fef3483daa2bf7d44940d.source_text: [GALLIUM](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0093) is a cyberespionage group that has been active since at least 2012, primarily targeting telecommunications companies, financial institutions, and government entities in Afghanistan, Australia, Belgium, Cambodia, Malaysia, Mozambique, the Philippines, Russia, and Vietnam. This group is particularly known for launching Operation Soft Cell, a long-term campaign targeting telecommunications providers.(Citation: Cybereason Soft Cell June 2019) Security researchers have identified [GALLIUM](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0093) as a likely Chinese state-sponsored group, based in part on tools used and TTPs commonly associated with Chinese threat actors.(Citation: Cybereason Soft Cell June 2019)(Citation: Microsoft GALLIUM December 2019)(Citation: Unit 42 PingPull Jun 2022)
1a67c5a4caa2185b786fef3483daa2bf7d44940d.zh: [GALLIUM](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0093) 是一个自至少2012年以来一直活跃的网络间谍组织，主要针对阿富汗、澳大利亚、比利时、柬埔寨、马来西亚、莫桑比克、菲律宾、俄罗斯和越南的电信公司、金融机构和政府实体。该组织尤其以发动“软细胞行动”（Operation Soft Cell）而著称，这是一项长期针对电信提供商的活动。（引用：Cybereason “Soft Cell” 2019年6月报告）安全研究人员基于所使用的工具以及通常与中国的威胁行为者相关的战术、技术和程序（TTPs），将 [GALLIUM](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0093) 认定为一个很可能隶属于中国国家支持的集团。（引用：Cybereason “Soft Cell” 2019年6月报告）（引用：Microsoft GALLIUM 2019年12月报告）（引用：Unit 42 PingPull 2022年6月报告）

97e7c56893aa0f8b719144bd9386c8688be38e7f.source_text: Adversaries may use an external proxy to act as an intermediary for network communications to a command and control server to avoid direct connections to their infrastructure. Many tools exist that enable traffic redirection through proxies or port redirection, including [HTRAN](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0040), ZXProxy, and ZXPortMap. (Citation: Trend Micro APT Attack Tools) Adversaries use these types of proxies to manage command and control communications, to provide resiliency in the face of connection loss, or to ride over existing trusted communications paths to avoid suspicion. External connection proxies are used to mask the destination of C2 traffic and are typically implemented with port redirectors. Compromised systems outside of the victim environment may be used for these purposes, as well as purchased infrastructure such as cloud-based resources or virtual private servers. Proxies may be chosen based on the low likelihood that a connection to them from a compromised system would be investigated. Victim systems would communicate directly with the external proxy on the Internet and then the proxy would forward communications to the C2 server.
97e7c56893aa0f8b719144bd9386c8688be38e7f.zh: 敌方可能使用外部代理作为中间人来与命令和控制服务器进行网络通信，从而避免直接连接到其基础设施。存在许多支持通过代理或端口重定向转发流量的工具，包括 [HTRAN](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0040)、ZXProxy 和 ZXPortMap。（来源：Trend Micro APT Attack Tools）敌方利用这类代理来管理命令和控制通信，以在连接丢失时提供弹性，或借助已有的可信通信路径以避免引起怀疑。外部连接代理用于掩盖命令和控制流量的目标，通常通过端口重定向器实现。此类用途可利用受害者环境之外的被入侵系统，或利用购买的资源（如基于云的资源或虚拟专用服务器）。由于从被入侵系统连接到这些代理的关联性较低，因此不太可能受到调查。受害者系统会直接与互联网上的外部代理通信，随后该代理会将通信转发至命令和控制服务器。

bb68f303627307e8fa885439dd29b7476f2b38f1.source_text: [GALLIUM](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0093) used a modified version of [HTRAN](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0040) to redirect connections between networks.(Citation: Cybereason Soft Cell June 2019)
bb68f303627307e8fa885439dd29b7476f2b38f1.zh: [GALLIUM](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0093) 使用修改版的 [HTRAN](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0040) 来重定向网络间的连接。(Citation: Cybereason Soft Cell June 2019)

ecdd49bc4e58a198676cf1b8ab15a6b48f2a529e.source_text: [GALLIUM](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0093) dropped additional tools to victims during their operation, including portqry.exe, a renamed cmd.exe file, winrar, and [HTRAN](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0040).(Citation: Cybereason Soft Cell June 2019)(Citation: Microsoft GALLIUM December 2019)
ecdd49bc4e58a198676cf1b8ab15a6b48f2a529e.zh: [GALLIUM](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0093) 在行动期间向受害者投放了其他工具，包括 portqry.exe、一个重命名的 cmd.exe 文件、winrar 以及 [HTRAN](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0040)。(引用: Cybereason Soft Cell June 2019)(引用: Microsoft GALLIUM December 2019)

919db1653b3b443ae4ae9eb3869487ad8174860d.source_text: [APT17](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0025) is a China-based threat group that has conducted network intrusions against U.S. government entities, the defense industry, law firms, information technology companies, mining companies, and non-government organizations. (Citation: FireEye APT17)
919db1653b3b443ae4ae9eb3869487ad8174860d.zh: [APT17](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0025) 是一个基于中国的威胁组织，曾对美国政府的机构、国防工业、律师事务所、信息技术公司、采矿公司和非政府组织实施网络入侵。（引用来源：FireEye APT17）

71dc34501d46bf1593fb2c843a522c0c7580edeb.source_text: [APT3](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0022) is a China-based threat group that researchers have attributed to China's Ministry of State Security.(Citation: FireEye Clandestine Wolf)(Citation: Recorded Future APT3 May 2017) This group is responsible for the campaigns known as Operation Clandestine Fox, Operation Clandestine Wolf, and Operation Double Tap.(Citation: FireEye Clandestine Wolf)(Citation: FireEye Operation Double Tap) As of June 2015, the group appears to have shifted from targeting primarily US victims to primarily political organizations in Hong Kong.(Citation: Symantec Buckeye)
71dc34501d46bf1593fb2c843a522c0c7580edeb.zh: [APT3](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0022) 是一个基于中国的威胁组织，研究人员已将其归因于中国国家安全部。(引用：FireEye Clandestine Wolf)(引用：Recorded Future APT3 May 2017) 该组织负责实施称为“隐秘狐行动”（Operation Clandestine Fox）、“隐秘狼行动”（Operation Clandestine Wolf）和“双重打击行动”（Operation Double Tap）的攻击活动。(引用：FireEye Clandestine Wolf)(引用：FireEye Operation Double Tap) 截至2015年6月，该组织似乎已从主要针对美国受害者转向主要攻击香港的政治组织。(引用：Symantec Buckeye)

3d322667ca21f841489980274c73f84453145c9a.source_text: Adversaries may create multiple stages for command and control that are employed under different conditions or for certain functions. Use of multiple stages may obfuscate the command and control channel to make detection more difficult. Remote access tools will call back to the first-stage command and control server for instructions. The first stage may have automated capabilities to collect basic host information, update tools, and upload additional files. A second remote access tool (RAT) could be uploaded at that point to redirect the host to the second-stage command and control server. The second stage will likely be more fully featured and allow the adversary to interact with the system through a reverse shell and additional RAT features. The different stages will likely be hosted separately with no overlapping infrastructure. The loader may also have backup first-stage callbacks or [Fallback Channels](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1008) in case the original first-stage communication path is discovered and blocked.
3d322667ca21f841489980274c73f84453145c9a.zh: 对手可能创建多个命令与控制（C2）阶段，这些阶段在不同的条件下或用于特定功能时被使用。使用多个阶段可能会模糊命令与控制通道，使得检测更加困难。远程访问工具将回拨到第一阶段的命令与控制服务器以获取指令。第一阶段可能具备自动化的能力，如收集基本的主机信息、更新工具和上传额外文件。此时可以上传第二种远程访问工具（RAT），将主机重定向到第二阶段的命令与控制服务器。第二阶段的功能将更加完善，并允许对手通过反向Shell和附加的RAT功能与系统进行交互。不同的阶段通常会分别托管，且基础设施不重叠。加载器还可能有备用第一阶段回调或[回退信道](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1008)，以防原始的第一阶段通信路径被发现并阻塞。

e1a8bf82c746801f2b38b44bd6e45956a2c1a489.source_text: An [APT3](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0022) downloader first establishes a SOCKS5 connection to 192.157.198[.]103 using TCP port 1913; once the server response is verified, it then requests a connection to 192.184.60[.]229 on TCP port 81.(Citation: FireEye Operation Double Tap)
e1a8bf82c746801f2b38b44bd6e45956a2c1a489.zh: An [APT3](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0022) downloader首先通过TCP端口1913与192.157.198[.]103建立SOCKS5连接；在验证服务器响应后，再通过TCP端口81请求连接到192.184.60[.]229。(引用：FireEye Operation Double Tap)

ff70579b01f7bd82abf96ee69b10ed33911a9d40.source_text: An [APT3](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0022) downloader establishes SOCKS5 connections for its initial C2.(Citation: FireEye Operation Double Tap)
ff70579b01f7bd82abf96ee69b10ed33911a9d40.zh: [APT3](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0022) 下载器为其初始 C2 建立 SOCKS5 连接。(Citation: FireEye Operation Double Tap)

f9394693d29721a8724da8f81e1fe4c8454d5683.source_text: Adversaries may use an OSI non-application layer protocol for communication between host and C2 server or among infected hosts within a network. The list of possible protocols is extensive.(Citation: Wikipedia OSI) Specific examples include use of network layer protocols, such as the Internet Control Message Protocol (ICMP), transport layer protocols, such as the User Datagram Protocol (UDP), session layer protocols, such as Socket Secure (SOCKS), as well as redirected/tunneled protocols, such as Serial over LAN (SOL). ICMP communication between hosts is one example.(Citation: Cisco Synful Knock Evolution) Because ICMP is part of the Internet Protocol Suite, it is required to be implemented by all IP-compatible hosts.(Citation: Microsoft ICMP) However, it is not as commonly monitored as other Internet Protocols such as TCP or UDP and may be used by adversaries to hide communications. In ESXi environments, adversaries may leverage the Virtual Machine Communication Interface (VMCI) for communication between guest virtual machines and the ESXi host. This traffic is similar to client-server communications on traditional network sockets but is localized to the physical machine running the ESXi host, meaning it does not traverse external networks (routers, switches). This results in communications that are invisible to external monitoring and standard networking tools like tcpdump, netstat, nmap, and Wireshark. By adding a VMCI backdoor to a compromised ESXi host, adversaries may persistently regain access from any guest VM to the compromised ESXi host’s backdoor, regardless of network segmentation or firewall rules in place.(Citation: Google Cloud Threat Intelligence VMWare ESXi Zero-Day 2023)
f9394693d29721a8724da8f81e1fe4c8454d5683.zh: 对手可能使用 OSI 非应用层协议在主机与 C2 服务器之间或网络中受感染的主机之间进行通信。可能的协议列表非常广泛。（引用：Wikipedia OSI）具体示例包括使用网络层协议，如互联网控制消息协议（ICMP），传输层协议，如用户数据报协议（UDP），会话层协议，如 Socket Secure (SOCKS)，以及重定向/隧道协议，如 LAN over Serial (SOL)。主机之间的 ICMP 通信就是一个例子。（引用：Cisco Synful Knock Evolution）由于 ICMP 是 Internet Protocol Suite 的一部分，所有 IP 兼容主机都必须实现它。（引用：Microsoft ICMP）然而，与其他 Internet 协议（如 TCP 或 UDP）相比，它的监控较少，对手可能利用它来隐藏通信。在 ESXi 环境中，对手可能会利用虚拟机通信接口 (VMCI) 进行来宾虚拟机和 ESXi 主机之间的通信。这种流量类似于传统网络套接字上的客户端-服务器通信，但仅限于运行 ESXi 主机的物理机器，这意味着它不会穿越外部网络（路由器、交换机）。这导致通信对外部监控以及 tcpdump、netstat、nmap 和 Wireshark 等标准网络工具不可见。通过在受损的 ESXi 主机中添加 VMCI 后门，对手可以持续地从任何来宾虚拟机重新访问受损 ESXi 主机的后门，无论存在何种网络分段或防火墙规则。（引用：Google Cloud Threat Intelligence VMWare ESXi Zero-Day 2023）

6f7b88263271c7e5936a73613d9817cd710ee1a4.source_text: [APT3](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0022) has a tool that can copy files to remote machines.(Citation: FireEye Clandestine Fox)
6f7b88263271c7e5936a73613d9817cd710ee1a4.zh: [APT3](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0022) 拥有一种能够将文件复制到远程计算机的工具。（引用：FireEye Clandestine Fox）

496cf8958c20cea60e476d68b19254448d877806.source_text: [Mustard Tempest](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1020) is an initial access broker that has operated the [SocGholish](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1124) distribution network since at least 2017. [Mustard Tempest](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1020) has partnered with [Indrik Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0119) to provide access for the download of additional malware including LockBit, [WastedLocker](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0612), and remote access tools.(Citation: Microsoft Ransomware as a Service)(Citation: Microsoft Threat Actor Naming July 2023)(Citation: Secureworks Gold Prelude Profile)(Citation: SocGholish-update)
496cf8958c20cea60e476d68b19254448d877806.zh: [Mustard Tempest](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1020) 是一个初始访问中介，自 2017 年以来一直运营 [SocGholish](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1124) 分发网络。[Mustard Tempest](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1020) 与 [Indrik Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0119) 合作，提供下载其他恶意软件（包括 LockBit、[WastedLocker](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0612)）和远程访问工具的访问权限。（引用：Microsoft Ransomware as a Service）（引用：Microsoft Threat Actor Naming July 2023）（引用：Secureworks Gold Prelude Profile）（引用：SocGholish-update）

656ddd541be8a979fde4df69cfb6c722e2c8f4d3.source_text: [Mustard Tempest](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1020) has deployed secondary payloads and third stage implants to compromised hosts.(Citation: Microsoft Ransomware as a Service)
656ddd541be8a979fde4df69cfb6c722e2c8f4d3.zh: [Mustard Tempest](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1020) 已向受感染的计算机部署了辅助有效载荷和第三阶段植入程序。（Citation: Microsoft Ransomware as a Service）

18e1f2da73b2f32dd86578ef446a2b4d742c2f4d.source_text: [GCMAN](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0036) is a threat group that focuses on targeting banks for the purpose of transferring money to e-currency services. (Citation: Securelist GCMAN)
18e1f2da73b2f32dd86578ef446a2b4d742c2f4d.zh: [GCMAN](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0036) 是一个专注于针对银行、以便将资金转移至电子货币服务 Threat Group。（来源：Securelist GCMAN）

27405dda9fc33f2ffc31c0732121b8d88cc7e905.source_text: [Kimsuky](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0094) is a Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK)-based cyber espionage group that has been active since at least 2012. The group initially targeted South Korean government agencies, think tanks, and subject-matter experts in various fields. Its operations expanded to include the United Nations and organizations in the government, education, business services, and manufacturing sectors across the United States, Japan, Russia, and Europe. [Kimsuky](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0094) has focused collection on foreign policy and national security issues tied to the Korean Peninsula, nuclear policy, and sanctions. [Kimsuky](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0094) operations have overlapped with those of other North Korean state-sponsored cyber espionage actors as a result of ad hoc collaborations or other limited resource sharing.(Citation: EST Kimsuky April 2019)(Citation: Cybereason Kimsuky November 2020)(Citation: Malwarebytes Kimsuky June 2021)(Citation: CISA AA20-301A Kimsuky)(Citation: Mandiant APT43 March 2024)(Citation: Proofpoint TA427 April 2024) [Kimsuky](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0094) was assessed to be responsible for the 2014 Korea Hydro & Nuclear Power Co. compromise; other notable campaigns include Operation STOLEN PENCIL (2018), Operation Kabar Cobra (2019), and Operation Smoke Screen (2019).(Citation: Netscout Stolen Pencil Dec 2018)(Citation: EST Kimsuky SmokeScreen April 2019)(Citation: AhnLab Kimsuky Kabar Cobra Feb 2019) In 2023, [Kimsuky](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0094) was observed using commercial large language models (LLMs) to assist with vulnerability research, scripting, social engineering and reconnaissance.(Citation: MSFT-AI) DPRK threat actor cluster boundaries overlap in open source reporting, with some security researchers consolidating all attributed North Korean state-sponsored cyber activity under [Lazarus Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0032), rather than tracking operationally distinct subgroups.
27405dda9fc33f2ffc31c0732121b8d88cc7e905.zh: [金苏克](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0094)是一个基于朝鲜民主主义人民共和国（DPRK）的网络间谍组织，自2012年以来一直活跃。该组织最初针对韩国政府机构、智库以及各个领域的主题专家。其行动范围扩展到联合国以及在政府、教育、商业服务和制造部门中的组织，涉及美国、日本、俄罗斯和欧洲。[金苏克](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0094)重点关注与朝鲜半岛、核政策和制裁相关的外交政策和国家安全问题。(引用: EST 金苏克 2019年4月)(引用: Cybereason 金苏克 2020年11月)(引用: Malwarebytes 金苏克 2021年6月)(引用: CISA AA20-301A 金苏克)(引用: Mandiant APT43 2024年3月)(引用: Proofpoint TA427 2024年4月) [金苏克](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0094)被认为对2014年韩国水力与核电公司被入侵事件负责；其他值得注意的活动包括“被盗铅笔”行动（2018）、“卡巴尔眼镜蛇”行动（2019）和“烟幕屏”行动（2019）。(引用: Netscout 被盗铅笔 2018年12月)(引用: EST 金苏克 烟幕屏 2019年4月)(引用: AhnLab 金苏克 卡巴尔眼镜蛇 2019年2月) 在2023年，观察到[金苏克](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0094)使用商业大型语言模型（LLMs）来协助漏洞研究、脚本编写、社交工程及侦察工作。(引用: MSFT-AI) 在北约源报告中，威胁行为者集群边界存在重叠，部分安全研究人员将所有归因于朝鲜国家赞助的网络活动整合到[ Lazarus Group ](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0032)，而不是追踪操作性不同的子群组。

1b18af7bc9c24df801030fc6a4acc1efe147c722.source_text: [Kimsuky](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0094) has downloaded additional scripts, tools, and malware onto victim systems.(Citation: Talos Kimsuky Nov 2021)(Citation: Crowdstrike GTR2020 Mar 2020)(Citation: Securonix Kimsuky February 2025)(Citation: Aryaka Kimsuky July 2025)
1b18af7bc9c24df801030fc6a4acc1efe147c722.zh: [Kimsuky](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0094) 已在受害者系统中下载了额外的脚本、工具和恶意软件。(Citation: Talos Kimsuky Nov 2021)(Citation: Crowdstrike GTR2020 Mar 2020)(Citation: Securonix Kimsuky February 2025)(Citation: Aryaka Kimsuky July 2025)

128a0fa35b10e866267a721e8b74c2d5a8038c59.source_text: Adversaries may use an existing, legitimate external Web service as a means for sending commands to and receiving output from a compromised system over the Web service channel. Compromised systems may leverage popular websites and social media to host command and control (C2) instructions. Those infected systems can then send the output from those commands back over that Web service channel. The return traffic may occur in a variety of ways, depending on the Web service being utilized. For example, the return traffic may take the form of the compromised system posting a comment on a forum, issuing a pull request to development project, updating a document hosted on a Web service, or by sending a Tweet. Popular websites and social media acting as a mechanism for C2 may give a significant amount of cover due to the likelihood that hosts within a network are already communicating with them prior to a compromise. Using common services, such as those offered by Google or Twitter, makes it easier for adversaries to hide in expected noise. Web service providers commonly use SSL/TLS encryption, giving adversaries an added level of protection.
128a0fa35b10e866267a721e8b74c2d5a8038c59.zh: adversaries may leverage an existing, legitimate external web service as a means for sending commands to and receiving output from a compromised system over the web service channel. Compromised systems may use popular websites and social media platforms to host command and control (c2) instructions. Once infected, these systems can send the results of those commands back through the same web service channel. The return traffic may take various forms depending on the specific web service being used. For instance, the return traffic might appear as a comment posted by the compromised system on a forum, a pull request submitted to a development project, an update to a document hosted on a web service, or a tweet sent via twitter. Popular websites and social media platforms acting as c2 mechanisms can provide significant cover due to the likelihood that hosts within a network are already communicating with them before compromise occurs. Leveraging common services such as those offered by google or twitter enables adversaries to blend into expected network noise more easily. Web service providers typically employ ssl/tls encryption, providing adversaries with an additional layer of protection.

61a742eb6dcc8e60603a0ef629b9b36ceb535f86.source_text: [Kimsuky](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0094) has used Blogspot pages and a Github repository for C2.(Citation: Talos Kimsuky Nov 2021)(Citation: Zscaler Kimsuky TRANSLATEXT) [Kimsuky](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0094) has also leveraged Dropbox for downloading payloads and uploading victim system information.(Citation: Securonix Kimsuky February 2025)
61a742eb6dcc8e60603a0ef629b9b36ceb535f86.zh: [Kimsuky](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0094) 使用 Blogspot 页面和 GitHub 仓库作为 C2。（来源：Talos Kimsuky Nov 2021）（来源：Zscaler Kimsuky TRANSLATEXT）[Kimsuky](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0094) 还利用 Dropbox 下载有效载荷并上传受害者系统信息。（来源：Securonix Kimsuky February 2025）

c79623c4653cf4557b2654028a31f6970470ac33.source_text: An adversary may use legitimate desktop support software to establish an interactive command and control channel to target systems within networks. Desktop support software provides a graphical interface for remotely controlling another computer, transmitting the display output, keyboard input, and mouse control between devices using various protocols. Desktop support software, such as `VNC`, `Team Viewer`, `AnyDesk`, `ScreenConnect`, `LogMein`, `AmmyyAdmin`, and other remote monitoring and management (RMM) tools, are commonly used as legitimate technical support software and may be allowed by application control within a target environment.(Citation: Symantec Living off the Land)(Citation: CrowdStrike 2015 Global Threat Report)(Citation: CrySyS Blog TeamSpy) Remote access modules/features may also exist as part of otherwise existing software such as Zoom or Google Chrome’s Remote Desktop.(Citation: Google Chrome Remote Desktop)(Citation: Chrome Remote Desktop)
c79623c4653cf4557b2654028a31f6970470ac33.zh: 攻击者可以使用合法的桌面支持软件在目标系统内建立交互式命令与控制通道。桌面支持软件提供图形界面，用于远程控制另一台计算机，并通过各种协议在设备之间传输显示输出、键盘输入和鼠标控制。`VNC`、`Team Viewer`、`AnyDesk`、`ScreenConnect`、`LogMein`、`AmmyyAdmin` 以及其他远程监控和管理 (RMM) 工具通常被用作合法的技术支持软件，并可能被目标环境中的应用程序控制允许使用。(引用: Symantec Living off the Land)(引用: CrowdStrike 2015 Global Threat Report)(引用: CrySyS Blog TeamSpy) 远程访问模块/功能也可能作为现有软件的一部分存在，例如 Zoom 或 Google Chrome 的 Remote Desktop。(引用: Google Chrome Remote Desktop)(引用: Chrome Remote Desktop)

e9603c5bf4afd12b860b1485c408191f9b555b93.source_text: [Kimsuky](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0094) has used a modified TeamViewer client as a command and control channel.(Citation: Securelist Kimsuky Sept 2013)(Citation: Crowdstrike GTR2020 Mar 2020)
e9603c5bf4afd12b860b1485c408191f9b555b93.zh: [Kimsuky](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0094) 曾使用经过修改的 TeamViewer 客户端作为命令与控制通道。(引用: Securelist Kimsuky Sept 2013)(引用: Crowdstrike GTR2020 Mar 2020)

f900002a0dc90a9d7d60445042bf7892c8b8d9aa.source_text: [Kimsuky](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0094) has used HTTP GET and POST requests for C2.(Citation: Talos Kimsuky Nov 2021)(Citation: Aryaka Kimsuky July 2025)
f900002a0dc90a9d7d60445042bf7892c8b8d9aa.zh: [Kimsuky](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0094) 曾使用 HTTP GET 和 POST 请求进行C2通信。(引用：Talos Kimsuky Nov 2021)(引用：Aryaka Kimsuky July 2025)

cc304c9f45b7b909c80f1a697f73a229359d3197.source_text: Adversaries may dynamically establish connections to command and control infrastructure to evade common detections and remediations. This may be achieved by using malware that shares a common algorithm with the infrastructure the adversary uses to receive the malware's communications. These calculations can be used to dynamically adjust parameters such as the domain name, IP address, or port number the malware uses for command and control. Adversaries may use dynamic resolution for the purpose of [Fallback Channels](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1008). When contact is lost with the primary command and control server malware may employ dynamic resolution as a means to reestablishing command and control.(Citation: Talos CCleanup 2017)(Citation: FireEye POSHSPY April 2017)(Citation: ESET Sednit 2017 Activity)
cc304c9f45b7b909c80f1a697f73a229359d3197.zh: 对手可能动态建立与指挥和控制（C2）基础设施的连接，以规避常见的检测和修复措施。这可以通过使用与对手用于接收恶意软件通信的基础设施共享通用算法的恶意软件来实现。这些计算可用于动态调整恶意软件用于指挥和控制的参数，如域名、IP 地址或端口号。对手可能出于[备用通道](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1008)的目的使用动态解析。当与主指挥和控制服务器的连接丢失时，恶意软件可能会采用动态解析作为重新建立指挥和控制的手段。(Citation: Talos CCleanup 2017)(Citation: FireEye POSHSPY April 2017)(Citation: ESET Sednit 2017 Activity)

c1377918fb24d5727df5c6efc8f150ba88fc29a3.source_text: [Kimsuky](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0094) has used Dynamic DNS (DDNS) services, such as FreeDNS or No-IP DDNS, to include servers located in South Korea.(Citation: NaumaanProofpoint_GlobalClickFix_April2025)
c1377918fb24d5727df5c6efc8f150ba88fc29a3.zh: [Kimsuky](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0094) 曾使用动态域名系统（DDNS）服务，如 FreeDNS 或 No-IP DDNS，以包含位于韩国的服务器。（引用：NaumaanProofpoint_GlobalClickFix_April2025）

30fd1df8602cc2ced58c57f7149253f4a7e6eca7.source_text: Adversaries may communicate using application layer protocols associated with electronic mail delivery to avoid detection/network filtering by blending in with existing traffic. Commands to the remote system, and often the results of those commands, will be embedded within the protocol traffic between the client and server. Protocols such as SMTP/S, POP3/S, and IMAP that carry electronic mail may be very common in environments. Packets produced from these protocols may have many fields and headers in which data can be concealed. Data could also be concealed within the email messages themselves. An adversary may abuse these protocols to communicate with systems under their control within a victim network while also mimicking normal, expected traffic.(Citation: FireEye APT28)
30fd1df8602cc2ced58c57f7149253f4a7e6eca7.zh: adversaries may communicate using application layer protocols associated with electronic mail delivery to avoid detection/network filtering by blending in with existing traffic. commands to the remote system, and often the results of those commands, will be embedded within the protocol traffic between the client and server. protocols such as smtp/s, pop3/s, and imap that carry electronic mail may be very common in environments. packets produced from these protocols may have many fields and headers in which data can be concealed. data could also be concealed within the email messages themselves. an adversary may abuse these protocols to communicate with systems under their control within a victim network while also mimicking normal, expected traffic.(citation: fireeye apt28)

2f633cae58cd95164a15f96272a2a882884865e9.source_text: [Kimsuky](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0094) has used e-mail to send exfiltrated data to C2 servers.(Citation: CISA AA20-301A Kimsuky)
2f633cae58cd95164a15f96272a2a882884865e9.zh: [Kimsuky](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0094) 曾使用电子邮件将窃取的数据发送到 C2 服务器。(Citation: CISA AA20-301A Kimsuky)

a32f651bd69ed28bb81bf0c64524abfc8aebc1ba.source_text: Adversaries may use an existing, legitimate external Web service to host information that points to additional command and control (C2) infrastructure. Adversaries may post content, known as a dead drop resolver, on Web services with embedded (and often obfuscated/encoded) domains or IP addresses. Once infected, victims will reach out to and be redirected by these resolvers. Popular websites and social media acting as a mechanism for C2 may give a significant amount of cover due to the likelihood that hosts within a network are already communicating with them prior to a compromise. Using common services, such as those offered by Google or Twitter, makes it easier for adversaries to hide in expected noise. Web service providers commonly use SSL/TLS encryption, giving adversaries an added level of protection. Use of a dead drop resolver may also protect back-end C2 infrastructure from discovery through malware binary analysis while also enabling operational resiliency (since this infrastructure may be dynamically changed).
a32f651bd69ed28bb81bf0c64524abfc8aebc1ba.zh: 对手可能利用一个现有的、合法的外部 Web 服务来托管指向额外命令与控制（C2）基础设施的信息。对手可能在具有嵌入（且通常被混淆/编码）的域名或 IP 地址的 Web 服务上发布内容，称为“死投递解析器”（dead drop resolver）。一旦系统被感染，受害方将与这些解析器联系并被重定向。作为 C2 机制使用的流行网站和社交媒体可能提供大量的掩护，因为在受到攻击之前，网络内的主机很可能已经在与它们通信。使用常见服务（例如由 Google 或 Twitter 提供的服务），使对手更容易隐藏在预期的流量噪音中。Web 服务提供商通常使用 SSL/TLS 加密，为对手提供了额外的保护层。使用死投递解析器还可以保护后端 C2 基础设施免遭通过恶意软件二进制分析发现，同时实现操作的弹性（因为这些基础设施可以被动态更改）。

829c3949d2b7889d7e452b841dcc9ead1bb9491e.source_text: [Kimsuky](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0094) has used [TRANSLATEXT](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1201) and a dead drop resolver to retrieve configurations and commands from a public blog site.(Citation: Zscaler Kimsuky TRANSLATEXT)
829c3949d2b7889d7e452b841dcc9ead1bb9491e.zh: [Kimsuky](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0094) 使用了 [TRANSLATEXT](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1201) 和死投递解析器，从公共博客站点检索配置和命令。（引用：Zscaler Kimsuky TRANSLATEXT）

ab80663c9dd4e73981daee33df0eefb476bd3e0d.source_text: Adversaries may encode data with a non-standard data encoding system to make the content of command and control traffic more difficult to detect. Command and control (C2) information can be encoded using a non-standard data encoding system that diverges from existing protocol specifications. Non-standard data encoding schemes may be based on or related to standard data encoding schemes, such as a modified Base64 encoding for the message body of an HTTP request.(Citation: Wikipedia Binary-to-text Encoding)(Citation: Wikipedia Character Encoding)
ab80663c9dd4e73981daee33df0eefb476bd3e0d.zh: 对抗者可能会使用非标准数据编码系统对数据进行编码，使得命令和控制（C2）流量的内容更难以被检测。命令与控制（C2）信息可以使用不符合现有协议规范的非标准数据编码系统进行编码。非标准数据编码方案可能基于或与标准数据编码方案相关，例如对 HTTP 请求正文的 Base64 编码进行修改。（来源：Wikipedia Binary-to-text Encoding）（来源：Wikipedia Character Encoding）

28354e37c624ef486abd350c75f2e8cf2d0dea45.source_text: [Kimsuky](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0094) has obfuscated HTTP Post request communications utilizing XOR with a designated key, followed by Base64 encoding.(Citation: Gen Digital Kimsuky HTTPTroy October 2025)
28354e37c624ef486abd350c75f2e8cf2d0dea45.zh: [Kimsuky](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0094) 使用与指定密钥进行异或（XOR）操作后，再进行 Base64 编码的方式对 HTTP Post 请求通信进行了混淆。(Citation: Gen Digital Kimsuky HTTPTroy October 2025)

ac50a5afd780f2a85de25a53b0b978411c84e2ff.source_text: Adversaries may communicate using application layer protocols associated with transferring files to avoid detection/network filtering by blending in with existing traffic. Commands to the remote system, and often the results of those commands, will be embedded within the protocol traffic between the client and server. Protocols such as SMB(Citation: US-CERT TA18-074A), FTP(Citation: ESET Machete July 2019), FTPS, and TFTP that transfer files may be very common in environments. Packets produced from these protocols may have many fields and headers in which data can be concealed. Data could also be concealed within the transferred files. An adversary may abuse these protocols to communicate with systems under their control within a victim network while also mimicking normal, expected traffic.
ac50a5afd780f2a85de25a53b0b978411c84e2ff.zh: adversaries may use application-layer protocols commonly associated with file transfer to blend in with existing traffic and thereby evade detection or network filtering. Commands sent to the remote system, as well as typically the results of those commands, are embedded within the protocol traffic exchanged between the client and server. Protocols such as SMB(Citation: US-CERT TA18-074A), FTP(Citation: ESET Machete July 2019), FTPS, and TFTP, which are used for file transfer, may be very common in environments. Packets generated by these protocols can contain numerous fields and headers that can be used to conceal data. Additionally, data may be hidden within the transferred files themselves. Adversaries may abuse these protocols to communicate with systems under their control within a victim’s network while simultaneously mimicking normal, expected traffic.

37a265f87a917b292c2c23f9d5361b8c49d6408b.source_text: [Kimsuky](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0094) has used FTP to download additional malware to the target machine.(Citation: VirusBulletin Kimsuky October 2019)
37a265f87a917b292c2c23f9d5361b8c49d6408b.zh: [Kimsuky](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0094) 使用 FTP 将其他恶意软件下载到目标机器上。（引用：VirusBulletin Kimsuky October 2019）

af7375fc6e01f03c8c404ff35fbbb7f3895f9f0f.source_text: Adversaries may use traffic signaling to hide open ports or other malicious functionality used for persistence or command and control. Traffic signaling involves the use of a magic value or sequence that must be sent to a system to trigger a special response, such as opening a closed port or executing a malicious task. This may take the form of sending a series of packets with certain characteristics before a port will be opened that the adversary can use for command and control. Usually this series of packets consists of attempted connections to a predefined sequence of closed ports (i.e. [Port Knocking](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1205/001)), but can involve unusual flags, specific strings, or other unique characteristics. After the sequence is completed, opening a port may be accomplished by the host-based firewall, but could also be implemented by custom software. Adversaries may also communicate with an already open port, but the service listening on that port will only respond to commands or trigger other malicious functionality if passed the appropriate magic value(s). The observation of the signal packets to trigger the communication can be conducted through different methods. One means, originally implemented by Cd00r (Citation: Hartrell cd00r 2002), is to use the libpcap libraries to sniff for the packets in question. Another method leverages raw sockets, which enables the malware to use ports that are already open for use by other programs. On network devices, adversaries may use crafted packets to enable [Network Device Authentication](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1556/004) for standard services offered by the device such as telnet. Such signaling may also be used to open a closed service port such as telnet, or to trigger module modification of malware implants on the device, adding, removing, or changing malicious capabilities. Adversaries may use crafted packets to attempt to connect to one or more (open or closed) ports, but may also attempt to connect to a router interface, broadcast, and network address IP on the same port in order to achieve their goals and objectives.(Citation: Cisco Synful Knock Evolution)(Citation: Mandiant - Synful Knock)(Citation: Cisco Blog Legacy Device Attacks) To enable this traffic signaling on embedded devices, adversaries must first achieve and leverage [Patch System Image](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1601/001) due to the monolithic nature of the architecture. Adversaries may also use the Wake-on-LAN feature to turn on powered off systems. Wake-on-LAN is a hardware feature that allows a powered down system to be powered on, or woken up, by sending a magic packet to it. Once the system is powered on, it may become a target for lateral movement.(Citation: Bleeping Computer - Ryuk WoL)(Citation: AMD Magic Packet)
af7375fc6e01f03c8c404ff35fbbb7f3895f9f0f.zh:
对手可能利用流量信令来隐藏用于持久化或命令与控制功能的开放端口或其他恶意功能。流量信令涉及使用必须发送至系统以触发特殊响应的魔法值（magic value）或序列，例如打开一个关闭的端口或执行恶意任务。这可以通过在某个端口被打开以便对手用于命令与控制之前，发送具有某些特定特征的一系列数据包来实现。通常，这一系列数据包包括尝试连接到预定义序列中的多个关闭端口（即[端口敲门法](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1205/001)），但也可能涉及非常规的标志位、特定字符串或其他独特特征。完成该序列后，端口的打开可以由基于主机的防火墙实现，也可以通过自定义软件来实现。对手还可能与已经开放的端口进行通信，但监听该端口的服务仅在接收到适当的魔法值时才会响应命令或触发其他恶意功能。

观察触发通信的信号数据包可以通过不同的方法进行。一种最初由Cd00r实现的方法是，使用libpcap库来嗅探目标数据包。(Citation: Hartrell cd00r 2002) 另一种方法则利用原始套接字（raw sockets），使恶意软件能够使用已被其他程序使用的已开放端口。在网络设备上，对手可能使用精心构造的数据包来启用网络设备的标准服务（如telnet）的[网络设备认证](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1556/004)。此类信令也可用于打开像telnet这样的关闭服务端口，或在设备上的恶意植入物中触发热模块修改，从而添加、移除或更改恶意能力。对手可以使用精心构造的数据包尝试连接到一个或多个（开放或关闭的）端口，但也可能尝试连接到同一端口上的路由器接口、广播地址和IP网络地址，以实现其目标和目的。(Citation: Cisco Synful Knock Evolution)(Citation: Mandiant - Synful Knock)(Citation: Cisco Blog Legacy Device Attacks)

为了在嵌入式设备上启用此类流量信令，对手必须首先获得并利用[修补系统镜像](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1601/001)，这是由于该架构具有单体性质。对手还可以使用受管唤醒（Wake-on-LAN）功能来启动处于关机状态的系统。受管唤醒是一项硬件功能，允许通过向关机系统发送魔术数据包来将其通电或唤醒。一旦系统被启动，它就可能成为横向移动的目标。(Citation: Bleeping Computer - Ryuk WoL)(Citation: AMD Magic Packet)

a03cccf97cc5ee6be13bbef763485f29e0ebbeb0.source_text: [Kimsuky](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0094) has used [TRANSLATEXT](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1201) to redirect clients to legitimate Gmail, Naver or Kakao pages if the clients connect with no parameters.(Citation: Zscaler Kimsuky TRANSLATEXT)
a03cccf97cc5ee6be13bbef763485f29e0ebbeb0.zh: [Kimsuky](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0094) 已使用 [TRANSLATEXT](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1201) 将未附带参数的客户端重定向至合法的 Gmail、Naver 或 Kakao 页面。（出处：Zscaler Kimsuky TRANSLATEXT）

9e24355690be63a885bea9797d6250585c65fc74.source_text: [EXOTIC LILY](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1011) is a financially motivated group that has been closely linked with [Wizard Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0102) and the deployment of ransomware including [Conti](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0575) and [Diavol](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0659). [EXOTIC LILY](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1011) may be acting as an initial access broker for other malicious actors, and has targeted a wide range of industries including IT, cybersecurity, and healthcare since at least September 2021.(Citation: Google EXOTIC LILY March 2022)
9e24355690be63a885bea9797d6250585c65fc74.zh: [EXOTIC LILY](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1011) 是一个以经济利益为动机的黑客组织，与 [Wizard Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0102) 关系密切，并参与部署了包括 [Conti](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0575) 和 [Diavol](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0659) 在内的勒索软件。自 2021 年 9 月以来，[EXOTIC LILY](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1011) 可能作为初始访问代理（initial access broker）服务于其他恶意行为者，针对信息技术、网络安全和医疗保健等多个行业进行了攻击。(Citation: Google EXOTIC LILY March 2022)

eb0c2405198957b51f57e221666bc5f2cc7e8513.source_text: Adversaries may use an existing, legitimate external Web service as a means for relaying data to/from a compromised system. Popular websites, cloud services, and social media acting as a mechanism for C2 may give a significant amount of cover due to the likelihood that hosts within a network are already communicating with them prior to a compromise. Using common services, such as those offered by Google, Microsoft, or Twitter, makes it easier for adversaries to hide in expected noise.(Citation: Broadcom BirdyClient Microsoft Graph API 2024) Web service providers commonly use SSL/TLS encryption, giving adversaries an added level of protection. Use of Web services may also protect back-end C2 infrastructure from discovery through malware binary analysis while also enabling operational resiliency (since this infrastructure may be dynamically changed).
eb0c2405198957b51f57e221666bc5f2cc7e8513.zh: adversary 可能利用现有的合法外部 Web 服务作为中继数据到/从被入侵系统的手段。流行网站、云服务和社交媒体作为 C2 机制，由于在遭受入侵之前网络中的主机很可能已经与这些服务进行通信，因此可以为攻击者提供大量的掩护。使用常见服务，如 Google、Microsoft 或 Twitter 提供的服务，使得攻击者更容易隐藏在预期的噪声中。（来源：Broadcom BirdyClient Microsoft Graph API 2024）Web 服务提供商通常使用 SSL/TLS 加密，这为攻击者提供了额外的保护级别。使用 Web 服务还可以通过对恶意软件二进制分析防止后端 C2 基础设施被发现，同时实现运营弹性（因为该基础设施可能会动态更改）。

aceca5b0877302b64868bad13326dcce36cd1844.source_text: [EXOTIC LILY](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1011) has used file-sharing services including WeTransfer, TransferNow, and OneDrive to deliver payloads.(Citation: Google EXOTIC LILY March 2022)
aceca5b0877302b64868bad13326dcce36cd1844.zh: [EXOTIC LILY](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1011) 曾使用包括 WeTransfer、TransferNow 和 OneDrive 在内的文件共享服务来投放有效载荷。（出处：Google EXOTIC LILY March 2022）

84ef41106386632732a4abbc3c4c5e957336f9a8.source_text: [TA577](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1037) is an initial access broker (IAB) that has distributed [QakBot](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0650) and [Pikabot](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1145), and was among the first observed groups distributing [Latrodectus](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1160) in 2023.(Citation: Latrodectus APR 2024)
84ef41106386632732a4abbc3c4c5e957336f9a8.zh: [TA577](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1037) 是一个初始访问代理（IAB），曾分发 [QakBot](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0650) 和 [Pikabot](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1145)，并在2023年是首批被观察到分发 [Latrodectus](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1160) 的群体之一。(Citation: Latrodectus APR 2024)

07b2e1952b41e2fd4f1c17c7702cdbcce46e3d9d.source_text: [AppleJeus](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1049) is a North Korean state-sponsored threat group attributed to the Reconnaissance General Bureau. Associated with the broader [Lazarus Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0032) umbrella of actors, [AppleJeus](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1049) has been active since at least 2018 and is closely aligned in resources with TEMP.hermit, another DPRK-affiliated group under the same umbrella.(Citation: dtex DPRK 2025 structure ITworkers) The group’s primary mission is to generate and launder revenue to provide financial support to the government. [AppleJeus](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1049) primarily targets the cryptocurrency industry and is most notably responsible for the [3CX Supply Chain Attack](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0057).(Citation: Mandiant 3cx UNC4736 2023) The group traditionally deploys malicious cryptocurrency software in combination with [Phishing](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1566). From these compromised environments, it selectively deploys additional backdoors to enable extended operations against high-value financial targets.(Citation: Mandiant DPRK Groups 2023)(Citation: JPCert Blog Laz Subgroups 2025)
07b2e1952b41e2fd4f1c17c7702cdbcce46e3d9d.zh: [AppleJeus](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1049) 是一个隶属于朝鲜侦察总局的朝鲜国家支持威胁组织。与更广泛的 [Lazarus Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0032) 行为体群 umbrella 相关联，[AppleJeus](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1049) 自至少 2018 年起一直活跃，并且在与同一 umbrella 下的另一朝鲜关联组织 TEMP.hermit 在资源上紧密对齐。(Citation: dtex DPRK 2025 structure ITworkers) 该组织的主要任务是生成和洗钱收入，以为政府提供财政支持。[AppleJeus](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1049) 主要瞄准加密货币行业，最著名的是对 [3CX 供应链攻击](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0057) 负责。(Citation: Mandiant 3cx UNC4736 2023) 该组织传统上使用恶意加密货币软件结合 [Phishing](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1566) 进行部署。从这些被入侵的环境中，它有针对性地部署额外的后门以扩展针对高价值金融目标的行动。(Citation: Mandiant DPRK Groups 2023)(Citation: JPCert Blog Laz Subgroups 2025)

7d14dd650c3caa86debdb2c1ffde22b151073b41.source_text: [admin@338](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0018) is a China-based cyber threat group. It has previously used newsworthy events as lures to deliver malware and has primarily targeted organizations involved in financial, economic, and trade policy, typically using publicly available RATs such as [PoisonIvy](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0012), as well as some non-public backdoors. (Citation: FireEye admin@338)
7d14dd650c3caa86debdb2c1ffde22b151073b41.zh: [admin@338](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0018) 是一个位于中国的网络威胁组织。该组织曾利用备受关注的新闻事件作为诱饵投放恶意软件，并主要针对参与金融、经济及贸易政策的相关机构，通常使用公开可用的远程访问木马（RAT），例如 [PoisonIvy](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0012)，以及部分非公开的远程控制后门程序。(Citation: FireEye admin@338)

d2927e3232d0cc5fa573a289c6e835ef20ce4eb3.source_text: [Volt Typhoon](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1017) is a People's Republic of China (PRC) state-sponsored actor that has been active since at least 2021, primarily targeting critical infrastructure organizations in the US and its territories including Guam. [Volt Typhoon](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1017)'s targeting and pattern of behavior have been assessed as pre-positioning to enable lateral movement to operational technology (OT) assets for potential destructive or disruptive attacks. [Volt Typhoon](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1017) has emphasized stealth in operations using web shells, living-off-the-land (LOTL) binaries, hands on keyboard activities, and stolen credentials.(Citation: CISA AA24-038A PRC Critical Infrastructure February 2024)(Citation: Microsoft Volt Typhoon May 2023)(Citation: Joint Cybersecurity Advisory Volt Typhoon June 2023)(Citation: Secureworks BRONZE SILHOUETTE May 2023). The group has leveraged compromised SOHO routers to proxy command and control traffic and obscure its infrastructure, activity associated with the KV botnet.(Citation: DOJ KVBotnet 2024). Reporting indicates a separate initial access cluster, SYLVANITE, has been observed exploiting internet-facing edge devices and transferring access to [Volt Typhoon](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1017), also tracked as VOLTZITE, for follow-on operations. (Citation: Dragos 2025 Year in Review)
d2927e3232d0cc5fa573a289c6e835ef20ce4eb3.zh: [Volt Typhoon](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1017)是一个中华人民共和国（PRC）国家支持的行为体，自至少2021年以来一直活跃，主要针对美国及其领土（包括关岛）的关键基础设施组织。[Volt Typhoon](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1017)的定向攻击和行为模式被评估为预置行动，以实现向运营技术（OT）资产的水平移动，从而可能发动破坏性或干扰性攻击。[Volt Typhoon](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1017)在行动中强调隐蔽性，使用了Web Shell、“利用现有工具”（LOTL）二进制文件、键盘操作活动以及被盗凭据。(Citation: CISA AA24-038A PRC Critical Infrastructure February 2024)(Citation: Microsoft Volt Typhoon May 2023)(Citation: Joint Cybersecurity Advisory Volt Typhoon June 2023)(Citation: Secureworks BRONZE SILHOUETTE May 2023)。该团伙利用被入侵的家庭办公路由器代理命令与控制流量，并掩盖其基础架构，此类活动与KV僵尸网络相关。(Citation: DOJ KVBotnet 2024)。报道显示，一个独立的初始访问集群SYLVANITE被发现利用面向互联网的边缘设备，并将对[Volt Typhoon](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1017)（也被跟踪为VOLTZITE）的访问权转移用于后续行动。(Citation: Dragos 2025 Year in Review)

5bcf9c9bfaec476b42ad5f4e3ddbfb1af1fbc6de.source_text: Adversaries may use a connection proxy to direct network traffic between systems or act as an intermediary for network communications to a command and control server to avoid direct connections to their infrastructure. Many tools exist that enable traffic redirection through proxies or port redirection, including [HTRAN](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0040), ZXProxy, and ZXPortMap. (Citation: Trend Micro APT Attack Tools) Adversaries use these types of proxies to manage command and control communications, reduce the number of simultaneous outbound network connections, provide resiliency in the face of connection loss, or to ride over existing trusted communications paths between victims to avoid suspicion. Adversaries may chain together multiple proxies to further disguise the source of malicious traffic. Adversaries can also take advantage of routing schemes in Content Delivery Networks (CDNs) to proxy command and control traffic.
5bcf9c9bfaec476b42ad5f4e3ddbfb1af1fbc6de.zh: 对手可能使用连接代理来引导系统之间的网络流量，或作为到命令与控制服务器的网络通信的中间人，从而避免与其基础设施建立直接连接。存在许多工具，可通过代理或端口重定向启用流量重定向，包括 [HTRAN](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0040)、ZXProxy 和 ZXPortMap。（引用：Trend Micro APT Attack Tools）对手使用这些类型的代理来管理命令与控制通信、减少同时发出的外部网络连接数量、在连接丢失时提供韧性，或利用受害方之间现有的可信通信路径以避免引起怀疑。对手可能会串联多个代理，以进一步掩盖恶意流量的来源。对手还可以利用内容分发网络（CDN）中的路由方案来代理命令与控制流量。

0eb826247db3400d18e4ea024c3332cb8a3ec7f1.source_text: [Volt Typhoon](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1017) has used compromised devices and customized versions of open source tools such as [FRP](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1144) (Fast Reverse Proxy), Earthworm, and [Impacket](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0357) to proxy network traffic.(Citation: Microsoft Volt Typhoon May 2023)(Citation: Joint Cybersecurity Advisory Volt Typhoon June 2023)(Citation: CISA AA24-038A PRC Critical Infrastructure February 2024)
0eb826247db3400d18e4ea024c3332cb8a3ec7f1.zh: [Volt Typhoon](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1017) 已使用被入侵的设备以及自定义版本的开源工具（如 [FRP](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1144)（Fast Reverse Proxy）、Earthworm 和 [Impacket](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0357)）来代理网络流量。（来源：Microsoft Volt Typhoon 2023年5月）（来源：联合网络安全警报 Volt Typhoon 2023年6月）（来源：CISA AA24-038A 中国关键基础设施 2024年2月）

44d13626c5a128e33b33a4e5d13e27beb6cb83e8.source_text: Adversaries may employ a known symmetric encryption algorithm to conceal command and control traffic rather than relying on any inherent protections provided by a communication protocol. Symmetric encryption algorithms use the same key for plaintext encryption and ciphertext decryption. Common symmetric encryption algorithms include AES, DES, 3DES, Blowfish, and RC4.
44d13626c5a128e33b33a4e5d13e27beb6cb83e8.zh: 对抗者可能使用已知的对称加密算法来隐藏命令与控制（C2）流量，而不是依赖通信协议本身提供的任何保护。对称加密算法使用相同的密钥进行明文加密和密文解密。常见的对称加密算法包括AES、DES、3DES、Blowfish和RC4。

c4ca64382b6f246e10bbf5bd356d7a679e0f30f7.source_text: [Volt Typhoon](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1017) has used a version of the Awen web shell that employed AES encryption and decryption for C2 communications.(Citation: Secureworks BRONZE SILHOUETTE May 2023)
c4ca64382b6f246e10bbf5bd356d7a679e0f30f7.zh: [Volt Typhoon](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1017) 曾使用一个版本的 Awen Webshell，该版本在 C2 通信中采用了 AES 加密和解密技术。(Citation: Secureworks BRONZE SILHOUETTE May 2023)

6bfb91f0c4b84fa4b3df694124351d40ba92fc94.source_text: Adversaries may use an internal proxy to direct command and control traffic between two or more systems in a compromised environment. Many tools exist that enable traffic redirection through proxies or port redirection, including [HTRAN](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0040), ZXProxy, and ZXPortMap. (Citation: Trend Micro APT Attack Tools) Adversaries use internal proxies to manage command and control communications inside a compromised environment, to reduce the number of simultaneous outbound network connections, to provide resiliency in the face of connection loss, or to ride over existing trusted communications paths between infected systems to avoid suspicion. Internal proxy connections may use common peer-to-peer (p2p) networking protocols, such as SMB, to better blend in with the environment. By using a compromised internal system as a proxy, adversaries may conceal the true destination of C2 traffic while reducing the need for numerous connections to external systems.
6bfb91f0c4b84fa4b3df694124351d40ba92fc94.zh: adversary 可能会使用内部代理来在受污染环境中的两个或多个系统之间定向命令和控制（C2）流量。许多工具支持通过代理或端口重定向实现流量转发，包括 [HTRAN](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0040)、ZXProxy 和 ZXPortMap。（来源：Trend Micro APT Attack Tools）对抗者使用内部代理来管理受污染环境内的命令与控制通信，以减少同时向外发出的网络连接数量，在连接丢失的情况下提供韧性，或者利用被感染系统之间已有的可信通信路径以避免引起怀疑。内部代理连接可能使用常见的点对点（p2p）网络协议，例如 SMB，以更好地融入环境。通过使用被攻陷的内部系统作为代理，对抗者可以隐藏 C2 流量的真实目的地，同时减少对大量外部系统连接的需求。

c1bfee04074a5dd1bb0c8c5403b4c31257dbc75f.source_text: [Volt Typhoon](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1017) has used the built-in [netsh](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0108) `port proxy` command to create proxies on compromised systems to facilitate access.(Citation: Microsoft Volt Typhoon May 2023)(Citation: CISA AA24-038A PRC Critical Infrastructure February 2024)
c1bfee04074a5dd1bb0c8c5403b4c31257dbc75f.zh: [Volt Typhoon](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1017) 已使用内置的 [netsh](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0108) `port proxy` 命令在受感染的系统上创建代理，以促进访问。(引用：Microsoft Volt Typhoon 2023年5月)(引用：CISA AA24-038A 中国关键基础设施 2024年2月)

1c2099cc154a6339c68900cceb8a15c7cde14c82.source_text: Adversaries may chain together multiple proxies to disguise the source of malicious traffic. Typically, a defender will be able to identify the last proxy traffic traversed before it enters their network; the defender may or may not be able to identify any previous proxies before the last-hop proxy. This technique makes identifying the original source of the malicious traffic even more difficult by requiring the defender to trace malicious traffic through several proxies to identify its source. For example, adversaries may construct or use onion routing networks – such as the publicly available [Tor](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0183) network – to transport encrypted C2 traffic through a compromised population, allowing communication with any device within the network.(Citation: Onion Routing) Adversaries may also use operational relay box (ORB) networks composed of virtual private servers (VPS), Internet of Things (IoT) devices, smart devices, and end-of-life routers to obfuscate their operations.(Citation: ORB Mandiant) In the case of network infrastructure, it is possible for an adversary to leverage multiple compromised devices to create a multi-hop proxy chain (i.e., [Network Devices](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1584/008)). By leveraging [Patch System Image](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1601/001) on routers, adversaries can add custom code to the affected network devices that will implement onion routing between those nodes. This method is dependent upon the [Network Boundary Bridging](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1599) method allowing the adversaries to cross the protected network boundary of the Internet perimeter and into the organization’s Wide-Area Network (WAN). Protocols such as ICMP may be used as a transport. Similarly, adversaries may abuse peer-to-peer (P2P) and blockchain-oriented infrastructure to implement routing between a decentralized network of peers.(Citation: NGLite Trojan)
1c2099cc154a6339c68900cceb8a15c7cde14c82.zh: 对手可能会将多个代理串联在一起，以伪装恶意流量的来源。通常，防御方能够识别在进入其网络之前最后一个经过的代理；防御方可能能够也可能无法识别在最后一跳代理之前的任何先前代理。通过将恶意流量追溯穿过多个代理以确定其来源，该技术使得确定恶意流量的原始来源更加困难。例如，对手可以构建或使用洋葱路由网络——如公开可用的 [Tor](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0183) 网络——来通过受感染的节点传输加密的命令与控制（C2）流量，从而允许与网络中的任何设备进行通信。（来源：Onion Routing）对手还可能使用由虚拟专用服务器（VPS）、物联网（IoT）设备、智能设备和过时路由器组成的操作中继盒（ORB）网络来模糊其操作。（来源：ORB Mandiant）在网络基础设施方面，对手可以利用多台受感染设备创建多跳代理链（即 [Network Devices](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1584/008)）。通过在路由器上使用 [Patch System Image](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1601/001)，对手可以为受影响的网络设备添加自定义代码，从而在这些节点之间实现洋葱路由。此方法依赖于 [Network Boundary Bridging](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1599) 方法，使对手能够穿越受保护的网络边界，从互联网外围进入组织广域网（WAN）。协议如 ICMP 可用作传输层。类似地，对手可能滥用点对点（P2P）和面向区块链的基础设施，在以对等节点为核心的去中心化网络中实施路由。（来源：NGLite Trojan）

219c508c69224a97aaf8105f3c0bbeeb973a62d4.source_text: [Volt Typhoon](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1017) has used multi-hop proxies for command-and-control infrastructure.(Citation: CISA AA24-038A PRC Critical Infrastructure February 2024)
219c508c69224a97aaf8105f3c0bbeeb973a62d4.zh: [Volt Typhoon](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1017)已使用多跳代理进行命令与控制基础设施。（引用：CISA AA24-038A PRC Critical Infrastructure February 2024）

981f19c1cea35fb30efadf50865d3dee38702029.source_text: [Volt Typhoon](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1017) has downloaded an outdated version of comsvcs.dll to a compromised domain controller in a non-standard folder.(Citation: CISA AA24-038A PRC Critical Infrastructure February 2024)
981f19c1cea35fb30efadf50865d3dee38702029.zh: [伏特飓风](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1017)将旧版本的comsvcs.dll下载到受陷的域控制器的非标准文件夹中。（CISA AA24-038A PRC Critical Infrastructure February 2024）

0eae01a79b3349d5001f642ce28cbf9a4e10b641.source_text: [Patchwork](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0040) is a cyber espionage group that was first observed in December 2015. While the group has not been definitively attributed, circumstantial evidence suggests the group may be a pro-Indian or Indian entity. [Patchwork](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0040) has been seen targeting industries related to diplomatic and government agencies. Much of the code used by this group was copied and pasted from online forums. [Patchwork](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0040) was also seen operating spearphishing campaigns targeting U.S. think tank groups in March and April of 2018.(Citation: Cymmetria Patchwork) (Citation: Symantec Patchwork)(Citation: TrendMicro Patchwork Dec 2017)(Citation: Volexity Patchwork June 2018)
0eae01a79b3349d5001f642ce28cbf9a4e10b641.zh: [Patchwork](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0040) 是一个网络间谍组织，于2015年12月首次被观察到。尽管该组织尚未得到明确归属，但间接证据表明该组织可能是亲印度或印度的实体。[Patchwork](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0040) 已被发现针对与外交和政府机构相关的行业。该组织使用的代码中，大量是从在线论坛复制并粘贴的。[Patchwork](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0040) 还被发现在2018年3月和4月对美国的智库组织开展了钓鱼攻击活动。(Citation: Cymmetria Patchwork) (Citation: Symantec Patchwork)(Citation: TrendMicro Patchwork Dec 2017)(Citation: Volexity Patchwork June 2018)

70549dff8ced2a4a4f517a707ae98547d8facae6.source_text: Adversaries may encode data with a standard data encoding system to make the content of command and control traffic more difficult to detect. Command and control (C2) information can be encoded using a standard data encoding system that adheres to existing protocol specifications. Common data encoding schemes include ASCII, Unicode, hexadecimal, Base64, and MIME.(Citation: Wikipedia Binary-to-text Encoding)(Citation: Wikipedia Character Encoding) Some data encoding systems may also result in data compression, such as gzip.
70549dff8ced2a4a4f517a707ae98547d8facae6.zh: 敌方可能使用标准数据编码系统对数据进行编码，使指挥和控制（C2）流量中的内容更难以被检测。C2信息可以使用符合现有协议规范的标准数据编码系统进行编码。常见的数据编码方案包括ASCII、Unicode、十六进制、Base64和MIME。（引用：Wikipedia Binary-to-text Encoding）（引用：Wikipedia Character Encoding）某些数据编码系统还可能产生数据压缩，例如gzip。

20ee639d74b292a879c9ec79fb02dac9221d6c0f.source_text: [Patchwork](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0040) used Base64 to encode C2 traffic.(Citation: Cymmetria Patchwork)
20ee639d74b292a879c9ec79fb02dac9221d6c0f.zh: [Patchwork](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0040) 使用 Base64 对 C2 流量进行编码。(Citation: Cymmetria Patchwork)

78caf7e586f24f0027720d8c38b71d4a83486cbd.source_text: [Patchwork](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0040) hides base64-encoded and encrypted C2 server locations in comments on legitimate websites.(Citation: Securelist Dropping Elephant)
78caf7e586f24f0027720d8c38b71d4a83486cbd.zh: [Patchwork](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0040) 将 base64 编码和加密的 C2 服务器位置隐藏在合法网站的注释中。(引用：Securelist Dropping Elephant)

61e2f8d633fb12d5231761398481e0d71a3b5de6.source_text: [Patchwork](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0040) payloads download additional files from the C2 server.(Citation: Securelist Dropping Elephant)(Citation: TrendMicro Patchwork Dec 2017)
61e2f8d633fb12d5231761398481e0d71a3b5de6.zh: [Patchwork](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0040)的有效载荷从C2服务器下载额外文件。（引用：Securelist Dropping Elephant）（引用：TrendMicro Patchwork Dec 2017）

b7180564274cab57d6655647cd6599d2afc22044.source_text: [APT41](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0096) is a threat group that researchers have assessed as Chinese state-sponsored espionage group that also conducts financially-motivated operations. Active since at least 2012, [APT41](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0096) has been observed targeting various industries, including but not limited to healthcare, telecom, technology, finance, education, retail and video game industries in 14 countries.(Citation: apt41_mandiant) Notable behaviors include using a wide range of malware and tools to complete mission objectives. [APT41](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0096) overlaps at least partially with public reporting on groups including BARIUM and [Winnti Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0044).(Citation: FireEye APT41 Aug 2019)(Citation: Group IB APT 41 June 2021)
b7180564274cab57d6655647cd6599d2afc22044.zh: [AAPT41](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0096) 是一个被研究人员评估为中国国家资助的情报搜集组织，同时也开展以经济利益为动机的行动。自至少2012年以来活跃，[APT41](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0096) 已被观察到针对多个行业，包括但不仅限于医疗保健、电信、科技、金融、教育、零售和游戏行业的14个国家。(Citation: apt41_mandiant) 其显著行为特征是使用多种恶意软件和工具来完成任务目标。[APT41](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0096) 与公开报告中提到的 BARIUM 和 [Winnti Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0044) 等组织存在至少部分重叠。(Citation: FireEye APT41 Aug 2019)(Citation: Group IB APT 41 June 2021)

27ffcc7cffd5941bf7702ecddc6ee3cafc4d4773.source_text: [APT41](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0096) used exploit payloads that initiate download via [ftp](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0095).(Citation: FireEye APT41 March 2020)
27ffcc7cffd5941bf7702ecddc6ee3cafc4d4773.zh: [APT41](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0096) 使用的利用载荷通过 [ftp](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0095) 发起下载。(Citation: FireEye APT41 March 2020)

de538602f444da8bb59666063b76125a4a91dcb9.source_text: [APT41](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0096) used HTTP to download payloads for CVE-2019-19781 and CVE-2020-10189 exploits.(Citation: FireEye APT41 March 2020)
de538602f444da8bb59666063b76125a4a91dcb9.zh: [APT41](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0096)使用HTTP下载用于CVE-2019-19781和CVE-2020-10189漏洞利用的有效载荷。(Citation: FireEye APT41 March 2020)

72824f120928c5806ca4fdf9d74cee5341b23954.source_text: Adversaries may make use of Domain Generation Algorithms (DGAs) to dynamically identify a destination domain for command and control traffic rather than relying on a list of static IP addresses or domains. This has the advantage of making it much harder for defenders to block, track, or take over the command and control channel, as there potentially could be thousands of domains that malware can check for instructions.(Citation: Cybereason Dissecting DGAs)(Citation: Cisco Umbrella DGA)(Citation: Unit 42 DGA Feb 2019) DGAs can take the form of apparently random or “gibberish” strings (ex: istgmxdejdnxuyla.ru) when they construct domain names by generating each letter. Alternatively, some DGAs employ whole words as the unit by concatenating words together instead of letters (ex: cityjulydish.net). Many DGAs are time-based, generating a different domain for each time period (hourly, daily, monthly, etc). Others incorporate a seed value as well to make predicting future domains more difficult for defenders.(Citation: Cybereason Dissecting DGAs)(Citation: Cisco Umbrella DGA)(Citation: Talos CCleanup 2017)(Citation: Akamai DGA Mitigation) Adversaries may use DGAs for the purpose of [Fallback Channels](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1008). When contact is lost with the primary command and control server malware may employ a DGA as a means to reestablishing command and control.(Citation: Talos CCleanup 2017)(Citation: FireEye POSHSPY April 2017)(Citation: ESET Sednit 2017 Activity)
