72824f120928c5806ca4fdf9d74cee5341b23954.zh: 攻击者可能会利用域名生成算法（DGA）动态确定命令和控制流量的目标域名，而不是依赖固定的IP地址或域名列表。这一优势使得防御者更难阻止、追踪或接管命令和控制通道，因为恶意软件可能存在成千上万个可供检查指令的域名。(引用：Cybereason Dissecting DGAs)(引用：Cisco Umbrella DGA)(引用：Unit 42 DGA Feb 2019) DGA在构造域名时可能表现为看似随机或“无意义”的字符串（例如：istgmxdejdnxuyla.ru），即通过逐个生成字母来构建域名； alternatively，一些DGA则以完整单词为单位，将单词拼接在一起而非逐个字母生成（例如：cityjulydish.net）。许多DGA是基于时间的，为每个时间段（每小时、每天、每月等）生成不同的域名；其他DGA还结合种子值，使防御者更难预测未来的域名。(引用：Cybereason Dissecting DGAs)(引用：Cisco Umbrella DGA)(引用：Talos CCleanup 2017)(引用：Akamai DGA Mitigation) 攻击者可能出于[备用通信频道](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1008)的目的使用DGA。当与主命令和控制服务器失去联系时，恶意软件可将DGA作为重新建立命令和控制的一种手段。(引用：Talos CCleanup 2017)(引用：FireEye POSHSPY April 2017)(引用：ESET Sednit 2017 Activity)

e31c96d4f38580806d699fec2121ded124741940.source_text: [APT41](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0096) has used DGAs to change their C2 servers monthly.(Citation: FireEye APT41 Aug 2019)
e31c96d4f38580806d699fec2121ded124741940.zh: [APT41](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0096) 已使用 DGA 每月更改其 C2 服务器。(引用：FireEye APT41 2019 年 8 月)

baa6d53ec44605f335df164fade0049d03de2385.source_text: Adversaries may communicate using the Domain Name System (DNS) application layer protocol to avoid detection/network filtering by blending in with existing traffic. Commands to the remote system, and often the results of those commands, will be embedded within the protocol traffic between the client and server. The DNS protocol serves an administrative function in computer networking and thus may be very common in environments. DNS traffic may also be allowed even before network authentication is completed. DNS packets contain many fields and headers in which data can be concealed. Often known as DNS tunneling, adversaries may abuse DNS to communicate with systems under their control within a victim network while also mimicking normal, expected traffic.(Citation: PAN DNS Tunneling)(Citation: Medium DnsTunneling) DNS beaconing may be used to send commands to remote systems via DNS queries. A DNS beacon is created by tunneling DNS traffic (i.e. [Protocol Tunneling](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1572)). The commands may be embedded into different DNS records, for example, TXT or A records.(Citation: OilRig Uses Updated BONDUPDATER to Target Middle Eastern Government) DNS beacons may be difficult to detect because the beacons infrequently communicate with infected devices.(Citation: DNS Beacons) Infrequent communication conceals the malicious DNS traffic with normal DNS traffic.
baa6d53ec44605f335df164fade0049d03de2385.zh: 对手可能使用域名系统（DNS）应用层协议进行通信，以通过融入现有流量来避免检测/网络过滤。发送给远程系统的命令以及这些命令的结果通常嵌入在客户端和服务器之间的协议流量中。DNS 协议在计算机网络中具有管理功能，因此在环境中可能非常普遍。即使在网络身份验证完成之前，也可能会允许 DNS 流量。DNS 数据包包含许多可以隐藏数据的字段和标头。通常称为 DNS 隧道，对手可以利用 DNS 与受害者网络内受其控制的系统进行通信，同时模仿正常、预期的流量。(Citation: PAN DNS Tunneling)(Citation: Medium DnsTunneling) 可使用 DNS 信标通过 DNS 查询向远程系统发送命令。DNS 信标是通过隧道传输 DNS 流量创建的（即 [Protocol Tunneling](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1572)）。命令可以嵌入到不同的 DNS 记录中，例如 TXT 或 A 记录。(Citation: OilRig Uses Updated BONDUPDATER to Target Middle Eastern Government) DNS 信标可能难以检测，因为这些信标很少与被感染的设备进行通信。(Citation: DNS Beacons) 不频繁的通信使得恶意 DNS 流量隐藏在正常的 DNS 流量之中。

31dfc0c85a80618eee34b6b8292ad4e4c548dcdf.source_text: [APT41](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0096) used DNS for C2 communications.(Citation: FireEye APT41 Aug 2019)(Citation: Group IB APT 41 June 2021)
31dfc0c85a80618eee34b6b8292ad4e4c548dcdf.zh: [APT41](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0096) 使用 DNS 进行 C2 通信。(Citation: FireEye APT41 Aug 2019)(Citation: Group IB APT 41 June 2021)

7e6bed08e2f77bfe4f5988d6cfef5ad3a87fcd6a.source_text: Adversaries may use fallback or alternate communication channels if the primary channel is compromised or inaccessible in order to maintain reliable command and control and to avoid data transfer thresholds.
7e6bed08e2f77bfe4f5988d6cfef5ad3a87fcd6a.zh: 如果主要通信通道被攻破或无法访问，攻击者可能会使用备用或替代的通信通道，以维持可靠的命令与控制（C2）并避免触发数据传输阈值。

2063cec5d4a5a8a8bda53f4b6b236eb9cafd95ed.zh: [APT41](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0096)使用Steam社区页面作为C2的备用机制。（引用：FireEye APT41 Aug 2019）

6e01b45b4eeefe3340995d46906ffec4dff3e0d5.source_text: [APT41](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0096) used [certutil](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0160) to download additional files.(Citation: FireEye APT41 March 2020)(Citation: Crowdstrike GTR2020 Mar 2020)(Citation: Group IB APT 41 June 2021) [APT41](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0096) downloaded post-exploitation tools such as [Cobalt Strike](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0154) via command shell following initial access.(Citation: Rostovcev APT41 2021) [APT41](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0096) has uploaded Procdump and NATBypass to a staging directory and has used these tools in follow-on activities.(Citation: apt41_dcsocytec_dec2022)
6e01b45b4eeefe3340995d46906ffec4dff3e0d5.zh: [APT41](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0096) 使用 [certutil](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0160) 下载了额外的文件。（引用：FireEye APT41 2020年3月）（引用：Crowdstrike GTR2020 2020年3月）（引用：Group IB APT 41 2021年6月）[APT41](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0096) 在初始访问后通过命令Shell下载了后渗透工具，如 [Cobalt Strike](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0154)。（引用：Rostovcev APT41 2021）[APT41](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0096) 已将 Procdump 和 NATBypass 上传到暂存目录，并在后续活动中使用了这些工具。（引用：apt41_dcsocytec_dec2022）

8dd7b229fec10041a85a0069b69b8bfb901e5c3d.source_text: [Salt Typhoon](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1045) is a People's Republic of China (PRC) state-backed actor that has been active since at least 2019 and responsible for numerous compromises of network infrastructure at major U.S. telecommunication and internet service providers (ISP).(Citation: US Dept. of Treasury Salt Typhoon JAN 2025)(Citation: Cisco Salt Typhoon FEB 2025)
8dd7b229fec10041a85a0069b69b8bfb901e5c3d.zh: [Salt Typhoon](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1045) 是一个自至少2019年以来活跃、由中华人民共和国（PRC）国家支持的实体，负责对多家美国大型电信和互联网服务提供商（ISP）的网络基础设施进行大量入侵活动。(Citation: US Dept. of Treasury Salt Typhoon JAN 2025)(Citation: Cisco Salt Typhoon FEB 2025)

c4adda2a6ba783449df75a2b4df4a7db8f3a42b4.source_text: Adversaries may tunnel network communications to and from a victim system within a separate protocol to avoid detection/network filtering and/or enable access to otherwise unreachable systems. Tunneling involves explicitly encapsulating a protocol within another. This behavior may conceal malicious traffic by blending in with existing traffic and/or provide an outer layer of encryption (similar to a VPN). Tunneling could also enable routing of network packets that would otherwise not reach their intended destination, such as SMB, RDP, or other traffic that would be filtered by network appliances or not routed over the Internet. There are various means to encapsulate a protocol within another protocol. For example, adversaries may perform SSH tunneling (also known as SSH port forwarding), which involves forwarding arbitrary data over an encrypted SSH tunnel.(Citation: SSH Tunneling)(Citation: Sygnia Abyss Locker 2025) [Protocol Tunneling](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1572) may also be abused by adversaries during [Dynamic Resolution](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1568). Known as DNS over HTTPS (DoH), queries to resolve C2 infrastructure may be encapsulated within encrypted HTTPS packets.(Citation: BleepingComp Godlua JUL19) Adversaries may also leverage [Protocol Tunneling](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1572) in conjunction with [Proxy](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1090) and/or [Protocol or Service Impersonation](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1001/003) to further conceal C2 communications and infrastructure.
c4adda2a6ba783449df75a2b4df4a7db8f3a42b4.zh: 攻击者可能在受害者系统中，通过在另一个独立协议内对网络通信进行隧道化操作，以避免检测/网络过滤和/或实现对其他不可达系统的访问。隧道技术涉及将一个协议显式地封装到另一个协议中。这种行为可以通过与现有流量融合来隐藏恶意流量，以及/或提供外层的加密（类似于VPN）。隧道化还可以实现网络数据包的重新路由，否则这些数据包将无法到达其预期目的地，例如由网络应用程序过滤或不通过互联网路由的SMB、RDP或其他流量。有多种方法可以将一个协议封装到另一个协议中。例如，攻击者可能执行SSH隧道（也称为SSH端口转发），这涉及在加密的SSH隧道中转发任意数据。（引用：SSH Tunneling）（引用：Sygnia Abyss Locker 2025）[协议隧道](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1572)也可能在[动态解析](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1568)期间被攻击者滥用。已知为DNS over HTTPS (DoH)，用于解析C2基础架构的查询可能会被封装在加密的HTTPS数据包中。（引用：BleepingComp Godlua JUL19）攻击者还可能结合[协议隧道](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1572)和/或[代理](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1090)和/或[协议或服务模拟](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1001/003)进一步隐藏C2通信和基础设施。

73cb122a03f5b2e03192b8ce0879650677445826.source_text: [Salt Typhoon](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1045) has modified device configurations to create and use Generic Routing Encapsulation (GRE) tunnels.(Citation: Cisco Salt Typhoon FEB 2025)
73cb122a03f5b2e03192b8ce0879650677445826.zh: [Salt Typhoon](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1045) 修改了设备配置以创建和使用通用路由封装（GRE）隧道。（来源：Cisco Salt Typhoon FEB 2025）

d635fd503781bf732ab8717653ce51c6253813d9.source_text: [Dragonfly](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0035) is a cyber espionage group that has been attributed to Russia's Federal Security Service (FSB) Center 16.(Citation: DOJ Russia Targeting Critical Infrastructure March 2022)(Citation: UK GOV FSB Factsheet April 2022) Active since at least 2010, [Dragonfly](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0035) has targeted defense and aviation companies, government entities, companies related to industrial control systems, and critical infrastructure sectors worldwide through supply chain, spearphishing, and drive-by compromise attacks.(Citation: Symantec Dragonfly)(Citation: Secureworks IRON LIBERTY July 2019)(Citation: Symantec Dragonfly Sept 2017)(Citation: Fortune Dragonfly 2.0 Sept 2017)(Citation: Gigamon Berserk Bear October 2021)(Citation: CISA AA20-296A Berserk Bear December 2020)(Citation: Symantec Dragonfly 2.0 October 2017)
d635fd503781bf732ab8717653ce51c6253813d9.zh: [Dragonfly](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0035)是一个网络间谍组织，已被归因于俄罗斯联邦安全局（FSB）第16中心。（引用：DOJ Russia Targeting Critical Infrastructure March 2022）（引用：UK GOV FSB Factsheet April 2022）自至少2010年以来活跃，[Dragonfly](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0035)通过供应链、鱼叉式钓鱼和恶意网站攻击等方式，针对全球范围内的国防和航空企业、政府实体、工业控制系统相关企业以及关键基础设施行业。（引用：Symantec Dragonfly）（引用：Secureworks IRON LIBERTY July 2019）（引用：Symantec Dragonfly Sept 2017）（引用：Fortune Dragonfly 2.0 Sept 2017）（引用：Gigamon Berserk Bear October 2021）（引用：CISA AA20-296A Berserk Bear December 2020）（引用：Symantec Dragonfly 2.0 October 2017）

f653427d1bb64f2d24f0123697c20d9449f4e70d.zh: [Dragonfly](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0035) 曾使用 SMB 进行 C2。（Citation: US-CERT TA18-074A）

152bf37626c6e50f5af3df213c4016d5496e9b24.source_text: [Dragonfly](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0035) has copied and installed tools for operations once in the victim environment.(Citation: US-CERT TA18-074A)

84d2b9f9ea817b91436e465bee5df34e5c50fc5d.source_text: [Gorgon Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0078) is a threat group consisting of members who are suspected to be Pakistan-based or have other connections to Pakistan. The group has performed a mix of criminal and targeted attacks, including campaigns against government organizations in the United Kingdom, Spain, Russia, and the United States. (Citation: Unit 42 Gorgon Group Aug 2018)
84d2b9f9ea817b91436e465bee5df34e5c50fc5d.zh: [Gorgon Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0078) 是一个威胁组织，其成员被怀疑位于巴基斯坦或与其他巴基斯坦相关实体有关联。该组织实施了多种犯罪行为和目标明确的攻击，包括针对英国、西班牙、俄罗斯和美国政府组织的行动。（来源：Unit 42 Gorgon Group Aug 2018）

ffeff9c2726781066a8e27b9099f4df36bdf90f4.source_text: [Gorgon Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0078) malware can download additional files from C2 servers.(Citation: Unit 42 Gorgon Group Aug 2018)
ffeff9c2726781066a8e27b9099f4df36bdf90f4.zh: [Gorgon 团伙](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0078)的恶意软件可以从命令与控制（C2）服务器下载附加文件。（Citation: Unit 42 Gorgon Group Aug 2018）

629ed33cfd12420ab7aa912cd26cd4b22f701b40.source_text: [menuPass](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0045) is a threat group that has been active since at least 2006. Individual members of [menuPass](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0045) are known to have acted in association with the Chinese Ministry of State Security's (MSS) Tianjin State Security Bureau and worked for the Huaying Haitai Science and Technology Development Company.(Citation: DOJ APT10 Dec 2018)(Citation: District Court of NY APT10 Indictment December 2018) [menuPass](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0045) has targeted healthcare, defense, aerospace, finance, maritime, biotechnology, energy, and government sectors globally, with an emphasis on Japanese organizations. In 2016 and 2017, the group is known to have targeted managed IT service providers (MSPs), manufacturing and mining companies, and a university.(Citation: Palo Alto menuPass Feb 2017)(Citation: Crowdstrike CrowdCast Oct 2013)(Citation: FireEye Poison Ivy)(Citation: PWC Cloud Hopper April 2017)(Citation: FireEye APT10 April 2017)(Citation: DOJ APT10 Dec 2018)(Citation: District Court of NY APT10 Indictment December 2018)
629ed33cfd12420ab7aa912cd26cd4b22f701b40.zh: [menuPass](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0045) 是一个自至少 2006 年以来一直活跃的网络威胁组织。[menuPass](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0045) 的成员已知与中国国家安全部（MSS）天津市国家安全局有关联，并为华海泰科技开发公司工作。(Citation: DOJ APT10 Dec 2018)(Citation: District Court of NY APT10 Indictment December 2018) [menuPass](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0045) 在全球范围内针对医疗、国防、航空航天、金融、海事、生物技术、能源和政府部门发动攻击，重点瞄准日本企业。在 2016 年和 2017 年，该组织被发现在攻击托管 IT 服务提供商（MSP）、制造和矿业公司以及一所大学。(Citation: Palo Alto menuPass Feb 2017)(Citation: Crowdstrike CrowdCast Oct 2013)(Citation: FireEye Poison Ivy)(Citation: PWC Cloud Hopper April 2017)(Citation: FireEye APT10 April 2017)(Citation: DOJ APT10 Dec 2018)(Citation: District Court of NY APT10 Indictment December 2018)

fe80bf3854b44a6ae2c72489a417af159646c2d0.source_text: [menuPass](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0045) has installed updates and new malware on victims.(Citation: PWC Cloud Hopper April 2017)(Citation: District Court of NY APT10 Indictment December 2018)
fe80bf3854b44a6ae2c72489a417af159646c2d0.zh: [menuPass](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0045) 已在受害者系统中安装更新和新恶意软件。（来源：PWC Cloud Hopper April 2017）（来源：纽约南区联邦地区法院 APT10 起诉书 December 2018）

e26194ba6474c74b193d2b5954be23e78f4cacfd.source_text: [menuPass](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0045) has used a global service provider's IP as a proxy for C2 traffic from a victim.(Citation: FireEye APT10 April 2017)(Citation: FireEye APT10 Sept 2018)
e26194ba6474c74b193d2b5954be23e78f4cacfd.zh: [menuPass](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0045)曾使用全球服务提供商的IP作为受害者C2流量的代理。(引用：FireEye APT10 2017年4月)(引用：FireEye APT10 2018年9月)

e266b7108e64ed67d9bb2cc414eee6889d55137d.source_text: Adversaries may use Fast Flux DNS to hide a command and control channel behind an array of rapidly changing IP addresses linked to a single domain resolution. This technique uses a fully qualified domain name, with multiple IP addresses assigned to it which are swapped with high frequency, using a combination of round robin IP addressing and short Time-To-Live (TTL) for a DNS resource record.(Citation: MehtaFastFluxPt1)(Citation: MehtaFastFluxPt2)(Citation: Fast Flux - Welivesecurity) The simplest, "single-flux" method, involves registering and de-registering an addresses as part of the DNS A (address) record list for a single DNS name. These registrations have a five-minute average lifespan, resulting in a constant shuffle of IP address resolution.(Citation: Fast Flux - Welivesecurity) In contrast, the "double-flux" method registers and de-registers an address as part of the DNS Name Server record list for the DNS zone, providing additional resilience for the connection. With double-flux additional hosts can act as a proxy to the C2 host, further insulating the true source of the C2 channel.
e266b7108e64ed67d9bb2cc414eee6889d55137d.zh: 对手可能利用快速通量DNS（Fast Flux DNS）将命令和控制通道隐藏在与单一域名解析相关联的、快速变化的IP地址数组背后。该技术使用一个完全限定域名，为其分配多个IP地址，并通过结合使用轮询IP寻址和DNS资源记录的短生存时间（TTL），以高频率进行互换。（引用：MehtaFastFluxPt1）（引用：MehtaFastFluxPt2）（引用：Fast Flux - Welivesecurity）最简单的方法是“单通量”（single-flux），即作为单个DNS名称的DNS A（地址）记录列表的一部分注册和注销地址。这些注册的平均生命周期为五分钟，导致IP地址解析不断轮换。（引用：Fast Flux - Welivesecurity）相比之下，“双通量”（double-flux）方法将地址作为DNS区域DNS名称服务器记录列表的一部分进行注册和注销，为连接提供额外的弹性。在双通量中，额外的主机可以作为C2主机的代理，进一步掩盖C2通道的真实来源。

b01e0963ae635110ecff9a13160abd4f21662d62.source_text: [menuPass](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0045) has used dynamic DNS service providers to host malicious domains.(Citation: District Court of NY APT10 Indictment December 2018)
b01e0963ae635110ecff9a13160abd4f21662d62.zh: [menuPass](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0045) 使用动态 DNS 服务提供商来托管恶意域名。（来源：纽约地区法院 APT10 起诉书，2018年12月）

33c3c6e5bde8b3222d398db16b713c8dd4ceed05.source_text: [Night Dragon](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0014) is a campaign name for activity involving a threat group that has conducted activity originating primarily in China. (Citation: McAfee Night Dragon)
33c3c6e5bde8b3222d398db16b713c8dd4ceed05.zh: [Night Dragon](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0014) 是一个活动名称，指代主要来自中国的威胁组织所开展的活动。（来源：McAfee Night Dragon）

b342ed2f68846cf14728dcb506f87b73c73f0cbc.source_text: [APT32](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0050) is a suspected Vietnam-based threat group that has been active since at least 2014. The group has targeted multiple private sector industries as well as foreign governments, dissidents, and journalists with a strong focus on Southeast Asian countries like Vietnam, the Philippines, Laos, and Cambodia. They have extensively used strategic web compromises to compromise victims.(Citation: FireEye APT32 May 2017)(Citation: Volexity OceanLotus Nov 2017)(Citation: ESET OceanLotus)
b342ed2f68846cf14728dcb506f87b73c73f0cbc.zh: [APT32](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0050) 是一个涉嫌位于越南的威胁组织，自至少 2014 年以来一直活跃。该组织针对多个私营行业以及外国政府、异议人士和记者发动攻击，重点关注东南亚国家，如越南、菲律宾、老挝和柬埔寨。（引用：FireEye APT32 May 2017）（引用：Volexity OceanLotus Nov 2017）（引用：ESET OceanLotus）

f819534c06060d9eb7793aaf05bdd101ea8ceadf.source_text: Adversaries may communicate using a protocol and port pairing that are typically not associated. For example, HTTPS over port 8088(Citation: Symantec Elfin Mar 2019) or port 587(Citation: Fortinet Agent Tesla April 2018) as opposed to the traditional port 443. Adversaries may make changes to the standard port used by a protocol to bypass filtering or muddle analysis/parsing of network data. Adversaries may also make changes to victim systems to abuse non-standard ports. For example, Registry keys and other configuration settings can be used to modify protocol and port pairings.(Citation: change_rdp_port_conti)
f819534c06060d9eb7793aaf05bdd101ea8ceadf.zh: 对手可能使用通常不相关联的协议和端口组合进行通信。例如，在端口 8088（出处：Symantec Elfin 2019年3月）或端口 587（出处：Fortinet Agent Tesla 2018年4月）上使用 HTTPS，而不是传统的端口 443。对手可能会更改协议所使用的标准端口，以绕过过滤或混淆网络数据的分析和解析。对手还可能更改受害者系统的配置，以滥用非标准端口。例如，注册表键和其他配置设置可用于修改协议与端口的配对。（出处：change_rdp_port_conti）

8e9a88516c68c3a9364d769a18a218c6cb677428.source_text: An [APT32](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0050) backdoor can use HTTP over a non-standard TCP port (e.g 14146) which is specified in the backdoor configuration.(Citation: ESET OceanLotus Mar 2019)
8e9a88516c68c3a9364d769a18a218c6cb677428.zh: 一个 [APT32](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0050) 后门可以使用非标准 TCP 端口（例如 14146）上的 HTTP，该端口在后门配置中指定。（Citation: ESET OceanLotus Mar 2019）

bbf6bc51e94bb2543a2f4b88e939dd4d4f3e6e6b.source_text: [APT32](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0050) has used email for C2 via an Office macro.(Citation: Cybereason Oceanlotus May 2017)(Citation: Cybereason Cobalt Kitty 2017)
bbf6bc51e94bb2543a2f4b88e939dd4d4f3e6e6b.zh: [APT32](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0050) 曾通过带有 Office 宏的电子邮件进行命令与控制通信。（Citation: Cybereason Oceanlotus May 2017）（Citation: Cybereason Cobalt Kitty 2017）

e7469630c7055835533653dc54b7cb42e2144275.source_text: [APT32](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0050) has used JavaScript that communicates over HTTP or HTTPS to attacker controlled domains to download additional frameworks. The group has also used downloaded encrypted payloads over HTTP.(Citation: Volexity OceanLotus Nov 2017)(Citation: Cybereason Cobalt Kitty 2017)
e7469630c7055835533653dc54b7cb42e2144275.zh: [APT32](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0050)已使用通过HTTP或HTTPS与攻击者控制的域名进行通信的JavaScript来下载额外的框架。该组织还曾通过HTTP下载过加密的有效载荷。(Citation: Volexity OceanLotus Nov 2017)(Citation: Cybereason Cobalt Kitty 2017)

64e6abae9e6c231e5d3dcf88d7afcda6fb92675d.source_text: [APT32](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0050) has added JavaScript to victim websites to download additional frameworks that profile and compromise website visitors.(Citation: Volexity OceanLotus Nov 2017)
64e6abae9e6c231e5d3dcf88d7afcda6fb92675d.zh: [APT32](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0050) 在受害者的网站中添加了 JavaScript 代码，用于下载额外的框架，以配置文件并入侵网站访问者。(Citation: Volexity OceanLotus Nov 2017)

2490beea5dc893e8fac5be12762f30aff6f5abc5.source_text: [APT32](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0050) has used Dropbox, Amazon S3, and Google Drive to host malicious downloads.(Citation: Volexity Ocean Lotus November 2020)
2490beea5dc893e8fac5be12762f30aff6f5abc5.zh: [APT32](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0050) 曾使用 Dropbox、Amazon S3 和 Google Drive 来托管恶意下载文件。（引用：Volexity Ocean Lotus 2020年11月）

f5f368034711a33c0488479e5279a0cc6ead178b.source_text: [HAFNIUM](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0125) is a likely state-sponsored cyber espionage group operating out of China that has been active since at least January 2021. [HAFNIUM](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0125) primarily targets entities in the US across a number of industry sectors, including infectious disease researchers, law firms, higher education institutions, defense contractors, policy think tanks, and NGOs. [HAFNIUM](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0125) has targeted remote management tools and cloud software for intial access and has demonstrated an ability to quickly operationalize exploits for identified vulnerabilities in edge devices.(Citation: Microsoft HAFNIUM March 2020)(Citation: Volexity Exchange Marauder March 2021)(Citation: Microsoft Silk Typhoon MAR 2025)
f5f368034711a33c0488479e5279a0cc6ead178b.zh: [HAFNIUM](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0125) 是一个可能由国家支持的、在中国运营的赛博间谍组织，自至少2021年1月起就有活动。[HAFNIUM](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0125) 主要针对美国境内的实体，涉及多个行业部门，包括传染病研究人员、律师事务所、高等教育机构、国防承包商、政策智库和非政府组织（NGO）。[HAFNIUM](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0125) 针对远程管理工具和云软件以实现初始访问，并展示了快速利用已识别的边界设备漏洞的能力。(Citation: Microsoft HAFNIUM March 2020)(Citation: Volexity Exchange Marauder March 2021)(Citation: Microsoft Silk Typhoon MAR 2025)

5c09ced32a1b1c8a64cc07be0f044a33b3be214c.source_text: [HAFNIUM](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0125) has downloaded malware and tools--including Nishang and PowerCat--onto a compromised host.(Citation: Microsoft HAFNIUM March 2020)(Citation: Rapid7 HAFNIUM Mar 2021)
5c09ced32a1b1c8a64cc07be0f044a33b3be214c.zh: [HAFNIUM](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0125) 已将恶意软件和工具（包括 Nishang 和 PowerCat）下载到受感染的主机上。(引用：Microsoft HAFNIUM 2020年3月)(引用：Rapid7 HAFNIUM 2021年3月)

563fffddd1bd9f260a115a5a214ae256a230a488.source_text: [HAFNIUM](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0125) has used open-source C2 frameworks, including [Covenant](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1155).(Citation: Microsoft HAFNIUM March 2020)
563fffddd1bd9f260a115a5a214ae256a230a488.zh: [HAFNIUM](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0125) 已使用开源 C2 框架，包括 [Covenant](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1155)。（参考：Microsoft HAFNIUM March 2020）

93c6ca618908c156e1fcfb325afeb7f23da9e8bf.source_text: [HAFNIUM](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0125) has used TCP for C2.(Citation: Microsoft HAFNIUM March 2020)
93c6ca618908c156e1fcfb325afeb7f23da9e8bf.zh: [HAFNIUM](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0125) 已使用 TCP 进行 C2 通信。（出处：Microsoft HAFNIUM March 2020）

d8b42c8a3ea253e9c44d4228301db206db419c3d.source_text: [HAFNIUM](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0125) has used ASCII encoding for C2 traffic.(Citation: Microsoft HAFNIUM March 2020)
d8b42c8a3ea253e9c44d4228301db206db419c3d.zh: [HAFNIUM](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0125) 曾为 C2 流量使用 ASCII 编码。(引用：Microsoft HAFNIUM March 2020)

fea36e5bb6c301f686d3deb255956a372fefadf1.source_text: [MuddyWater](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0069) is a cyber espionage group assessed to be a subordinate element within Iran's Ministry of Intelligence and Security (MOIS).(Citation: CYBERCOM Iranian Intel Cyber January 2022) Since at least 2017, [MuddyWater](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0069) has targeted a range of government and private organizations across sectors, including telecommunications, local government, finance, defense, and oil and natural gas organizations, in the Middle East (specifically the UAE and Saudi Arabia), Asia, Africa, Europe, and North America. [MuddyWater](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0069) has reused domains dating back to October 2025, and has a preference for NameCheap and Hosterdaddy Private Limited (AS136557). In late 2025 and early 2026, [MuddyWater](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0069) used commercial satellite internet (i.e., Starlink) for command and control (C2) communication. (Citation: FalconFeeds_Iran_Mar2026)(Citation: Huntio_IranInfra_Mar2026)(Citation: Unit 42 MuddyWater Nov 2017)(Citation: Symantec MuddyWater Dec 2018)(Citation: ClearSky MuddyWater Nov 2018)(Citation: ClearSky MuddyWater June 2019)(Citation: Reaqta MuddyWater November 2017)(Citation: DHS CISA AA22-055A MuddyWater February 2022)(Citation: Talos MuddyWater Jan 2022)(Citation: NaumaanProofpoint_GlobalClickFix_April2025)(Citation: ESET_MuddyWater_Dec2025)(Citation: SymantecCarbonBlack_Seedworm_Mar2026)
fea36e5bb6c301f686d3deb255956a372fefadf1.zh: [MuddyWater](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0069) 是一个被评估为隶属于伊朗情报与安全部（MOIS）下属分支的网络间谍组织。(Citation: CYBERCOM Iranian Intel Cyber January 2022) 自2017年以来，[MuddyWater](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0069) 针对中东（具体为阿联酋和沙特阿拉伯）、亚洲、非洲、欧洲和北美各地的政府及私营部门开展了广泛的目标攻击，涉及电信、地方政府、金融、国防以及石油和天然气等行业。[MuddyWater](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0069) 复用了可追溯至2025年10月的域名，并倾向于使用 NameCheap 和 Hosterdaddy Private Limited (AS136557)。在2025年末和2026年初，[MuddyWater](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0069) 使用商业卫星互联网（即 Starlink）进行命令与控制（C2）通信。(Citation: FalconFeeds_Iran_Mar2026)(Citation: Huntio_IranInfra_Mar2026)(Citation: Unit 42 MuddyWater Nov 2017)(Citation: Symantec MuddyWater Dec 2018)(Citation: ClearSky MuddyWater Nov 2018)(Citation: ClearSky MuddyWater June 2019)(Citation: Reaqta MuddyWater November 2017)(Citation: DHS CISA AA22-055A MuddyWater February 2022)(Citation: Talos MuddyWater Jan 2022)(Citation: NaumaanProofpoint_GlobalClickFix_April2025)(Citation: ESET_MuddyWater_Dec2025)(Citation: SymantecCarbonBlack_Seedworm_Mar2026)

ba5fd01b8f899748598059fe61b7a9e9ff7f61e6.source_text: [MuddyWater](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0069) has used ports 8043 and 8848 for botnet C2 communication.(Citation: FalconFeeds_MuddyWaterPSRust_Mar2026)
ba5fd01b8f899748598059fe61b7a9e9ff7f61e6.zh: [MuddyWater](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0069) 已使用端口 8043 和 8848 进行僵尸网络 C2 通信。（Citation: FalconFeeds_MuddyWaterPSRust_Mar2026）

29c80a63c26e1d4db29f373a0acb8d76091b25ab.source_text: [MuddyWater](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0069) has used HTTP for C2 communications.(Citation: ClearSky MuddyWater June 2019)(Citation: Trend Micro Muddy Water March 2021)
29c80a63c26e1d4db29f373a0acb8d76091b25ab.zh: [MuddyWater](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0069) 曾使用 HTTP 进行 C2 通信。(Citation: ClearSky MuddyWater June 2019)(Citation: Trend Micro Muddy Water March 2021)

0b64d414fab9bb95e030b91fdee9f61eeb2e99e5.source_text: [MuddyWater](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0069) has used malware that can upload additional files to the victim’s machine.(Citation: Securelist MuddyWater Oct 2018)(Citation: ClearSky MuddyWater Nov 2018)(Citation: Reaqta MuddyWater November 2017)(Citation: Trend Micro Muddy Water March 2021) [MuddyWater](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0069) has used PowerShell commands to install remote management and monitoring (RMM) software on the victim’s machine to conduct espionage and to exfiltrate data.(Citation: NaumaanProofpoint_GlobalClickFix_April2025)
0b64d414fab9bb95e030b91fdee9f61eeb2e99e5.zh: [MuddyWater](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0069) 已使用能够将额外文件上传到受害者计算机中的恶意软件。(Citation: Securelist MuddyWater Oct 2018)(Citation: ClearSky MuddyWater Nov 2018)(Citation: Reaqta MuddyWater November 2017)(Citation: Trend Micro Muddy Water March 2021) [MuddyWater](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0069) 已使用 PowerShell 命令在受害者的机器上安装远程管理和监控（RMM）软件，以进行间谍活动和数据外泄。(Citation: NaumaanProofpoint_GlobalClickFix_April2025)

c62601d2686259bd717a151d5ff3fa1f0f4762db.source_text: [MuddyWater](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0069) has used AES to encrypt C2 responses.(Citation: Talos MuddyWater Jan 2022)
c62601d2686259bd717a151d5ff3fa1f0f4762db.zh: [MuddyWater](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0069) 使用 AES 加密 C2 响应。（Citation: Talos MuddyWater Jan 2022）

44e5004292705c67b32d4eda16c10ea97c8a7f76.source_text: [MuddyWater](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0069) has used tools to encode C2 communications including Base64 encoding.(Citation: ClearSky MuddyWater June 2019)(Citation: Trend Micro Muddy Water March 2021)
44e5004292705c67b32d4eda16c10ea97c8a7f76.zh: [MuddyWater](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0069) 已使用工具对 C2 通信进行编码，包括 Base64 编码。(Citation: ClearSky MuddyWater June 2019)(Citation: Trend Micro Muddy Water March 2021)

50c816453d5c1f892cd785d2ddd369374dfe9b4a.source_text: [MuddyWater](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0069) has used one C2 to obtain enumeration scripts and monitor web logs, but a different C2 to send data back.(Citation: Talos MuddyWater May 2019)
50c816453d5c1f892cd785d2ddd369374dfe9b4a.zh: [MuddyWater](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0069) 使用一个C2来获取枚举脚本和监控Web日志，但使用另一个C2来发送数据。

9e4564b73e863b0e0253e00b06fd9af767191e36.source_text: [MuddyWater](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0069) has used NordVPN to proxy phishing emails, making them appear to originate from France.(Citation: FalconFeeds_Iran_Mar2026)
9e4564b73e863b0e0253e00b06fd9af767191e36.zh: [MuddyWater](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0069) 曾使用 NordVPN 对钓鱼邮件进行代理，使其看似源自法国。(引用：FalconFeeds_Iran_Mar2026)

13008a91ab593e61558e124a69bb026dc4f7c53e.source_text: [MuddyWater](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0069) has controlled [POWERSTATS](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0223) from behind a proxy network to obfuscate the C2 location.(Citation: Symantec MuddyWater Dec 2018) [MuddyWater](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0069) has used a series of compromised websites that victims connected to randomly to relay information to command and control (C2).(Citation: Reaqta MuddyWater November 2017)(Citation: Trend Micro Muddy Water March 2021) [MuddyWater](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0069) has also used go-socks5 variants to bypass firewalls and Network Address Translation (NAT), to communicate with a hardcoded C2 server, and to exfiltrate data.(Citation: ESET_MuddyWater_Dec2025)
13008a91ab593e61558e124a69bb026dc4f7c53e.zh: [MuddyWater](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0069) 通过代理网络控制 [POWERSTATS](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0223)，以隐藏其命令与控制（C2）位置。（来源：Symantec MuddyWater Dec 2018）[MuddyWater](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0069) 使用了一系列受害者随机连接的受感染网站来中继信息到命令与控制（C2）服务器。（来源：Reaqta MuddyWater November 2017）（来源：Trend Micro Muddy Water March 2021）[MuddyWater](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0069) 还使用了 go-socks5 的变种版本以绕过防火墙和网络地址转换（NAT），与硬编码的 C2 服务器进行通信并外泄数据。（来源：ESET_MuddyWater_Dec2025）

2d5e23b93d3debe91b96d425d3227295cdd41666.source_text: [MuddyWater](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0069) has leveraged RMM solutions including ScreenConnect, AteraAgent, SimpleHelp, Action1, Level, and PDQ to facilitate follow-on actions within compromised hosts to include data exfiltration.(Citation: Trend Micro Muddy Water March 2021)(Citation: Anomali Static Kitten February 2021)(Citation: Proofpoint TA450 Phishing March 2024)(Citation: group-ib_muddywater_infra)(Citation: FalconFeeds_Iran_Mar2026)(Citation: NaumaanProofpoint_GlobalClickFix_April2025)(Citation: FalconFeeds_MuddyWaterPSRust_Mar2026)
2d5e23b93d3debe91b96d425d3227295cdd41666.zh: [MuddyWater](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0069) 利用了远程管理（RMM）解决方案，包括 ScreenConnect、AteraAgent、SimpleHelp、Action1、Level 和 PDQ，以在被攻破的主机内促成后续操作，包括数据外泄。(Citation: Trend Micro Muddy Water March 2021)(Citation: Anomali Static Kitten February 2021)(Citation: Proofpoint TA450 Phishing March 2024)(Citation: group-ib_muddywater_infra)(Citation: FalconFeeds_Iran_Mar2026)(Citation: NaumaanProofpoint_GlobalClickFix_April2025)(Citation: FalconFeeds_MuddyWaterPSRust_Mar2026)

2daf909f06ffc8b8dca14694cba1722848d23e17.source_text: [MuddyWater](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0069) has used web services including OneHub to distribute remote access tools.(Citation: Anomali Static Kitten February 2021)
2daf909f06ffc8b8dca14694cba1722848d23e17.zh: [MuddyWater](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0069) 曾利用包括 OneHub 在内的网络服务来分发远程访问工具。(Citation: Anomali Static Kitten February 2021)

3788c62c29c9f78735d6e7822b1df2e20bdf4640.source_text: [Strider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0041) is a threat group that has been active since at least 2011 and has targeted victims in Russia, China, Sweden, Belgium, Iran, and Rwanda.(Citation: Symantec Strider Blog)(Citation: Kaspersky ProjectSauron Blog)
3788c62c29c9f78735d6e7822b1df2e20bdf4640.zh: [Strider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0041) 是一个自至少2011年以来活跃的黑客组织，其针对俄罗斯、中国、瑞典、比利时、伊朗和卢旺达等地的受害者进行了攻击。(Citation: Symantec Strider Blog)(Citation: Kaspersky ProjectSauron Blog)

64635a6ed2f15997c0ee38f3767ae747d5c32fc8.source_text: [Strider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0041) has used local servers with both local network and Internet access to act as internal proxy nodes to exfiltrate data from other parts of the network without direct Internet access.(Citation: Kaspersky ProjectSauron Blog)
64635a6ed2f15997c0ee38f3767ae747d5c32fc8.zh: [Strider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0041) 使用具有本地网络和互联网访问权限的本地服务器作为内部代理节点，以从其他没有直接互联网访问的网络部分窃取数据。(Citation: Kaspersky ProjectSauron Blog)

cfbac37dd5f5c0fe626f062014ef9e6c522f5260.source_text: [Operation Wocao](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0116) described activities carried out by a China-based cyber espionage adversary. [Operation Wocao](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0116) targeted entities within the government, managed service providers, energy, health care, and technology sectors across several countries, including China, France, Germany, the United Kingdom, and the United States. [Operation Wocao](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0116) used similar TTPs and tools to APT20, suggesting a possible overlap.(Citation: FoxIT Wocao December 2019)
cfbac37dd5f5c0fe626f062014ef9e6c522f5260.zh: [Operation Wocao](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0116) 描述了中国背景的网络间谍对手开展的活动。[Operation Wocao](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0116) 针对多个国家的政府、管理服务提供商、能源、医疗保健和技术部门内的实体，这些国家包括中国、法国、德国、英国和美国。[Operation Wocao](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0116) 使用了与 APT20 类似的战术、技术和程序（TTPs）以及工具，表明可能存在重叠。(Citation: FoxIT Wocao December 2019)

b05f6c103c3d57a299cbc025496a13d19caf9358.source_text: [Naikon](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0019) is assessed to be a state-sponsored cyber espionage group attributed to the Chinese People’s Liberation Army’s (PLA) Chengdu Military Region Second Technical Reconnaissance Bureau (Military Unit Cover Designator 78020).(Citation: CameraShy) Active since at least 2010, [Naikon](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0019) has primarily conducted operations against government, military, and civil organizations in Southeast Asia, as well as against international bodies such as the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) and the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN).(Citation: CameraShy)(Citation: Baumgartner Naikon 2015) While [Naikon](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0019) shares some characteristics with [APT30](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0013), the two groups do not appear to be exact matches.(Citation: Baumgartner Golovkin Naikon 2015)
b05f6c103c3d57a299cbc025496a13d19caf9358.zh: [Naikon](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0019)被评估为由中国人民解放军（PLA）成都军区第二技术侦察局（军事单位覆盖代号78020）所属的国家支持的网络间谍组织。(Citation: CameraShy) 自至少2010年以来活跃，[Naikon](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0019)主要对东南亚的政府、军事和民用组织实施行动，并对联合国开发计划署（UNDP）和东南亚国家联盟（ASEAN）等国际机构进行攻击。(Citation: CameraShy)(Citation: Baumgartner Naikon 2015) 尽管[Naikon](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0019)与[APT30](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0013)具有一些共同特征，但两组之间似乎并不完全匹配。(Citation: Baumgartner Golovkin Naikon 2015)

8f914a07924091097fbd2a3ee90c664ef536462f.source_text: [FIN6](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0037) is a cyber crime group that has stolen payment card data and sold it for profit on underground marketplaces. This group has aggressively targeted and compromised point of sale (PoS) systems in the hospitality and retail sectors.(Citation: FireEye FIN6 April 2016)(Citation: FireEye FIN6 Apr 2019)
8f914a07924091097fbd2a3ee90c664ef536462f.zh: [FIN6](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0037) 是一个网络犯罪组织，其从支付卡中窃取数据并在地下市场出售以牟取利润。该组织积极针对并入侵了酒店和零售行业的点-of-sale (PoS) 系统。(引用：FireEye FIN6 April 2016)(引用：FireEye FIN6 Apr 2019)

bd388e7595be80968565ac737a15d81ebf71bac4.source_text: [FIN6](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0037) used the Plink command-line utility to create SSH tunnels to C2 servers.(Citation: FireEye FIN6 April 2016)
bd388e7595be80968565ac737a15d81ebf71bac4.zh: [FIN6](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0037) 使用 Plink 命令行实用程序创建到 C2 服务器的 SSH 隧道。(Citation: FireEye FIN6 April 2016)

49273b6277ffc07e3f8bdd37378dec2eb36cad89.source_text: [FIN6](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0037) has used Pastebin and Google Storage to host content for their operations.(Citation: FireEye FIN6 Apr 2019)
49273b6277ffc07e3f8bdd37378dec2eb36cad89.zh: [FIN6](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0037) 已使用 Pastebin 和 Google Storage 为其行动托管内容。（引用：FireEye FIN6 2019年4月）

a7ccdc0cc6d4bb1ff9c5813758350ab8571ab69e.source_text: [FIN6](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0037) has used Metasploit Bind and Reverse TCP stagers.(Citation: Trend Micro FIN6 October 2019)
a7ccdc0cc6d4bb1ff9c5813758350ab8571ab69e.zh: [FIN6](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0037) 曾使用 Metasploit Bind 和 Reverse TCP stagers。（来源：Trend Micro FIN6 October 2019）

fdb921b4a317b402cf6987d8a54794672971561b.source_text: Adversaries may employ a known asymmetric encryption algorithm to conceal command and control traffic rather than relying on any inherent protections provided by a communication protocol. Asymmetric cryptography, also known as public key cryptography, uses a keypair per party: one public that can be freely distributed, and one private. Due to how the keys are generated, the sender encrypts data with the receiver’s public key and the receiver decrypts the data with their private key. This ensures that only the intended recipient can read the encrypted data. Common public key encryption algorithms include RSA and ElGamal. For efficiency, many protocols (including SSL/TLS) use symmetric cryptography once a connection is established, but use asymmetric cryptography to establish or transmit a key. As such, these protocols are classified as [Asymmetric Cryptography](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1573/002).
fdb921b4a317b402cf6987d8a54794672971561b.zh: 敌方可能采用已知的非对称加密算法来隐藏命令与控制流量，而不是依赖于通信协议提供的任何固有保护。非对称密码学，也称为公钥密码学，为每个参与方使用一对密钥：一个可以自由分发的公钥和一个私有的私钥。由于密钥的生成方式，发送方使用接收方的公钥对数据进行加密，而接收方使用其私钥对数据进行解密。这确保了只有预期的接收方才能读取加密数据。常见的公钥加密算法包括 RSA 和 ElGamal。出于效率考虑，许多协议（包括 SSL/TLS）在连接建立后使用对称密码学，但使用非对称密码学来建立或传输密钥。因此，这些协议被归类于 [非对称加密](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1573/002)。

73a128529caa2416024333d9b3629cff1d386fcc.source_text: [RedEcho](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1042) is a People’s Republic of China-related threat actor associated with long-running intrusions in Indian critical infrastructure entities. [RedEcho](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1042) overlaps with various other PRC-linked threat groups, such as [APT41](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0096), and is linked to [ShadowPad](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0596) malware use through shared infrastructure.(Citation: RecordedFuture RedEcho 2021)(Citation: RecordedFuture RedEcho 2022)
73a128529caa2416024333d9b3629cff1d386fcc.zh: [RedEcho](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1042) 是一个与中华人民共和国相关的威胁行为者，与针对印度关键基础设施实体的长期入侵活动有关。[RedEcho](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1042) 与其他各种与中华人民共和国关联的威胁组织（如 [APT41](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0096)）存在重叠，并通过共享基础设施与 [ShadowPad](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0596) 恶意软件的使用相关联。(Citation: RecordedFuture RedEcho 2021)(Citation: RecordedFuture RedEcho 2022)

582005799bbdde20dabde1cbe9112b56b0896765.source_text: [RedEcho](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1042) used dynamic DNS domains associated with malicious infrastructure.(Citation: RecordedFuture RedEcho 2021)
582005799bbdde20dabde1cbe9112b56b0896765.zh: [RedEcho](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1042) 使用了与恶意基础设施关联的动态 DNS 域名。（来源：RecordedFuture RedEcho 2021）

ae618397127e92810c2c1a52f43584353d7063eb.zh: [RedEcho](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1042) 的网络活动与通过 TCP 443 的 SSL 流量以及非标准端口上的代理 HTTP 流量相关联。(Citation: RecordedFuture RedEcho 2021)

90d3b6082ad0d2a7dbbebb6a03cd0459ef429230.source_text: [RedEcho](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1042) has used non-standard ports such as TCP 8080 for HTTP communication.(Citation: RecordedFuture RedEcho 2021)
90d3b6082ad0d2a7dbbebb6a03cd0459ef429230.zh: [RedEcho](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1042) 已使用 TCP 8080 等非标准端口进行 HTTP 通信。(Citation: RecordedFuture RedEcho 2021)

3c571502dd879715dc7ef3a9421b38c98641fa5b.source_text: [RedEcho](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1042) uses SSL for network communication.(Citation: RecordedFuture RedEcho 2021)
3c571502dd879715dc7ef3a9421b38c98641fa5b.zh: [RedEcho](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1042) 使用 SSL 进行网络通信。(Citation: RecordedFuture RedEcho 2021)

49299de35421cb36a9badf9ebed55b6f3507c490.source_text: [Gamaredon Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0047) is a suspected Russian cyber espionage group that has targeted military, law enforcement, judiciary, non-profit, and non-governmental organizations in Ukraine since at least 2013. The name [Gamaredon Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0047) derives from a misspelling of the word "Armageddon," found in early campaigns.(Citation: Palo Alto Gamaredon Feb 2017)(Citation: TrendMicro Gamaredon April 2020)(Citation: ESET Gamaredon June 2020)(Citation: Symantec Shuckworm January 2022)(Citation: Microsoft Actinium February 2022) In November 2021, the Ukrainian government publicly attributed [Gamaredon Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0047) to Russia’s Federal Security Service (FSB) Center 18, an assessment later supported by multiple independent cybersecurity researchers. (Citation: Bleepingcomputer Gamardeon FSB November 2021)(Citation: Microsoft Actinium February 2022)
49299de35421cb36a9badf9ebed55b6f3507c490.zh: [Gamaredon Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0047) 是一个涉嫌隶属于俄罗斯的网络间谍组织，自至少2013年起一直针对乌克兰的军事、执法、司法、非营利组织和非政府组织实施攻击。该名称源于早期活动中出现的“Armageddon”一词的错误拼写。(Citation: Palo Alto Gamaredon Feb 2017)(Citation: TrendMicro Gamaredon April 2020)(Citation: ESET Gamaredon June 2020)(Citation: Symantec Shuckworm January 2022)(Citation: Microsoft Actinium February 2022) 2021年11月，乌克兰政府公开将 [Gamaredon Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0047) 归因于俄罗斯联邦安全局（FSB）第18中心，这一评估随后得到了多家独立网络安全研究人员的支持。(Citation: Bleepingcomputer Gamardeon FSB November 2021)(Citation: Microsoft Actinium February 2022)

95aadf26b52431a4102cfa011c800f8a8e65e6d1.source_text: Adversaries may obfuscate command and control traffic to make it more difficult to detect.(Citation: Bitdefender FunnyDream Campaign November 2020) Command and control (C2) communications are hidden (but not necessarily encrypted) in an attempt to make the content more difficult to discover or decipher and to make the communication less conspicuous and hide commands from being seen. This encompasses many methods, such as adding junk data to protocol traffic, using steganography, or impersonating legitimate protocols.
95aadf26b52431a4102cfa011c800f8a8e65e6d1.zh: 对抗者可能混淆命令与控制（C2）流量，使其更难被检测。(Citation: Bitdefender FunnyDream Campaign November 2020) 命令与控制（C2）通信被隐藏（但不一定加密），以试图使内容更难被发现或破译，并使通信更不显眼，从而隐藏命令不被看见。这涵盖了许多方法，例如在协议流量中添加垃圾数据、使用隐写术或伪装合法协议。

b0b942e4c47ce803e2edf6e5e445685f491b1b2d.source_text: [Gamaredon Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0047) has used obfuscated VBScripts with randomly generated variable names and concatenated strings.(Citation: unit42_gamaredon_dec2022)
b0b942e4c47ce803e2edf6e5e445685f491b1b2d.zh: [Gamaredon Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0047) 使用过包含随机生成的变量名和拼接字符串的混淆 VBScript。（Citation: unit42_gamaredon_dec2022）

7850fcd1d431083f0adce813c737ca37ced31678.source_text: [Gamaredon Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0047) has used SOCKS5 over port 9050 for C2 communication.(Citation: SymantecCarbonBlack_ShuckwormUSB_Apr2025)
7850fcd1d431083f0adce813c737ca37ced31678.zh: [Gamaredon Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0047) 已使用端口 9050 上的 SOCKS5 进行 C2 通信。（来源：SymantecCarbonBlack_ShuckwormUSB_Apr2025）

77f4b5ca72c3a55138b735604fa4999bc951e4ed.source_text: [Gamaredon Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0047) has downloaded additional malware and tools onto a compromised host.(Citation: Palo Alto Gamaredon Feb 2017)(Citation: TrendMicro Gamaredon April 2020)(Citation: ESET Gamaredon June 2020)(Citation: Microsoft Actinium February 2022)(Citation: ESET Gamaredon Sept2024)(Citation: VenereCiscoTalos_Gamaredon_Mar2025) For example, [Gamaredon Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0047) uses a backdoor script to retrieve and decode additional payloads once in victim environments.(Citation: unit42_gamaredon_dec2022)
77f4b5ca72c3a55138b735604fa4999bc951e4ed.zh: [Gamaredon Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0047) 已在受感染的主机上下载了额外的恶意软件和工具。（Citation: Palo Alto Gamaredon Feb 2017）（Citation: TrendMicro Gamaredon April 2020）（Citation: ESET Gamaredon June 2020）（Citation: Microsoft Actinium February 2022）（Citation: ESET Gamaredon Sept2024）（Citation: VenereCiscoTalos_Gamaredon_Mar2025）例如，[Gamaredon Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0047) 使用后门脚本在受害者环境中检索和解码额外的有效载荷。（Citation: unit42_gamaredon_dec2022）

fccee6b3b60f8e7be379790d1ccfef04d9638f09.source_text: Adversaries may use an existing, legitimate external Web service as a means for sending commands to a compromised system without receiving return output over the Web service channel. Compromised systems may leverage popular websites and social media to host command and control (C2) instructions. Those infected systems may opt to send the output from those commands back over a different C2 channel, including to another distinct Web service. Alternatively, compromised systems may return no output at all in cases where adversaries want to send instructions to systems and do not want a response. Popular websites and social media acting as a mechanism for C2 may give a significant amount of cover due to the likelihood that hosts within a network are already communicating with them prior to a compromise. Using common services, such as those offered by Google or Twitter, makes it easier for adversaries to hide in expected noise. Web service providers commonly use SSL/TLS encryption, giving adversaries an added level of protection.
fccee6b3b60f8e7be379790d1ccfef04d9638f09.zh: 对手可能利用现存的、合法的外部 Web 服务作为向受损系统发送命令的手段，而无需通过该 Web 服务通道接收返回输出。受损系统可利用流行的网站和社交媒体来托管命令和控制（C2）指令。这些被感染的系统可以选择通过另一个不同的 C2 通道将那些命令的输出发回，例如发送到另一个独立的 Web 服务。或者，在某些情况下，如果对手希望向系统发送指令而不需要响应，则受损系统可能完全不返回任何输出。由于网络内的主机在遭受入侵之前很可能已经在与流行的网站和社交媒体通信，因此将这些平台作为 C2 机制可为对手提供大量的掩护。使用诸如 Google 或 Twitter 提供的常见服务，使对手更容易隐藏在预期的正常流量噪声中。Web 服务提供商通常使用 SSL/TLS 加密，为对手提供了额外一层保护。

291ee015dd1dab44b01c18d334f407854d5ec2d9.source_text: [Gamaredon Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0047) has used Telegram Messenger content to discover the IP address for C2 communications.(Citation: unit42_gamaredon_dec2022)
291ee015dd1dab44b01c18d334f407854d5ec2d9.zh: [Gamaredon Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0047) 利用 Telegram Messenger 的内容来发现用于 C2 通信的 IP 地址。(Citation: unit42_gamaredon_dec2022)

409c12e0fac7a347ea389858f63e2a917500f342.source_text: [Gamaredon Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0047) has used port 6856 for C2 communications.(Citation: VenereCiscoTalos_Gamaredon_Mar2025)
409c12e0fac7a347ea389858f63e2a917500f342.zh: [Gamaredon 组织](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0047) 曾使用端口 6856 进行 C2 通信。（引用：VenereCiscoTalos_Gamaredon_Mar2025）

057b78895e0bc8bab07f22e1cf495d27d528847e.source_text: [Gamaredon Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0047) has used HTTP and HTTPS for C2 communications.(Citation: Palo Alto Gamaredon Feb 2017)(Citation: TrendMicro Gamaredon April 2020)(Citation: ESET Gamaredon June 2020)(Citation: Symantec Shuckworm January 2022)(Citation: CERT-EE Gamaredon January 2021)(Citation: Unit 42 Gamaredon February 2022)(Citation: unit42_gamaredon_dec2022)(Citation: ESET Gamaredon Sept2024)(Citation: VenereCiscoTalos_Gamaredon_Mar2025)
057b78895e0bc8bab07f22e1cf495d27d528847e.zh: [Gamaredon Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0047) 已使用 HTTP 和 HTTPS 进行 C2 通信。(Citation: Palo Alto Gamaredon Feb 2017)(Citation: TrendMicro Gamaredon April 2020)(Citation: ESET Gamaredon June 2020)(Citation: Symantec Shuckworm January 2022)(Citation: CERT-EE Gamaredon January 2021)(Citation: Unit 42 Gamaredon February 2022)(Citation: unit42_gamaredon_dec2022)(Citation: ESET Gamaredon Sept2024)(Citation: VenereCiscoTalos_Gamaredon_Mar2025)

4ab60258442f648b8867b53338135667a940f4de.source_text: [Gamaredon Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0047) has used fast flux DNS to mask their command and control channel behind rotating IP addresses.(Citation: unit42_gamaredon_dec2022)(Citation: ESET Gamaredon Sept2024)(Citation: SilentPush_GamaredonFastFlux_Sept2023) Additionally, [Gamaredon Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0047) has used a low-frequency variant of the single-flux method.(Citation: Huntio_GamaredonFlux_Apr2025)
4ab60258442f648b8867b53338135667a940f4de.zh: [Gamaredon Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0047) 已使用快速通量 DNS 技术，将他们的命令与控制通道隐藏在不断变化的 IP 地址背后。(Citation: unit42_gamaredon_dec2022)(Citation: ESET Gamaredon Sept2024)(Citation: SilentPush_GamaredonFastFlux_Sept2023) 此外，[Gamaredon Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0047) 还使用了低频版本的单通量方法。(Citation: Huntio_GamaredonFlux_Apr2025)

79a9cf0b1db9d664814ca537fa17ff0247d355e9.source_text: [Gamaredon Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0047) has used [Tor](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0183) for C2 traffic.(Citation: SymantecCarbonBlack_ShuckwormUSB_Apr2025)
79a9cf0b1db9d664814ca537fa17ff0247d355e9.zh: [伽马顿组织](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0047) 曾使用 [Tor](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0183) 进行 C2 通信。(Citation: SymantecCarbonBlack_ShuckwormUSB_Apr2025)

6dadf9ec16556659559236c71f8aa1e6e183ec73.source_text: [Gamaredon Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0047) has incorporated dynamic DNS domains in its infrastructure.(Citation: Unit 42 Gamaredon February 2022)
6dadf9ec16556659559236c71f8aa1e6e183ec73.zh: [Gamaredon Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0047) 已将其基础设施与动态 DNS 域名整合在一起。(Citation: Unit 42 Gamaredon February 2022)

f84f3b83c5da1b2da881fb6f5197e544378d2452.source_text: [Gamaredon Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0047) has used the Cloudflare Tunnel client to proxy C2 traffic.(Citation: ESET Gamaredon Sept2024)
f84f3b83c5da1b2da881fb6f5197e544378d2452.zh: [Gamaredon 组织](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0047)曾使用 Cloudflare Tunnel 客户端来代理 C2 流量。(引用: ESET Gamaredon Sept2024)

4d90d705d32062dbf189b6f8779e4a0d641ca116.source_text: [Gamaredon Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0047) has used several ways to try to resolve the C2 server, including: public third-party websites, an adversary-operated Telegraph channel, the [ngrok](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0508) utility and the TXT record of a hardcoded C2 domain.(Citation: ESET Gamaredon Sept2024)(Citation: SymantecCarbonBlack_ShuckwormUSB_Apr2025)
4d90d705d32062dbf189b6f8779e4a0d641ca116.zh: [Gamaredon Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0047) 曾使用多种方式尝试解析 C2 服务器，包括：公共第三方网站、由 adversary 运营的 Telegram 频道、[ngrok](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0508) 工具以及硬编码 C2 域名的 TXT 记录。(Citation: ESET Gamaredon Sept2024)(Citation: SymantecCarbonBlack_ShuckwormUSB_Apr2025)

a209775a4c1263743eed4602bd6e282c6fcd9874.source_text: [Gamaredon Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0047) has used GitHub repositories for downloaders which will be obtained by the group's .NET executable on the compromised system.(Citation: ESET Gamaredon June 2020)
a209775a4c1263743eed4602bd6e282c6fcd9874.zh: [Gamaredon Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0047) 已使用 GitHub 仓库中的下载器，这些下载器将被受害者系统上该组织的 .NET 可执行文件获取。（引用：ESET Gamaredon 2020年6月）

996abcc2cbffe0348dc1e79a0f0417747df4232e.source_text: [Moafee](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0002) is a threat group that appears to operate from the Guandong Province of China. Due to overlapping TTPs, including similar custom tools, Moafee is thought to have a direct or indirect relationship with the threat group [DragonOK](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0017). (Citation: Haq 2014)
996abcc2cbffe0348dc1e79a0f0417747df4232e.zh: [Moafee](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0002) 是一个被认为在中国广东省活动的威胁组织。由于在 TTPs（战术、技术和程序）上存在重叠，包括使用类似的定制工具，Moafee 被认为与威胁组织 [DragonOK](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0017) 存在直接或间接的关系。（引用来源：Haq 2014）

32afc3bd0a5cfef8c81537dcf51ac50cbe92d44e.source_text: [Gallmaker](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0084) is a cyberespionage group that has targeted victims in the Middle East and has been active since at least December 2017. The group has mainly targeted victims in the defense, military, and government sectors.(Citation: Symantec Gallmaker Oct 2018)
32afc3bd0a5cfef8c81537dcf51ac50cbe92d44e.zh: [Gallmaker](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0084) 是一个网络间谍组织，已针对中东地区的受害者发动攻击，且自2017年12月以来一直在活动。该组织主要 targeting 国防、军事和政府部门的受害者。（来源：Symantec Gallmaker Oct 2018）

02b91f8c403a9f8fd006e720b57fab70b65d8113.source_text: [Storm-1811](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1046) is a financially-motivated entity linked to [Black Basta](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1070) ransomware deployment. [Storm-1811](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1046) is notable for unique phishing and social engineering mechanisms for initial access, such as overloading victim email inboxes with non-malicious spam to prompt a fake "help desk" interaction leading to the deployment of adversary tools and capabilities.(Citation: Microsoft Storm-1811 2024)(Citation: rapid7-email-bombing)(Citation: RedCanary Storm-1811 2024)(Citation: RedCanary June Insights 2024)
02b91f8c403a9f8fd006e720b57fab70b65d8113.zh: [Storm-1811](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1046) 是一个以经济利益为动机的实体，与 [Black Basta](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1070) 勒索软件的部署相关联。[Storm-1811](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1046) 以其用于初始访问的独特网络钓鱼和社会工程机制而著称，例如通过向受害者邮箱发送大量非恶意垃圾邮件来过载收件箱，从而诱发虚假的“帮助台”互动，进而导致敌方工具和能力的部署。(Citation: Microsoft Storm-1811 2024)(Citation: rapid7-email-bombing)(Citation: RedCanary Storm-1811 2024)(Citation: RedCanary June Insights 2024)

fb77ae3b1af2b7f72147b31209949a2ba2080a98.source_text: [Storm-1811](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1046) has abused multiple types of legitimate remote access software and tools, such as ScreenConnect, NetSupport Manager, and AnyDesk.(Citation: Microsoft Storm-1811 2024)(Citation: rapid7-email-bombing)
fb77ae3b1af2b7f72147b31209949a2ba2080a98.zh: [Storm-1811](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1046) 滥用多种类型的合法远程访问软件和工具，例如 ScreenConnect、NetSupport Manager 和 AnyDesk。（出处：Microsoft Storm-1811 2024）（出处：rapid7-email-bombing）

1731048c40ffea757d9f45a6ea06da357d6c9423.source_text: [Storm-1811](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1046) has used scripted `cURL` commands, [BITSAdmin](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0190), and other mechanisms to retrieve follow-on batch scripts and tools for execution on victim devices.(Citation: Microsoft Storm-1811 2024)(Citation: rapid7-email-bombing)(Citation: RedCanary June Insights 2024)
1731048c40ffea757d9f45a6ea06da357d6c9423.zh: [Storm-1811](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1046) 已使用脚本化的 `cURL` 命令、[BITSAdmin](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0190) 和其他机制，以便在受害设备上检索并执行后续批处理脚本和工具。(Citation: Microsoft Storm-1811 2024)(Citation: rapid7-email-bombing)(Citation: RedCanary June Insights 2024)

e9f67f111eedb4d4e3fba605cea58a458725c9ed.source_text: [Leafminer](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0077) is an Iranian threat group that has targeted government organizations and business entities in the Middle East since at least early 2017. (Citation: Symantec Leafminer July 2018)
e9f67f111eedb4d4e3fba605cea58a458725c9ed.zh: [Leafminer](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0077) 是一个伊朗威胁组织，自2017年初至少以来就针对中东地区的政府机构和商业实体进行攻击。（来源：Symantec Leafminer July 2018）

5b649af28dcc9084c78660e2e7ca0cc076d1d2d0.source_text: [TeamTNT](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0139) is a threat group that has primarily targeted cloud and containerized environments. The group as been active since at least October 2019 and has mainly focused its efforts on leveraging cloud and container resources to deploy cryptocurrency miners in victim environments.(Citation: Palo Alto Black-T October 2020)(Citation: Lacework TeamTNT May 2021)(Citation: Intezer TeamTNT September 2020)(Citation: Cado Security TeamTNT Worm August 2020)(Citation: Unit 42 Hildegard Malware)(Citation: Trend Micro TeamTNT)(Citation: ATT TeamTNT Chimaera September 2020)(Citation: Aqua TeamTNT August 2020)(Citation: Intezer TeamTNT Explosion September 2021)
5b649af28dcc9084c78660e2e7ca0cc076d1d2d0.zh: [TeamTNT](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0139)是一个主要针对云环境和容器化环境进行攻击的攻击组织。该组织至少自2019年10月起开始活动，其主要工作重心是利用云和容器资源在受害者环境中部署加密货币矿工。（Citation: Palo Alto Black-T October 2020）(Citation: Lacework TeamTNT May 2021)(Citation: Intezer TeamTNT September 2020)(Citation: Cado Security TeamTNT Worm August 2020)(Citation: Unit 42 Hildegard Malware)(Citation: Trend Micro TeamTNT)(Citation: ATT TeamTNT Chimaera September 2020)(Citation: Aqua TeamTNT August 2020)(Citation: Intezer TeamTNT Explosion September 2021)

6fe4aa2df27db88f391eab0f09065ff266e4880f.source_text: [TeamTNT](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0139) has established tmate sessions for C2 communications.(Citation: Unit 42 Hildegard Malware)(Citation: Cisco Talos Intelligence Group)
6fe4aa2df27db88f391eab0f09065ff266e4880f.zh: [TeamTNT](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0139) 已建立 tmate 会话用于 C2 通信。（引用：Unit 42 Hildegard Malware）（引用：Cisco Talos Intelligence Group）

896d5d963142316d3311e8b2c3a1d0e2b718b592.source_text: [TeamTNT](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0139) has the curl and wget commands as well as batch scripts to download new tools.(Citation: Intezer TeamTNT September 2020)(Citation: Cisco Talos Intelligence Group)
896d5d963142316d3311e8b2c3a1d0e2b718b592.zh: [TeamTNT](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0139) 拥有 curl 和 wget 命令以及批处理脚本，用于下载新工具。(Citation: Intezer TeamTNT September 2020)(Citation: Cisco Talos Intelligence Group)

af83d844ef3c3da81b84e5ef2d08a4325019cba8.source_text: Adversaries may communicate using OSI application layer protocols to avoid detection/network filtering by blending in with existing traffic. Commands to the remote system, and often the results of those commands, will be embedded within the protocol traffic between the client and server. Adversaries may utilize many different protocols, including those used for web browsing, transferring files, electronic mail, DNS, or publishing/subscribing. For connections that occur internally within an enclave (such as those between a proxy or pivot node and other nodes), commonly used protocols are SMB, SSH, or RDP.(Citation: Mandiant APT29 Eye Spy Email Nov 22)
af83d844ef3c3da81b84e5ef2d08a4325019cba8.zh: 对手可能使用 OSI 应用层协议进行通信，以通过在现有流量中混入自身数据来避免检测/网络过滤。对远程系统的命令以及这些命令的结果通常会被嵌入在客户端与服务器之间的协议流量中。对手可能会使用多种不同的协议，包括用于网页浏览、文件传输、电子邮件、DNS 或发布/订阅的协议。对于在安全域内部（例如代理或跳板节点与其他节点之间）发生的连接，常用的协议是 SMB、SSH 或 RDP。(Citation: Mandiant APT29 Eye Spy Email Nov 22)

db225135c8f96a14cf836dd419bbfa7f8b988458.source_text: [TeamTNT](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0139) has used an IRC bot for C2 communications.(Citation: Trend Micro TeamTNT)
db225135c8f96a14cf836dd419bbfa7f8b988458.zh: [TeamTNT](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0139) 曾使用 IRC 机器人进行 C2 通信。(Citation: Trend Micro TeamTNT)

40bceec809f0180588975078745c9b3e8faf64de.source_text: [TeamTNT](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0139) has the `curl` command to send credentials over HTTP and the `curl` and `wget` commands to download new software.(Citation: Intezer TeamTNT September 2020)(Citation: Cado Security TeamTNT Worm August 2020)(Citation: Cisco Talos Intelligence Group) [TeamTNT](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0139) has also used a custom user agent HTTP header in shell scripts.(Citation: Trend Micro TeamTNT)
40bceec809f0180588975078745c9b3e8faf64de.zh: [TeamTNT](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0139) 使用 `curl` 命令通过 HTTP 发送凭据，并使用 `curl` 和 `wget` 命令下载新软件。(Citation: Intezer TeamTNT September 2020)(Citation: Cado Security TeamTNT Worm August 2020)(Citation: Cisco Talos Intelligence Group) [TeamTNT](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0139) 还在 shell 脚本中使用了自定义的 HTTP User-Agent 头。(Citation: Trend Micro TeamTNT)

ebb8203202d43c0a08e4f29c52180d6f78ba41e6.source_text: [TeamTNT](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0139) has leveraged iplogger.org to send collected data back to C2.(Citation: Aqua TeamTNT August 2020)(Citation: Cisco Talos Intelligence Group)
ebb8203202d43c0a08e4f29c52180d6f78ba41e6.zh: [TeamTNT](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0139) 已利用 iplogger.org 将收集的数据发送回 C2。（引用：Aqua TeamTNT 2020年8月）（引用：Cisco Talos Intelligence Group）

2c77d78ab5ab41541f295ff4c91d47d77ada9b9f.source_text: [FIN7](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0046) is a financially-motivated threat group that has been active since 2013. [FIN7](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0046) has targeted the retail, restaurant, hospitality, software, consulting, financial services, medical equipment, cloud services, media, food and beverage, transportation, pharmaceutical, and utilities industries in the United States. A portion of [FIN7](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0046) was operated out of a front company called Combi Security and often used point-of-sale malware for targeting efforts. Since 2020, [FIN7](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0046) shifted operations to big game hunting (BGH), including use of [REvil](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0496) ransomware and their own Ransomware-as-a-Service (RaaS), Darkside. FIN7 may be linked to the [Carbanak](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0008) Group, but multiple threat groups have been observed using [Carbanak](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0030), leading these groups to be tracked separately.(Citation: FireEye FIN7 March 2017)(Citation: FireEye FIN7 April 2017)(Citation: FireEye CARBANAK June 2017)(Citation: FireEye FIN7 Aug 2018)(Citation: CrowdStrike Carbon Spider August 2021)(Citation: Mandiant FIN7 Apr 2022)(Citation: BiZone Lizar May 2021)
2c77d78ab5ab41541f295ff4c91d47d77ada9b9f.zh: [FIN7](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0046) 是一个自 2013 年以来一直活跃的经济动机威胁组织。[FIN7](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0046) 针对美国零售、餐饮、酒店、软件、咨询、金融服务、医疗设备、云服务、媒体、食品饮料、交通、制药和公用事业行业。（Citation: FireEye FIN7 March 2017）（Citation: FireEye FIN7 April 2017）（Citation: FireEye CARBANAK June 2017）（Citation: FireEye FIN7 Aug 2018）（Citation: CrowdStrike Carbon Spider August 2021）（Citation: Mandiant FIN7 Apr 2022）（Citation: BiZone Lizar May 2021）其中一部分 [FIN7](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0046) 活动通过一家名为 Combi Security 的前台公司运作，并经常使用销售点（POS）恶意软件进行目标攻击。（Citation: FireEye FIN7 March 2017）（Citation: FireEye FIN7 April 2017）（Citation: FireEye CARBANAK June 2017）（Citation: FireEye FIN7 Aug 2018）（Citation: CrowdStrike Carbon Spider August 2021）（Citation: Mandiant FIN7 Apr 2022）（Citation: BiZone Lizar May 2021）自 2020 年起，[FIN7](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0046) 将行动转向大型狩猎（BGH）模式，包括使用 [REvil](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0496) 勒索软件及其自身的勒索即服务（RaaS）产品 Darkside。（Citation: FireEye FIN7 March 2017）（Citation: FireEye FIN7 April 2017）（Citation: FireEye CARBANAK June 2017）（Citation: FireEye FIN7 Aug 2018）（Citation: CrowdStrike Carbon Spider August 2021）（Citation: Mandiant FIN7 Apr 2022）（Citation: BiZone Lizar May 2021）[FIN7](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0046) 可能与 [Carbanak](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0008) 组织有关联，但由于多个威胁组织已被观察到使用 [Carbanak](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0030)，这些组织被单独追踪。（Citation: FireEye FIN7 March 2017）（Citation: FireEye FIN7 April 2017）（Citation: FireEye CARBANAK June 2017）（Citation: FireEye FIN7 Aug 2018）（Citation: CrowdStrike Carbon Spider August 2021）（Citation: Mandiant FIN7 Apr 2022）（Citation: BiZone Lizar May 2021）

abd575a39a4adc240aab024574c043de0be00f96.source_text: [FIN7](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0046) has utilized the remote management tool Atera to download malware to a compromised system.(Citation: Mandiant FIN7 Apr 2022)
abd575a39a4adc240aab024574c043de0be00f96.zh: [FIN7](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0046) 利用远程管理工具 Atera 将恶意软件下载到被入侵的系统。(Citation: Mandiant FIN7 Apr 2022)

1391d23eb794697f88d716406b6aa9fc7486e32e.source_text: [FIN7](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0046) has tunneled C2 traffic via OpenSSH.(Citation: BlackBerry_FIN7_April2024)
1391d23eb794697f88d716406b6aa9fc7486e32e.zh: [FIN7](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0046) 通过 OpenSSH 隧道传输了 C2 流量。(Citation: BlackBerry_FIN7_April2024)

34c6f0779f563d9864b7f38c59851929c66c4002.source_text: [FIN7](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0046) has used port-protocol mismatches on ports such as 53, 80, 443, and 8080 during C2.(Citation: FireEye FIN7 Aug 2018) [FIN7](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0046) has used TCP ports 59999 and 9898 for firewall rules.(Citation: BlackBerry_FIN7_April2024)
34c6f0779f563d9864b7f38c59851929c66c4002.zh: [FIN7](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0046) 在C2通信中曾使用过53、80、443和8080等端口上的端口-协议不匹配情况。（引用：FireEye FIN7 Aug 2018）[FIN7](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0046) 曾使用TCP端口59999和9898进行防火墙规则配置。（引用：BlackBerry_FIN7_April2024）

5bb7e5bf0451acfb3c903ffbc4d76790694d65ee.source_text: [FIN7](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0046) used legitimate services like Google Docs, Google Scripts, and Pastebin for C2.(Citation: FireEye FIN7 Aug 2018)
5bb7e5bf0451acfb3c903ffbc4d76790694d65ee.zh: [FIN7](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0046) 使用合法服务（如 Google Docs、Google Scripts 和 Pastebin）进行命令与控制通信。（引用：FireEye FIN7 2018年8月报告）

2a1bb4dc39ebd47ecc0561b3f5bef31d3c13f7d3.source_text: [FIN7](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0046) has downloaded additional malware to execute on the victim's machine, including by using a PowerShell script to launch shellcode that retrieves an additional payload.(Citation: FireEye FIN7 April 2017)(Citation: DOJ FIN7 Aug 2018)(Citation: Mandiant FIN7 Apr 2022)(Citation: Gemini_FIN7_Jan2022)
2a1bb4dc39ebd47ecc0561b3f5bef31d3c13f7d3.zh: [FIN7](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0046) 已下载更多恶意软件在受害者计算机上执行，包括使用 PowerShell 脚本启动 shellcode 以检索其他有效载荷。(Citation: FireEye FIN7 April 2017)(Citation: DOJ FIN7 Aug 2018)(Citation: Mandiant FIN7 Apr 2022)(Citation: Gemini_FIN7_Jan2022)

51e148e863126ea45f17fb830d73fc991a76c4cc.source_text: [FIN7](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0046) has performed C2 using DNS via A, OPT, and TXT records.(Citation: FireEye FIN7 Aug 2018)
51e148e863126ea45f17fb830d73fc991a76c4cc.zh: [FIN7](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0046) 通过 A、OPT 和 TXT 记录使用 DNS 进行 C2。(Citation: FireEye FIN7 Aug 2018)

75b65deb178456f43d5abba408b8ea7dfa43f3dd.source_text: [FIN7](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0046)'s Harpy backdoor malware can use DNS as a backup channel for C2 if HTTP fails.(Citation: Crowdstrike GTR2020 Mar 2020)
75b65deb178456f43d5abba408b8ea7dfa43f3dd.zh: [FIN7](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0046) 的 Harpy 后门恶意软件可以在 HTTP 失败时使用 DNS 作为 C2 的备用通道。(Citation: Crowdstrike GTR2020 Mar 2020)

f6522bd8e234f02b7c579e6b3cc8813c23f3a7ef.source_text: [Sandworm Team](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0034) is a destructive threat group that has been attributed to Russia's General Staff Main Intelligence Directorate (GRU) Main Center for Special Technologies (GTsST) military unit 74455.(Citation: US District Court Indictment GRU Unit 74455 October 2020)(Citation: UK NCSC Olympic Attacks October 2020) This group has been active since at least 2009.(Citation: iSIGHT Sandworm 2014)(Citation: CrowdStrike VOODOO BEAR)(Citation: USDOJ Sandworm Feb 2020)(Citation: NCSC Sandworm Feb 2020) In October 2020, the US indicted six GRU Unit 74455 officers associated with [Sandworm Team](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0034) for the following cyber operations: the 2015 and 2016 attacks against Ukrainian electrical companies and government organizations, the 2017 worldwide [NotPetya](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0368) attack, targeting of the 2017 French presidential campaign, the 2018 [Olympic Destroyer](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0365) attack against the Winter Olympic Games, the 2018 operation against the Organisation for the Prohibition of Chemical Weapons, and attacks against the country of Georgia in 2018 and 2019.(Citation: US District Court Indictment GRU Unit 74455 October 2020)(Citation: UK NCSC Olympic Attacks October 2020) Some of these were conducted with the assistance of GRU Unit 26165, which is also referred to as [APT28](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0007).(Citation: US District Court Indictment GRU Oct 2018)
f6522bd8e234f02b7c579e6b3cc8813c23f3a7ef.zh: [Sandworm Team](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0034) 是一个破坏性威胁组织，被归因于俄罗斯总参谋部情报总局（GRU）特别技术中心（GTsST）军事单位74455。(Citation: US District Court Indictment GRU Unit 74455 October 2020)(Citation: UK NCSC Olympic Attacks October 2020) 该组织至少从2009年起就已活跃。(Citation: iSIGHT Sandworm 2014)(Citation: CrowdStrike VOODOO BEAR)(Citation: USDOJ Sandworm Feb 2020)(Citation: NCSC Sandworm Feb 2020) 2020年10月，美国对六名与[Sandworm Team](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0034)有关的GRU单位74455军官提起诉讼，指控其参与以下网络行动：2015年和2016年针对乌克兰电力公司和政府机构的攻击、2017年全球[NotPetya](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0368)攻击、对2017年法国总统竞选活动的目标打击、2018年针对冬季奥运会的[Olympic Destroyer](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0365)攻击、2018年针对禁止化学武器组织的行动，以及2018年和2019年对格鲁吉亚的攻击。(Citation: US District Court Indictment GRU Unit 74455 October 2020)(Citation: UK NCSC Olympic Attacks October 2020) 其中一些行动是在GRU单位26165的帮助下实施的，该单位也被称为[APT28](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0007)。(Citation: US District Court Indictment GRU Oct 2018)

627d4cf17a306cf34601b2ea77322b08173d2041.source_text: [Sandworm Team](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0034)'s BCS-server tool uses base64 encoding and HTML tags for the communication traffic between the C2 server.(Citation: ESET Telebots Dec 2016)
627d4cf17a306cf34601b2ea77322b08173d2041.zh: [Sandworm Team](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0034)的BCS-server工具使用base64编码和HTML标签进行C2服务器之间的通信流量。(引用：ESET Telebots 2016年12月)

8ce54c652f86309603220aa8349fe3d01c75a829.source_text: [Sandworm Team](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0034)'s BCS-server tool can create an internal proxy server to redirect traffic from the adversary-controlled C2 to internal servers which may not be connected to the internet, but are interconnected locally.(Citation: ESET Telebots Dec 2016)
8ce54c652f86309603220aa8349fe3d01c75a829.zh: [Sandworm Team](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0034) 的 BCS-server 工具可以创建一个内部代理服务器，将来自攻击者控制的 C2 的流量重定向到内部服务器，这些内部服务器可能未连接到互联网，但在本地是相互连接的。(Citation: ESET Telebots Dec 2016)

c2787c009d300b7abacc64d610ecb7d00d133e6d.source_text: [Sandworm Team](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0034) has used port 6789 to accept connections on the group's SSH server.(Citation: ESET BlackEnergy Jan 2016)
c2787c009d300b7abacc64d610ecb7d00d133e6d.zh: [Sandworm团队](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0034)曾使用端口6789在其组织的SSH服务器上接受连接。（出处：ESET BlackEnergy 2016年1月）

2ac5a616411ed26427f5c1ca7397d6169df0efaf.source_text: [Sandworm Team](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0034) has used remote administration tools or remote industrial control system client software for execution and to maliciously release electricity breakers.(Citation: US-CERT Ukraine Feb 2016)(Citation: Microsoft Prestige ransomware October 2022)
2ac5a616411ed26427f5c1ca7397d6169df0efaf.zh: [Sandworm Team](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0034) 曾使用远程管理工具或远程工业控制系统客户端软件执行恶意操作，包括故意释放电力断路器。(Citation: US-CERT Ukraine Feb 2016)(Citation: Microsoft Prestige ransomware October 2022)

cb9086495a357c11fc274bd6f26f8212468c40aa.source_text: [Sandworm Team](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0034) has used the Telegram Bot API from Telegram Messenger to send and receive commands to its Python backdoor. [Sandworm Team](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0034) also used legitimate M.E.Doc software update check requests for sending and receiving commands and hosted malicious payloads on putdrive.com.(Citation: ESET Telebots Dec 2016)(Citation: ESET Telebots June 2017)
cb9086495a357c11fc274bd6f26f8212468c40aa.zh: [Sandworm Team](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0034) 使用 Telegram Messenger 的 Telegram Bot API 向其 Python 后门发送和接收指令。[Sandworm Team](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0034) 还利用合法的 M.E.Doc 软件更新检查请求来发送和接收指令，并在 putdrive.com 上托管恶意有效载荷。（出处：ESET Telebots Dec 2016）（出处：ESET Telebots June 2017）

358d6a3119571c65258b714cd246e11d3d93c1a6.source_text: [Sandworm Team](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0034) has pushed additional malicious tools onto an infected system to steal user credentials, move laterally, and destroy data.(Citation: ESET Telebots Dec 2016)(Citation: US District Court Indictment GRU Unit 74455 October 2020)
358d6a3119571c65258b714cd246e11d3d93c1a6.zh: [Sandworm Team](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0034) 已将其他恶意工具部署到已感染的系统上，以窃取用户凭据、横向移动并破坏数据。（引用：ESET Telebots Dec 2016）（引用：美国地区法院起诉书 GRU Unit 74455 October 2020）

38757264178e40b98b30e08fece489c3ed2a61a5.source_text: [Sandworm Team](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0034)'s BCS-server tool connects to the designated C2 server via HTTP.(Citation: ESET Telebots Dec 2016)
38757264178e40b98b30e08fece489c3ed2a61a5.zh: [Sandworm Team](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0034)的BCS-server工具通过HTTP连接到指定的C2服务器。(引用：ESET Telebots 2016年12月)

623a73f683581c29a1f0e83e6f25cdacde3713ec.source_text: Adversaries may use a connection proxy to direct network traffic between systems or act as an intermediary for network communications. The definition of a proxy can also be expanded to encompass trust relationships between networks in peer-to-peer, mesh, or trusted connections between networks consisting of hosts or systems that regularly communicate with each other. The network may be within a single organization or across multiple organizations with trust relationships. Adversaries could use these types of relationships to manage command and control communications, to reduce the number of simultaneous outbound network connections, to provide resiliency in the face of connection loss, or to ride over existing trusted communications paths between victims to avoid suspicion. (Citation: Enterprise ATT&CK January 2018)
623a73f683581c29a1f0e83e6f25cdacde3713ec.zh: 攻击者可以使用连接代理来指导系统之间的网络流量，或作为网络通信的中介。代理的定义也可以扩展为涵盖对等、网状结构或具有信任关系的网络之间由定期相互通信的主机或系统组成的受信任连接。该网络可能位于单个组织内部，也可能跨越多个具有信任关系的组织。攻击者可以利用这些类型的关系来管理命令与控制通信、减少同时进行的出站网络连接数量、在连接丢失时提供弹性，或利用受害者之间现有受信任的通信路径以避免怀疑。(Citation: Enterprise ATT&CK January 2018)

d4e9ceaadfb9e847a5cd26939f17eaf09af280d7.source_text: [Sandworm Team](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0034) establishes an internal proxy prior to the installation of backdoors within the network. (Citation: Dragos Inc. June 2017)
d4e9ceaadfb9e847a5cd26939f17eaf09af280d7.zh: [Sandworm Team](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0034)在在网络中安装后门之前建立内部代理。(Citation: Dragos Inc. June 2017)

7b76dbaaf9bee727d7e22c54fac9e97c69b13370.source_text: [Machete](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0095) is a suspected Spanish-speaking cyber espionage group that has been active since at least 2010. It has primarily focused its operations within Latin America, with a particular emphasis on Venezuela, but also in the US, Europe, Russia, and parts of Asia. [Machete](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0095) generally targets high-profile organizations such as government institutions, intelligence services, and military units, as well as telecommunications and power companies.(Citation: Cylance Machete Mar 2017)(Citation: Securelist Machete Aug 2014)(Citation: ESET Machete July 2019)(Citation: 360 Machete Sep 2020)
7b76dbaaf9bee727d7e22c54fac9e97c69b13370.zh: [Machete](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0095) 是一个被怀疑为说西班牙语的网络间谍组织，自2010年至少起就已活跃。该组织主要在其拉美地区的行动中集中力量，特别是对委内瑞拉的关注尤为突出，同时也在美国、欧洲、俄罗斯和亚洲的部分地区开展活动。[Machete](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0095) 通常针对高价值目标组织，如政府机构、情报服务和军事单位，以及电信和电力公司。（引文：Cylance Machete Mar 2017）（引文：Securelist Machete Aug 2014）（引文：ESET Machete July 2019）（引文：360 Machete Sep 2020）

becc294fe544b4eca6157738c8bd31cd457c2c69.source_text: [APT18](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0026) is a threat group that has operated since at least 2009 and has targeted a range of industries, including technology, manufacturing, human rights groups, government, and medical. (Citation: Dell Lateral Movement)
becc294fe544b4eca6157738c8bd31cd457c2c69.zh: [APT18](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0026) 是一个自至少2009年以来一直在活动的威胁组织，其目标涵盖多个行业，包括科技、制造、人权组织、政府和医疗。（引用：Dell横向移动）

4ff6d456bb97cd4bf955ed9c37aa27feeb3b1fa2.source_text: [APT18](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0026) can upload a file to the victim’s machine.(Citation: PaloAlto DNS Requests May 2016)
4ff6d456bb97cd4bf955ed9c37aa27feeb3b1fa2.zh: [APT18](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0026) 可以将文件上传到受害者的机器上。(Citation: PaloAlto DNS Requests May 2016)

2628ca91c80f78342efb24147f538927658a7a08.source_text: [APT18](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0026) uses DNS for C2 communications.(Citation: PaloAlto DNS Requests May 2016)
2628ca91c80f78342efb24147f538927658a7a08.zh: [APT18](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0026) 使用 DNS 进行 C2 通信。（Citation: PaloAlto DNS Requests May 2016）

247bd0220eb014c588e7dd5b9da730c49d303b95.source_text: [APT18](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0026) uses HTTP for C2 communications.(Citation: PaloAlto DNS Requests May 2016)
247bd0220eb014c588e7dd5b9da730c49d303b95.zh: [APT18](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0026) 使用 HTTP 进行 C2 通信。(Citation: PaloAlto DNS Requests May 2016)

d9893b6bd927babd42b4a7e84a5f35ae47687dd8.source_text: [Andariel](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0138) is a North Korean state-sponsored threat group that has been active since at least 2009. [Andariel](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0138) has primarily focused its operations--which have included destructive attacks--against South Korean government agencies, military organizations, and a variety of domestic companies; they have also conducted cyber financial operations against ATMs, banks, and cryptocurrency exchanges. [Andariel](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0138)'s notable activity includes Operation Black Mine, Operation GoldenAxe, and Campaign Rifle.(Citation: FSI Andariel Campaign Rifle July 2017)(Citation: IssueMakersLab Andariel GoldenAxe May 2017)(Citation: AhnLab Andariel Subgroup of Lazarus June 2018)(Citation: TrendMicro New Andariel Tactics July 2018)(Citation: CrowdStrike Silent Chollima Adversary September 2021) [Andariel](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0138) is considered a sub-set of [Lazarus Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0032), and has been attributed to North Korea's Reconnaissance General Bureau.(Citation: Treasury North Korean Cyber Groups September 2019) North Korean group definitions are known to have significant overlap, and some security researchers report all North Korean state-sponsored cyber activity under the name [Lazarus Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0032) instead of tracking clusters or subgroups.
