d9893b6bd927babd42b4a7e84a5f35ae47687dd8.zh: [Andariel](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0138) 是一个至少自2009年以来一直活跃的可追溯至朝鲜国家的威胁组织。[Andariel](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0138) 主要将其活动（包括破坏性攻击）针对韩国政府机构、军事组织以及各种国内公司；他们还针对自动柜员机 (ATM)、银行和加密货币交易所进行了网络金融犯罪活动。(Citation: FSI Andariel Campaign Rifle July 2017)(Citation: IssueMakersLab Andariel GoldenAxe May 2017)(Citation: AhnLab Andariel Subgroup of Lazarus June 2018)(Citation: TrendMicro New Andariel Tactics July 2018)(Citation: CrowdStrike Silent Chollima Adversary September 2021)[Andariel](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0138) 被认为是 [Lazarus Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0032) 的子集，并已被归因于朝鲜的 reconnaissance general bureau（侦察总局）。(Citation: Treasury North Korean Cyber Groups September 2019)众所周知，朝鲜组织的定义存在显著重叠，一些安全研究人员将所有朝鲜国家支持的网络活动都统称为 [Lazarus Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0032)，而不是跟踪具体的集群或子组。

103dd820576b5bc5f3aa95a9d2c860410557d91b.source_text: [Andariel](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0138) has downloaded additional tools and malware onto compromised hosts.(Citation: AhnLab Andariel Subgroup of Lazarus June 2018)
103dd820576b5bc5f3aa95a9d2c860410557d91b.zh: [Andariel](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0138) 已在受 compromising 的主机上下载了额外的工具和恶意软件。(Citation: AhnLab Andariel Subgroup of Lazarus June 2018)

ff8393c4fe5943cc8754fc7ac9af06cd95436a51.source_text: [CURIUM](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1012) is an Iranian threat group, first reported in September 2019 and active since at least July 2018, targeting IT service providers in the Middle East.(Citation: Symantec Tortoiseshell 2019) [CURIUM](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1012) has since invested in building relationships with potential targets via social media over a period of months to establish trust and confidence before sending malware. Security researchers note [CURIUM](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1012) has demonstrated great patience and persistence by chatting with potential targets daily and sending benign files to help lower their security consciousness.(Citation: Microsoft Iranian Threat Actor Trends November 2021)
ff8393c4fe5943cc8754fc7ac9af06cd95436a51.zh: [CURIUM](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1012) 是一个伊朗威胁组织，于2019年9月首次被报告，自2018年7月至少就开始活跃，目标指向中东的IT服务提供商。(Citation: Symantec Tortoiseshell 2019) [CURIUM](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1012) 此后投入数月时间通过社交媒体与潜在目标建立关系，以在发送恶意软件之前建立信任和信心。安全研究人员指出，[CURIUM](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1012) 在与潜在目标每日交谈并发送无害文件以帮助降低其安全意识方面表现出了极大的耐心和持久性。(Citation: Microsoft Iranian Threat Actor Trends November 2021)

835db3012df36d5f6bdf16d8152b7b8f732ca67c.source_text: [Sidewinder](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0121) is a suspected Indian threat actor group that has been active since at least 2012. They have been observed targeting government, military, and business entities throughout Asia, primarily focusing on Pakistan, China, Nepal, and Afghanistan.(Citation: ATT Sidewinder January 2021)(Citation: Securelist APT Trends April 2018)(Citation: Cyble Sidewinder September 2020)
835db3012df36d5f6bdf16d8152b7b8f732ca67c.zh: [Sidewinder](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0121) 是一个涉嫌来自印度的威胁行为者组织，自至少2012年以来一直活跃。该组织被观察到针对亚洲各国的政府、军事和商业实体，主要关注巴基斯坦、中国、尼泊尔和阿富汗。(Citation: ATT Sidewinder January 2021)(Citation: Securelist APT Trends April 2018)(Citation: Cyble Sidewinder September 2020)

6fa9795cde080e3ef276648374ca66ee1ccec774.source_text: [Sidewinder](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0121) has used LNK files to download remote files to the victim's network.(Citation: ATT Sidewinder January 2021)(Citation: Cyble Sidewinder September 2020)
6fa9795cde080e3ef276648374ca66ee1ccec774.zh: [Sidewinder](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0121) 曾使用 LNK 文件将远程文件下载到受害者网络中。（引用：ATT Sidewinder 2021年1月）（引用：Cyble Sidewinder 2020年9月）

ef8a0fdc72d75a8da1789e4b07219cff14f02054.source_text: [Sidewinder](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0121) has used HTTP in C2 communications.(Citation: ATT Sidewinder January 2021)(Citation: Rewterz Sidewinder APT April 2020)(Citation: Rewterz Sidewinder COVID-19 June 2020)
ef8a0fdc72d75a8da1789e4b07219cff14f02054.zh: [Sidewinder](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0121) 在C2通信中使用了HTTP。(Citation: ATT Sidewinder January 2021)(Citation: Rewterz Sidewinder APT April 2020)(Citation: Rewterz Sidewinder COVID-19 June 2020)

3e3497860484a448579e696127313e3b42b9f75c.source_text: [Mustang Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0129) is a China-based cyber espionage threat actor that has been conducting operations since at least 2012. [Mustang Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0129) has been known to use tailored phishing lures and decoy documents to deliver malicious payloads. [Mustang Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0129) has targeted government, diplomatic, and non-governmental organizations, including think tanks, religious institutions, and research entities, across the United States, Europe, and Asia, with notable activity in Russia, Mongolia, Myanmar, Pakistan, and Vietnam. (Citation: BlackBerry MUSTANG PANDA October 2022)(Citation: Eset PlugX Korplug Mustang Panda March 2022)(Citation: Anomali MUSTANG PANDA October 2019)(Citation: Cisco Talos MUSTANG PANDA PLUGX PUBLOAD MAY 2022)(Citation: Secureworks BRONZE PRESIDENT December 2019)(Citation: DOJ Affidavit Search and Seizure PlugX December 2024)(Citation: EclecticIQ Mustang Panda PlugX)(Citation: ATTACKIQ MUSTANG PANDA TONESHELL March 2023)(Citation: Crowdstrike MUSTANG PANDA June 2018)(Citation: Palo Alto Networks, Unit 42)(Citation: Sophos PlugX September 2022)(Citation: Sophos Mustang Panda PLUGX)(Citation: Zscaler)
3e3497860484a448579e696127313e3b42b9f75c.zh: [Mustang Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0129) 是一个源自中国的网络间谍威胁行为者，自至少2012年以来一直在开展相关活动。据知，[Mustang Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0129) 使用量身定制的钓鱼诱饵文件和伪装文档来投递恶意负载。该组织 targeting 美国政府、外交机构和非政府组织，包括智库、宗教机构和研究实体，行动范围覆盖美国、欧洲和亚洲，在俄罗斯、蒙古、缅甸、巴基斯坦和越南等地有显著活动。(Citation: BlackBerry MUSTANG PANDA October 2022)(Citation: Eset PlugX Korplug Mustang Panda March 2022)(Citation: Anomali MUSTANG PANDA October 2019)(Citation: Cisco Talos MUSTANG PANDA PLUGX PUBLOAD MAY 2022)(Citation: Secureworks BRONZE PRESIDENT December 2019)(Citation: DOJ Affidavit Search and Seizure PlugX December 2024)(Citation: EclecticIQ Mustang Panda PlugX)(Citation: ATTACKIQ MUSTANG PANDA TONESHELL March 2023)(Citation: Crowdstrike MUSTANG PANDA June 2018)(Citation: Palo Alto Networks, Unit 42)(Citation: Sophos PlugX September 2022)(Citation: Sophos Mustang Panda PLUGX)(Citation: Zscaler)

676f58c930520e773cd654cb7cf530463301ad33.source_text: [Mustang Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0129) has encrypted C2 communications with RC4.(Citation: Eset PlugX Korplug Mustang Panda March 2022)(Citation: Recorded Future REDDELTA July 2020) [Mustang Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0129) has also leveraged encryption and compression algorithms to obfuscate the traffic between the system and C2 server, methods observed included RC4, AES, XOR with 0x5a, and LZO.(Citation: Unit42 Bookworm Nov2015)
676f58c930520e773cd654cb7cf530463301ad33.zh: [Mustang Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0129) 使用 RC4 对 C2 通信进行加密。(Citation: Eset PlugX Korplug Mustang Panda March 2022)(Citation: Recorded Future REDDELTA July 2020) [Mustang Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0129) 还利用加密和压缩算法来混淆系统与 C2 服务器之间的流量，观察到的方法包括 RC4、AES、与 0x5a 进行 XOR 运算以及 LZO。(Citation: Unit42 Bookworm Nov2015)

2add16e91e5bf49a6f90d338984dbbff98541d2e.source_text: Adversaries may abuse Integrated Development Environment (IDE) software with remote development features to establish an interactive command and control channel on target systems within a network. IDE tunneling combines SSH, port forwarding, file sharing, and debugging into a single secure connection, letting developers work on remote systems as if they were local. Unlike SSH and port forwarding, IDE tunneling encapsulates an entire session and may use proprietary tunneling protocols alongside SSH, allowing adversaries to blend in with legitimate development workflows. Some IDEs, like Visual Studio Code, also provide CLI tools (e.g., `code tunnel`) that adversaries may use to programmatically establish tunnels and generate web-accessible URLs for remote access. These tunnels can be authenticated through accounts such as GitHub, enabling the adversary to control the compromised system via a legitimate developer portal.(Citation: sentinelone operationDigitalEye Dec 2024)(Citation: Unit42 Chinese VSCode 06 September 2024)(Citation: Thornton tutorial VSCode shell September 2023) Additionally, adversaries may use IDE tunneling for persistence. Some IDEs, such as Visual Studio Code and JetBrains, support automatic reconnection. Adversaries may configure the IDE to auto-launch at startup, re-establishing the tunnel upon execution. Compromised developer machines may also be exploited as jump hosts to move further into the network. IDE tunneling tools may be built-in or installed as [IDE Extensions](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1176/002).
2add16e91e5bf49a6f90d338984dbbff98541d2e.zh: 攻击者可能会滥用具有远程开发功能的集成开发环境（IDE）软件，在目标系统的网络中建立交互式命令和控制通道。IDE 隧道技术将 SSH、端口转发、文件共享和调试功能整合到单一的安全连接中，使开发人员能够在远程系统上工作，如同操作本地系统一样。与传统的 SSH 和端口转发不同，IDE 隧道封装了整个会话，并可能在 SSH 的基础上使用专有隧道协议，使攻击者能够融入合法的开发工作流程。一些 IDE，例如 Visual Studio Code，还提供了命令行界面工具（如 `code tunnel`），攻击者可利用这些工具以编程方式建立隧道，并生成可供 Web 访问的 URL，用于远程访问。这些隧道可以通过 GitHub 等账户进行身份验证，从而使攻击者能够通过合法的开发者门户控制被攻陷的系统。(Citation: sentinelone operationDigitalEye Dec 2024)(Citation: Unit42 Chinese VSCode 06 September 2024)(Citation: Thornton tutorial VSCode shell September 2023) 此外，攻击者还可能利用 IDE 隧道技术实现持久化。Visual Studio Code 和 JetBrains 等部分 IDE 支持自动重连。攻击者可配置 IDE 以便在系统启动时自动启动，从而在执行时重新建立隧道。被攻陷的开发人员计算机还可被利用作为跳板机，以在网络中进一步横向移动。IDE 隧道工具可能是内置的，也可能是作为 [IDE 扩展](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1176/002) 安装的。

5deab5c6986ce023b83401fe032a3ebf45c8e314.source_text: [Mustang Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0129) has utilized an established Github account to create a tunnel within the victim environment using Visual Studio Code through the `code.exe tunnel` command.(Citation: Unit42 Chinese VSCode 06 September 2024)
5deab5c6986ce023b83401fe032a3ebf45c8e314.zh: [Mustang Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0129) 利用一个既有的 GitHub 账户，通过 `code.exe tunnel` 命令在受害者环境中使用 Visual Studio Code 创建了一个隧道。(Citation: Unit42 Chinese VSCode 06 September 2024)

b9f853cf4eec38d94d4a9fa838d7e1d094552ab0.source_text: [Mustang Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0129) has installed TeamViewer on targeted systems.(Citation: Secureworks BRONZE PRESIDENT December 2019)
b9f853cf4eec38d94d4a9fa838d7e1d094552ab0.zh: [Mustang Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0129) 已在目标系统上安装了 TeamViewer。(Citation: Secureworks BRONZE PRESIDENT December 2019)

9b55426637e6f756076b08323e192ccc787c98c2.source_text: [Mustang Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0129) has communicated with its C2 via HTTP POST requests.(Citation: Anomali MUSTANG PANDA October 2019)(Citation: Secureworks BRONZE PRESIDENT December 2019)(Citation: Recorded Future REDDELTA July 2020)(Citation: Unit42 Bookworm Nov2015)(Citation: McAfee Dianxun March 2021)
9b55426637e6f756076b08323e192ccc787c98c2.zh: [Mustang Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0129) 通过 HTTP POST 请求与其 C2 进行通信。(Citation: Anomali MUSTANG PANDA October 2019)(Citation: Secureworks BRONZE PRESIDENT December 2019)(Citation: Recorded Future REDDELTA July 2020)(Citation: Unit42 Bookworm Nov2015)(Citation: McAfee Dianxun March 2021)

a9ff9f8cac30c1bf54ab7cb591e2d3d5bdac8a26.source_text: Adversaries may impersonate legitimate protocols or web service traffic to disguise command and control activity and thwart analysis efforts. By impersonating legitimate protocols or web services, adversaries can make their command and control traffic blend in with legitimate network traffic. Adversaries may impersonate a fake SSL/TLS handshake to make it look like subsequent traffic is SSL/TLS encrypted, potentially interfering with some security tooling, or to make the traffic look like it is related with a trusted entity. Adversaries may also leverage legitimate protocols to impersonate expected web traffic or trusted services. For example, adversaries may manipulate HTTP headers, URI endpoints, SSL certificates, and transmitted data to disguise C2 communications or mimic legitimate services such as Gmail, Google Drive, and Yahoo Messenger.(Citation: ESET Okrum July 2019)(Citation: Malleable-C2-U42)
a9ff9f8cac30c1bf54ab7cb591e2d3d5bdac8a26.zh: 对手可能冒充合法协议或 Web 服务流量，以隐藏命令与控制（C2）活动并阻碍分析工作。通过冒充合法协议或 Web 服务，对手可以使其命令与控制流量与合法网络流量混同。对手可能伪造 SSL/TLS 握手，使后续流量看起来像是经过 SSL/TLS 加密的，从而可能干扰某些安全工具；或者使流量看起来与可信实体相关。对手还可以利用合法协议来冒充预期的 Web 流量或受信任的服务。例如，对手可能篡改 HTTP 头、URI 端点、SSL 证书以及传输数据，以伪装 C2 通信或模仿 Gmail、Google Drive 和 Yahoo Messenger 等合法服务。(Citation: ESET Okrum July 2019)(Citation: Malleable-C2-U42)

3c6e612cb657f5b0fc92c6f1acdbba5a30131258.source_text: [Mustang Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0129) has utilized TLS record headers in network packets to impersonate various versions of TLS protocols to blend in with legitimate network traffic. [Mustang Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0129) has used FakeTLS to communicate with its C2 servers.(Citation: Zscaler)
3c6e612cb657f5b0fc92c6f1acdbba5a30131258.zh: [Mustang Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0129) 利用网络包中的 TLS 记录头来伪装成不同版本的 TLS 协议，从而与合法的网络流量融合在一起。[Mustang Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0129) 使用 FakeTLS 与其 C2 服务器进行通信。（来源：Zscaler）

ea58808deeea2cf12d8f5f208360620f9e31ce7e.source_text: [Mustang Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0129) has utilized TCP-based reverse shells using cmd.exe.(Citation: Cisco Talos MUSTANG PANDA PLUGX PUBLOAD MAY 2022)
ea58808deeea2cf12d8f5f208360620f9e31ce7e.zh: [Mustang Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0129) 曾使用基于 TCP 的反向 shell，借助 cmd.exe 实现。（引用：Cisco Talos MUSTANG PANDA PLUGX PUBLOAD MAY 2022）

22c6418546d2ae33a7b7d1bcd7e70da90ded6e16.source_text: [Mustang Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0129) has downloaded additional executables following the initial infection stage.(Citation: Eset PlugX Korplug Mustang Panda March 2022)(Citation: Cisco Talos MUSTANG PANDA PLUGX PUBLOAD MAY 2022)(Citation: Recorded Future REDDELTA July 2020)(Citation: Sophos PlugX September 2022) [Mustang Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0129) has also leveraged Visual Studio Code `code.exe` and Dev Tunnels using `DevTunnel.exe` to propagate additional tools and payloads.(Citation: Unit42 Chinese VSCode 06 September 2024)
22c6418546d2ae33a7b7d1bcd7e70da90ded6e16.zh: [Mustang Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0129) 在初始感染阶段之后下载了其他可执行文件。(Citation: Eset PlugX Korplug Mustang Panda March 2022)(Citation: Cisco Talos MUSTANG PANDA PLUGX PUBLOAD MAY 2022)(Citation: Recorded Future REDDELTA July 2020)(Citation: Sophos PlugX September 2022) [Mustang Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0129) 还利用 Visual Studio Code `code.exe` 和 Dev Tunnels（使用 `DevTunnel.exe`）传播其他工具和有效载荷。(Citation: Unit42 Chinese VSCode 06 September 2024)

b18a22a77b3fda1d54b878d2677366db38c6dbaf.source_text: [Mustang Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0129) has leveraged OpenSSH (sshd.exe) to execute commands, transfer files and spread across the environment communicating over SMB port 445.(Citation: Unit42 Chinese VSCode 06 September 2024)
b18a22a77b3fda1d54b878d2677366db38c6dbaf.zh: [Mustang Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0129) 利用 OpenSSH（sshd.exe）执行命令、传输文件，并在环境中通过 SMB 端口 445 进行通信以实现横向移动。（Citation: Unit42 Chinese VSCode 06 September 2024）

d04b59876fe382104170f70277cd076046ea3f11.source_text: [Mustang Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0129) has used DropBox URLs to deliver variants of [PlugX](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0013).(Citation: Proofpoint TA416 Europe March 2022) [Mustang Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0129) has also used Google Drive to host malicious downloads.(Citation: IBM MUSTANG PANDA PUBLOAD CLAIMLOADER JUNE 2025)
d04b59876fe382104170f70277cd076046ea3f11.zh: [Mustang Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0129) 已使用 Dropbox 链接交付 [PlugX](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0013) 的多个变种。(Citation: Proofpoint TA416 Europe March 2022) [Mustang Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0129) 还曾利用 Google Drive 托管恶意下载文件。(Citation: IBM MUSTANG PANDA PUBLOAD CLAIMLOADER JUNE 2025)

8a12e9a5aa8d1d4a53843665c0262d20764ec3d3.source_text: [Mustang Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0129) has utilized a magic value in C2 communications and only executes in memory when response packets match specific values of “17 03 03” or “46 77 4d”.(Citation: CSIRT CTI MUSTANG PANDA PUBLOAD TONESHELL JAN 2024)
8a12e9a5aa8d1d4a53843665c0262d20764ec3d3.zh: [Mustang Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0129) 已在C2通信中利用了一个magic值，并且仅在响应数据包匹配“17 03 03”或“46 77 4d”的特定值时以内存方式执行。(Citation: CSIRT CTI MUSTANG PANDA PUBLOAD TONESHELL JAN 2024)

811ab8cc3d6be971e2fe5a809006d0ab605c1680.source_text: [ZIRCONIUM](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0128) is a threat group operating out of China, active since at least 2017, that has targeted individuals associated with the 2020 US presidential election and prominent leaders in the international affairs community.(Citation: Microsoft Targeting Elections September 2020)(Citation: Check Point APT31 February 2021)
811ab8cc3d6be971e2fe5a809006d0ab605c1680.zh: [ZIRCONIUM](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0128) 是一个源自中国的威胁组织，自至少2017年以来活跃，主要针对与2020年美国总统选举相关的人员以及国际事务领域的知名领导人。(Citation: Microsoft Targeting Elections September 2020)(Citation: Check Point APT31 February 2021)

39b6aa06474bde57c10dc9977bfbe16c1fc14b25.source_text: Adversaries may manipulate network traffic in order to hide and evade detection of their C2 infrastructure. This can be accomplished by identifying and filtering traffic from defensive tools,(Citation: TA571) masking malicious domains to obfuscate the true destination from both automated scanning tools and security researchers,(Citation: Schema-abuse)(Citation: Facad1ng)(Citation: Browser-updates) and otherwise hiding malicious artifacts to delay discovery and prolong the effectiveness of adversary infrastructure that could otherwise be identified, blocked, or taken down entirely. C2 networks may include the use of [Proxy](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1090) or VPNs to disguise IP addresses, which can allow adversaries to blend in with normal network traffic and bypass conditional access policies or anti-abuse protections. For example, an adversary may use a virtual private cloud to spoof their IP address to closer align with a victim's IP address ranges. This may also bypass security measures relying on geolocation of the source IP address.(Citation: sysdig)(Citation: Orange Residential Proxies) Adversaries may also attempt to filter network traffic in order to evade defensive tools in numerous ways, including blocking/redirecting common incident responder or security appliance user agents.(Citation: mod_rewrite)(Citation: SocGholish-update) Filtering traffic based on IP and geo-fencing may also avoid automated sandboxing or researcher activity (i.e., [Virtualization/Sandbox Evasion](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1497)).(Citation: TA571)(Citation: mod_rewrite) Hiding C2 infrastructure may also be supported by [Resource Development](https://attack.mitre.org/tactics/TA0042) activities such as [Acquire Infrastructure](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1583) and [Compromise Infrastructure](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1584). For example, using widely trusted hosting services or domains such as prominent URL shortening providers or marketing services for C2 networks may enable adversaries to present benign content that later redirects victims to malicious web pages or infrastructure once specific conditions are met.(Citation: StarBlizzard)(Citation: QR-cofense)
39b6aa06474bde57c10dc9977bfbe16c1fc14b25.zh: adversaries 可能操纵网络流量，以隐藏并规避对其 C2 基础设施的检测。这可以通过识别和过滤防御性工具发出的流量（引用：TA571）、掩盖恶意域名以同时欺骗自动扫描工具和安全研究人员（引用：Schema-abuse、Facad1ng、Browser-updates），以及隐藏其他恶意工件来延迟发现并延长对手基础设施的有效性——这些基础设施若未被隐藏则可能被识别、阻止或完全关闭。C2 网络可能使用 [代理](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1090) 或 VPN 来伪装 IP 地址，从而使对手能够融入正常网络流量并绕过基于条件的访问策略或反滥用保护机制。例如，对手可能利用虚拟私有云（VPC）来伪造其 IP 地址，使其更接近受害者的 IP 地址范围。这也可能绕过依赖源 IP 地址地理位置的安全措施（引用：sysdig、Orange Residential Proxies）。此外，对手还可能尝试通过多种方式过滤网络流量以规避防御性工具，包括阻止或重定向常见的应急响应人员或安全设备用户代理字符串（引用：mod_rewrite、SocGholish-update）。基于 IP 和地理围栏的流量过滤也可能用于规避自动化沙箱或研究人员活动（即 [虚拟化/沙箱逃逸](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1497)）（引用：TA571、mod_rewrite）。隐藏 C2 基础设施还可能得到 [资源开发](https://attack.mitre.org/tactics/TA0042) 活动的支持，例如 [获取基础设施](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1583) 和 [利用基础设施](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1584)。例如，对手使用广泛信任的主机服务或域名（如知名的 URL 缩短提供商或营销服务）作为 C2 网络的基础，可以在特定条件满足后向受害者展示看似无害的内容，随后将其重定向至恶意网页或基础设施（引用：StarBlizzard、QR-cofense）。

1a6afcf82131097e9da383874672b7837e6ae4a1.source_text: [ZIRCONIUM](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0128) has utilized an ORB (operational relay box) network – consisting compromised devices such as small office and home office (SOHO) routers, IoT devices, and leased virtual private servers (VPS) – to obfuscate the origin of C2 traffic.(Citation: ORB Mandiant)
1a6afcf82131097e9da383874672b7837e6ae4a1.zh: [ZIRCONIUM](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0128) 利用了由受感染的设备（包括小型办公室/家庭办公室（SOHO）路由器、物联网设备和租用的虚拟专用服务器（VPS））组成的操作中继盒（ORB）网络，以混淆命令与控制（C2）流量的来源。(Citation: ORB Mandiant)

7264f19a06c6d2549ae59edb1af26919d8608226.source_text: [ZIRCONIUM](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0128) has used AES encrypted communications in C2.(Citation: Zscaler APT31 Covid-19 October 2020)
7264f19a06c6d2549ae59edb1af26919d8608226.zh: [ZIRCONIUM](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0128) 在 C2（命令与控制）通信中使用了 AES 加密。(Citation: Zscaler APT31 Covid-19 October 2020)

a0e8636640f12b00d69bccf831228759e9554991.source_text: [ZIRCONIUM](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0128) has utilized an ORB (operational relay box) network – consisting compromised devices such as small office and home office (SOHO) routers, IoT devices, and leased virtual private servers (VPS) – to proxy traffic.(Citation: ORB Mandiant)
a0e8636640f12b00d69bccf831228759e9554991.zh: [ZIRCONIUM](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0128) 利用了一个由被入侵设备（如小型办公室/家庭办公室（SOHO）路由器、物联网设备和租用的虚拟专用服务器（VPS））组成的运营中继箱（ORB）网络来代理流量。（出处：Mandiant 的 ORB）

6178f2f77fdd01e4a607b576da8da1ed27b2c789.source_text: [ZIRCONIUM](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0128) has used tools to download malicious files to compromised hosts.(Citation: Zscaler APT31 Covid-19 October 2020)
6178f2f77fdd01e4a607b576da8da1ed27b2c789.zh: [ZIRCONIUM](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0128) 使用工具将恶意文件下载至被入侵的主机。（来源：Zscaler APT31 新冠状病毒 2020年10月）

088f3718d1a9a2467b1da0a391513f4493def253.source_text: [ZIRCONIUM](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0128) has used Dropbox for C2 allowing upload and download of files as well as execution of arbitrary commands.(Citation: Google Election Threats October 2020)(Citation: Zscaler APT31 Covid-19 October 2020)
088f3718d1a9a2467b1da0a391513f4493def253.zh: [ZIRCONIUM](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0128) 已使用 Dropbox 作为命令与控制（C2）通道，用于上传和下载文件以及执行任意命令。（引用：Google Election Threats October 2020）（引用：Zscaler APT31 Covid-19 October 2020）

13baa24614c3f708282c73b8b41f6a8a502a38ef.source_text: [Rocke](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0106) is an alleged Chinese-speaking adversary whose primary objective appeared to be cryptojacking, or stealing victim system resources for the purposes of mining cryptocurrency. The name [Rocke](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0106) comes from the email address "rocke@live.cn" used to create the wallet which held collected cryptocurrency. Researchers have detected overlaps between [Rocke](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0106) and the Iron Cybercrime Group, though this attribution has not been confirmed.(Citation: Talos Rocke August 2018)
13baa24614c3f708282c73b8b41f6a8a502a38ef.zh: [Rocke](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0106) 是一个据称使用中文的对手组织，其主要目标似乎是加密货币劫持，即窃取受害者系统资源以用于挖矿。[Rocke](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0106) 的名称来源于创建用于存放所获加密货币的钱包时所使用的电子邮件地址 "rocke@live.cn"。研究人员已发现 [Rocke](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0106) 与铁网犯罪集团（Iron Cybercrime Group）之间存在关联重叠，但该归属关系尚未得到证实。(Citation: Talos Rocke August 2018)

89e75e0c3291d1684c43ec06eb7113ec3264cc87.source_text: [Rocke](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0106) has used Pastebin, Gitee, and GitLab for Command and Control.(Citation: Anomali Rocke March 2019)(Citation: Talos Rocke August 2018)
89e75e0c3291d1684c43ec06eb7113ec3264cc87.zh: [Rocke](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0106) 曾使用 Pastebin、Gitee 和 GitLab 进行命令与控制（Citation: Anomali Rocke March 2019）(Citation: Talos Rocke August 2018)。

3d64d6da2b314d7f8d75b83ccb5ee15dfc4e0847.source_text: [Rocke](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0106) issued wget requests from infected systems to the C2.(Citation: Talos Rocke August 2018)
3d64d6da2b314d7f8d75b83ccb5ee15dfc4e0847.zh: [Rocke](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0106) 从受感染的系统向 C2 发起 wget 请求。(Citation: Talos Rocke August 2018)

12824ddf62f2f138224dd37598ee820f83b6ab9b.source_text: [Rocke](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0106) used malware to download additional malicious files to the target system.(Citation: Talos Rocke August 2018)
12824ddf62f2f138224dd37598ee820f83b6ab9b.zh: [Rocke](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0106) 使用恶意软件将其他恶意文件下载到目标系统。(Citation: Talos Rocke August 2018)

f92b2927a7fbab7cba1d31052192549268173972.source_text: [Rocke](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0106) has used Pastebin to check the version of beaconing malware and redirect to another Pastebin hosting updated malware.(Citation: Anomali Rocke March 2019)
f92b2927a7fbab7cba1d31052192549268173972.zh: [Rocke](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0106) 曾使用 Pastebin 检查信标恶意软件的版本，并重定向到另一个托管更新版恶意软件的 Pastebin 平台。(Citation: Anomali Rocke March 2019)

7cbc1ffc577589817a051b41de270629a01c57aa.source_text: [Rocke](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0106) has executed wget and curl commands to Pastebin over the HTTPS protocol.(Citation: Anomali Rocke March 2019)
7cbc1ffc577589817a051b41de270629a01c57aa.zh: [Rocke](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0106) 通过 HTTPS 协议执行了 wget 和 curl 命令访问 Pastebin。（引用：Anomali Rocke 2019年3月报告）

f7ec456a00a93e98348673df49862bb7473401cc.source_text: [Rocke](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0106)'s miner connects to a C2 server using port 51640.(Citation: Anomali Rocke March 2019)
f7ec456a00a93e98348673df49862bb7473401cc.zh: [Rocke](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0106) 的矿池通过端口 51640 连接到 C2 服务器。(引用：Anomali Rocke 2019年3月报告)

83113410de1b7020843552864783d3a59628a7a7.source_text: [Scattered Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1015) is a native English-speaking cybercriminal group active since at least 2022. (Citation: CrowdStrike Scattered Spider Profile) (Citation: MSTIC Octo Tempest Operations October 2023) The group initially targeted customer relationship management (CRM) providers, business process outsourcing (BPO) firms, and telecommunications and technology companies before expanding in 2023 to gaming, hospitality, retail, managed service provider (MSP), manufacturing, and financial sectors. (Citation: MSTIC Octo Tempest Operations October 2023) [Scattered Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1015) relies heavily on social engineering, including impersonating IT and help-desk staff, to gain initial access, bypass multi-factor authentication (MFA), and compromise enterprise networks. The group has adapted its tooling to evade endpoint detection and response (EDR) defenses and used ransomware for financial gain. (Citation: CISA Scattered Spider Advisory November 2023) (Citation: CrowdStrike Scattered Spider BYOVD January 2023) (Citation: Crowdstrike TELCO BPO Campaign December 2022) [Scattered Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1015) had expanded into hybrid cloud and identity environments, using help-desk impersonation and MFA bypass to obtain administrator access in Okta, AWS, and Office 365. (Citation: Mandiant UNC3944 May 2025)
83113410de1b7020843552864783d3a59628a7a7.zh: [Scattered Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1015) 是一个自2022年至少以来活跃的原生英语网络犯罪团伙。（出处：CrowdStrike Scattered Spider Profile）（出处：MSTIC Octo Tempest Operations October 2023）该团伙最初针对客户关系管理（CRM）提供商、业务流程外包（BPO）公司以及电信和技术公司，随后在2023年将目标扩展至游戏、酒店、零售、托管服务提供商（MSP）、制造和金融领域。（出处：MSTIC Octo Tempest Operations October 2023）[Scattered Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1015) 严重依赖社会工程学手段，包括冒充IT和支持台工作人员，以获取初始访问权限、绕过多重身份验证（MFA），并渗透企业网络。该团伙调整了其工具组合以规避终端检测与响应（EDR）防御，并使用勒索软件谋取经济利益。（出处：CISA Scattered Spider Advisory November 2023）（出处：CrowdStrike Scattered Spider BYOVD January 2023）（出处：Crowdstrike TELCO BPO Campaign December 2022）[Scattered Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1015) 已扩展到混合云和身份环境，利用支持台冒充和MFA绕过手段在Okta、AWS和Office 365中获取管理员访问权限。（出处：Mandiant UNC3944 May 2025）

ee86f5026c3bf115075ca4b3129921e116382d6a.source_text: [Scattered Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1015) has downloaded the Teleport remote access tool to compromised VMware vCenter Servers.(Citation: Mandiant VMware vSphere JUL 2025)
ee86f5026c3bf115075ca4b3129921e116382d6a.zh: [Scattered Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1015) 已将 Teleport 远程访问工具下载到被入侵的 VMware vCenter Server 上。（引用：Mandiant VMware vSphere JUL 2025）

3f25de28fa24ebb8a0eba284679f3c58cfa921b8.source_text: In addition to directing victims to run remote software, [Scattered Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1015) members themselves also deploy RMM software including TeamViewer, AnyDesk, LogMeIn, [ngrok](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0508), and [ConnectWise](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0591) to establish persistence on the compromised network.(Citation: CISA Scattered Spider Advisory November 2023)(Citation: Trellix Scattered Spider MO August 2023)(Citation: Mandiant UNC3944 May 2025)(Citation: CrowdStrike Scattered Spider JUL 2025)(Citation: Check Point Scattered Spider JUL 2025)
3f25de28fa24ebb8a0eba284679f3c58cfa921b8.zh: 除了指示受害者运行远程软件外，[Scattered Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1015) 成员自身也部署了包括 TeamViewer、AnyDesk、LogMeIn、[ngrok](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0508) 和 [ConnectWise](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0591) 在内的远程管理（RMM）软件，以在受 compromised 的网络中建立持久化。(Citation: CISA Scattered Spider Advisory November 2023)(Citation: Trellix Scattered Spider MO August 2023)(Citation: Mandiant UNC3944 May 2025)(Citation: CrowdStrike Scattered Spider JUL 2025)(Citation: Check Point Scattered Spider JUL 2025)

8c35790c42212fab31dcf05f47d3ecc4b90728b3.source_text: [Scattered Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1015) has used proxy networks to hamper detection and has installed legitimate proxy tools on VMware vCenter and adversary-controlled VMs.(Citation: CrowdStrike Scattered Spider JUL 2025)(Citation: CISA Scattered Spider Advisory November 2023)
8c35790c42212fab31dcf05f47d3ecc4b90728b3.zh: [Scattered Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1015) 已使用代理网络来阻碍检测，并在 VMware vCenter 以及攻击者控制的虚拟机上安装了合法的代理工具。(Citation: CrowdStrike Scattered Spider JUL 2025)(Citation: CISA Scattered Spider Advisory November 2023)

9910b602661a427b891d063e4780d9a644517e1f.source_text: [Scattered Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1015) has installed protocol-tunneling tools on VMware vCenter and adversary-controlled VMs, including Teleport.sh, Chisel (configured to communicate with trycloudflare[.]com subdomains), MobaXterm, ngrok, Pinggy, and Teleport.(Citation: CrowdStrike Scattered Spider JUL 2025)(Citation: CISA Scattered Spider Advisory November 2023)
9910b602661a427b891d063e4780d9a644517e1f.zh: [Scattered Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1015) 在 VMware vCenter 和对抗方控制的虚拟机上安装了协议隧道工具，包括 Teleport.sh、Chisel（配置为与 trycloudflare[.]com 子域名通信）、MobaXterm、ngrok、Pinggy 和 Teleport。（引用：CrowdStrike Scattered Spider JUL 2025）（引用：CISA Scattered Spider Advisory November 2023）

326a61df3c1f5f45ac57fad56e6855b93c7cad33.source_text: [APT39](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0087) is one of several names for cyber espionage activity conducted by the Iranian Ministry of Intelligence and Security (MOIS) through the front company Rana Intelligence Computing since at least 2014. [APT39](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0087) has primarily targeted the travel, hospitality, academic, and telecommunications industries in Iran and across Asia, Africa, Europe, and North America to track individuals and entities considered to be a threat by the MOIS.(Citation: FireEye APT39 Jan 2019)(Citation: Symantec Chafer Dec 2015)(Citation: FBI FLASH APT39 September 2020)(Citation: Dept. of Treasury Iran Sanctions September 2020)(Citation: DOJ Iran Indictments September 2020)
326a61df3c1f5f45ac57fad56e6855b93c7cad33.zh: [APT39](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0087) 是伊朗情报与安全部（MOIS）自至少2014年以来通过壳公司 Rana Intelligence Computing 实施的网络间谍活动所使用的多个名称之一。[APT39](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0087) 主要针对伊朗以及亚洲、非洲、欧洲和北美的旅行、酒店、学术和电信行业，以追踪被 MOIS 视为威胁的个人和实体。(Citation: FireEye APT39 Jan 2019)(Citation: Symantec Chafer Dec 2015)(Citation: FBI FLASH APT39 September 2020)(Citation: Dept. of Treasury Iran Sanctions September 2020)(Citation: DOJ Iran Indictments September 2020)

ce79125537e32da337f5f3a7331b655abbde0c1d.source_text: [APT39](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0087) has used various tools to proxy C2 communications.(Citation: BitDefender Chafer May 2020)
ce79125537e32da337f5f3a7331b655abbde0c1d.zh: [APT39](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0087) 已使用多种工具来代理 C2 通信。（Citation: BitDefender Chafer May 2020）

f051b06def55753604906dd2b1ef82f50c09b2b5.source_text: [APT39](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0087) has communicated with C2 through files uploaded to and downloaded from DropBox.(Citation: BitDefender Chafer May 2020)
f051b06def55753604906dd2b1ef82f50c09b2b5.zh: [APT39](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0087) 通过上传到和从 DropBox 下载的文件与 C2 进行通信。（引用：BitDefender Chafer 2020年5月）

fc039c33dd74afbece04761002811e1ca51427e4.source_text: [APT39](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0087) has downloaded tools to compromised hosts.(Citation: Symantec Chafer February 2018)(Citation: FBI FLASH APT39 September 2020)
fc039c33dd74afbece04761002811e1ca51427e4.zh: [APT39](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0087) 已下载工具到被攻击的主机。(Citation: Symantec Chafer February 2018)(Citation: FBI FLASH APT39 September 2020)

7a8fef9a5103069a805c354c48357b5e5925a6b9.source_text: [APT39](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0087) has used remote access tools that leverage DNS in communications with C2.(Citation: BitDefender Chafer May 2020)
7a8fef9a5103069a805c354c48357b5e5925a6b9.zh: [APT39](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0087) 使用了利用 DNS 与 C2 进行通信的远程访问工具。(Citation: BitDefender Chafer May 2020)

9c840983ad200613e7c22cd44a6b93c6b72fb848.source_text: [APT39](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0087) has used HTTP in communications with C2.(Citation: BitDefender Chafer May 2020)(Citation: FBI FLASH APT39 September 2020)
9c840983ad200613e7c22cd44a6b93c6b72fb848.zh: [APT39](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0087) 在与其 C2（命令与控制）的通信中使用了 HTTP。（来源：BitDefender Chafer May 2020）（来源：FBI FLASH APT39 September 2020）

c7c1c3567d6ed49e477c0a9a5230d48bb55aa231.source_text: [APT39](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0087) used custom tools to create SOCK5 and custom protocol proxies between infected hosts.(Citation: FireEye APT39 Jan 2019)(Citation: BitDefender Chafer May 2020)
c7c1c3567d6ed49e477c0a9a5230d48bb55aa231.zh: [APT39](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0087) 使用定制工具在受感染的计算机之间创建 SOCK5 和自定义协议代理。(Citation: FireEye APT39 Jan 2019)(Citation: BitDefender Chafer May 2020)

afd35b692ffad7d13e4f8e17622d0978b200c954.source_text: [UNC3886](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1048) is a China-nexus cyberespionage group that has been active since at least 2022, targeting defense, technology, and telecommunication organizations located in the United States and the Asia-Pacific-Japan (APJ) regions. [UNC3886](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1048) has displayed a deep understanding of edge devices and virtualization technologies through the exploitation of zero-day vulnerabilities and the use of novel malware families and utilities.(Citation: Mandiant Fortinet Zero Day)(Citation: Google Cloud Threat Intelligence VMWare ESXi Zero-Day 2023)
afd35b692ffad7d13e4f8e17622d0978b200c954.zh: [UNC3886](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1048) 是一个与中国相关的网络间谍组织，自至少2022年以来一直活跃，目标为位于美国和亚太-日本（APJ）地区的国防、技术和电信组织。[UNC3886](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1048) 通过利用零日漏洞以及使用新型恶意软件家族和工具，展现了对边缘设备和虚拟化技术的深刻理解。(Citation: Mandiant Fortinet Zero Day)(Citation: Google Cloud Threat Intelligence VMWare ESXi Zero-Day 2023)

1bbd42b9f61e7c91e1dba0f89e84cb37c4c67b93.source_text: Adversaries may use port knocking to hide open ports used for persistence or command and control. To enable a port, an adversary sends a series of attempted connections to a predefined sequence of closed ports. After the sequence is completed, opening a port is often accomplished by the host based firewall, but could also be implemented by custom software. This technique has been observed both for the dynamic opening of a listening port as well as the initiating of a connection to a listening server on a different system. The observation of the signal packets to trigger the communication can be conducted through different methods. One means, originally implemented by Cd00r (Citation: Hartrell cd00r 2002), is to use the libpcap libraries to sniff for the packets in question. Another method leverages raw sockets, which enables the malware to use ports that are already open for use by other programs.
1bbd42b9f61e7c91e1dba0f89e84cb37c4c67b93.zh: 敌手可能利用端口敲门（Port Knocking）技术来隐藏用于持久化或命令与控制（C2）的开放端口。为了启用某个端口，敌手会按照预定义的顺序向一系列封闭的端口发送尝试连接的请求。一旦序列完成，端口的开启通常由基于主机的防火墙实现，但也可能通过自定义软件实现。该技术既被观察到用于动态打开监听端口，也被观察到用于向其他系统上的监听服务器发起连接。可以通过不同方法观察用于触发通信的信号数据包。其中一种方式最初由 Cd00r（引用：Hartrell cd00r 2002）实现，即使用 libpcap 库嗅探相关的特定数据包。另一种方法则利用原始套接字（raw sockets），使恶意软件能够使用已被其他程序占用的开放端口。

b4cbfea0a9ba35aa3dcdcc083c4cec36e52cb448.source_text: [UNC3886](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1048) maintained persistence on FortiGate Firewalls through ICMP port knocking.(Citation: Mandiant Fortinet Zero Day)
b4cbfea0a9ba35aa3dcdcc083c4cec36e52cb448.zh: [UNC3886](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1048) 通过 ICMP 端口敲门在 FortiGate 防火墙上维持持久性。(引用：Mandiant Fortinet 零日漏洞报告)

d3ec6e43d694cf4aa5a706e02395fd97af1cf76d.source_text: [UNC3886](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1048) has deployed backdoors that communicate over TCP to compromised network devices and over VMCI to ESXi hosts.(Citation: Google Cloud Threat Intelligence VMWare ESXi Zero-Day 2023)(Citation: Google Cloud Mandiant UNC3886 2024)(Citation: Mandiant Fortinet Zero Day)
d3ec6e43d694cf4aa5a706e02395fd97af1cf76d.zh: [UNC3886](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1048) 已部署后门程序，通过 TCP 与受 compromising 的网络设备通信，并通过 VMCI 与 ESXi 主机通信。(Citation: Google Cloud Threat Intelligence VMWare ESXi Zero-Day 2023)(Citation: Google Cloud Mandiant UNC3886 2024)(Citation: Mandiant Fortinet Zero Day)

be31a7276b082610b270d264a562be476a76c0fe.source_text: [UNC3886](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1048) has used the TABLEFLIP traffic redirection utility to listen for specialized command packets on compromised FortiManager devices.(Citation: Mandiant Fortinet Zero Day)
be31a7276b082610b270d264a562be476a76c0fe.zh: [UNC3886](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1048) 已使用 TABLEFLIP 流量重定向工具在受 compromised 的 FortiManager 设备上监听专用命令数据包。(Citation: Mandiant Fortinet Zero Day)

73e71846fddf9bfc18bb2753f82ad495935cbd4d.source_text: [UNC3886](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1048) has employed layers of redundancy to maintain access to compromised environments including network devices, hypervisors, and virtual machines.(Citation: Google Cloud Mandiant UNC3886 2024)
73e71846fddf9bfc18bb2753f82ad495935cbd4d.zh: [UNC3886](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1048) 已采用多层冗余机制来维持对包括网络设备、超级管理器和虚拟机在内的已被入侵环境的访问。(Citation: Google Cloud Mandiant UNC3886 2024)

545a889e7646fccaab82399bf448624a0196ad88.source_text: [Contagious Interview](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1052) is a North Korea–aligned threat group active since 2023. The group conducts both cyberespionage and financially motivated operations, including the theft of cryptocurrency and user credentials. [Contagious Interview](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1052) targets Windows, Linux, and macOS systems, with a particular focus on individuals engaged in software development and cryptocurrency-related activities. (Citation: Validin Contagious Interview North Korea ClickFix January 2025)(Citation: Esentire ContagiousInterview BeaverTail InvisibleFerret November 2024)(Citation: Datadog Contagious Interview Tenacious Pungsan October 2024)(Citation: Recorded Future Contagious Inteview BeaverTail InvisibleFerret OtterCookie February 2025)(Citation: ESET Contagious Interview BeaverTail InvisibleFerret February 2025)(Citation: Zscaler ContagiousInterview BeaverTail InvisibleFerret November 2024)(Citation: PaloAlto ContagiousInterview BeaverTail InvisibleFerret November 2023)(Citation: PaloAlto Unit42 ContagiousInterview BeaverTail InvisibileFerret October 2024)
545a889e7646fccaab82399bf448624a0196ad88.zh: [Contagious Interview](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1052) 是一个自2023年起活跃的、与朝鲜有关联的威胁组织。该组织开展网络间谍活动和以经济利益为动机的操作，包括窃取加密货币和用户凭证。[Contagious Interview](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1052) 针对 Windows、Linux 和 macOS 系统，尤其专注于从事软件开发和加密货币相关活动的个人。(Citation: Validin Contagious Interview North Korea ClickFix January 2025)(Citation: Esentire ContagiousInterview BeaverTail InvisibleFerret November 2024)(Citation: Datadog Contagious Interview Tenacious Pungsan October 2024)(Citation: Recorded Future Contagious Inteview BeaverTail InvisibleFerret OtterCookie February 2025)(Citation: ESET Contagious Interview BeaverTail InvisibleFerret February 2025)(Citation: Zscaler ContagiousInterview BeaverTail InvisibleFerret November 2024)(Citation: PaloAlto ContagiousInterview BeaverTail InvisibleFerret November 2023)(Citation: PaloAlto Unit42 ContagiousInterview BeaverTail InvisibileFerret October 2024)

1f8e167d435948574a0163f796c3603eeb901df4.source_text: [Contagious Interview](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1052) has used TCP port 1224 for C2.(Citation: Socket Contagious Interview NPM April 2025)
1f8e167d435948574a0163f796c3603eeb901df4.zh: [Contagious Interview](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1052) 已使用 TCP 端口 1224 进行 C2。(Citation: Socket Contagious Interview NPM April 2025)

1c3d0791d4250956e71ef72bb7f28db3dd32e278.source_text: [Contagious Interview](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1052) has downloaded remote management and monitoring software such as “AnyDesk” for post compromise activities.(Citation: Esentire ContagiousInterview BeaverTail InvisibleFerret November 2024)(Citation: ESET Contagious Interview BeaverTail InvisibleFerret February 2025)(Citation: SecurityScorecard Contagious Interview October 2024)(Citation: PaloAlto ContagiousInterview BeaverTail InvisibleFerret November 2023)(Citation: PaloAlto Unit42 ContagiousInterview BeaverTail InvisibileFerret October 2024)
1c3d0791d4250956e71ef72bb7f28db3dd32e278.zh: [Contagious Interview](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1052) 已下载诸如“AnyDesk”之类的远程管理和监控软件，用于妥协后的活动。(Citation: Esentire ContagiousInterview BeaverTail InvisibleFerret November 2024)(Citation: ESET Contagious Interview BeaverTail InvisibleFerret February 2025)(Citation: SecurityScorecard Contagious Interview October 2024)(Citation: PaloAlto ContagiousInterview BeaverTail InvisibleFerret November 2023)(Citation: PaloAlto Unit42 ContagiousInterview BeaverTail InvisibileFerret October 2024)

fb35a2d7b695488547b2275e4a75f20afe477e60.source_text: [Contagious Interview](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1052) has leveraged Astrill VPN for C2.(Citation: Recorded Future Contagious Inteview BeaverTail InvisibleFerret OtterCookie February 2025)
fb35a2d7b695488547b2275e4a75f20afe477e60.zh: [Contagious Interview](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1052) 利用 Astrill VPN 进行 C2。（引用：Recorded Future Contagious Inteview BeaverTail InvisibleFerret OtterCookie 2025年2月）

b60e1864dcddc5477a1ea6102e916ed5c17dd7fb.source_text: [Contagious Interview](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1052) has encrypted C2 traffic using RC4.(Citation: Sekoia ClickFake 2025)
b60e1864dcddc5477a1ea6102e916ed5c17dd7fb.zh: [Contagious Interview](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1052) 使用 RC4 加密了其 C2 流量。(Citation: Sekoia ClickFake 2025)

f1093c46a29940f5a578d485778cb135707a45f9.source_text: [Contagious Interview](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1052) has utilized email notifications from malware distribution servers to track victim engagement.(Citation: Sentinel One Contagious Interview ClickFix September 2025)
f1093c46a29940f5a578d485778cb135707a45f9.zh: [Contagious Interview](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1052) 利用恶意软件分发服务器的电子邮件通知来追踪受害者的参与情况。（出处：Sentinel One Contagious Interview ClickFix September 2025）

9c61f08bbb6b1ab59cd5a69d55298578e30c263b.source_text: [TA2541](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1018) is a cybercriminal group that has been targeting the aviation, aerospace, transportation, manufacturing, and defense industries since at least 2017. [TA2541](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1018) campaigns are typically high volume and involve the use of commodity remote access tools obfuscated by crypters and themes related to aviation, transportation, and travel.(Citation: Proofpoint TA2541 February 2022)(Citation: Cisco Operation Layover September 2021)
9c61f08bbb6b1ab59cd5a69d55298578e30c263b.zh: [TA2541](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1018)是一个网络犯罪组织，自2017年以来一直针对航空、航空航天、运输、制造和国防行业。[TA2541](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1018)的活动通常是大规模的，并使用由加密器混淆的通用远程访问工具以及涉及航空、运输和旅行的主题。（参考：Proofpoint TA2541 2022年2月）（参考：Cisco Operation Layover 2021年9月）

a29999ddc50edd1432110fc02e9e97e2a125d287.source_text: [TA2541](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1018) has used TLS encrypted C2 communications including for campaigns using AsyncRAT.(Citation: Cisco Operation Layover September 2021)
a29999ddc50edd1432110fc02e9e97e2a125d287.zh: [T2541](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1018) 已使用经过 TLS 加密的 C2 通信，其中包括采用 AsyncRAT 的活动。（引用：Cisco Operation Layover September 2021）

30aa492322a96aa2d60e5819d20d6509b4e360dd.source_text: [TA2541](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1018) has used malicious scripts and macros with the ability to download additional payloads.(Citation: Cisco Operation Layover September 2021)
30aa492322a96aa2d60e5819d20d6509b4e360dd.zh: [TA2541](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1018) 已使用具有下载其他有效负载能力的恶意脚本和宏。（引用：Cisco Operation Layover September 2021）

ae999eaa5bee0424028b11ff520dee2f06b2d168.source_text: [TA2541](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1018) has used dynamic DNS services for C2 infrastructure.(Citation: Proofpoint TA2541 February 2022)
ae999eaa5bee0424028b11ff520dee2f06b2d168.zh: [TA2541](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1018) 曾使用动态 DNS 服务作为 C2 基础设施。(引用：Proofpoint TA2541 2022年2月)

1584109d5360234827f22e927e252a4af60da96b.source_text: [Akira](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1024) is a ransomware variant and ransomware deployment entity active since at least March 2023.(Citation: Arctic Wolf Akira 2023) [Akira](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1024) uses compromised credentials to access single-factor external access mechanisms such as VPNs for initial access, then various publicly-available tools and techniques for lateral movement.(Citation: Arctic Wolf Akira 2023)(Citation: Secureworks GOLD SAHARA) [Akira](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1024) operations are associated with "double extortion" ransomware activity, where data is exfiltrated from victim environments prior to encryption, with threats to publish files if a ransom is not paid. Technical analysis of [Akira](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1129) ransomware indicates variants capable of targeting Windows or VMWare ESXi hypervisors and multiple overlaps with [Conti](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0575) ransomware.(Citation: BushidoToken Akira 2023)(Citation: CISA Akira Ransomware APR 2024)(Citation: Cisco Akira Ransomware OCT 2024)
1584109d5360234827f22e927e252a4af60da96b.zh: [Akira](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1024) 是一种勒索软件变种及勒索软件部署实体，自至少2023年3月起活跃。(Citation: Arctic Wolf Akira 2023) [Akira](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1024) 使用被盗用的凭据来访问单因素外部访问机制（如 VPN）以进行初始访问，随后利用各种公开可用的工具和技巧进行横向移动。(Citation: Arctic Wolf Akira 2023)(Citation: Secureworks GOLD SAHARA) [Akira](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1024) 的运营与“双重勒索”活动相关，即在加密之前从受害环境中窃取数据，并威胁若不支付赎金则公开文件。对 [Akira](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1129) 勒索软件的技术分析表明，其存在能够针对 Windows 或 VMWare ESXi 管理程序的变种，并且与 [Conti](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0575) 勒索软件存在多处重合。(Citation: BushidoToken Akira 2023)(Citation: CISA Akira Ransomware APR 2024)(Citation: Cisco Akira Ransomware OCT 2024)

20665078f93964610ec50fcc63953c54e3611589.source_text: [Akira](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1024) uses legitimate utilities such as AnyDesk and PuTTy for maintaining remote access to victim environments.(Citation: Secureworks GOLD SAHARA)(Citation: Arctic Wolf Akira 2023)
20665078f93964610ec50fcc63953c54e3611589.zh: [Akira](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1024) 使用 AnyDesk 和 PuTTy 等合法实用程序来维持对受害者环境的远程访问。(Citation: Secureworks GOLD SAHARA)(Citation: Arctic Wolf Akira 2023)

c4a0c99b4ae458d200884940fdced6eca549e571.source_text: [APT37](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0067) is a North Korean state-sponsored cyber espionage group that has been active since at least 2012. The group has targeted victims primarily in South Korea, but also in Japan, Vietnam, Russia, Nepal, China, India, Romania, Kuwait, and other parts of the Middle East. [APT37](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0067) has also been linked to the following campaigns between 2016-2018: Operation Daybreak, Operation Erebus, Golden Time, Evil New Year, Are you Happy?, FreeMilk, North Korean Human Rights, and Evil New Year 2018.(Citation: FireEye APT37 Feb 2018)(Citation: Securelist ScarCruft Jun 2016)(Citation: Talos Group123) North Korean group definitions are known to have significant overlap, and some security researchers report all North Korean state-sponsored cyber activity under the name [Lazarus Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0032) instead of tracking clusters or subgroups.
c4a0c99b4ae458d200884940fdced6eca549e571.zh: [APT37](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0067) 是一个朝鲜国家支持的网络间谍组织，自至少2012年以来一直在活跃。该组织主要目标包括韩国，同时也针对日本、越南、俄罗斯、尼泊尔、中国、印度、罗马尼亚、科威特以及中东其他地区的目标。(引用：FireEye APT37 Feb 2018)(引用：Securelist ScarCruft Jun 2016)(引用：Talos Group123) 已知朝鲜相关组织的定义存在较大重叠，一些安全研究人员将所有朝鲜国家支持的网络活动统一归类为 [Lazarus Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0032)，而非追踪其聚类或子组。

abef0f0c83e83ee1a06a02bdd1724946301d2ec3.source_text: [APT37](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0067) has downloaded second stage malware from compromised websites.(Citation: FireEye APT37 Feb 2018)(Citation: Securelist ScarCruft May 2019)(Citation: Volexity InkySquid BLUELIGHT August 2021)(Citation: Volexity InkySquid RokRAT August 2021)
abef0f0c83e83ee1a06a02bdd1724946301d2ec3.zh: [APT37](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0067) 已从被攻陷的网站下载第二阶段恶意软件。(Citation: FireEye APT37 Feb 2018)(Citation: Securelist ScarCruft May 2019)(Citation: Volexity InkySquid BLUELIGHT August 2021)(Citation: Volexity InkySquid RokRAT August 2021)

bd7450b2a99e2637128607fb882b3393a1d17b27.source_text: [APT37](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0067) uses HTTPS to conceal C2 communications.(Citation: Talos Group123)
bd7450b2a99e2637128607fb882b3393a1d17b27.zh: [APT37](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0067) 使用 HTTPS 来隐藏 C2 通信。（来源：Talos Group123）

f9d7dbbe6e9833e36818d5bde971ce3fc3be327e.source_text: [APT37](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0067) leverages social networking sites and cloud platforms (AOL, Twitter, Yandex, Mediafire, pCloud, Dropbox, and Box) for C2.(Citation: FireEye APT37 Feb 2018)(Citation: Talos Group123)
f9d7dbbe6e9833e36818d5bde971ce3fc3be327e.zh: [APT37](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0067) 利用社交网络和云平台（AOL、Twitter、Yandex、Mediafire、pCloud、Dropbox 和 Box）进行命令与控制通信。(Citation: FireEye APT37 Feb 2018)(Citation: Talos Group123)

b2de402fe80bf7563b666718f642236632ff4bb1.source_text: [Moses Staff](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1009) is a suspected Iranian threat group that has primarily targeted Israeli companies since at least September 2021. [Moses Staff](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1009) openly stated their motivation in attacking Israeli companies is to cause damage by leaking stolen sensitive data and encrypting the victim's networks without a ransom demand.(Citation: Checkpoint MosesStaff Nov 2021) Security researchers assess [Moses Staff](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1009) is politically motivated, and has targeted government, finance, travel, energy, manufacturing, and utility companies outside of Israel as well, including those in Italy, India, Germany, Chile, Turkey, the UAE, and the US.(Citation: Cybereason StrifeWater Feb 2022)
b2de402fe80bf7563b666718f642236632ff4bb1.zh: [Moses Staff](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1009) 是一个疑似来自伊朗的攻击组织，自至少2021年9月以来主要瞄准以色列公司。[Moses Staff](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1009) 公开表示，其攻击以色列公司的动机是通过泄露被盗的敏感数据和加密受害者网络来造成损害，且未索要赎金。(Citation: Checkpoint MosesStaff Nov 2021) 安全研究人员评估 [Moses Staff](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1009) 具有政治动机，并曾针对以色列以外的政府、金融、旅游、能源、制造和公用事业公司进行攻击，包括位于意大利、印度、德国、智利、土耳其、阿联酋和美国的公司。(Citation: Cybereason StrifeWater Feb 2022)

6f9975bb964bfc536f037506f21119390278c532.source_text: [Moses Staff](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1009) has downloaded and installed web shells to following path C:\inetpub\wwwroot\aspnet_client\system_web\IISpool.aspx.(Citation: Checkpoint MosesStaff Nov 2021)
6f9975bb964bfc536f037506f21119390278c532.zh: [Moses Staff](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1009) 已将 Web 外壳程序下载并安装到以下路径：C:\inetpub\wwwroot\aspnet_client\system_web\IISpool.aspx。(引用：Checkpoint MosesStaff Nov 2021)

b7c4946a18bdb4c73be6336f248d81f07a3828d1.source_text: [OilRig](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0049) is a suspected Iranian threat group that has targeted Middle Eastern and international victims since at least 2014. The group has targeted a variety of sectors, including financial, government, energy, chemical, and telecommunications. It appears the group carries out supply chain attacks, leveraging the trust relationship between organizations to attack their primary targets. The group works on behalf of the Iranian government based on infrastructure details that contain references to Iran, use of Iranian infrastructure, and targeting that aligns with nation-state interests.(Citation: FireEye APT34 Dec 2017)(Citation: Palo Alto OilRig April 2017)(Citation: ClearSky OilRig Jan 2017)(Citation: Palo Alto OilRig May 2016)(Citation: Palo Alto OilRig Oct 2016)(Citation: Unit42 OilRig Playbook 2023)(Citation: Unit 42 QUADAGENT July 2018)
b7c4946a18bdb4c73be6336f248d81f07a3828d1.zh: [OilRig](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0049) 是一个疑似来自伊朗的威胁组织，自2014年以来一直针对中东和国际受害者。该组织 targeting 了多种行业，包括金融、政府、能源、化工和电信。它似乎开展供应链攻击，利用组织之间的信任关系来攻击其主要目标。根据基础设施细节中包含对伊朗的引用、使用伊朗的基础设施以及打击行动与国家战略利益相一致等情况判断，该组织代表伊朗政府行事。(Citation: FireEye APT34 Dec 2017)(Citation: Palo Alto OilRig April 2017)(Citation: ClearSky OilRig Jan 2017)(Citation: Palo Alto OilRig May 2016)(Citation: Palo Alto OilRig Oct 2016)(Citation: Unit42 OilRig Playbook 2023)(Citation: Unit 42 QUADAGENT July 2018)

306f8d32ddcf7443dd919502631b42cbb4bfb813.source_text: [OilRig](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0049) malware ISMAgent falls back to its DNS tunneling mechanism if it is unable to reach the C2 server over HTTP.(Citation: OilRig ISMAgent July 2017)
306f8d32ddcf7443dd919502631b42cbb4bfb813.zh: [OilRig](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0049) 恶意软件 ISMAgent 在无法通过 HTTP 与 C2 服务器通信时，会回退到其 DNS 隧道机制。(引用：OilRig ISMAgent 2017年7月)

2431acddb1b6278b1096f9e89a80fb72e8cccd9d.source_text: [OilRig](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0049) has used HTTP for C2.(Citation: Unit42 OilRig Playbook 2023)(Citation: FireEye APT34 Webinar Dec 2017)(Citation: FireEye APT34 July 2019)
2431acddb1b6278b1096f9e89a80fb72e8cccd9d.zh: [OilRig](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0049) 曾使用 HTTP 进行 C2。(Citation: Unit42 OilRig Playbook 2023)(Citation: FireEye APT34 Webinar Dec 2017)(Citation: FireEye APT34 July 2019)

850e18855e66edbd23597d0358b11dca28366083.source_text: [OilRig](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0049) has incorporated remote monitoring and management (RMM) tools into their operations including [ngrok](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0508).(Citation: Trend Micro Earth Simnavaz October 2024)
850e18855e66edbd23597d0358b11dca28366083.zh: [OilRig](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0049) 已将其远程监控和管理（RMM）工具纳入其运营活动，其中包括 [ngrok](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0508)。(Citation: Trend Micro Earth Simnavaz October 2024)

aed1825857414ac366b7096a804820d56e1200f3.source_text: [OilRig](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0049) has used DNS for C2 including the publicly available requestbin.net tunneling service.(Citation: Unit42 OilRig Playbook 2023)(Citation: FireEye APT34 Webinar Dec 2017)(Citation: FireEye APT34 July 2019)(Citation: Check Point APT34 April 2021)
aed1825857414ac366b7096a804820d56e1200f3.zh: [OilRig](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0049) 曾使用 DNS 进行命令与控制（C2）通信，包括利用公开的 requestbin.net 隧道服务。（Citation: Unit42 OilRig Playbook 2023）（Citation: FireEye APT34 Webinar Dec 2017）（Citation: FireEye APT34 July 2019）（Citation: Check Point APT34 April 2021）

2a8078a95709b6488165c243c3f78b53259ddb7b.source_text: [OilRig](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0049) had downloaded remote files onto victim infrastructure.(Citation: FireEye APT34 Dec 2017)(Citation: Trend Micro Earth Simnavaz October 2024)
2a8078a95709b6488165c243c3f78b53259ddb7b.zh: [OilRig](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0049) 已将远程文件下载至受害者的基础设施中。(Citation: FireEye APT34 Dec 2017)(Citation: Trend Micro Earth Simnavaz October 2024)

4654e18c9abeaf6bd4222280fbc6d1122b2f6145.source_text: [OilRig](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0049) used the [PowerExchange](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1173) utility and other tools to create tunnels to C2 servers.(Citation: FireEye APT34 Webinar Dec 2017)
4654e18c9abeaf6bd4222280fbc6d1122b2f6145.zh: [OilRig](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0049) 使用 [PowerExchange](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1173) 工具和其他工具创建了通往 C2 服务器的隧道。(Citation: FireEye APT34 Webinar Dec 2017)

0353988ba4a6175e7b8a81135dfc020b21dd0f02.source_text: [OilRig](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0049) has used the Plink utility and other tools to create tunnels to C2 servers.(Citation: Unit42 OilRig Playbook 2023)(Citation: FireEye APT34 Webinar Dec 2017)(Citation: FireEye APT34 July 2019)(Citation: Symantec Crambus OCT 2023)
0353988ba4a6175e7b8a81135dfc020b21dd0f02.zh: [OilRig](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0049) 使用 Plink 工具及其他工具创建了指向命令与控制（C2）服务器的隧道。（引用：Unit42 OilRig Playbook 2023）（引用：FireEye APT34 Webinar Dec 2017）（引用：FireEye APT34 July 2019）（引用：Symantec Crambus OCT 2023）

b6f31b0e2f978674ae7c9e3091d687c44371b26c.source_text: Adversaries may establish command and control capabilities over commonly used application layer protocols such as HTTP(S), OPC, RDP, telnet, DNP3, and modbus. These protocols may be used to disguise adversary actions as benign network traffic. Standard protocols may be seen on their associated port or in some cases over a non-standard port. Adversaries may use these protocols to reach out of the network for command and control, or in some cases to other infected devices within the network.
b6f31b0e2f978674ae7c9e3091d687c44371b26c.zh: adversary 可以在常用的应用层协议（如 HTTP(S)、OPC、RDP、telnet、DNP3 和 modbus）上建立命令与控制能力。这些协议可用于将敌对行为伪装成正常的网络流量。标准协议可能在与其关联的端口上使用，在某些情况下也可能在非标准端口上使用。敌对组织可能利用这些协议向外网发起命令与控制通信，或在某些情况下用于与网络内其他受感染设备进行通信。

e395521eb64a6368a1361c17562a172fdd342057.source_text: [OilRig](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0049) communicated with its command and control using HTTP requests. (Citation: Robert Falcone, Bryan Lee May 2016)
e395521eb64a6368a1361c17562a172fdd342057.zh: [OilRig](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0049) 使用 HTTP 请求与其命令和控制基础设施进行通信。（Citation: Robert Falcone, Bryan Lee May 2016）

3bf7df27575490b47b164c8e5d6aa1f92363326f.source_text: The [Windigo](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0124) group has been operating since at least 2011, compromising thousands of Linux and Unix servers using the [Ebury](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0377) SSH backdoor to create a spam botnet. Despite law enforcement intervention against the creators, [Windigo](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0124) operators continued updating [Ebury](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0377) through 2019.(Citation: ESET Windigo Mar 2014)(Citation: CERN Windigo June 2019)
3bf7df27575490b47b164c8e5d6aa1f92363326f.zh: [Windigo](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0124) 组织自至少 2011 年起运营，利用 [Ebury](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0377) SSH 后门入侵了数千台 Linux 和 Unix 服务器，构建了垃圾邮件僵尸网络。尽管执法部门对创建者进行了干预，但 [Windigo](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0124) 的操作人员持续更新 [Ebury](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0377)，直至 2019 年。(Citation: ESET Windigo Mar 2014)(Citation: CERN Windigo June 2019)

5ae821de387ca755af6ea8003add332b6508c836.source_text: [Windigo](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0124) has delivered a generic Windows proxy Win32/Glubteta.M. [Windigo](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0124) has also used multiple reverse proxy chains as part of their C2 infrastructure.(Citation: ESET Windigo Mar 2014)
5ae821de387ca755af6ea8003add332b6508c836.zh: [Windigo](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0124) 投递了通用的 Windows 代理 Win32/Glubteta.M。[Windigo](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0124) 还使用过多个反向代理链作为其 C2 基础设施的一部分。（引用：ESET Windigo Mar 2014）

ca7cf926be9411b4f11cf615b64e3f7d81325697.source_text: [Higaisa](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0126) is a threat group suspected to have South Korean origins. [Higaisa](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0126) has targeted government, public, and trade organizations in North Korea; however, they have also carried out attacks in China, Japan, Russia, Poland, and other nations. [Higaisa](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0126) was first disclosed in early 2019 but is assessed to have operated as early as 2009.(Citation: Malwarebytes Higaisa 2020)(Citation: Zscaler Higaisa 2020)(Citation: PTSecurity Higaisa 2020)
ca7cf926be9411b4f11cf615b64e3f7d81325697.zh: [Higaisa](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0126) 是一个被怀疑起源于韩国的威胁组织。[Higaisa](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0126) 曾针对朝鲜的政府、公共和贸易组织发动攻击；此外，他们还在中国、日本、俄罗斯、波兰等国家实施了攻击。[Higaisa](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0126) 于 2019 年初首次被披露，但评估认为其可能早在 2009 年就开始活动。(Citation: Malwarebytes Higaisa 2020)(Citation: Zscaler Higaisa 2020)(Citation: PTSecurity Higaisa 2020)

306848be8ffe31cbdb84897b36b47ebe0eef666d.source_text: [Higaisa](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0126) discovered system proxy settings and used them if available.(Citation: Zscaler Higaisa 2020)
306848be8ffe31cbdb84897b36b47ebe0eef666d.zh: [Higaisa](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0126) 发现并使用了系统代理设置（如果可用）。（引用：Zscaler Higaisa 2020）

565d73ecd7be907e83e3b7372713703e854fa58a.source_text: [Higaisa](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0126) used HTTP and HTTPS to send data back to its C2 server.(Citation: Malwarebytes Higaisa 2020)(Citation: Zscaler Higaisa 2020)
565d73ecd7be907e83e3b7372713703e854fa58a.zh: [Higaisa](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0126) 使用 HTTP 和 HTTPS 向 C2 服务器发送数据。（引用：Malwarebytes Higaisa 2020）（引用：Zscaler Higaisa 2020）

b37d42d404bcf011bc51ebc74c63fc90a40988ec.source_text: [Higaisa](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0126) used a FakeTLS session for C2 communications.(Citation: Zscaler Higaisa 2020)
b37d42d404bcf011bc51ebc74c63fc90a40988ec.zh: [Higaisa](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0126) 使用 FakeTLS 会话进行 C2 通信。（引用：Zscaler Higaisa 2020）

72e4dab1d1b9d9827af233026a76a40e6c1da825.source_text: [Higaisa](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0126) used AES-128 to encrypt C2 traffic.(Citation: Zscaler Higaisa 2020)
72e4dab1d1b9d9827af233026a76a40e6c1da825.zh: [Higaisa](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0126) 使用 AES-128 加密 C2 流量。（来源：Zscaler Higaisa 2020）

bae4a938838ced89dd80f3eda19de25fdd41ca9a.source_text: [Carbanak](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0008) is a cybercriminal group that has used [Carbanak](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0030) malware to target financial institutions since at least 2013. [Carbanak](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0008) may be linked to groups tracked separately as [Cobalt Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0080) and [FIN7](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0046) that have also used [Carbanak](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0030) malware.(Citation: Kaspersky Carbanak)(Citation: FireEye FIN7 April 2017)(Citation: Europol Cobalt Mar 2018)(Citation: Secureworks GOLD NIAGARA Threat Profile)(Citation: Secureworks GOLD KINGSWOOD Threat Profile)
bae4a938838ced89dd80f3eda19de25fdd41ca9a.zh: [Carbanak](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0008) 是一个网络犯罪团伙，自2013年起一直使用 [Carbanak](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0030) 恶意软件来攻击金融机构。[Carbanak](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0008) 可能与被单独追踪的 [Cobalt Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0080) 和 [FIN7](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0046) 有关联，这些组织也曾使用过 [Carbanak](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0030) 恶意软件。(引用：卡巴斯基 Carbanak)(引用：FireEye FIN7 2017年4月)(引用：欧洲刑警组织 Cobalt 2018年3月)(引用：Secureworks GOLD NIAGARA 威胁概况)(引用：Secureworks GOLD KINGSWOOD 威胁概况)

5279f5c01062474f816d2c76ef82d6f75617c38e.source_text: [Carbanak](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0008) has used a VBScript named "ggldr" that uses Google Apps Script, Sheets, and Forms services for C2.(Citation: Forcepoint Carbanak Google C2)
5279f5c01062474f816d2c76ef82d6f75617c38e.zh: [Carbanak](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0008) 曾使用名为 “ggldr” 的 VBScript，该脚本利用 Google Apps Script、Google Sheets 和 Google Forms 服务作为命令与控制（C2）通道。（引用：Forcepoint Carbanak Google C2）

0ca5f5f9a14e85468279a348a1fc5505b5663ab1.source_text: [Carbanak](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0008) used legitimate programs such as AmmyyAdmin and Team Viewer for remote interactive C2 to target systems.(Citation: Group-IB Anunak)
0ca5f5f9a14e85468279a348a1fc5505b5663ab1.zh: [Carbanak](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0008) 使用合法程序，例如 AmmyyAdmin 和 Team Viewer，作为远程交互式的命令与控制（C2）手段来针对系统。（来源：Group-IB Anunak）

83e4418320f15ef8138aa0958abe24161b24eccc.source_text: [Tropic Trooper](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0081) is an unaffiliated threat group that has led targeted campaigns against targets in Taiwan, the Philippines, and Hong Kong. [Tropic Trooper](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0081) focuses on targeting government, healthcare, transportation, and high-tech industries and has been active since 2011.(Citation: TrendMicro Tropic Trooper Mar 2018)(Citation: Unit 42 Tropic Trooper Nov 2016)(Citation: TrendMicro Tropic Trooper May 2020)
83e4418320f15ef8138aa0958abe24161b24eccc.zh: [Tropic Trooper](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0081) 是一个非隶属的威胁组织，曾针对台湾、菲律宾和香港的多个目标开展定向行动。[Tropic Trooper](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0081) 主要瞄准政府、医疗保健、交通运输和高科技行业，自2011年起活跃至今。(Citation: TrendMicro Tropic Trooper Mar 2018)(Citation: Unit 42 Tropic Trooper Nov 2016)(Citation: TrendMicro Tropic Trooper May 2020)

bac767467fe2fcae8b8ca85ec316ffd01898fcb7.source_text: [Tropic Trooper](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0081) has used a delivered trojan to download additional files.(Citation: TrendMicro Tropic Trooper May 2020)
bac767467fe2fcae8b8ca85ec316ffd01898fcb7.zh: [Tropic Trooper](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0081) 使用了已投放的木马程序来下载附加文件。(Citation: TrendMicro Tropic Trooper May 2020)

fe93f81a543bc7cfd5e7a05c807ea6bb528fc73c.source_text: Adversaries may employ an encryption algorithm to conceal command and control traffic rather than relying on any inherent protections provided by a communication protocol. Despite the use of a secure algorithm, these implementations may be vulnerable to reverse engineering if secret keys are encoded and/or generated within malware samples/configuration files.
fe93f81a543bc7cfd5e7a05c807ea6bb528fc73c.zh: adversaries may employ an encryption algorithm to conceal command and control traffic rather than relying on any inherent protections provided by a communication protocol. despite the use of a secure algorithm, these implementations may be vulnerable to reverse engineering if secret keys are encoded and/or generated within malware samples/configuration files.

91cadfb2d6fe8177b53c10f49268d4f8759e9b08.source_text: [Tropic Trooper](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0081) has encrypted traffic with the C2 to prevent network detection.(Citation: TrendMicro Tropic Trooper May 2020)
91cadfb2d6fe8177b53c10f49268d4f8759e9b08.zh: [Tropic Trooper](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0081) 使用了与 C2 通信的加密流量，以防止网络检测。(Citation: TrendMicro Tropic Trooper May 2020)

1a667d65c2a8e6ed8a6a9e54b2263301d26b416a.source_text: [Tropic Trooper](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0081) has used HTTP in communication with the C2.(Citation: Anomali Pirate Panda April 2020)(Citation: TrendMicro Tropic Trooper May 2020)
1a667d65c2a8e6ed8a6a9e54b2263301d26b416a.zh: [Tropic Trooper](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0081)在与控制与指挥（C2）的通信中使用了HTTP。(Citation: Anomali Pirate Panda April 2020)(Citation: TrendMicro Tropic Trooper May 2020)

89b7944ff21086ef8d26722c054620bd42cb0ac6.source_text: [Tropic Trooper](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0081) has used SSL to connect to C2 servers.(Citation: TrendMicro Tropic Trooper Mar 2018)(Citation: TrendMicro Tropic Trooper May 2020)
89b7944ff21086ef8d26722c054620bd42cb0ac6.zh: [Tropic Trooper](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0081) 使用 SSL 连接到 C2 服务器。（引用：TrendMicro Tropic Trooper 2018年3月）（引用：TrendMicro Tropic Trooper 2020年5月）

0a0649b75d169766ab2e59ddaee568bb08bd2a47.source_text: [Tropic Trooper](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0081) has used base64 encoding to hide command strings delivered from the C2.(Citation: TrendMicro Tropic Trooper May 2020)
0a0649b75d169766ab2e59ddaee568bb08bd2a47.zh: [Tropic Trooper](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0081) 使用了 Base64 编码来隐藏从 C2 交付的命令字符串。（引用：TrendMicro Tropic Trooper May 2020）

4b299d0c9b76285cdac7071352959bb7a69e3a7e.source_text: [Tropic Trooper](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0081)'s backdoor has communicated to the C2 over the DNS protocol.(Citation: TrendMicro Tropic Trooper May 2020)
4b299d0c9b76285cdac7071352959bb7a69e3a7e.zh: [Tropic Trooper](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0081)的后门通过DNS协议与C2进行通信。(Citation: TrendMicro Tropic Trooper May 2020)

0fb6ab293dff4a2e11f0523814e1e5f7fdcc99a1.source_text: [Orangeworm](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0071) is a group that has targeted organizations in the healthcare sector in the United States, Europe, and Asia since at least 2015, likely for the purpose of corporate espionage.(Citation: Symantec Orangeworm April 2018) Reverse engineering of [Kwampirs](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0236), directly associated with [Orangeworm](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0071) activity, indicates significant functional and development overlaps with [Shamoon](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0140).(Citation: Cylera Kwampirs 2022)
0fb6ab293dff4a2e11f0523814e1e5f7fdcc99a1.zh: [Orangeworm](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0071) 是一个自 2015 年起针对美国、欧洲和亚洲医疗行业组织进行攻击的团体，其目的大概是为了企业间谍活动。(Citation: Symantec Orangeworm April 2018) 对与 [Orangeworm](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0071) 活动直接相关的 [Kwampirs](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0236) 进行逆向工程分析表明，[Kwampirs](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0236) 在功能和开发方面与 [Shamoon](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0140) 存在显著的重合之处。(Citation: Cylera Kwampirs 2022)

0835b1a738d45ed2087b530a802f4a9ff517e9ea.source_text: [Orangeworm](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0071) has used HTTP for C2.(Citation: Symantec Orangeworm IOCs April 2018)
0835b1a738d45ed2087b530a802f4a9ff517e9ea.zh: [Orangeworm](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0071) 曾使用 HTTP 作为 C2。（引用：Symantec Orangeworm IOCs April 2018）

60a979eea38386f9acccfcdd98a656251f3f149b.source_text: [Sea Turtle](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1041) is a Türkiye-linked threat actor active since at least 2017 performing espionage and service provider compromise operations against victims in Asia, Europe, and North America. [Sea Turtle](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1041) is notable for targeting registrars managing ccTLDs and complex DNS-based intrusions where the threat actor compromised DNS providers to hijack DNS resolution for ultimate victims, enabling [Sea Turtle](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1041) to spoof log in portals and other applications for credential collection.(Citation: Talos Sea Turtle 2019)(Citation: Talos Sea Turtle 2019_2)(Citation: PWC Sea Turtle 2023)(Citation: Hunt Sea Turtle 2024)
60a979eea38386f9acccfcdd98a656251f3f149b.zh: [Sea Turtle](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1041) 是一个与土耳其有关联的黑客组织，自至少2017年起活跃，针对亚洲、欧洲和北美地区的受害者进行间谍活动和服务提供商入侵操作。[Sea Turtle](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1041) 以其对管理国家代码顶级域名（ccTLDs）的注册商的 targeting 以及复杂的基于DNS的入侵行为而闻名。该黑客组织通过入侵DNS提供商来劫持最终受害者的DNS解析过程，从而使 [Sea Turtle](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1041) 能够伪造登录门户和其他应用程序以收集凭据。(Citation: Talos Sea Turtle 2019)(Citation: Talos Sea Turtle 2019_2)(Citation: PWC Sea Turtle 2023)(Citation: Hunt Sea Turtle 2024)

35618cc2b03757f5a55843e2512f10c106cdd5be.source_text: [Sea Turtle](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1041) connected over TCP using HTTP to establish command and control channels.(Citation: Hunt Sea Turtle 2024)
35618cc2b03757f5a55843e2512f10c106cdd5be.zh: [Sea Turtle](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1041) 通过 TCP 使用 HTTP 建立命令和控制通道。(引用：Hunt Sea Turtle 2024)

9daaf7e9b460efcda832b62ca2deb3e78954acbc.source_text: [Taidoor](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0015) has been deprecated, as the only technique it was linked to was deprecated in ATT&CK v7.
9daaf7e9b460efcda832b62ca2deb3e78954acbc.zh: 已弃用 [Taidoor](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0015)，因为它唯一关联的技术在 ATT&CK v7 中已被弃用。

fc1bcb381d07ee42fa9a99397df2930683fde037.source_text: [Suckfly](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0039) is a China-based threat group that has been active since at least 2014. (Citation: Symantec Suckfly March 2016)
fc1bcb381d07ee42fa9a99397df2930683fde037.zh: [Suckfly](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0039) 是一个位于中国的威胁组织，自至少 2014 年以来一直在活跃。（引用：Symantec Suckfly March 2016）

f584d5804e4c4b24b1964b502c7c1480af630346.source_text: [Putter Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0024) is a Chinese threat group that has been attributed to Unit 61486 of the 12th Bureau of the PLA’s 3rd General Staff Department (GSD). (Citation: CrowdStrike Putter Panda)
f584d5804e4c4b24b1964b502c7c1480af630346.zh: [Putter Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0024) 是一个被归因于中国人民解放军第三总参谋部第12局61486部的中国威胁组织。（参考来源：CrowdStrike Putter Panda）

6aac76a29f151d5238970e3508582b8e75208686.source_text: Operation [Sharpshooter](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0104) is the name of a cyber espionage campaign discovered in October 2018 targeting nuclear, defense, energy, and financial companies. Though overlaps between this adversary and [Lazarus Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0032) have been noted, definitive links have not been established.(Citation: McAfee Sharpshooter December 2018)
6aac76a29f151d5238970e3508582b8e75208686.zh: Operation [Sharpshooter](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0104) 是一项网络间谍行动的名称，于2018年10月被发现，其目标为核能、国防、能源和金融公司。尽管已注意到该对手与 [Lazarus Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0032) 之间存在重叠之处，但尚未建立确凿的关联。(Citation: McAfee Sharpshooter December 2018)

2c012e6ac8aca67f4655779453998ebcf88613c7.source_text: [POLONIUM](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1005) is a Lebanon-based group that has primarily targeted Israeli organizations, including critical manufacturing, information technology, and defense industry companies, since at least February 2022. Security researchers assess [POLONIUM](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1005) has coordinated their operations with multiple actors affiliated with Iran’s Ministry of Intelligence and Security (MOIS), based on victim overlap as well as common techniques and tooling.(Citation: Microsoft POLONIUM June 2022)
2c012e6ac8aca67f4655779453998ebcf88613c7.zh: [庞诺斯（POLONIUM）](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1005) 是一个以黎巴嫩为基地的组织，自至少2022年2月以来主要针对以色列的组织，包括关键制造业、信息技术和国防工业公司。安全研究人员评估认为 [庞诺斯（POLONIUM）](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1005) 与多个隶属于伊朗情报与安全部（MOIS）的行动者协调了其行动，基于受害者重叠以及共同的技术和工具。（引用：微软 POLONIUM 2022年6月）

cbd04fcbbb7ef8bf962ab17662b5af5df17eb970.source_text: [POLONIUM](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1005) has used OneDrive and DropBox for C2.(Citation: Microsoft POLONIUM June 2022)
cbd04fcbbb7ef8bf962ab17662b5af5df17eb970.zh: [钋（POLONIUM）](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1005) 曾使用 OneDrive 和 DropBox 进行命令与控制通信（C2）。（来源：微软 POLONIUM 2022年6月报告）

a992965b6e4737e08c479d694cdea9aefdc2628b.source_text: [POLONIUM](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1005) has used the AirVPN service for operational activity.(Citation: Microsoft POLONIUM June 2022)
a992965b6e4737e08c479d694cdea9aefdc2628b.zh: [POLONIUM](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1005) 一直在运营活动中使用 AirVPN 服务。（来源：Microsoft POLONIUM June 2022）

fb4b46745c8c599331e5929d3a49d30821736af0.source_text: [TA459](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0062) is a threat group believed to operate out of China that has targeted countries including Russia, Belarus, Mongolia, and others. (Citation: Proofpoint TA459 April 2017)
fb4b46745c8c599331e5929d3a49d30821736af0.zh: [TA459](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0062) 是一个据信在中国运营的威胁组织，其目标包括俄罗斯、白俄罗斯、蒙古等国家。 (引用：Proofpoint TA459 2017年4月)

2bb0fad3d740afa44ad66304dec50df2362295fd.source_text: [Aquatic Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0143) is a suspected China-based threat group with a dual mission of intelligence collection and industrial espionage. Active since at least May 2020, [Aquatic Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0143) has primarily targeted entities in the telecommunications, technology, and government sectors.(Citation: CrowdStrike AQUATIC PANDA December 2021)
2bb0fad3d740afa44ad66304dec50df2362295fd.zh: [Aquatic Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0143) 是一个疑似位于中国的威胁组织，其双重任务是情报收集和工业间谍活动。自至少2020年5月以来，[Aquatic Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0143) 主要 targeting 电信、技术和政府领域的实体。(Citation: CrowdStrike AQUATIC PANDA December 2021)

142be74a2cabcc84ae71c3e6826c4559d8ca96fd.source_text: [Aquatic Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0143) has downloaded additional malware onto compromised hosts.(Citation: CrowdStrike AQUATIC PANDA December 2021)
142be74a2cabcc84ae71c3e6826c4559d8ca96fd.zh: [Aquatic Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0143) 将额外的恶意软件下载到了被入侵的主机上。（来源：CrowdStrike AQUATIC PANDA December 2021）

08129aeb28a00e76b210d1cae257bd67755a4851.source_text: [Aoqin Dragon](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1007) is a suspected Chinese cyber espionage threat group that has been active since at least 2013. [Aoqin Dragon](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1007) has primarily targeted government, education, and telecommunication organizations in Australia, Cambodia, Hong Kong, Singapore, and Vietnam. Security researchers noted a potential association between [Aoqin Dragon](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1007) and UNC94, based on malware, infrastructure, and targets.(Citation: SentinelOne Aoqin Dragon June 2022)
08129aeb28a00e76b210d1cae257bd67755a4851.zh: [奥秦龙](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1007) 是一个涉嫌来自中国、自2013年至少就活跃的网络间谍威胁组织。[奥秦龙](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1007) 主要针对澳大利亚、柬埔寨、香港、新加坡和越南的政府、教育和电信机构。安全研究人员基于恶意软件、基础设施和目标，注意到 [奥秦龙](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1007) 与 UNC94 之间可能存在关联。（来源：SentinelOne 奥秦龙 2022年6月）

9c85c25bbe2066e3283ca9f07d9cf1f83972bd18.source_text: [Ferocious Kitten](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0137) is a threat group that has primarily targeted Persian-speaking individuals in Iran since at least 2015.(Citation: Kaspersky Ferocious Kitten Jun 2021)
9c85c25bbe2066e3283ca9f07d9cf1f83972bd18.zh: [凶猛小猫](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0137) 是一个威胁组织，自2015年以来主要针对伊朗的波斯语使用者。（引用：卡巴斯基 Ferocious Kitten Jun 2021）

cf9a893ff7321662fd0a938fd0091814c63d2c71.source_text: [The White Company](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0089) is a likely state-sponsored threat actor with advanced capabilities. From 2017 through 2018, the group led an espionage campaign called Operation Shaheen targeting government and military organizations in Pakistan.(Citation: Cylance Shaheen Nov 2018)
