cf9a893ff7321662fd0a938fd0091814c63d2c71.zh: [White Company](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0089) 是一个具有高级能力的疑似国家支持的威胁行为体。2017年至2018年间，该组织领导了代号为“Shaheen行动”的情报窃取活动，针对巴基斯坦的政府和军事机构进行攻击。(Citation: Cylance Shaheen Nov 2018)

7628429688debbe91443a6700648181ab3a71968.source_text: [Ke3chang](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0004) is a threat group attributed to actors operating out of China. [Ke3chang](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0004) has targeted oil, government, diplomatic, military, and NGOs in Central and South America, the Caribbean, Europe, and North America since at least 2010.(Citation: Mandiant Operation Ke3chang November 2014)(Citation: NCC Group APT15 Alive and Strong)(Citation: APT15 Intezer June 2018)(Citation: Microsoft NICKEL December 2021)
7628429688debbe91443a6700648181ab3a71968.zh: [Ke3chang](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0004) 是一个被归因于来自中国境内的攻击者的威胁组织。自2010年以来，[Ke3chang](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0004) 一直针对拉丁美洲、加勒比地区、欧洲和北美地区的石油、政府、外交、军事以及非政府组织。(Citation: Mandiant Operation Ke3chang November 2014)(Citation: NCC Group APT15 Alive and Strong)(Citation: APT15 Intezer June 2018)(Citation: Microsoft NICKEL December 2021)

0c25d3ffb687d022bbe17b934d54b61558395519.source_text: [Ke3chang](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0004) has used tools to download files to compromised machines.(Citation: Microsoft NICKEL December 2021)
0c25d3ffb687d022bbe17b934d54b61558395519.zh: [Ke3chang](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0004) 已使用工具将文件下载到被入侵的计算机上。（引用：Microsoft NICKEL 2021年12月）

9530f468d1c2e3657ab0a8107a3fe8d5a44eaebd.source_text: [Ke3chang](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0004) malware RoyalDNS has used DNS for C2.(Citation: NCC Group APT15 Alive and Strong)
9530f468d1c2e3657ab0a8107a3fe8d5a44eaebd.zh: [Ke3chang](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0004) 恶意软件 RoyalDNS 已使用 DNS 进行 C2。（引用：NCC Group APT15 Alive and Strong）

0f5ec8192dfdc299ad7baa022020d06a017688d0.source_text: [Ke3chang](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0004) malware including RoyalCli and BS2005 have communicated over HTTP with the C2 server through Internet Explorer (IE) by using the COM interface IWebBrowser2.(Citation: NCC Group APT15 Alive and Strong)(Citation: Microsoft NICKEL December 2021)
0f5ec8192dfdc299ad7baa022020d06a017688d0.zh: [Ke3chang](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0004) 恶意软件，包括 RoyalCli 和 BS2005，通过 Internet Explorer (IE) 使用 COM 接口 IWebBrowser2 与 C2 服务器进行 HTTP 通信。(Citation: NCC Group APT15 Alive and Strong)(Citation: Microsoft NICKEL December 2021)

9612a70a04a6d4326e1425b3268c76f9ab26c8b6.source_text: [Saint Bear](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1031) is a Russian-nexus threat actor active since early 2021, primarily targeting entities in Ukraine and Georgia. The group is notable for a specific remote access tool, [Saint Bot](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1018), and information stealer, [OutSteel](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1017) in campaigns. [Saint Bear](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1031) typically relies on phishing or web staging of malicious documents and related file types for initial access, spoofing government or related entities.(Citation: Palo Alto Unit 42 OutSteel SaintBot February 2022 )(Citation: Cadet Blizzard emerges as novel threat actor) [Saint Bear](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1031) has previously been confused with [Ember Bear](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1003) operations, but analysis of behaviors, tools, and targeting indicates these are distinct clusters.
9612a70a04a6d4326e1425b3268c76f9ab26c8b6.zh: [Saint Bear](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1031) 是一个自2021年初开始活跃的俄罗斯关联威胁行为体，主要针对乌克兰和格鲁吉亚境内的实体。该组织在行动中以其特定的远程访问工具[Saint Bot](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1018)和信息窃取软件[OutSteel](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1017)而著称。(Citation: Palo Alto Unit 42 OutSteel SaintBot February 2022 )(Citation: Cadet Blizzard emerges as novel threat actor) [Saint Bear](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1031)通常依赖于钓鱼攻击或利用网络挂马传播恶意文档及相关文件类型以实现初始访问，并伪造政府或相关机构的身份。(Citation: Palo Alto Unit 42 OutSteel SaintBot February 2022 )(Citation: Cadet Blizzard emerges as novel threat actor) [Saint Bear](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1031)此前曾与[Ember Bear](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1003)的行动混淆，但对行为、工具和目标的分析表明，这些是截然不同的集群。

66f676b1faaff5575b35d7da8d65dcab186d3d6d.source_text: [APT1](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0006) is a Chinese threat group that has been attributed to the 2nd Bureau of the People’s Liberation Army (PLA) General Staff Department’s (GSD) 3rd Department, commonly known by its Military Unit Cover Designator (MUCD) as Unit 61398. (Citation: Mandiant APT1)
66f676b1faaff5575b35d7da8d65dcab186d3d6d.zh: [APT1](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0006) 是一个中国威胁组织，被归因于中国人民解放军总参谋部（GSD）二部三部，其军事单位伪装代号（MUCD）通常被称为61398部队。（Citation: Mandiant APT1）

a3849e903487aac98fb37d947f5703887966f411.source_text: [Frankenstein](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0101) is a campaign carried out between January and April 2019 by unknown threat actors. The campaign name comes from the actors' ability to piece together several unrelated components.(Citation: Talos Frankenstein June 2019)
a3849e903487aac98fb37d947f5703887966f411.zh: [弗兰肯斯坦](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0101) 是一场由未知威胁行为者在2019年1月至4月期间开展的活动。该活动名称源于攻击者能够将多个不相关的组件拼接在一起的能力。(Citation: Talos Frankenstein June 2019)

daed05725b36a0409bd2eb2725d282125c5b09da.source_text: [DarkHydrus](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0079) is a threat group that has targeted government agencies and educational institutions in the Middle East since at least 2016. The group heavily leverages open-source tools and custom payloads for carrying out attacks. (Citation: Unit 42 DarkHydrus July 2018) (Citation: Unit 42 Playbook Dec 2017)
daed05725b36a0409bd2eb2725d282125c5b09da.zh: [DarkHydrus](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0079) 是一个自至少2016年以来一直针对中东地区政府机构和教育机构的威胁组织。该组织大量利用开源工具和自定义载荷来实施攻击。(Citation: Unit 42 DarkHydrus July 2018) (Citation: Unit 42 Playbook Dec 2017)

b061f37dd8aa6fcf02dd842d6ebc089e1c8e83af.source_text: [Confucius](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0142) is a cyber espionage group that has primarily targeted military personnel, high-profile personalities, business persons, and government organizations in South Asia since at least 2013. Security researchers have noted similarities between [Confucius](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0142) and [Patchwork](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0040), particularly in their respective custom malware code and targets.(Citation: TrendMicro Confucius APT Feb 2018)(Citation: TrendMicro Confucius APT Aug 2021)(Citation: Uptycs Confucius APT Jan 2021)
b061f37dd8aa6fcf02dd842d6ebc089e1c8e83af.zh: [Confucius](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0142) 是一个网络间谍组织，自 2013 年以来主要针对南亚地区的军事人员、知名人士、商界人士和政府机构。安全研究人员注意到 [Confucius](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0142) 与 [Patchwork](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0040) 之间存在相似之处，特别是在各自的定制恶意代码和目标方面。(Citation: TrendMicro Confucius APT Feb 2018)(Citation: TrendMicro Confucius APT Aug 2021)(Citation: Uptycs Confucius APT Jan 2021)

3cf56456852a720578a404bee05c457f77f98bb9.source_text: [Confucius](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0142) has downloaded additional files and payloads onto a compromised host following initial access.(Citation: Uptycs Confucius APT Jan 2021)(Citation: TrendMicro Confucius APT Aug 2021)
3cf56456852a720578a404bee05c457f77f98bb9.zh: [孔子](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0142) 在初始访问后，将额外的文件和有效载荷下载到了受感染的主机上。(Citation: Uptycs Confucius APT Jan 2021)(Citation: TrendMicro Confucius APT Aug 2021)

5339084bcbe472b616b1778444091caa29a89fb7.source_text: [Confucius](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0142) has used HTTP for C2 communications.(Citation: Uptycs Confucius APT Jan 2021)
5339084bcbe472b616b1778444091caa29a89fb7.zh: [孔子](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0142) 已使用 HTTP 进行 C2 通信。(Citation: Uptycs Confucius APT Jan 2021)

fbbf11aa47a68b15aa387f04606ee1fab3a1ef30.source_text: [BlackTech](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0098) is a suspected Chinese cyber espionage group that has primarily targeted organizations in East Asia--particularly Taiwan, Japan, and Hong Kong--and the US since at least 2013. [BlackTech](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0098) has used a combination of custom malware, dual-use tools, and living off the land tactics to compromise media, construction, engineering, electronics, and financial company networks.(Citation: TrendMicro BlackTech June 2017)(Citation: Symantec Palmerworm Sep 2020)(Citation: Reuters Taiwan BlackTech August 2020)
fbbf11aa47a68b15aa387f04606ee1fab3a1ef30.zh: [BlackTech](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0098) 是一个涉嫌从事网络间谍活动的中国组织，自2013年以来主要 targeting 亚洲东部地区——尤其是台湾、日本和香港——以及美国的组织。(Citation: TrendMicro BlackTech June 2017)(Citation: Symantec Palmerworm Sep 2020)(Citation: Reuters Taiwan BlackTech August 2020)

92405c59eb504caba79b85d89ae250725d35237c.source_text: [Leviathan](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0065) is a Chinese state-sponsored cyber espionage group that has been attributed to the Ministry of State Security's (MSS) Hainan State Security Department and an affiliated front company.(Citation: CISA AA21-200A APT40 July 2021) Active since at least 2009, [Leviathan](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0065) has targeted the following sectors: academia, aerospace/aviation, biomedical, defense industrial base, government, healthcare, manufacturing, maritime, and transportation across the US, Canada, Australia, Europe, the Middle East, and Southeast Asia.(Citation: CISA AA21-200A APT40 July 2021)(Citation: Proofpoint Leviathan Oct 2017)(Citation: FireEye Periscope March 2018)(Citation: CISA Leviathan 2024)
92405c59eb504caba79b85d89ae250725d35237c.zh: [Leviathan](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0065) 是一个中国国家赞助的网络间谍组织，该组织被归因于国家安全部（MSS）下属的海南省国家安全厅及其关联的前台公司。(Citation: CISA AA21-200A APT40 July 2021) 自至少2009年以来活跃至今，[Leviathan](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0065) 已针对以下部门进行攻击：学术界、航空航天/航空、生物医学、国防工业基地、政府、医疗、制造业、海事和交通运输，受影响的地理范围包括美国、加拿大、澳大利亚、欧洲、中东和东南亚。(Citation: CISA AA21-200A APT40 July 2021)(Citation: Proofpoint Leviathan Oct 2017)(Citation: FireEye Periscope March 2018)(Citation: CISA Leviathan 2024)

ccf12b338a9cc71302d4a66902c611bfa723b9ce.source_text: [Leviathan](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0065) has received C2 instructions from user profiles created on legitimate websites such as Github and TechNet.(Citation: FireEye Periscope March 2018)
ccf12b338a9cc71302d4a66902c611bfa723b9ce.zh: [Leviathan](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0065) 已通过创建在合法网站（如 Github 和 TechNet）上的用户配置文件接收命令与控制（C2）指令。（引用：FireEye Periscope 2018年3月报告）

070e9894dc225a5af46b3dca0b237e9bba40141f.source_text: [Leviathan](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0065) has downloaded additional scripts and files from adversary-controlled servers.(Citation: Proofpoint Leviathan Oct 2017)(Citation: FireEye Periscope March 2018)
070e9894dc225a5af46b3dca0b237e9bba40141f.zh: [Leviathan](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0065) 已从攻击者控制的服务器下载了额外的脚本和文件。(Citation: Proofpoint Leviathan Oct 2017)(Citation: FireEye Periscope March 2018)

c6f5d18d8216352ef56b85d17cf797ac510c1df1.source_text: [Leviathan](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0065) has used multi-hop proxies to disguise the source of their malicious traffic.(Citation: CISA AA21-200A APT40 July 2021)
c6f5d18d8216352ef56b85d17cf797ac510c1df1.zh: [Leviathan](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0065) 使用多跳代理来伪装其恶意流量的来源。(Citation: CISA AA21-200A APT40 July 2021)

062bf60f62452c38ec485727d0c3e973caa81c77.source_text: [Leviathan](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0065) has used protocol tunneling to further conceal C2 communications and infrastructure.(Citation: CISA AA21-200A APT40 July 2021)
062bf60f62452c38ec485727d0c3e973caa81c77.zh: [Leviathan](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0065) 已使用协议隧道技术进一步隐藏 C2（命令与控制）通信及其基础设施。（出处：CISA AA21-200A APT40 2021年7月）

0beb039850db6413af79c07d81fa2df8f9db0b53.source_text: [MoustachedBouncer](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1019) is a cyberespionage group that has been active since at least 2014 targeting foreign embassies in Belarus.(Citation: MoustachedBouncer ESET August 2023)
0beb039850db6413af79c07d81fa2df8f9db0b53.zh: [MoustachedBouncer](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1019)是一个自至少2014年以来活跃的网络间谍组织，其目标为白俄罗斯的外国大使馆。(Citation: MoustachedBouncer ESET August 2023)

66a16ac39a01973a10c9c288050c5e01c71a76eb.source_text: [MoustachedBouncer](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1019) has used a reverse proxy tool similar to the GitHub repository revsocks.(Citation: MoustachedBouncer ESET August 2023)
66a16ac39a01973a10c9c288050c5e01c71a76eb.zh: [MoustachedBouncer](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1019) 使用了类似于 GitHub 仓库 revsocks 的 reverse proxy 工具。（Citation: MoustachedBouncer ESET August 2023）

66495c7461d57c527de157ddb7485c3fbe5e8b00.source_text: Adversaries may gain access and continuously communicate with victims by injecting malicious content into systems through online network traffic. Rather than luring victims to malicious payloads hosted on a compromised website (i.e., [Drive-by Target](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1608/004) followed by [Drive-by Compromise](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1189)), adversaries may initially access victims through compromised data-transfer channels where they can manipulate traffic and/or inject their own content. These compromised online network channels may also be used to deliver additional payloads (i.e., [Ingress Tool Transfer](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1105)) and other data to already compromised systems.(Citation: ESET MoustachedBouncer) Adversaries may inject content to victim systems in various ways, including: * From the middle, where the adversary is in-between legitimate online client-server communications (**Note:** this is similar but distinct from [Adversary-in-the-Middle](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1557), which describes AiTM activity solely within an enterprise environment) (Citation: Kaspersky Encyclopedia MiTM) * From the side, where malicious content is injected and races to the client as a fake response to requests of a legitimate online server (Citation: Kaspersky ManOnTheSide) Content injection is often the result of compromised upstream communication channels, for example at the level of an internet service provider (ISP) as is the case with "lawful interception."(Citation: Kaspersky ManOnTheSide)(Citation: ESET MoustachedBouncer)(Citation: EFF China GitHub Attack)
66495c7461d57c527de157ddb7485c3fbe5e8b00.zh: 攻击者可能通过向在线网络流量中注入恶意内容，实现对受害系统的访问并持续通信。与诱骗受害者访问托管在已被入侵网站上的恶意负载（即 [Drive-by Target](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1608/004)，随后进行 [Drive-by Compromise](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1189)）不同，攻击者最初可能通过被篡改的数据传输通道访问受害者，在这些通道中可以操纵流量和/或注入其自己的内容。这些被篡改的在线网络通道还可用于向已经受损的系统传递其他负载（例如 [Ingress Tool Transfer](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1105)）和其他数据。(Citation: ESET MoustachedBouncer) 攻击者可以通过多种方式向受害系统注入内容，包括： * 从中部注入，即攻击者位于合法在线客户端-服务器通信之间（**注意**：这与 [Adversary-in-the-Middle](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1557) 类似但有所区别，后者仅描述企业环境内的 AiTM 活动） (Citation: Kaspersky Encyclopedia MiTM) * 从侧面注入，即恶意内容作为对合法在线服务器请求的伪造响应被注入并与之竞争到达客户端 (Citation: Kaspersky ManOnTheSide) 内容注入通常是上游通信渠道被入侵的结果，例如在因特网服务提供商（ISP）层面发生的情况，如“合法拦截”所示。(Citation: Kaspersky ManOnTheSide)(Citation: ESET MoustachedBouncer)(Citation: EFF China GitHub Attack)

d6adba51be00503e1c22b7e5f9c7dfc849ff4499.source_text: [MoustachedBouncer](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1019) has injected content into DNS, HTTP, and SMB replies to redirect specifically-targeted victims to a fake Windows Update page to download malware.(Citation: MoustachedBouncer ESET August 2023)
d6adba51be00503e1c22b7e5f9c7dfc849ff4499.zh: [MoustachedBouncer](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1019) 已在 DNS、HTTP 和 SMB 响应中注入内容，将特定目标受害者重定向至伪造的 Windows Update 页面以下载恶意软件。(Citation: MoustachedBouncer ESET August 2023)

2c4fd262bcaea873064854e28c99951d2d58241c.source_text: [Group5](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0043) is a threat group with a suspected Iranian nexus, though this attribution is not definite. The group has targeted individuals connected to the Syrian opposition via spearphishing and watering holes, normally using Syrian and Iranian themes. [Group5](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0043) has used two commonly available remote access tools (RATs), [njRAT](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0385) and [NanoCore](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0336), as well as an Android RAT, DroidJack. (Citation: Citizen Lab Group5)
2c4fd262bcaea873064854e28c99951d2d58241c.zh: [Group5](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0043)是一个具有疑似伊朗背景的威胁组织，尽管这一归因尚未确定。该组织通过网络钓鱼和水坑攻击针对与叙利亚反对派有关联的个人，通常使用叙利亚和伊朗主题的元素。(Citation: Citizen Lab Group5)

bee2a26eb3133dcc21da85774edea610a26a4aa9.source_text: [Blue Mockingbird](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0108) is a cluster of observed activity involving Monero cryptocurrency-mining payloads in dynamic-link library (DLL) form on Windows systems. The earliest observed Blue Mockingbird tools were created in December 2019.(Citation: RedCanary Mockingbird May 2020)
bee2a26eb3133dcc21da85774edea610a26a4aa9.zh: [Blue Mockingbird](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0108) 是一个由在 Windows 系统上以动态链接库 (DLL) 形式存在的门罗币 (Monero) 加密货币挖矿载荷所构成的观察到的活动集合。最早被观察到使用 Blue Mockingbird 工具是在 2019 年 12 月。(Citation: RedCanary Mockingbird May 2020)

506f0d885664a309158e6cdb16ce254aae40f7b8.source_text: [Blue Mockingbird](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0108) has used [FRP](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1144), ssf, and Venom to establish SOCKS proxy connections.(Citation: RedCanary Mockingbird May 2020)
506f0d885664a309158e6cdb16ce254aae40f7b8.zh: [Blue Mockingbird](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0108) 使用了 [FRP](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1144)、ssf 和 Venom 来建立 SOCKS 代理连接。（来源：RedCanary 2020年5月关于Mockingbird的报告）

3a09cc186e3d864b8dfbee2c40454e92f53d3269.source_text: Winter Vivern is a group linked to Russian and Belorussian interests active since at least 2020 targeting various European government and NGO entities, along with sporadic targeting of Indian and US victims. The group leverages a combination of document-based phishing activity and server-side exploitation for initial access, leveraging adversary-controlled and -created infrastructure for follow-on command and control.(Citation: DomainTools WinterVivern 2021)(Citation: SentinelOne WinterVivern 2023)(Citation: CERT-UA WinterVivern 2023)(Citation: ESET WinterVivern 2023)(Citation: Proofpoint WinterVivern 2023)
3a09cc186e3d864b8dfbee2c40454e92f53d3269.zh: Winter Vivern 是一个与俄罗斯和白俄罗斯利益相关的组织，自至少2020年起活跃，主要针对欧洲各国政府和NGO实体，并对印度和美国受害者进行零星攻击。该组织利用基于文档的网络钓鱼活动和服务器端漏洞实现初始访问，并使用攻击者控制和创建的基础设施进行后续的命令与控制。(引用: DomainTools WinterVivern 2021)(引用: SentinelOne WinterVivern 2023)(引用: CERT-UA WinterVivern 2023)(引用: ESET WinterVivern 2023)(引用: Proofpoint WinterVivern 2023)

2d7e61bae02682ab4426269326e4fe8f44bc37be.source_text: [Winter Vivern](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1035) uses HTTP and HTTPS protocols for exfiltration and command and control activity.(Citation: SentinelOne WinterVivern 2023)(Citation: CERT-UA WinterVivern 2023)
2d7e61bae02682ab4426269326e4fe8f44bc37be.zh: [Winter Vivern](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1035) 使用 HTTP 和 HTTPS 协议进行数据外泄以及命令与控制活动。(Citation: SentinelOne WinterVivern 2023)(Citation: CERT-UA WinterVivern 2023)

bb24cd7242003db8da8a619821d287f5d7570b43.source_text: [Winter Vivern](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1035) executed PowerShell scripts to create scheduled tasks to retrieve remotely-hosted payloads.(Citation: DomainTools WinterVivern 2021)
bb24cd7242003db8da8a619821d287f5d7570b43.zh: [Winter Vivern](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1035) 执行了 PowerShell 脚本以创建计划任务，用于检索远程托管的有效载荷。（出处：DomainTools WinterVivern 2021）

a2fe85bf4ae4a0456278e03e1de916b849b17f14.source_text: [SilverTerrier](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0083) is a Nigerian threat group that has been seen active since 2014. [SilverTerrier](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0083) mainly targets organizations in high technology, higher education, and manufacturing.(Citation: Unit42 SilverTerrier 2018)(Citation: Unit42 SilverTerrier 2016)
a2fe85bf4ae4a0456278e03e1de916b849b17f14.zh: [SilverTerrier](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0083) 是一个自2014年以来一直活跃的尼日利亚威胁组织。[SilverTerrier](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0083) 主要针对高科技、高等教育和制造业的组织。(Citation: Unit42 SilverTerrier 2018)(Citation: Unit42 SilverTerrier 2016)

d2dbdc3012c9be029edcd9a50bfda668981af67a.source_text: [SilverTerrier](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0083) uses SMTP for C2 communications.(Citation: Unit42 SilverTerrier 2018)
d2dbdc3012c9be029edcd9a50bfda668981af67a.zh: [SilverTerrier](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0083) 使用 SMTP 进行 C2 通信。(Citation: Unit42 SilverTerrier 2018)

4b11415efbbc9d90f1bbf94d2676420a507805bc.source_text: [SilverTerrier](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0083) uses HTTP for C2 communications.(Citation: Unit42 SilverTerrier 2018)
4b11415efbbc9d90f1bbf94d2676420a507805bc.zh: [SilverTerrier](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0083) 使用 HTTP 进行 C2 通信。（引用：Unit42 SilverTerrier 2018）

7f0fc31474f4d383b4b955673034020c555ab700.source_text: [SilverTerrier](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0083) uses FTP for C2 communications.(Citation: Unit42 SilverTerrier 2018)
7f0fc31474f4d383b4b955673034020c555ab700.zh: [SilverTerrier](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0083) 使用 FTP 进行 C2 通信。(Citation: Unit42 SilverTerrier 2018)

98e6415df460daa227969134607ded0e5b0de94e.source_text: [Dragonfly 2.0](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0074) is a suspected Russian group that has targeted government entities and multiple U.S. critical infrastructure sectors since at least December 2015. (Citation: US-CERT TA18-074A) (Citation: Symantec Dragonfly Sept 2017) There is debate over the extent of overlap between [Dragonfly 2.0](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0074) and [Dragonfly](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0035), but there is sufficient evidence to lead to these being tracked as two separate groups. (Citation: Fortune Dragonfly 2.0 Sept 2017)(Citation: Dragos DYMALLOY )
98e6415df460daa227969134607ded0e5b0de94e.zh: [Dragonfly 2.0](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0074)是一个涉嫌针对政府实体和多个美国关键基础设施领域的俄罗斯组织，至少自2015年12月起已开展活动。(Citation: US-CERT TA18-074A) (Citation: Symantec Dragonfly Sept 2017) 关于[Dragonfly 2.0](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0074)与[Dragonfly](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0035)之间重叠程度的多少存在争议，但有充分证据支持将这两个组织作为独立群体进行追踪。(Citation: Fortune Dragonfly 2.0 Sept 2017)(Citation: Dragos DYMALLOY )

f04947ec65c9978bd715d9cfb31070d08c0a6da1.source_text: [Stolen Pencil](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0086) is a threat group likely originating from DPRK that has been active since at least May 2018. The group appears to have targeted academic institutions, but its motives remain unclear.(Citation: Netscout Stolen Pencil Dec 2018)
f04947ec65c9978bd715d9cfb31070d08c0a6da1.zh: [Stolen Pencil](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0086) 是一个很可能源自朝鲜的威胁组织，自至少2018年5月以来一直活跃。该组织似乎针对了学术机构，但其动机尚不清楚。（引用来源：Netscout Stolen Pencil Dec 2018）

634403918257d432f420d3113a536d3d28cb84d0.source_text: [Turla](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0010) is a cyber espionage threat group that has been attributed to Russia's Federal Security Service (FSB). They have compromised victims in over 50 countries since at least 2004, spanning a range of industries including government, embassies, military, education, research and pharmaceutical companies. [Turla](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0010) is known for conducting watering hole and spearphishing campaigns, and leveraging in-house tools and malware, such as [Uroburos](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0022).(Citation: Kaspersky Turla)(Citation: ESET Gazer Aug 2017)(Citation: CrowdStrike VENOMOUS BEAR)(Citation: ESET Turla Mosquito Jan 2018)(Citation: Joint Cybersecurity Advisory AA23-129A Snake Malware May 2023)
634403918257d432f420d3113a536d3d28cb84d0.zh: [Turla](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0010) 是一个网络间谍威胁组织，已被认定与俄罗斯联邦安全局（FSB）有关。自2004年以来，他们已在超过50个国家的受害者中进行了入侵活动，涉及多个行业，包括政府机构、大使馆、军事部门、教育机构、研究单位和制药公司。[Turla](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0010) 以进行水坑攻击和网络钓鱼活动著称，并利用其内部的工具和恶意软件，如 [Uroburos](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0022)。（出处：Kaspersky Turla）（出处：ESET Gazer Aug 2017）（出处：CrowdStrike VENOMOUS BEAR）（出处：ESET Turla Mosquito Jan 2018）（出处：联合网络安全公告 AA23-129A Snake Malware May 2023）

508c16273d68bf1ac82ac71981fe223d05591013.source_text: [Turla](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0010) has used shellcode to download Meterpreter after compromising a victim.(Citation: ESET Turla Mosquito May 2018)
508c16273d68bf1ac82ac71981fe223d05591013.zh: [Turla](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0010) 在成功入侵受害系统后，使用 shellcode 来下载 Meterpreter。（引用：ESET Turla Mosquito May 2018）

8fdae8052ae169b87df1bb85ac38fae47bd4ebd6.source_text: [Turla](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0010) RPC backdoors have included local UPnP RPC proxies.(Citation: ESET Turla PowerShell May 2019)
8fdae8052ae169b87df1bb85ac38fae47bd4ebd6.zh: [Turla](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0010) 的 RPC 后门包括本地 UPnP RPC 代理。（引用：ESET Turla PowerShell May 2019）

26da94a00657a0de961b3f9a6d4f7a157523d722.source_text: [Turla](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0010) has used multiple backdoors which communicate with a C2 server via email attachments.(Citation: Crowdstrike GTR2020 Mar 2020)
26da94a00657a0de961b3f9a6d4f7a157523d722.zh: [Turla](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0010) 使用了多个后门程序，这些后门通过电子邮件附件与 C2 服务器进行通信。（出处：Crowdstrike GTR2020 Mar 2020）

01b7431d6ef6c03b0fb4ce69ca4d2d5230b61f05.source_text: A [Turla](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0010) JavaScript backdoor has used Google Apps Script as its C2 server.(Citation: ESET Turla Mosquito Jan 2018)(Citation: ESET Turla Mosquito May 2018)
01b7431d6ef6c03b0fb4ce69ca4d2d5230b61f05.zh: [Turla](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0010)的JavaScript后门利用Google Apps Script作为其C2服务器。（出处：ESET Turla Mosquito Jan 2018）（出处：ESET Turla Mosquito May 2018）

ca583c53b1deae68ed87dd9bf48ec7527e4eebdf.source_text: [Turla](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0010) has used HTTP and HTTPS for C2 communications.(Citation: ESET Turla Mosquito Jan 2018)(Citation: ESET Turla Mosquito May 2018)
ca583c53b1deae68ed87dd9bf48ec7527e4eebdf.zh: [Turla](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0010) 已使用 HTTP 和 HTTPS 进行 C2 通信。(Citation: ESET Turla Mosquito Jan 2018)(Citation: ESET Turla Mosquito May 2018)

ddf53f4f29fbbf0d5756959f4f04c08fd2f3a520.source_text: [Turla](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0010) has compromised internal network systems to act as a proxy to forward traffic to C2.(Citation: Talos TinyTurla September 2021)
ddf53f4f29fbbf0d5756959f4f04c08fd2f3a520.zh: [Turla](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0010) 已入侵内部网络系统，充当代理以将流量转发至命令与控制（C2）服务器。(引用：Talos TinyTurla 2021年9月报告)

5d2c9adcf6ea0af13f85500f754e78fad8685383.source_text: [Turla](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0010) has used legitimate web services including Pastebin, Dropbox, and GitHub for C2 communications.(Citation: Accenture HyperStack October 2020)(Citation: ESET Crutch December 2020)
5d2c9adcf6ea0af13f85500f754e78fad8685383.zh: [Turla](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0010) 曾使用 Pastebin、Dropbox 和 GitHub 等合法网络服务进行 C2 通信。(引用：Accenture HyperStack 2020年10月)(引用：ESET Crutch 2020年12月)

0d297a2786c2114baa703edd20898d4933244e44.source_text: [Storm-0501](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1053) is a financially motivated cyber criminal group that uses commodity and open-source tools to conduct ransomware operations. [Storm-0501](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1053) has been active since 2021 and has previously been affiliated with Sabbath Ransomware and other Ransomware-as-a-Service (RaaS) variants such as Hive, [BlackCat](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1068), Hunters International, [LockBit 3.0](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1202), and [Embargo](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1247) ransomware.(Citation: Avertium Storm-0501 Sabbath Ransomware Arcane January 2022)(Citation: Microsoft Storm-501 Sabbath Ransomware Embargo September 2024)(Citation: Microsoft Storm-0501 Embargo Ransomware August 2025)(Citation: Google Mandiant Storm-0501 Sabbath Ransomware November 2021)
0d297a2786c2114baa703edd20898d4933244e44.zh: [Storm-0501](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1053)是一个以经济利益为动机的网络犯罪组织，使用商业和开源工具进行勒索软件活动。[Storm-0501](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1053)自2021年以来一直活跃，并曾与Sabbath Ransomware及其他勒索软件即服务（RaaS）变种（如Hive、[BlackCat](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1068)、Hunters International、[LockBit 3.0](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1202)和[Embargo](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1247)勒索软件）有关联。(引用：Avertium Storm-0501 Sabbath Ransomware Arcane January 2022)(引用：Microsoft Storm-501 Sabbath Ransomware Embargo September 2024)(引用：Microsoft Storm-0501 Embargo Ransomware August 2025)(引用：Google Mandiant Storm-0501 Sabbath Ransomware November 2021)

5269748f5d769bdb53a1d76008f56992a32d4bc4.source_text: [Storm-0501](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1053) has used legitimate remote monitoring and management (RMM) tools including AnyDesk, NinjaOne, and Level.io.(Citation: Microsoft Storm-501 Sabbath Ransomware Embargo September 2024)
5269748f5d769bdb53a1d76008f56992a32d4bc4.zh: [Storm-0501](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1053) 已使用合法远程监控和管理 (RMM) 工具，包括 AnyDesk、NinjaOne 和 Level.io。(Citation: Microsoft Storm-501 Sabbath Ransomware Embargo September 2024)

5323a1044f7bf8cf264e629bb03290a8a7cd9cbe.source_text: [Poseidon Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0033) is a Portuguese-speaking threat group that has been active since at least 2005. The group has a history of using information exfiltrated from victims to blackmail victim companies into contracting the [Poseidon Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0033) as a security firm. (Citation: Kaspersky Poseidon Group)
5323a1044f7bf8cf264e629bb03290a8a7cd9cbe.zh: [Poseidon Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0033) 是一个葡萄牙语威胁组织，自2005年以来一直活跃。该组织有利用从受害者处窃取的信息进行勒索的历史，迫使受害者公司与其签订安全服务协议。（来源：Kaspersky Poseidon Group）

fe4bafd0df37097e40742879eafd5d220154aa5a.source_text: [TA505](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0092) is a cyber criminal group that has been active since at least 2014. [TA505](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0092) is known for frequently changing malware, driving global trends in criminal malware distribution, and ransomware campaigns involving [Clop](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0611).(Citation: Proofpoint TA505 Sep 2017)(Citation: Proofpoint TA505 June 2018)(Citation: Proofpoint TA505 Jan 2019)(Citation: NCC Group TA505)(Citation: Korean FSI TA505 2020)
fe4bafd0df37097e40742879eafd5d220154aa5a.zh: [TA505](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0092) 是一个自至少 2014 年以来活跃的网络犯罪组织。[TA505](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0092) 以频繁更换恶意软件、推动全球刑事恶意软件分发趋势以及涉及 [Clop](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0611) 的勒索软件行动而闻名。(引用：Proofpoint TA505 Sep 2017)(引用：Proofpoint TA505 June 2018)(引用：Proofpoint TA505 Jan 2019)(引用：NCC Group TA505)(引用：Korean FSI TA505 2020)

6641d1f58f55266729394e220cee3207b5fc5bc7.source_text: [TA505](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0092) has used fast flux to mask botnets by distributing payloads across multiple IPs.(Citation: Trend Micro TA505 June 2019)
6641d1f58f55266729394e220cee3207b5fc5bc7.zh: [TA505](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0092) 曾利用快速流转换（fast flux）技术，通过将有效载荷分布到多个 IP 地址来隐藏僵尸网络。(Citation: Trend Micro TA505 June 2019)

cd7dcd1b5181fe1405abecb0a6fa0991fd6c2928.source_text: [TA505](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0092) has downloaded additional malware to execute on victim systems.(Citation: Cybereason TA505 April 2019)(Citation: Deep Instinct TA505 Apr 2019)(Citation: ProofPoint SettingContent-ms July 2018)
cd7dcd1b5181fe1405abecb0a6fa0991fd6c2928.zh: [TA505](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0092) 已下载其他恶意软件以在受害系统上执行。(Citation: Cybereason TA505 April 2019)(Citation: Deep Instinct TA505 Apr 2019)(Citation: ProofPoint SettingContent-ms July 2018)

3c0f53dfeeb48c67b36b0a4b4c44bbdad70e8703.source_text: [TA505](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0092) has used HTTP to communicate with C2 nodes.(Citation: IBM TA505 April 2020)
3c0f53dfeeb48c67b36b0a4b4c44bbdad70e8703.zh: [TA505](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0092) 使用 HTTP 与 C2 节点进行通信。(Citation: IBM TA505 April 2020)

8a8a9c5370283733e7dd049633ddfc1856a8a3cd.source_text: [BITTER](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1002) is a suspected South Asian cyber espionage threat group that has been active since at least 2013. [BITTER](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1002) has targeted government, energy, and engineering organizations in Pakistan, China, Bangladesh, and Saudi Arabia.(Citation: Cisco Talos Bitter Bangladesh May 2022)(Citation: Forcepoint BITTER Pakistan Oct 2016)
8a8a9c5370283733e7dd049633ddfc1856a8a3cd.zh: [BITTER](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1002) 是一个涉嫌参与网络间谍活动的南亚威胁组织，自至少 2013 年起持续活跃。[BITTER](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1002) 针对巴基斯坦、中国、孟加拉国和沙特阿拉伯的政府、能源和工程机构发动攻击。(Citation: Cisco Talos Bitter Bangladesh May 2022)(Citation: Forcepoint BITTER Pakistan Oct 2016)

85b20cdbe4c0c646feb5471f042ca9a745d34eec.source_text: [BITTER](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1002) has downloaded additional malware and tools onto a compromised host.(Citation: Cisco Talos Bitter Bangladesh May 2022)(Citation: Forcepoint BITTER Pakistan Oct 2016)
85b20cdbe4c0c646feb5471f042ca9a745d34eec.zh: [BITTER](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1002)已在一个被攻陷的主机上下载了其他恶意软件和工具。(Citation: Cisco Talos Bitter Bangladesh May 2022)(Citation: Forcepoint BITTER Pakistan Oct 2016)

f06defb9c150491709311dad5503c64bd0bd4903.source_text: [BITTER](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1002) has used HTTP POST requests for C2.(Citation: Cisco Talos Bitter Bangladesh May 2022)(Citation: Forcepoint BITTER Pakistan Oct 2016)
f06defb9c150491709311dad5503c64bd0bd4903.zh: [BITTER](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1002) 曾使用 HTTP POST 请求进行命令与控制（C2）通信。（参考：Cisco Talos Bitter Bangladesh May 2022）（参考：Forcepoint BITTER Pakistan Oct 2016）

8c4212e115d0a9bc07f7522adf0db174dc1571b3.source_text: [BITTER](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1002) has used DDNS for C2 communications.(Citation: Forcepoint BITTER Pakistan Oct 2016)
8c4212e115d0a9bc07f7522adf0db174dc1571b3.zh: [BITTER](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1002) 曾使用动态域名服务（DDNS）进行命令与控制（C2）通信。（来源：Forcepoint BITTER Pakistan Oct 2016）

77f653242db17fc5980995583297c580612808ee.source_text: [BITTER](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1002) has encrypted their C2 communications.(Citation: Forcepoint BITTER Pakistan Oct 2016)
77f653242db17fc5980995583297c580612808ee.zh: [BITTER](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1002) 已对其 C2 通信进行加密。(Citation: Forcepoint BITTER Pakistan Oct 2016)

d9a0f9585658880892e93fe57d783653b19c8b2e.source_text: [BITTER](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1002) has used TCP for C2 communications.(Citation: Forcepoint BITTER Pakistan Oct 2016)
d9a0f9585658880892e93fe57d783653b19c8b2e.zh: [BITTER](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1002) 已使用 TCP 进行 C2 通信。（来源：Forcepoint BITTER Pakistan Oct 2016）

4816076eca22da9d208c3819c16f50f687a22f1b.source_text: [DarkVishnya](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0105) is a financially motivated threat actor targeting financial institutions in Eastern Europe. In 2017-2018 the group attacked at least 8 banks in this region.(Citation: Securelist DarkVishnya Dec 2018)
4816076eca22da9d208c3819c16f50f687a22f1b.zh: [DarkVishnya](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0105) 是一个以经济利益为动机的威胁行为者，主要针对东欧的金融机构。2017年至2018年间，该组织攻击了该地区至少8家银行。(Citation: Securelist DarkVishnya Dec 2018)

45c4a10f8f5a668a2fb07293fa1a117ee2bcf7ce.source_text: [DarkVishnya](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0105) used DameWare Mini Remote Control for lateral movement.(Citation: Securelist DarkVishnya Dec 2018)
45c4a10f8f5a668a2fb07293fa1a117ee2bcf7ce.zh: [DarkVishnya](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0105) 使用 DameWare Mini Remote Control 进行横向移动。(引用: Securelist DarkVishnya Dec 2018)

cee8303968a95283c1ddbd182f1e5dd732c630ff.source_text: [DarkVishnya](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0105) used ports 5190 and 7900 for shellcode listeners, and 4444, 4445, 31337 for shellcode C2.(Citation: Securelist DarkVishnya Dec 2018)
cee8303968a95283c1ddbd182f1e5dd732c630ff.zh: [DarkVishnya](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0105) 使用端口 5190 和 7900 作为 shellcode 监听器，使用端口 4444、4445、31337 作为 shellcode C2。（引用：Securelist DarkVishnya Dec 2018）

13f7812d244806bdd3c4ce59379fb80b2b918426.source_text: [RedCurl](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1039) is a threat actor active since 2018 notable for corporate espionage targeting a variety of locations, including Ukraine, Canada and the United Kingdom, and a variety of industries, including but not limited to travel agencies, insurance companies, and banks.(Citation: group-ib_redcurl1) [RedCurl](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1039) is allegedly a Russian-speaking threat actor.(Citation: group-ib_redcurl1)(Citation: group-ib_redcurl2) The group’s operations typically start with spearphishing emails to gain initial access, then the group executes discovery and collection commands and scripts to find corporate data. The group concludes operations by exfiltrating files to the C2 servers.
13f7812d244806bdd3c4ce59379fb80b2b918426.zh: [RedCurl](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1039) 是一个自2018年以来活跃的黑客组织，以针对乌克兰、加拿大和英国等多个地点以及旅行社、保险公司和银行等各种行业（包括但不限于这些行业）的企业间谍活动而闻名。(Citation: group-ib_redcurl1)[RedCurl](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1039)据信是一个讲俄语的黑客组织。(Citation: group-ib_redcurl1)(Citation: group-ib_redcurl2)该组织的操作通常从发送钓鱼邮件开始，以获得初始访问权限，然后执行发现和收集命令及脚本来查找企业数据。最后，该组织通过将文件传输到C2服务器来完成其操作。

4684a43a59a92dad13680c92f08bf3f5c7f7dec4.source_text: [RedCurl](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1039) has used web services to download malicious files.(Citation: group-ib_redcurl1)(Citation: group-ib_redcurl2)
4684a43a59a92dad13680c92f08bf3f5c7f7dec4.zh: [RedCurl](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1039) 利用 Web 服务下载恶意文件。(Citation: group-ib_redcurl1)(Citation: group-ib_redcurl2)

87abc96cab0ffe33dc06c0ada86a122d5fce5d85.source_text: [RedCurl](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1039) has used AES-128 CBC to encrypt C2 communications.(Citation: group-ib_redcurl2)
87abc96cab0ffe33dc06c0ada86a122d5fce5d85.zh: [RedCurl](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1039) 曾使用 AES-128 CBC 加密其 C2 通信。(Citation: group-ib_redcurl2)

1702fbebcc4b1e88948606e3f66e9bd46c26ba00.source_text: [RedCurl](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1039) has used HTTP, HTTPS and Webdav protocls for C2 communications.(Citation: group-ib_redcurl1)(Citation: group-ib_redcurl2)
1702fbebcc4b1e88948606e3f66e9bd46c26ba00.zh: [RedCurl](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1039) 已使用 HTTP、HTTPS 和 Webdav 协议进行 C2 通信。（出处：group-ib_redcurl1）（出处：group-ib_redcurl2）

e3c14b9cdb801beac7913c72ae4b85ed48cb9ee9.source_text: [RedCurl](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1039) has used HTTPS for C2 communication.(Citation: group-ib_redcurl1)(Citation: group-ib_redcurl2)
e3c14b9cdb801beac7913c72ae4b85ed48cb9ee9.zh: [RedCurl](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1039) 已使用 HTTPS 进行 C2 通信。（引用：group-ib_redcurl1）（引用：group-ib_redcurl2）

a6e1c84e3c590517cf976ac0b0dfd5a9c301a959.source_text: [APT-C-23](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1028) is a threat group that has been active since at least 2014.(Citation: symantec_mantis) [APT-C-23](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1028) has primarily focused its operations on the Middle East, including Israeli military assets. [APT-C-23](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1028) has developed mobile spyware targeting Android and iOS devices since 2017.(Citation: welivesecurity_apt-c-23)
a6e1c84e3c590517cf976ac0b0dfd5a9c301a959.zh: [APT-C-23](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1028) 是一个自至少 2014 年以来活跃的黑客组织。[APT-C-23](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1028) 的行动主要集中在中东地区，包括以色列的军事资产。(Citation: symantec_mantis) [APT-C-23](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1028) 自 2017 年起开发了针对 Android 和 iOS 设备的移动间谍软件。(Citation: welivesecurity_apt-c-23)

db612d52f99aec2e405912ad909283fed8011375.source_text: [FIN5](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0053) is a financially motivated threat group that has targeted personally identifiable information and payment card information. The group has been active since at least 2008 and has targeted the restaurant, gaming, and hotel industries. The group is made up of actors who likely speak Russian. (Citation: FireEye Respond Webinar July 2017) (Citation: Mandiant FIN5 GrrCON Oct 2016) (Citation: DarkReading FireEye FIN5 Oct 2015)
db612d52f99aec2e405912ad909283fed8011375.zh: [FIN5](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0053)是一个以经济利益为动机的威胁组织，曾针对个人可识别信息和支付卡信息。该组织自至少2008年以来一直活跃，主要针对餐饮、博彩和酒店行业。该组织的成员很可能使用俄语进行交流。（出处：FireEye Respond Webinar 2017年7月）（出处：Mandiant FIN5 GrrCON 2016年10月）（出处：DarkReading FireEye FIN5 2015年10月）

a39cf1929ca60ea305a79891ada9e6c40c0dbeb4.source_text: [FIN5](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0053) maintains access to victim environments by using [FLIPSIDE](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0173) to create a proxy for a backup RDP tunnel.(Citation: Mandiant FIN5 GrrCON Oct 2016)
a39cf1929ca60ea305a79891ada9e6c40c0dbeb4.zh: [FIN5](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0053)通过利用[FLIPSIDE](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0173)为备用RDP隧道创建代理，从而维持对受害者环境的访问权限。(Citation: Mandiant FIN5 GrrCON Oct 2016)

cb2c1b2f16e3f3736925a9a2818ef61142913133.source_text: [Mofang](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0103) is a likely China-based cyber espionage group, named for its frequent practice of imitating a victim's infrastructure. This adversary has been observed since at least May 2012 conducting focused attacks against government and critical infrastructure in Myanmar, as well as several other countries and sectors including military, automobile, and weapons industries.(Citation: FOX-IT May 2016 Mofang)
cb2c1b2f16e3f3736925a9a2818ef61142913133.zh: [Mofang](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0103) 是一个可能源自中国的网络间谍组织，因其经常模仿受害者的基础设施而得名。自2012年5月以来，已观察到该敌对势力针对缅甸的政府及关键基础设施展开针对性攻击，同时还涉及其他多个国家以及军事、汽车和武器行业等多个领域。(Citation: FOX-IT May 2016 Mofang)

f7b1da72fd79eb2521cccddc55d4ceaf3e5d6253.source_text: [Lotus Blossom](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0030) is a long-standing threat group largely targeting various entities in Asia since at least 2009. In addition to government and related targets, [Lotus Blossom](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0030) has also targeted entities such as digital certificate issuers.(Citation: Lotus Blossom Jun 2015)(Citation: Symantec Bilbug 2022)(Citation: Cisco LotusBlossom 2025)
f7b1da72fd79eb2521cccddc55d4ceaf3e5d6253.zh: [Lotus Blossom](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0030) 是一个长期活动的威胁组织，自至少2009年以来主要针对亚洲各地的各类实体。除了政府和关联目标外，[Lotus Blossom](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0030) 还针对数字证书发行机构等实体。(Citation: Lotus Blossom Jun 2015)(Citation: Symantec Bilbug 2022)(Citation: Cisco LotusBlossom 2025)

8b532bbff510c60008fd307cf74be61a3541f5a6.source_text: [Lotus Blossom](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0030) has used publicly available tools such as the Venom proxy tool to proxy traffic out of victim environments.(Citation: Cisco LotusBlossom 2025)
8b532bbff510c60008fd307cf74be61a3541f5a6.zh: [Lotus Blossom](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0030) 已使用诸如 Venom 代理工具等公开可用的工具，将流量从受害者环境中通过代理进行外传。(Citation: Cisco LotusBlossom 2025)

0526eedb421c26af8492b3833ddc3b23e9a1a144.source_text: [Lotus Blossom](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0030) has used tools such as the publicly available HTran tool for proxying traffic in victim environments.(Citation: Cisco LotusBlossom 2025)
0526eedb421c26af8492b3833ddc3b23e9a1a144.zh: [莲花]（Lotus Blossom）（https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0030）在受害者环境中使用过诸如公开发布的 HTran 工具等工具来进行流量代理。（出处：Cisco LotusBlossom 2025）

dcc6da557b8dd66139c30ed295cd73760d120bf8.source_text: [Stealth Falcon](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0038) is a threat group that has conducted targeted spyware attacks against Emirati journalists, activists, and dissidents since at least 2012. Circumstantial evidence suggests there could be a link between this group and the United Arab Emirates (UAE) government, but that has not been confirmed. (Citation: Citizen Lab Stealth Falcon May 2016)
dcc6da557b8dd66139c30ed295cd73760d120bf8.zh: [Stealth Falcon](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0038) 是一个自至少2012年以来针对阿联酋记者、活动人士和异议人士进行针对性间谍软件攻击的威胁组织。间接证据表明该组织与阿拉伯联合酋长国（UAE）政府之间可能存在联系，但尚未得到证实。（出处：Citizen Lab Stealth Falcon May 2016）

b9a2de2a6566a7b764adbdb89068db39cdb93ffc.source_text: [Stealth Falcon](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0038) malware encrypts C2 traffic using RC4 with a hard-coded key.(Citation: Citizen Lab Stealth Falcon May 2016)
b9a2de2a6566a7b764adbdb89068db39cdb93ffc.zh: [隐形猎鹰](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0038) 恶意软件使用硬编码密钥通过 RC4 加密 C2 流量。（来源：公民实验室 隐形猎鹰 2016年5月）

eabb8de000945ee4bf2590de3633c221d97f9670.source_text: [Stealth Falcon](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0038) malware communicates with its C2 server via HTTPS.(Citation: Citizen Lab Stealth Falcon May 2016)
eabb8de000945ee4bf2590de3633c221d97f9670.zh: [Stealth Falcon](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0038) 恶意软件通过 HTTPS 与其 C2 服务器进行通信。（引用：Citizen Lab Stealth Falcon May 2016）

57d67daa4ee2463ec293f849b406c05c0783e3c9.source_text: [APT29](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0016) is threat group that has been attributed to Russia's Foreign Intelligence Service (SVR).(Citation: White House Imposing Costs RU Gov April 2021)(Citation: UK Gov Malign RIS Activity April 2021) They have operated since at least 2008, often targeting government networks in Europe and NATO member countries, research institutes, and think tanks. [APT29](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0016) reportedly compromised the Democratic National Committee starting in the summer of 2015.(Citation: F-Secure The Dukes)(Citation: GRIZZLY STEPPE JAR)(Citation: Crowdstrike DNC June 2016)(Citation: UK Gov UK Exposes Russia SolarWinds April 2021) In April 2021, the US and UK governments attributed the [SolarWinds Compromise](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0024) to the SVR; public statements included citations to [APT29](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0016), Cozy Bear, and The Dukes.(Citation: NSA Joint Advisory SVR SolarWinds April 2021)(Citation: UK NSCS Russia SolarWinds April 2021) Industry reporting also referred to the actors involved in this campaign as UNC2452, NOBELIUM, StellarParticle, Dark Halo, and SolarStorm.(Citation: FireEye SUNBURST Backdoor December 2020)(Citation: MSTIC NOBELIUM Mar 2021)(Citation: CrowdStrike SUNSPOT Implant January 2021)(Citation: Volexity SolarWinds)(Citation: Cybersecurity Advisory SVR TTP May 2021)(Citation: Unit 42 SolarStorm December 2020)
57d67daa4ee2463ec293f849b406c05c0783e3c9.zh: [APT29](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0016) 是一个被归因于俄罗斯对外情报局（SVR）的威胁组织。(Citation: White House Imposing Costs RU Gov April 2021)(Citation: UK Gov Malign RIS Activity April 2021) 该组织自至少2008年以来一直在运作，通常针对欧洲和北约成员国的政府网络、研究机构和智库。据报道，[APT29](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0016) 从2015年夏天开始入侵了美国民主党全国委员会。(Citation: F-Secure The Dukes)(Citation: GRIZZLY STEPPE JAR)(Citation: Crowdstrike DNC June 2016)(Citation: UK Gov UK Exposes Russia SolarWinds April 2021) 2021年4月，美国和英国政府将 [SolarWinds Compromise](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0024) 归因于SVR；公开声明中提到了 [APT29](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0016)、Cozy Bear 和 The Dukes。(Citation: NSA Joint Advisory SVR SolarWinds April 2021)(Citation: UK NSCS Russia SolarWinds April 2021) 行业报告也将参与此次活动的实体称为 UNC2452、NOBELIUM、StellarParticle、Dark Halo 和 SolarStorm。(Citation: FireEye SUNBURST Backdoor December 2020)(Citation: MSTIC NOBELIUM Mar 2021)(Citation: CrowdStrike SUNSPOT Implant January 2021)(Citation: Volexity SolarWinds)(Citation: Cybersecurity Advisory SVR TTP May 2021)(Citation: Unit 42 SolarStorm December 2020)

f529d71b0a2a7751ca5b4c52b498dfcd6b0b3e93.source_text: Adversaries may take advantage of routing schemes in Content Delivery Networks (CDNs) and other services which host multiple domains to obfuscate the intended destination of HTTPS traffic or traffic tunneled through HTTPS. (Citation: Fifield Blocking Resistent Communication through domain fronting 2015) Domain fronting involves using different domain names in the SNI field of the TLS header and the Host field of the HTTP header. If both domains are served from the same CDN, then the CDN may route to the address specified in the HTTP header after unwrapping the TLS header. A variation of the the technique, "domainless" fronting, utilizes a SNI field that is left blank; this may allow the fronting to work even when the CDN attempts to validate that the SNI and HTTP Host fields match (if the blank SNI fields are ignored). For example, if domain-x and domain-y are customers of the same CDN, it is possible to place domain-x in the TLS header and domain-y in the HTTP header. Traffic will appear to be going to domain-x, however the CDN may route it to domain-y.
f529d71b0a2a7751ca5b4c52b498dfcd6b0b3e93.zh: 敌对方可利用内容分发网络（CDN）及其他托管多个域名的服务的路由方案，以混淆 HTTPS 流量或通过 HTTPS 隧道传输的流量的预期目的地。（引用：Fifield Blocking Resistent Communication through domain fronting 2015）域名前端（domain fronting）技术涉及在 TLS 头部的 SNI 字段和 HTTP 头部的 Host 字段中使用不同的域名。如果这两个域名都由同一个 CDN 提供服务，那么 CDN 可能在剥离 TLS 头部后将流量路由到 HTTP 头部中指定的地址。该技术的一种变体是“无域名（domainless）”前端技术，其使用的 SNI 字段为空；这即使在该 CDN 试图验证 SNI 和 HTTP Host 字段匹配时（如果忽略空的 SNI 字段），也可能使前端技术生效。例如，如果 domain-x 和 domain-y 是同一 CDN 的客户，则可以在 TLS 头部放置 domain-x，而在 HTTP 头部放置 domain-y。流量将显示为发往 domain-x，但 CDN 可能将其路由到 domain-y。

17787f3da3278306b77d90d593b18b89b59405d7.source_text: A backdoor used by [APT29](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0016) created a [Tor](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0183) hidden service to forward traffic from the [Tor](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0183) client to local ports 3389 (RDP), 139 (Netbios), and 445 (SMB) enabling full remote access from outside the network and has also used TOR.(Citation: Mandiant No Easy Breach)(Citation: MSTIC Nobelium Oct 2021)
17787f3da3278306b77d90d593b18b89b59405d7.zh: 由 [APT29](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0016) 使用的一个后门创建了一个 [Tor](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0183) 隐藏服务，用于将来自 [Tor](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0183) 客户端的流量转发到本地端口 3389（RDP）、139（Netbios）和 445（SMB），从而实现从网络外部进行完整的远程访问。此外，该组织还使用了 TOR。(引用：Mandiant No Easy Breach)(引用：MSTIC Nobelium 2021年10月)

0692b8a2fea5d6713be997ec910d89316dc65e16.zh: [APT29](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0016) 利用被攻陷的住宅端点作为代理，以实现防御规避和获取网络访问权限。（引用：NCSC 等 APT29 2024）

ecc30306459cebe183b4e840f8f9165bd45c2a93.source_text: [APT29](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0016) has used multiple layers of encryption within malware to protect C2 communication.(Citation: Secureworks IRON HEMLOCK Profile)
ecc30306459cebe183b4e840f8f9165bd45c2a93.zh: [APT29](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0016) 在恶意软件中使用了多层加密来保护 C2 通信。（引用：Secureworks IRON HEMLOCK Profile）

4713315b89d5f68ad26e88e7474a162627ad63db.source_text: [APT29](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0016) uses compromised residential endpoints, typically within the same ISP IP address range, as proxies to hide the true source of C2 traffic.(Citation: NCSC et al APT29 2024)
4713315b89d5f68ad26e88e7474a162627ad63db.zh: [APT29](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0016) 使用被入侵的家庭终端，这些终端通常位于同一ISP IP地址范围内，作为代理来隐藏C2流量的真实来源。(Citation: NCSC et al APT29 2024)

e3ab962f8ec1dd60b244b14a46ccc60126688b9d.source_text: [Dark Caracal](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0070) is threat group that has been attributed to the Lebanese General Directorate of General Security (GDGS) and has operated since at least 2012. (Citation: Lookout Dark Caracal Jan 2018)
e3ab962f8ec1dd60b244b14a46ccc60126688b9d.zh: [Dark Caracal](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0070) 是一个被归因于黎巴嫩国家安全总局（GDGS）的威胁组织，自2012年以来一直在运作。（来源：Lookout Dark Caracal Jan 2018）

0af4040e02d466401913abe240b88399c6c667b0.source_text: [Dark Caracal](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0070)'s version of [Bandook](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0234) communicates with their server over a TCP port using HTTP payloads Base64 encoded and suffixed with the string “&&&”.(Citation: Lookout Dark Caracal Jan 2018)
0af4040e02d466401913abe240b88399c6c667b0.zh: [Dark Caracal](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0070) 的 [Bandook](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0234) 版本通过 TCP 端口与其服务器通信，使用经过 Base64 编码并以字符串“&&&”结尾的 HTTP 有效载荷。(Citation: Lookout Dark Caracal Jan 2018)

bc9e76a9525dfa3a0aecd4e82539797c6f44d31d.source_text: Adversaries may communicate using application layer protocols associated with web protocols traffic to avoid detection/network filtering by blending in with existing traffic. Commands to remote mobile devices, and often the results of those commands, will be embedded within the protocol traffic between the mobile client and server. Web protocols such as HTTP and HTTPS are used for web traffic as well as well as notification services native to mobile messaging services such as Google Cloud Messaging (GCM) and newly, Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM), (GCM/FCM: two-way communication) and Apple Push Notification Service (APNS; one-way server-to-device). Such notification services leverage HTTP/S via the respective API and are commonly abused on Android and iOS respectively in order blend in with routine device traffic making it difficult for enterprises to inspect.
bc9e76a9525dfa3a0aecd4e82539797c6f44d31d.zh: adversaries may communicate using application layer protocols associated with web protocol traffic to avoid detection/network filtering by blending in with existing traffic. 39239705effa7b628cbfcccf0530ae1301b5490a.source_text: [Dark Caracal](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0070) controls implants using standard HTTP communication.(Citation: Lookout Dark Caracal Jan 2018)
39239705effa7b628cbfcccf0530ae1301b5490a.zh: [Dark Caracal](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0070) 使用标准的 HTTP 通信来控制植入物。(Citation: Lookout Dark Caracal Jan 2018)

34cbc8754f27db15d54e1b36827abc8a8e27fa04.source_text: [Cinnamon Tempest](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1021) is a China-based threat group that has been active since at least 2021 deploying multiple strains of ransomware based on the leaked [Babuk](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0638) source code. [Cinnamon Tempest](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1021) does not operate their ransomware on an affiliate model or purchase access but appears to act independently in all stages of the attack lifecycle. Based on victimology, the short lifespan of each ransomware variant, and use of malware attributed to government-sponsored threat groups, [Cinnamon Tempest](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1021) may be motivated by intellectual property theft or cyberespionage rather than financial gain.(Citation: Microsoft Ransomware as a Service)(Citation: Microsoft Threat Actor Naming July 2023)(Citation: Trend Micro Cheerscrypt May 2022)(Citation: SecureWorks BRONZE STARLIGHT Ransomware Operations June 2022)
34cbc8754f27db15d54e1b36827abc8a8e27fa04.zh: [Cinnamon Tempest](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1021) 是一个总部位于中国的威胁组织，自至少 2021 年以来一直活跃，部署了多种基于泄露的 [Babuk](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0638) 源代码的勒索软件变种。[Cinnamon Tempest](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1021) 不以联盟模式运营其勒索软件或购买访问权限，而是在攻击生命周期的所有阶段似乎独立行动。基于受害者画像、每种勒索软件变体的短暂生命周期以及使用归因于政府赞助威胁组织的恶意软件，[Cinnamon Tempest](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1021) 可能受知识产权窃取或网络间谍活动驱动，而非出于经济利益。(Citation: Microsoft Ransomware as a Service)(Citation: Microsoft Threat Actor Naming July 2023)(Citation: Trend Micro Cheerscrypt May 2022)(Citation: SecureWorks BRONZE STARLIGHT Ransomware Operations June 2022)

33bc4f323afac151802d4acdb1df67cb66bc8094.source_text: [Cinnamon Tempest](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1021) has downloaded files, including [Cobalt Strike](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0154), to compromised hosts.(Citation: Sygnia Emperor Dragonfly October 2022)
33bc4f323afac151802d4acdb1df67cb66bc8094.zh: [Cinnamon Tempest](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1021) 已下载文件，包括 [Cobalt Strike](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0154)，到被感染的宿主。（Citation: Sygnia Emperor Dragonfly October 2022）

87051560354bedb99730f48f627dc68138d52406.source_text: [Cinnamon Tempest](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1021) has used a customized version of the Iox port-forwarding and proxy tool.(Citation: Sygnia Emperor Dragonfly October 2022)
87051560354bedb99730f48f627dc68138d52406.zh: [Cinnamon Tempest](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1021) 使用了定制版的 Iox 端口转发和代理工具。（来源：Sygnia Emperor Dragonfly October 2022）

e1d9ee5804d6777b8a94f05b021c58e40288500b.source_text: [Cinnamon Tempest](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1021) has used the Iox and NPS proxy and tunneling tools in combination create multiple connections through a single tunnel.(Citation: Sygnia Emperor Dragonfly October 2022)
e1d9ee5804d6777b8a94f05b021c58e40288500b.zh: [Cinnamon Tempest](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1021) 组合使用了 Iox 和 NPS 代理与隧道工具，通过单个隧道创建多个连接。（引用：Sygnia Emperor Dragonfly October 2022）

7d27bd3b880fd6d5d8e71387f344570df93db852.source_text: [Chimera](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0114) is a suspected China-based threat group that has been active since at least 2018 targeting the semiconductor industry in Taiwan as well as data from the airline industry.(Citation: Cycraft Chimera April 2020)(Citation: NCC Group Chimera January 2021)
7d27bd3b880fd6d5d8e71387f344570df93db852.zh: [Chimera](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0114) 是一个涉嫌位于中国的威胁行为体，自至少2018年以来一直活跃，目标包括台湾的半导体行业以及航空业的数据。(Citation: Cycraft Chimera April 2020)(Citation: NCC Group Chimera January 2021)

f5ff362d062d77fe3d7e967c68dc541036912ce2.source_text: [Chimera](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0114) has used HTTPS for C2 communications.(Citation: NCC Group Chimera January 2021)
f5ff362d062d77fe3d7e967c68dc541036912ce2.zh: [Chimera](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0114) 已使用 HTTPS 进行 C2 通信。（出处：NCC Group Chimera January 2021）

a61c5ed2249bf23ae25c3efbd97e28cbd0e60e88.source_text: [Chimera](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0114) has used [Cobalt Strike](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0154) to encapsulate C2 in DNS traffic.(Citation: NCC Group Chimera January 2021)
a61c5ed2249bf23ae25c3efbd97e28cbd0e60e88.zh: [Chimera](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0114) 曾使用 [Cobalt Strike](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0154) 将 C2 通信封装到 DNS 流量中。(Citation: NCC Group Chimera January 2021)

cc4ac9de9478aa27342ea3442f2e0691bdbb6bbb.source_text: [Chimera](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0114) has encapsulated [Cobalt Strike](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0154)'s C2 protocol in DNS and HTTPS.(Citation: NCC Group Chimera January 2021)
cc4ac9de9478aa27342ea3442f2e0691bdbb6bbb.zh: [Chimera](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0114) 将 [Cobalt Strike](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0154) 的 C2 协议封装在 DNS 和 HTTPS 中。(Citation: NCC Group Chimera January 2021)

a1f75a93ac11f708b5c0ca466c95ee3f3270cc56.source_text: [Chimera](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0114) has remotely copied tools and malware onto targeted systems.(Citation: Cycraft Chimera April 2020)
a1f75a93ac11f708b5c0ca466c95ee3f3270cc56.zh: [Chimera](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0114) 将工具和恶意软件远程复制到目标系统上。(引用: Cycraft Chimera 2020年4月)

22ed85ec6b874865ede07be78c4814ba84b2b45b.source_text: [MirrorFace](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1054) is a People's Republic of China (PRC)-aligned cyberespionage actor believed to be a subgroup under the [menuPass](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0045) umbrella based on targeting, tools, and infrastructure overlaps. [MirrorFace](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1054) has been active since at least 2019, at first exclusively targeting Japanese organizations across the media, defense, diplomatic, financial, manufacturing, and academic sectors. Subsequent [MirrorFace](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1054) operations included targets in Central Europe and featured use of [LODEINFO](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9020), [HiddenFace](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9023), and [UPPERCUT](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0275) malware.(Citation: Kaspersky LODEINFO OCT 2022)(Citation: Kaspersky LODEINFO Part II OCT 2022)(Citation: ESET MirrorFace DEC 2022)(Citation: JPCERT MirrorFace JUL 2024)(Citation: Trend Micro Earth Kasha NOV 2024)(Citation: Trend Micro Earth Kasha Updates APR 2025)
22ed85ec6b874865ede07be78c4814ba84b2b45b.zh: [MirrorFace](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1054) 是一个与中华人民共和国（PRC）关联的网络间谍行为体，被认为是在 [menuPass](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0045) 伞形组织下的一个子群体，依据是目标、工具和基础设施的重叠。[MirrorFace](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1054) 自至少 2019 年以来活跃，最初专门针对日本的组织，涉及媒体、国防、外交、金融、制造和学术部门。后续的 [MirrorFace](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1054) 行动包括了对中欧地区的目标，并使用了 [LODEINFO](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9020)、[HiddenFace](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9023) 和 [UPPERCUT](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0275) 恶意软件。(Citation: Kaspersky LODEINFO OCT 2022)(Citation: Kaspersky LODEINFO Part II OCT 2022)(Citation: ESET MirrorFace DEC 2022)(Citation: JPCERT MirrorFace JUL 2024)(Citation: Trend Micro Earth Kasha NOV 2024)(Citation: Trend Micro Earth Kasha Updates APR 2025)

0233c99626e2641cd6606fe3012e023d994f60b6.source_text: [MirrorFace](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1054) has used the GO Simple Tunnel (GOST) proxy tool.(Citation: JPCERT MirrorFace JUL 2024)
0233c99626e2641cd6606fe3012e023d994f60b6.zh: [MirrorFace](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1054) 使用了 GO Simple Tunnel（GOST）代理工具。（引用：JPCERT MirrorFace JUL 2024）

7dbba8bd3851d990ed10f646ac7fdcc56307054c.source_text: [MirrorFace](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1054) has used the the PuTTY suite Secure Copy Protocol (SCP) client for file transfer.(Citation: ESET MirrorFace DEC 2022)
7dbba8bd3851d990ed10f646ac7fdcc56307054c.zh: [MirrorFace](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1054)曾使用PuTTY套件中的安全复制协议（SCP）客户端进行文件传输。（引用：ESET MirrorFace 2022年12月报告）

393b18da5a3b4b73dcf241f6508f1c9fd38914de.source_text: [Cleaver](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0003) is a threat group that has been attributed to Iranian actors and is responsible for activity tracked as Operation Cleaver. (Citation: Cylance Cleaver) Strong circumstantial evidence suggests Cleaver is linked to Threat Group 2889 (TG-2889). (Citation: Dell Threat Group 2889)
393b18da5a3b4b73dcf241f6508f1c9fd38914de.zh: [Cleaver](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0003) 是一个被归因于伊朗行为者的威胁组织，负责被追踪为“Cleaver行动”的活动。（来源：Cylance Cleaver）强有力的间接证据表明，Cleaver与威胁组织2889（TG-2889）有关联。（来源：Dell Threat Group 2889）

beffd0acc55b0dcaaac0838fc1c4321e7a78733d.source_text: [Silent Librarian](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0122) is a group that has targeted research and proprietary data at universities, government agencies, and private sector companies worldwide since at least 2013. Members of [Silent Librarian](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0122) are known to have been affiliated with the Iran-based Mabna Institute which has conducted cyber intrusions at the behest of the government of Iran, specifically the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC).(Citation: DOJ Iran Indictments March 2018)(Citation: Phish Labs Silent Librarian)(Citation: Malwarebytes Silent Librarian October 2020)
beffd0acc55b0dcaaac0838fc1c4321e7a78733d.zh: [Silent Librarian](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0122)是一个自至少2013年以来针对全球大学、政府机构和私营企业的研究和专有数据开展网络攻击的组织。据知，[Silent Librarian](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0122)成员与位于伊朗的Mabna研究所存在关联，该研究所受伊朗政府（特别是伊斯兰革命卫队（IRGC））指使进行网络入侵活动。(Citation: DOJ Iran Indictments March 2018)(Citation: Phish Labs Silent Librarian)(Citation: Malwarebytes Silent Librarian October 2020)

e81cac14ce0bcb1584c0edb3571f200eb9f64345.source_text: [Medusa Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1051) has been active since at least 2021 and was initially operated as a closed ransomware group before evolving into a Ransomware-as-a-Service (RaaS) operation. Some reporting indicates that certain attacks may still be conducted directly by the ransomware’s core developers. Public sources have also referred to the group as “Spearwing” or “Medusa Actors.” (Citation: CISA Medusa Group Medusa Ransomware March 2025) (Citation: Broadcom Medusa Ransomware Medusa Group March 2025) [Medusa Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1051) employs living-off-the-land techniques, frequently leveraging publicly available tools and common remote management software to conduct operations. The group engages in double extortion tactics, exfiltrating data prior to encryption and threatening to publish stolen information if ransom demands are not met. (Citation: Security Scorecard Medusa Ransomware January 2024) For initial access, [Medusa Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1051) has exploited publicly known vulnerabilities, conducted phishing campaigns, and used credentials or access purchased from Initial Access Brokers (IABs). The group is opportunistic and has targeted a wide range of sectors globally. (Citation: Intel471 Medusa Ransomware May 2025)
e81cac14ce0bcb1584c0edb3571f200eb9f64345.zh: [Medusa Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1051)自2021年以来一直活跃，最初作为一个封闭式勒索软件团伙运作，随后演变为勒索软件即服务（RaaS）运营。部分报道表明，某些攻击可能仍由该勒索软件的核心开发人员直接执行。公共来源也将该组织称为“Spearwing”或“Medusa Actors”。（Citation: CISA Medusa Group Medusa Ransomware March 2025）（Citation: Broadcom Medusa Ransomware Medusa Group March 2025）[Medusa Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1051)采用“利用生存于陆地”（living-off-the-land）技术，经常利用公开可用的工具和常见的远程管理软件开展行动。该组织从事双重勒索策略，在加密之前窃取数据，并威胁若未满足勒索要求，将公布被盗信息。（Citation: Security Scorecard Medusa Ransomware January 2024）为了实现初始访问，[Medusa Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1051)利用了已知漏洞、实施了网络钓鱼活动，并使用从初始访问经纪人（IABs）处购买的凭证或访问权限。该组织具有机会主义特征，在全球范围内针对多个行业展开攻击。（Citation: Intel471 Medusa Ransomware May 2025）

54cc3446d2eaec1db0d74a457d10d196ce4acfa6.source_text: [Medusa Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1051) has communicated through reverse or bind shells over port 443 (HTTPS).(Citation: CISA Medusa Group Medusa Ransomware March 2025)
54cc3446d2eaec1db0d74a457d10d196ce4acfa6.zh: [Medusa Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1051) 已通过端口443（HTTPS）上的反向或绑定 shell 进行通信。（引用：CISA Medusa Group Medusa Ransomware March 2025）

23b6866beb1ecfa3a4566fff531b8c8c4599ea07.source_text: [Medusa Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1051) has used TOR nodes for communications.(Citation: Palo Alto Unit 42 Medusa Group Medusa Ransomware January 2024)(Citation: Check Point Medusa Ransomware April 2025)(Citation: Broadcom Medusa Ransomware Medusa Group March 2025)
23b6866beb1ecfa3a4566fff531b8c8c4599ea07.zh: [Medusa 组织](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1051)曾使用 TOR 节点进行通信。（Citation: Palo Alto Unit 42 Medusa Group Medusa Ransomware January 2024）（Citation: Check Point Medusa Ransomware April 2025）（Citation: Broadcom Medusa Ransomware Medusa Group March 2025）

f6736592a1be3eba39bf2c5752adb0b42c38490e.source_text: [Medusa Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1051) has leveraged [certutil](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0160), PowerShell, and Windows Command to download additional tools to include RMM services.(Citation: CISA Medusa Group Medusa Ransomware March 2025) [Medusa Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1051) has also engaged in “Bring Your Own Vulnerable Driver” (BYOVD) and downloaded vulnerable or signed drivers to the victim environment to disable security tools.(Citation: CISA Medusa Group Medusa Ransomware March 2025)(Citation: Broadcom Medusa Ransomware Medusa Group March 2025)
f6736592a1be3eba39bf2c5752adb0b42c38490e.zh: [Medusa Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1051) 利用 [certutil](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0160)、PowerShell 和 Windows 命令下载附加工具，包括远程监控和管理（RMM）服务。（引用：CISA Medusa Group Medusa Ransomware March 2025）[Medusa Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1051) 还参与了“自带易受攻击驱动”（BYOVD）攻击，并将易受攻击或已签名的驱动程序下载到受害者环境中，以禁用安全工具。（引用：CISA Medusa Group Medusa Ransomware March 2025）（引用：Broadcom Medusa Ransomware Medusa Group March 2025）

5aeb8b33c3e4f078e048d598a003951920a00b07.source_text: [Medusa Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1051) has leveraged Remote Access Software for lateral movement and data exfiltration.(Citation: Palo Alto Unit 42 Medusa Group Medusa Ransomware January 2024)(Citation: CISA Medusa Group Medusa Ransomware March 2025)(Citation: Broadcom Medusa Ransomware Medusa Group March 2025)(Citation: Security Scorecard Medusa Ransomware January 2024) [Medusa Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1051) has also been known to utilize Remote Access Software such as AnyDesk, Atera, ConnectWise, eHorus, N-Able, PDQ Deploy, PDQ Inventory, SimpleHelp and Splashtop.(Citation: CISA Medusa Group Medusa Ransomware March 2025)
5aeb8b33c3e4f078e048d598a003951920a00b07.zh: [Medusa Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1051) 利用远程访问软件进行横向移动和数据外泄。（引用：Palo Alto Unit 42 Medusa Group Medusa Ransomware January 2024）（引用：CISA Medusa Group Medusa Ransomware March 2025）（引用：Broadcom Medusa Ransomware Medusa Group March 2025）（引用：Security Scorecard Medusa Ransomware January 2024）[Medusa Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1051) 还被已知使用 AnyDesk、Atera、ConnectWise、eHorus、N-Able、PDQ Deploy、PDQ Inventory、SimpleHelp 和 Splashtop 等远程访问软件。（引用：CISA Medusa Group Medusa Ransomware March 2025）

e298f10e0bb328ebc1725faec294bff15dba95fe.source_text: [Medusa Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1051) has used HTTPS for command and control.(Citation: CISA Medusa Group Medusa Ransomware March 2025)
e298f10e0bb328ebc1725faec294bff15dba95fe.zh: [Medusa Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1051) 使用 HTTPS 进行命令和控制。(引用：CISA Medusa Group Medusa Ransomware March 2025)

8315ee11d623553027f2fe484e157ecdaedb42d3.source_text: [Charming Kitten](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0058) is an Iranian cyber espionage group that has been active since approximately 2014. They appear to focus on targeting individuals of interest to Iran who work in academic research, human rights, and media, with most victims having been located in Iran, the US, Israel, and the UK. [[Charming Kitten](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0058) often tries to access private email and Facebook accounts, and sometimes establishes a foothold on victim computers as a secondary objective. The group's TTPs overlap extensively with another group, [Magic Hound](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0059), resulting in reporting that may not distinguish between the two groups' activities.(Citation: ClearSky Charming Kitten Dec 2017)
8315ee11d623553027f2fe484e157ecdaedb42d3.zh: [Charming Kitten](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0058) 是一个自约2014年以来一直活跃的伊朗网络间谍组织。他们似乎专注于 targeting 对伊朗感兴趣的个人，这些人在学术研究、人权和媒体领域工作，大多数受害者位于伊朗、美国、以色列和英国。(Citation: ClearSky Charming Kitten Dec 2017)[Charming Kitten](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0058) 通常试图访问私人电子邮件和 Facebook 账户，并且有时将控制受害者的计算机作为次要目标。该组织的 TTPs 与另一个组织 [Magic Hound](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0059) 的大量重叠，导致报告可能无法区分这两个组织的活动。

e0c2bb35e9389975506fe279f2871a205faae7fb.source_text: [BRONZE BUTLER](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0060) is a cyber espionage group with likely Chinese origins that has been active since at least 2008. The group primarily targets Japanese organizations, particularly those in government, biotechnology, electronics manufacturing, and industrial chemistry.(Citation: Trend Micro Daserf Nov 2017)(Citation: Secureworks BRONZE BUTLER Oct 2017)(Citation: Trend Micro Tick November 2019)
e0c2bb35e9389975506fe279f2871a205faae7fb.zh: [BRONZE BUTLER](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0060) 是一个网络间谍组织，可能源自中国，自至少2008年以来一直活跃。该组织主要针对日本的组织，尤其是政府、生物技术、电子制造和工业化学领域的机构。(Citation: Trend Micro Daserf Nov 2017)(Citation: Secureworks BRONZE BUTLER Oct 2017)(Citation: Trend Micro Tick November 2019)

f307ea350b8fadb4bc92436d625354a7465bcc52.source_text: Several [BRONZE BUTLER](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0060) tools encode data with base64 when posting it to a C2 server.(Citation: Secureworks BRONZE BUTLER Oct 2017)
f307ea350b8fadb4bc92436d625354a7465bcc52.zh: 多个[BRONZE BUTLER](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0060)工具在向C2服务器发送数据时使用Base64对数据进行编码。(Citation: Secureworks BRONZE BUTLER Oct 2017)

510f45748cca3f16a442d10154b52384989d3d31.source_text: [BRONZE BUTLER](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0060) malware has used HTTP for C2.(Citation: Secureworks BRONZE BUTLER Oct 2017)
510f45748cca3f16a442d10154b52384989d3d31.zh: [BRONZE BUTLER](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0060) 恶意软件曾使用 HTTP 进行 C2。(引用：Secureworks BRONZE BUTLER Oct 2017)

02b6b359b237158a235a4f47099e29ea2b1aaac9.source_text: [BRONZE BUTLER](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0060)'s MSGET downloader uses a dead drop resolver to access malicious payloads.(Citation: Secureworks BRONZE BUTLER Oct 2017)
02b6b359b237158a235a4f47099e29ea2b1aaac9.zh: [BRONZE BUTLER](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0060)的MSGET下载器使用死投解析器来访问恶意有效载荷。(Citation: Secureworks BRONZE BUTLER Oct 2017)

7ec0df111aec3913d5bf3dc006a1002a343d72d4.source_text: [BRONZE BUTLER](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0060) has used various tools to download files, including DGet (a similar tool to wget).(Citation: Secureworks BRONZE BUTLER Oct 2017)
7ec0df111aec3913d5bf3dc006a1002a343d72d4.zh: [BRONZE BUTLER](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0060) 已使用各种工具来下载文件，包括 DGet（类似于 wget 的工具）。(Citation: Secureworks BRONZE BUTLER Oct 2017)

8252f911b93a06f6ffe24f7b2bde5532631c324c.source_text: [BRONZE BUTLER](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0060) has used RC4 encryption (for Datper malware) and AES (for xxmm malware) to obfuscate HTTP traffic. [BRONZE BUTLER](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0060) has also used a tool called RarStar that encodes data with a custom XOR algorithm when posting it to a C2 server.(Citation: Secureworks BRONZE BUTLER Oct 2017)
8252f911b93a06f6ffe24f7b2bde5532631c324c.zh: [BRONZE BUTLER](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0060) 使用 RC4 加密（用于 Datper 恶意软件）和 AES（用于 xxmm 恶意软件）对 HTTP 流量进行混淆。[BRONZE BUTLER](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0060) 还使用了一种名为 RarStar 的工具，该工具在将数据发布到 C2 服务器时使用自定义 XOR 算法对数据进行编码。(Citation: Secureworks BRONZE BUTLER Oct 2017)

2c4744b820da7f17ed568da4c6adfc2cf3f58509.source_text: [TA551](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0127) is a financially-motivated threat group that has been active since at least 2018. (Citation: Secureworks GOLD CABIN) The group has primarily targeted English, German, Italian, and Japanese speakers through email-based malware distribution campaigns. (Citation: Unit 42 TA551 Jan 2021)
2c4744b820da7f17ed568da4c6adfc2cf3f58509.zh: [TA551](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0127) 是一个自至少 2018 年以来活跃的经济动机威胁组织。(Citation: Secureworks GOLD CABIN) 该组织主要通过基于电子邮件的恶意软件分发活动，主要针对英语、德语、意大利语和日语使用者。(Citation: Unit 42 TA551 Jan 2021)

eed6066d91eb77b5f13856de03058f5d4c150133.source_text: [TA551](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0127) has used encoded ASCII text for initial C2 communications.(Citation: Unit 42 Valak July 2020)
eed6066d91eb77b5f13856de03058f5d4c150133.zh: [TA551](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0127) 曾使用编码的 ASCII 文本进行初始 C2 通信。(Citation: Unit 42 Valak July 2020)

53a6e0c1e9c5821ae060641ac21b48e610db1973.source_text: [TA551](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0127) has used a DGA to generate URLs from executed macros.(Citation: Unit 42 TA551 Jan 2021)(Citation: Secureworks GOLD CABIN)
53a6e0c1e9c5821ae060641ac21b48e610db1973.zh: [TA551](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0127) 使用域生成算法（DGA）从已执行的宏中生成URL。（来源：Unit 42 TA551 Jan 2021）（来源：Secureworks GOLD CABIN）

bc5b1dca2a4fd4c3e2ef6a2361fcc0e644a9aa3c.source_text: [TA551](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0127) has used HTTP for C2 communications.(Citation: Unit 42 Valak July 2020)
bc5b1dca2a4fd4c3e2ef6a2361fcc0e644a9aa3c.zh: [TA551](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0127) 已使用 HTTP 进行 C2 通信。(引用：Unit 42 Valak July 2020)

50fa6456eedc224319763c70b25427822094ab76.source_text: [TA551](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0127) has retrieved DLLs and installer binaries for malware execution from C2.(Citation: Unit 42 TA551 Jan 2021)
50fa6456eedc224319763c70b25427822094ab76.zh: [TA551](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0127) 已从 C2（指挥与控制服务器）检索用于恶意软件执行的 DLL 和安装程序二进制文件。（Citation: Unit 42 TA551 Jan 2021）

1bb7104ecd265a720983e20dbdcb9b3d0bce6c36.source_text: [TEMP.Veles](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0088) is a Russia-based threat group that has targeted critical infrastructure. The group has been observed utilizing [TRITON](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0609), a malware framework designed to manipulate industrial safety systems.(Citation: FireEye TRITON 2019)(Citation: FireEye TEMP.Veles 2018)(Citation: FireEye TEMP.Veles JSON April 2019)
1bb7104ecd265a720983e20dbdcb9b3d0bce6c36.zh: [TEMP.Veles](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0088) 是一个位于俄罗斯的威胁组织，曾针对关键基础设施发动攻击。该组织被观察到使用了 [TRITON](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0609)，这是一个旨在操控工业安全系统的恶意软件框架。(Citation: FireEye TRITON 2019)(Citation: FireEye TEMP.Veles 2018)(Citation: FireEye TEMP.Veles JSON April 2019)

d9fdfcce5829315f4978ae3558b28679edc17d58.source_text: [Equation](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0020) is a sophisticated threat group that employs multiple remote access tools. The group is known to use zero-day exploits and has developed the capability to overwrite the firmware of hard disk drives. (Citation: Kaspersky Equation QA)
d9fdfcce5829315f4978ae3558b28679edc17d58.zh: [Equation](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0020) 是一个高级威胁组织，使用多种远程访问工具。该组织以利用零日漏洞而闻名，并已具备覆盖硬盘驱动器固件的能力。（来源：Kaspersky Equation QA）

a6a6e7925e81f91002e7648410246cb646b11056.source_text: [BackdoorDiplomacy](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0135) is a cyber espionage threat group that has been active since at least 2017. [BackdoorDiplomacy](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0135) has targeted Ministries of Foreign Affairs and telecommunication companies in Africa, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.(Citation: ESET BackdoorDiplomacy Jun 2021)
a6a6e7925e81f91002e7648410246cb646b11056.zh: [BackdoorDiplomacy](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0135) 是一个自至少2017年以来活跃的网络间谍威胁组织。[BackdoorDiplomacy](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0135) 曾针对非洲、欧洲、中东和亚洲的外交部和电信公司。(Citation: ESET BackdoorDiplomacy Jun 2021)

f9f20d02c996d011ce7a57f484baf0a1c13e0776.source_text: [BackdoorDiplomacy](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0135) has downloaded additional files and tools onto a compromised host.(Citation: ESET BackdoorDiplomacy Jun 2021)
f9f20d02c996d011ce7a57f484baf0a1c13e0776.zh: [BackdoorDiplomacy](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0135) 已将其他文件和工具下载到已受控主机中。(Citation: ESET BackdoorDiplomacy Jun 2021)

e6a2dde4247316ea4d108c914e56cb1dfbaca392.source_text: [BackdoorDiplomacy](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0135) has used EarthWorm for network tunneling with a SOCKS5 server and port transfer functionalities.(Citation: ESET BackdoorDiplomacy Jun 2021)
e6a2dde4247316ea4d108c914e56cb1dfbaca392.zh: [BackdoorDiplomacy](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0135) 使用 EarthWorm 进行带有 SOCKS5 服务器和端口转发功能网络隧道通信。(Citation: ESET BackdoorDiplomacy Jun 2021)

70b29fb16a3e7d4faf1677e89e1610b6a0b9f9ad.source_text: [Gelsemium](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0141) is a cyberespionage group that has been active since at least 2014, targeting governmental institutions, electronics manufacturers, universities, and religious organizations in East Asia and the Middle East.(Citation: ESET Gelsemium June 2021)
70b29fb16a3e7d4faf1677e89e1610b6a0b9f9ad.zh: [Gelsemium](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0141)是一个网络间谍组织，自至少2014年以来一直活跃，目标包括东亚和中东地区的政府机构、电子产品制造商、大学以及宗教组织。(Citation: ESET Gelsemium June 2021)

40c84f34883d653873b1c6292d2efe543e5c9257.source_text: [Star Blizzard](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1033) is a cyber espionage and influence group originating in Russia that has been active since at least 2019. [Star Blizzard](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1033) campaigns align closely with Russian state interests and have included persistent phishing and credential theft against academic, defense, government, NGO, and think tank organizations in NATO countries, particularly the US and the UK.(Citation: Microsoft Star Blizzard August 2022)(Citation: CISA Star Blizzard Advisory December 2023)(Citation: StarBlizzard)(Citation: Google TAG COLDRIVER January 2024)
40c84f34883d653873b1c6292d2efe543e5c9257.zh: [Star Blizzard](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1033) 是一个源自俄罗斯的网络间谍和影响力组织，自2019年以来一直活跃。[Star Blizzard](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1033)的行动与俄罗斯国家利益高度一致，主要包括针对北约国家（尤其是美国和英国）的学术、国防、政府、非政府组织和智库机构的持续钓鱼攻击和凭证窃取。(Citation: Microsoft Star Blizzard August 2022)(Citation: CISA Star Blizzard Advisory December 2023)(Citation: StarBlizzard)(Citation: Google TAG COLDRIVER January 2024)

ad2e3a0db9831d12d244edc70ce20e5aab6a206b.source_text: [Darkhotel](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0012) is a suspected South Korean threat group that has targeted victims primarily in East Asia since at least 2004.
