The group's name is based on cyber espionage operations conducted via hotel Internet networks against traveling executives and other select guests. [Darkhotel](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0012) has also conducted spearphishing campaigns and infected victims through peer-to-peer and file sharing networks.(Citation: Kaspersky Darkhotel)(Citation: Securelist Darkhotel Aug 2015)(Citation: Microsoft Digital Defense FY20 Sept 2020)
ad2e3a0db9831d12d244edc70ce20e5aab6a206b.zh: [Darkhotel](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0012) 是一个疑似来自韩国的威胁组织，自至少2004年起主要针对东亚地区的受害者。该组织的名称来源于其通过酒店互联网网络对出差的高管及其他特定客人进行的网络间谍活动。[Darkhotel](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0012) 还开展了钓鱼邮件攻击行动，并通过点对点及文件共享网络感染受害者。(Citation: Kaspersky Darkhotel)(Citation: Securelist Darkhotel Aug 2015)(Citation: Microsoft Digital Defense FY20 Sept 2020)

5a6f56e1cf767650757e44a1c8d89631abee0db2.source_text: [Darkhotel](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0012) has used AES-256 and 3DES for C2 communications.(Citation: Microsoft DUBNIUM July 2016)
5a6f56e1cf767650757e44a1c8d89631abee0db2.zh: [Darkhotel](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0012) 在C2通信中使用了AES-256和3DES。（引用：Microsoft DUBNIUM July 2016）

84f1dc877027fffdfe0eb91aa7fce094f1005560.source_text: [Darkhotel](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0012) has used first-stage payloads that download additional malware from C2 servers.(Citation: Microsoft DUBNIUM June 2016)
84f1dc877027fffdfe0eb91aa7fce094f1005560.zh: [Darkhotel](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0012) 已使用从 C2 服务器下载其他恶意软件的第一阶段有效载荷。（引用：Microsoft DUBNIUM June 2016）

ba37c7a1784867dbf95bf5c6ee293041856fca7a.source_text: [Axiom](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0001) is a suspected Chinese cyber espionage group that has targeted the aerospace, defense, government, manufacturing, and media sectors since at least 2008. Some reporting suggests a degree of overlap between [Axiom](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0001) and [Winnti Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0044) but the two groups appear to be distinct based on differences in reporting on TTPs and targeting.(Citation: Kaspersky Winnti April 2013)(Citation: Kaspersky Winnti June 2015)(Citation: Novetta Winnti April 2015)
ba37c7a1784867dbf95bf5c6ee293041856fca7a.zh: [Axiom](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0001)是一个涉嫌来自中国的网络间谍组织，自2008年以来一直针对航空航天、国防、政府、制造和媒体部门。一些报告表明[Axiom](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0001)与[Winnti Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0044)之间存在一定的重叠，但根据关于战术、技术和程序（TTPs）以及目标的不同报道，这两个组织似乎是独立的。(Citation: Kaspersky Winnti April 2013)(Citation: Kaspersky Winnti June 2015)(Citation: Novetta Winnti April 2015)

cfae07f604514a3b54d4785fdb95693337b3a06a.source_text: Adversaries may use steganographic techniques to hide command and control traffic to make detection efforts more difficult. Steganographic techniques can be used to hide data in digital messages that are transferred between systems. This hidden information can be used for command and control of compromised systems. In some cases, the passing of files embedded using steganography, such as image or document files, can be used for command and control.
cfae07f604514a3b54d4785fdb95693337b3a06a.zh: 敌手可能使用隐写技术来隐藏命令与控制（C2）流量，从而使检测工作更加困难。隐写技术可用于在被系统之间传输的数字消息中隐藏数据。这些隐藏的信息可用于对被入侵系统的命令与控制。在某些情况下，传递采用隐写术嵌入的文件（例如图像或文档文件）也可用于命令与控制。

8798a43ccf6d5dc9c84c8a5b10652574701f490d.source_text: [Axiom](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0001) has used steganography to hide its C2 communications.(Citation: Novetta-Axiom)
8798a43ccf6d5dc9c84c8a5b10652574701f490d.zh: [Axiom](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0001) 曾使用隐写术来隐藏其 C2 通信。(Citation: Novetta-Axiom)

25a5037ff8a319fa27d46e27263fddd67ae290d4.source_text: [TA578](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1038) is a threat actor that has used contact forms and email to initiate communications with victims and to distribute malware including [Latrodectus](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1160), [IcedID](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0483), and [Bumblebee](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1039).(Citation: Latrodectus APR 2024)(Citation: Bitsight Latrodectus June 2024)
25a5037ff8a319fa27d46e27263fddd67ae290d4.zh: [TA578](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1038) 是一个威胁行为体，曾使用联系表单和电子邮件与受害者建立联系并分发恶意软件，包括 [Latrodectus](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1160)、[IcedID](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0483) 和 [Bumblebee](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1039)。(Citation: Latrodectus APR 2024)(Citation: Bitsight Latrodectus June 2024)

12cee6281054866309fa36028adb186db1d807df.source_text: [Deep Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0009) is a suspected Chinese threat group known to target many industries, including government, defense, financial, and telecommunications. (Citation: Alperovitch 2014) The intrusion into healthcare company Anthem has been attributed to [Deep Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0009). (Citation: ThreatConnect Anthem) This group is also known as Shell Crew, WebMasters, KungFu Kittens, and PinkPanther. (Citation: RSA Shell Crew) [Deep Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0009) also appears to be known as Black Vine based on the attribution of both group names to the Anthem intrusion. (Citation: Symantec Black Vine) Some analysts track [Deep Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0009) and [APT19](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0073) as the same group, but it is unclear from open source information if the groups are the same. (Citation: ICIT China's Espionage Jul 2016)
12cee6281054866309fa36028adb186db1d807df.zh: [Deep Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0009) 是一个涉嫌来自中国的威胁行为体组织，已知其针对众多行业进行攻击，包括政府、国防、金融和电信行业。(Citation: Alperovitch 2014) 对医疗公司 Anthem 的网络入侵事件被归因于 [Deep Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0009)。(Citation: ThreatConnect Anthem) 该组织还被称为 Shell Crew、WebMasters、KungFu Kittens 和 PinkPanther。(Citation: RSA Shell Crew) 基于将这两个组织名称均归于 Anthem 入侵事件的归因分析，[Deep Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0009) 似乎也被称为 Black Vine。(Citation: Symantec Black Vine) 一些分析师将 [Deep Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0009) 与 [APT19](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0073) 视为同一组织，但开源信息尚无法明确判断它们是否为同一组织。(Citation: ICIT China's Espionage Jul 2016)

30181e42db171981b5e07944ac6389772b6b2537.source_text: [Ember Bear](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1003) is a Russian state-sponsored cyber espionage group that has been active since at least 2020, linked to Russia's General Staff Main Intelligence Directorate (GRU) 161st Specialist Training Center (Unit 29155).(Citation: CISA GRU29155 2024) [Ember Bear](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1003) has primarily focused operations against Ukrainian government and telecommunication entities, but has also operated against critical infrastructure entities in Europe and the Americas.(Citation: Cadet Blizzard emerges as novel threat actor) [Ember Bear](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1003) conducted the [WhisperGate](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0689) destructive wiper attacks against Ukraine in early 2022.(Citation: CrowdStrike Ember Bear Profile March 2022)(Citation: Mandiant UNC2589 March 2022)(Citation: CISA GRU29155 2024) There is some confusion as to whether [Ember Bear](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1003) overlaps with another Russian-linked entity referred to as [Saint Bear](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1031). At present available evidence strongly suggests these are distinct activities with different behavioral profiles.(Citation: Cadet Blizzard emerges as novel threat actor)(Citation: Palo Alto Unit 42 OutSteel SaintBot February 2022 )
30181e42db171981b5e07944ac6389772b6b2537.zh: [Ember Bear](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1003) 是一个至少自2020年以来活跃的俄罗斯国家支持的网络间谍组织，与俄罗斯总参谋部情报总局（GRU）第161专家培训中心（Unit 29155）有关联。(Citation: CISA GRU29155 2024) [Ember Bear](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1003) 主要针对乌克兰政府和电信实体开展行动，但也曾对欧洲和美洲的关键基础设施实体进行过行动。(Citation: Cadet Blizzard emerges as novel threat actor) [Ember Bear](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1003) 在2022年初对乌克兰实施了破坏性擦除攻击的 [WhisperGate](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0689)。(Citation: CrowdStrike Ember Bear Profile March 2022)(Citation: Mandiant UNC2589 March 2022)(Citation: CISA GRU29155 2024) 关于 [Ember Bear](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1003) 是否与另一个被称为 [Saint Bear](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1031) 的俄罗斯关联实体存在重叠，目前存在一些混淆。现有证据强烈表明，这些是行为特征不同的独立活动。(Citation: Cadet Blizzard emerges as novel threat actor)(Citation: Palo Alto Unit 42 OutSteel SaintBot February 2022 )

fbc483ca1eeda1ee428dd821edf23d6089e00d15.source_text: [Ember Bear](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1003) has configured multi-hop proxies via ProxyChains within victim environments.(Citation: CISA GRU29155 2024)
fbc483ca1eeda1ee428dd821edf23d6089e00d15.zh: [Ember Bear](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1003) 已在受害者环境中通过 ProxyChains 配置了多跳代理。(Citation: CISA GRU29155 2024)

3cde84a19ecace61c7c843677e5420779aa836dd.source_text: [Ember Bear](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1003) has used various non-standard ports for C2 communication.(Citation: CISA GRU29155 2024)
3cde84a19ecace61c7c843677e5420779aa836dd.zh: [Ember Bear](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1003) 已使用各种非标准端口进行 C2 通信。（引用：CISA GRU29155 2024）

3ef75eb70f30fdb285bc0faf247565430d2d7d24.source_text: [Ember Bear](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1003) uses socket-based tunneling utilities for command and control purposes such as NetCat and Go Simple Tunnel (GOST). These tunnels are used to push interactive command prompts over the created sockets.(Citation: Cadet Blizzard emerges as novel threat actor) [Ember Bear](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1003) has also used reverse TCP connections from Meterpreter installations to communicate back with C2 infrastructure.(Citation: CISA GRU29155 2024)
3ef75eb70f30fdb285bc0faf247565430d2d7d24.zh: [Ember Bear](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1003) 使用基于套接字的隧道工具进行命令与控制（C2），例如 NetCat 和 Go Simple Tunnel（GOST）。这些隧道用于在创建的套接字上推送交互式命令行提示。(Citation: Cadet Blizzard emerges as novel threat actor) [Ember Bear](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1003) 还使用 Meterpreter 安装的反向 TCP 连接与 C2 基础设施进行通信。(Citation: CISA GRU29155 2024)

22d40578ba4f1e3dc7dc99ceeeb8952585e8181b.source_text: [Ember Bear](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1003) has used ProxyChains to tunnel protocols to internal networks.(Citation: CISA GRU29155 2024)
22d40578ba4f1e3dc7dc99ceeeb8952585e8181b.zh: [Ember Bear](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1003) 使用 ProxyChains 将协议隧道传输到内部网络。(Citation: CISA GRU29155 2024)

5c21c5f934ac1892f098d30e212380d8ad71cd29.source_text: [Ember Bear](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1003) has used DNS tunnelling tools, such as dnscat/2 and Iodine, for C2 purposes.(Citation: CISA GRU29155 2024)
5c21c5f934ac1892f098d30e212380d8ad71cd29.zh: [Ember Bear](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1003) 曾使用 DNS 隧道工具，例如 dnscat/2 和 Iodine，用于 C2 目的。（引用：CISA GRU29155 2024）

330afbc79f0e188cd57a4c836c9074cc10475096.source_text: [LazyScripter](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0140) is threat group that has mainly targeted the airlines industry since at least 2018, primarily using open-source toolsets.(Citation: MalwareBytes LazyScripter Feb 2021)
330afbc79f0e188cd57a4c836c9074cc10475096.zh: [LazyScripter](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0140) 是一个自 2018 年以来主要针对航空业威胁的组织，主要使用开源工具集。(引用：MalwareBytes LazyScripter Feb 2021)

561d87dcdd275188511fadbc04304e9fc20d24b1.source_text: [LazyScripter](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0140) has used GitHub to host its payloads to operate spam campaigns.(Citation: MalwareBytes LazyScripter Feb 2021)
561d87dcdd275188511fadbc04304e9fc20d24b1.zh: [LazyScripter](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0140) 曾利用 GitHub 托管其有效负载，以执行垃圾邮件活动。（来源：MalwareBytes LazyScripter 2021年2月）

9657f08a8b2ca6f4d481e226fa8f8c888f8601d2.source_text: [LazyScripter](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0140) has leveraged dynamic DNS providers for C2 communications.(Citation: MalwareBytes LazyScripter Feb 2021)
9657f08a8b2ca6f4d481e226fa8f8c888f8601d2.zh: [LazyScripter](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0140) 利用了动态DNS服务提供商进行C2通信。（来源：MalwareBytes LazyScripter 2021年2月）

fcdf02a14613a49fbbca365f3c132b1d794a7560.source_text: [LazyScripter](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0140) had downloaded additional tools to a compromised host.(Citation: MalwareBytes LazyScripter Feb 2021)
fcdf02a14613a49fbbca365f3c132b1d794a7560.zh: [LazyScripter](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0140) 已将其他工具下载至被攻陷的主机。(Citation: MalwareBytes LazyScripter Feb 2021)

605bbc06b9d27ca1b182b795724641eef25f5bcb.source_text: [Dust Storm](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0031) is a threat group that has targeted multiple industries in Japan, South Korea, the United States, Europe, and several Southeast Asian countries. (Citation: Cylance Dust Storm)
605bbc06b9d27ca1b182b795724641eef25f5bcb.zh: [Dust Storm](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0031) 是一个针对日本、韩国、美国、欧洲及多个东南亚国家多个行业的威胁组织。（来源：Cylance Dust Storm）

162e14446bb5e2d55abc6bb3984b6d02c2542019.source_text: [Windshift](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0112) is a threat group that has been active since at least 2017, targeting specific individuals for surveillance in government departments and critical infrastructure across the Middle East.(Citation: SANS Windshift August 2018)(Citation: objective-see windtail1 dec 2018)(Citation: objective-see windtail2 jan 2019)
162e14446bb5e2d55abc6bb3984b6d02c2542019.zh: [Windshift](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0112) 是一个自2017年起活动的威胁组织，针对中东地区政府部门和关键基础设施中的特定个人进行监视。(Citation: SANS Windshift August 2018)(Citation: objective-see windtail1 dec 2018)(Citation: objective-see windtail2 jan 2019)

a17c2ab21ac68f4b37b35839bb66f14c77f1e4eb.source_text: [Windshift](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0112) has used tools that communicate with C2 over HTTP.(Citation: BlackBerry Bahamut)
a17c2ab21ac68f4b37b35839bb66f14c77f1e4eb.zh: [Windshift](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0112) 曾使用通过 HTTP 与 C2 进行通信的工具。（引用：BlackBerry Bahamut）

5718cfec30ea0aa68444ece4726442ef632391d0.source_text: [Windshift](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0112) has used tools to deploy additional payloads to compromised hosts.(Citation: BlackBerry Bahamut)
5718cfec30ea0aa68444ece4726442ef632391d0.zh: [Windshift](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0112) 已使用工具在被入侵的主机上部署其他有效载荷。(Citation: BlackBerry Bahamut)

5ef23d9cf4fead01ff2845c5ed7493eb46b4878b.source_text: Adversaries may employ a known symmetric encryption algorithm to conceal command and control traffic, rather than relying on any inherent protections provided by a communication protocol. Symmetric encryption algorithms use the same key for plaintext encryption and ciphertext decryption. Common symmetric encryption algorithms include AES, Blowfish, and RC4.
5ef23d9cf4fead01ff2845c5ed7493eb46b4878b.zh: 对手可能采用已知的对称加密算法来隐藏命令与控制流量，而不是依赖通信协议本身提供的任何保护。对称加密算法使用相同的密钥进行明文加密和解密。常见的对称加密算法包括 AES、Blowfish 和 RC4。

f6d889b74cb940923ee8bd4cff79e7159d2bff9a.source_text: [Windshift](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0112) has encrypted C2 communications using AES in CBC mode during Operation BULL and Operation ROCK.(Citation: BlackBerry Bahamut)
f6d889b74cb940923ee8bd4cff79e7159d2bff9a.zh: [Windshift](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0112)在BULL行动和ROCK行动期间使用CBC模式的AES加密了C2通信。（出处：BlackBerry Bahamut）

0e0459c060762ed9342721ccfca99db341532115.source_text: [Volatile Cedar](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0123) is a Lebanese threat group that has targeted individuals, companies, and institutions worldwide. [Volatile Cedar](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0123) has been operating since 2012 and is motivated by political and ideological interests.(Citation: CheckPoint Volatile Cedar March 2015)(Citation: ClearSky Lebanese Cedar Jan 2021)
0e0459c060762ed9342721ccfca99db341532115.zh: [Volatile Cedar](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0123)是一个黎巴嫩威胁组织，曾针对全球范围内的个人、公司和机构发动攻击。[Volatile Cedar](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0123)自2012年以来一直在运作，其动机源于政治和意识形态利益。(Citation: CheckPoint Volatile Cedar March 2015)(Citation: ClearSky Lebanese Cedar Jan 2021)

88f87a80ecb069bbe23c6a1f2edba17b0091e63f.source_text: [Volatile Cedar](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0123) can deploy additional tools.(Citation: ClearSky Lebanese Cedar Jan 2021)
88f87a80ecb069bbe23c6a1f2edba17b0091e63f.zh: [易失性Cedar](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0123)能够部署额外的工具。(Citation: ClearSky Lebanese Cedar Jan 2021)

6ba19d9a58859ae1c12df7d6a2a25c6c89dc0620.source_text: [ToddyCat](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1022) is a sophisticated threat group that has been active since at least 2020 using custom loaders and malware in multi-stage infection chains against government and military targets across Europe and Asia.(Citation: Kaspersky ToddyCat June 2022)(Citation: Kaspersky ToddyCat Check Logs October 2023)
6ba19d9a58859ae1c12df7d6a2a25c6c89dc0620.zh: [ToddyCat](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1022) 是一个复杂的威胁组织，自2020年至少开始活跃，针对欧洲和亚洲的政府及军事目标，使用自定义加载器和多阶段感染链中的恶意软件。(Citation: Kaspersky ToddyCat June 2022)(Citation: Kaspersky ToddyCat Check Logs October 2023)

2996eebb28d553d46eda6feeed1d5089b0417d3f.source_text: [ToddyCat](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1022) has used a passive backdoor that receives commands with UDP packets.(Citation: Kaspersky ToddyCat Check Logs October 2023)
2996eebb28d553d46eda6feeed1d5089b0417d3f.zh: [ToddyCat](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1022) 曾使用一种被动后门，通过 UDP 数据包接收命令。（Citation: Kaspersky ToddyCat Check Logs October 2023）

214a638222940c30ca7c0423bd204dbd4faa8674.source_text: [Whitefly](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0107) is a cyber espionage group that has been operating since at least 2017. The group has targeted organizations based mostly in Singapore across a wide variety of sectors, and is primarily interested in stealing large amounts of sensitive information. The group has been linked to an attack against Singapore’s largest public health organization, SingHealth.(Citation: Symantec Whitefly March 2019)
214a638222940c30ca7c0423bd204dbd4faa8674.zh: [Whitefly](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0107) 是一个自至少 2017 年以来一直在活动的网络间谍组织。该组织主要 targeting 位于新加坡的跨多个行业的组织，其主要目的是窃取大量敏感信息。该组织与针对新加坡最大的公共卫生机构 SingHealth 的攻击有关。(Citation: Symantec Whitefly March 2019)

c02fa18d211176453124754daa0fb5089701a6dd.source_text: [Whitefly](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0107) has the ability to download additional tools from the C2.(Citation: Symantec Whitefly March 2019)
c02fa18d211176453124754daa0fb5089701a6dd.zh: [Whitefly](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0107) 具备从C2下载额外工具的能力。（引用：Symantec Whitefly 2019年3月）

b091ef61ce708f2694f241cdcad31a64ae25dd81.source_text: [LuminousMoth](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1014) is a Chinese-speaking cyber espionage group that has been active since at least October 2020. [LuminousMoth](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1014) has targeted high-profile organizations, including government entities, in Myanmar, the Philippines, Thailand, and other parts of Southeast Asia. Some security researchers have concluded there is a connection between [LuminousMoth](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1014) and [Mustang Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0129) based on similar targeting and TTPs, as well as network infrastructure overlaps.(Citation: Kaspersky LuminousMoth July 2021)(Citation: Bitdefender LuminousMoth July 2021)
b091ef61ce708f2694f241cdcad31a64ae25dd81.zh: [LuminousMoth](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1014) 是一个自至少2020年10月以来活跃的中国语网络间谍组织。[LuminousMoth](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1014) 已经针对高知名度组织，包括缅甸、菲律宾、泰国和其他东南亚地区在内的政府机构。一些安全研究人员基于类似的攻击目标和战术、技术以及过程（TTPs）和网络基础设施重叠，得出 [LuminousMoth](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1014) 与 [Mustang Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0129) 之间存在联系。（引用：卡巴斯基 LuminousMoth 2021年7月）（引用：Bitdefender LuminousMoth 2021年7月）

7f7890d2c04ad2426b6f70663a27a7097735da1b.source_text: [LuminousMoth](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1014) has used HTTP for C2.(Citation: Kaspersky LuminousMoth July 2021)
7f7890d2c04ad2426b6f70663a27a7097735da1b.zh: [LuminousMoth](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1014) 已使用 HTTP 进行命令与控制通信。(Citation: Kaspersky LuminousMoth July 2021)

63a453892a3d4ccf8617ceeb4bda8b1b21c79241.source_text: [LuminousMoth](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1014) has downloaded additional malware and tools onto a compromised host.(Citation: Kaspersky LuminousMoth July 2021)(Citation: Bitdefender LuminousMoth July 2021)
63a453892a3d4ccf8617ceeb4bda8b1b21c79241.zh: [LuminousMoth](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1014) 已将额外的恶意软件和工具下载到被攻陷的主机上。(Citation: Kaspersky LuminousMoth July 2021)(Citation: Bitdefender LuminousMoth July 2021)

ee243637347d22e0680a1b9f48070a64b8b24795.source_text: [Agrius](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1030) is an Iranian threat actor active since 2020 notable for a series of ransomware and wiper operations in the Middle East, with an emphasis on Israeli targets.(Citation: SentinelOne Agrius 2021)(Citation: CheckPoint Agrius 2023) Public reporting has linked [Agrius](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1030) to Iran's Ministry of Intelligence and Security (MOIS).(Citation: Microsoft Iran Cyber 2023)
ee243637347d22e0680a1b9f48070a64b8b24795.zh: [Agrius](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1030) 是一个自2020年以来活跃的网络威胁行为体，以在中东地区进行的一系列勒索软件和擦除工具操作而闻名，尤其针对以色列目标。(Citation: SentinelOne Agrius 2021)(Citation: CheckPoint Agrius 2023) 公开报道已将 [Agrius](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1030) 与伊朗情报与安全部 (MOIS) 联系起来。(Citation: Microsoft Iran Cyber 2023)

364fb54bed296948694ad58a581c93d9f8e3c3b3.source_text: [CostaRicto](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0132) is a suspected hacker-for-hire cyber espionage campaign that has targeted multiple industries worldwide since at least 2019. [CostaRicto](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0132)'s targets, a large portion of which are financial institutions, are scattered across Europe, the Americas, Asia, Australia, and Africa, with a large concentration in South Asia.(Citation: BlackBerry CostaRicto November 2020)
364fb54bed296948694ad58a581c93d9f8e3c3b3.zh: [CostaRicto](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0132) 是一项涉嫌的“黑客-for-hire”网络间谍活动，自 2019 年或更早就针对全球多个行业进行攻击。[CostaRicto](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0132) 的目标遍布欧洲、美洲、亚洲、澳大利亚和非洲，其中很大一部分是金融机构，且在南亚地区高度集中。（Citation: BlackBerry CostaRicto November 2020）

3fe66a5b0ac32de7ed9e4c7893ddd9fe082d9795.source_text: [Water Galura](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1050) are the operators of the [Qilin](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1242) Ransomware-as-a-Service (RaaS) who handle payload generation, ransom negotiations, and the publication of stolen data for [Qilin](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1242) affilates recruited on Russian cybercrime forums. [Water Galura](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1050) have been active since at least 2022 and use a double extortion model where they demand payment for providing decryption keys and for refraining from publishing the stolen data to their leak site.(Citation: BushidoToken Qilin RaaS JUN 2024)(Citation: Sophos Qilin MSP APR 2025)
3fe66a5b0ac32de7ed9e4c7893ddd9fe082d9795.zh: [Water Galura](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1050) 是 [Qilin](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1242) 勒索软件即服务（RaaS）的运营方，负责为通过俄罗斯网络犯罪论坛招募的 [Qilin](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1242) 附属人员生成有效载荷、进行赎金谈判以及发布被盗数据。(Citation: BushidoToken Qilin RaaS JUN 2024)(Citation: Sophos Qilin MSP APR 2025)[Water Galura](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1050) 自至少 2022 年起一直活跃，采用双重勒索模式，即要求支付费用以提供解密密钥，并要求不将被盗数据发布到其泄漏网站。(Citation: BushidoToken Qilin RaaS JUN 2024)(Citation: Sophos Qilin MSP APR 2025)

e8e6c450c60031fd08b298b826be63820ed49ddf.source_text: [APT28](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0007) is a threat group that has been attributed to Russia's General Staff Main Intelligence Directorate (GRU) 85th Main Special Service Center (GTsSS) military unit 26165.(Citation: NSA/FBI Drovorub August 2020)(Citation: Cybersecurity Advisory GRU Brute Force Campaign July 2021) This group has been active since at least 2004.(Citation: DOJ GRU Indictment Jul 2018)(Citation: Ars Technica GRU indictment Jul 2018)(Citation: Crowdstrike DNC June 2016)(Citation: FireEye APT28)(Citation: SecureWorks TG-4127)(Citation: FireEye APT28 January 2017)(Citation: GRIZZLY STEPPE JAR)(Citation: Sofacy DealersChoice)(Citation: Palo Alto Sofacy 06-2018)(Citation: Symantec APT28 Oct 2018)(Citation: ESET Zebrocy May 2019) [APT28](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0007) reportedly compromised the Hillary Clinton campaign, the Democratic National Committee, and the Democratic Congressional Campaign Committee in 2016 in an attempt to interfere with the U.S. presidential election.(Citation: Crowdstrike DNC June 2016) In 2018, the US indicted five GRU Unit 26165 officers associated with [APT28](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0007) for cyber operations (including close-access operations) conducted between 2014 and 2018 against the World Anti-Doping Agency (WADA), the US Anti-Doping Agency, a US nuclear facility, the Organization for the Prohibition of Chemical Weapons (OPCW), the Spiez Swiss Chemicals Laboratory, and other organizations.(Citation: US District Court Indictment GRU Oct 2018) Some of these were conducted with the assistance of GRU Unit 74455, which is also referred to as [Sandworm Team](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0034).
e8e6c450c60031fd08b298b826be63820ed49ddf.zh: [APT28](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0007)是一个被归因于俄罗斯总参谋部情报总局（GRU）第85号主要特殊服务中心（GTsSS）军事单位26165的威胁组织。(Citation: NSA/FBI Drovorub August 2020)(Citation: Cybersecurity Advisory GRU Brute Force Campaign July 2021)该组织至少自2004年以来一直活跃。(Citation: DOJ GRU Indictment Jul 2018)(Citation: Ars Technica GRU indictment Jul 2018)(Citation: Crowdstrike DNC June 2016)(Citation: FireEye APT28)(Citation: SecureWorks TG-4127)(Citation: FireEye APT28 January 2017)(Citation: GRIZZLY STEPPE JAR)(Citation: Sofacy DealersChoice)(Citation: Palo Alto Sofacy 06-2018)(Citation: Symantec APT28 Oct 2018)(Citation: ESET Zebrocy May 2019)据报道，[APT28](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0007)在2016年侵入希拉里·克林顿竞选活动、美国民主党全国委员会和民主党国会竞选委员会，试图干涉美国总统选举。(Citation: Crowdstrike DNC June 2016)2018年，美国起诉了五名与[APT28](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0007)有关联的GRU单位26165军官，指控其在2014年至2018年间针对世界反兴奋剂机构（WADA）、美国反兴奋剂机构、美国核设施、禁止化学武器组织（OPCW）、瑞士斯皮耶兹化学实验室及其他组织实施的网络行动（包括接近式操作）。(Citation: US District Court Indictment GRU Oct 2018)部分行动是在GRU单位74455协助下进行的，该单位也被称为[Sandworm Team](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0034)。

a06a01d177ae22e5ff022d21f7f2e4e9372ece95.source_text: [APT28](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0007) used other victims as proxies to relay command traffic, for instance using a compromised Georgian military email server as a hop point to NATO victims. The group has also used a tool that acts as a proxy to allow C2 even if the victim is behind a router. [APT28](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0007) has also used a machine to relay and obscure communications between [CHOPSTICK](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0023) and their server.(Citation: FireEye APT28)(Citation: Bitdefender APT28 Dec 2015)(Citation: DOJ GRU Indictment Jul 2018)
a06a01d177ae22e5ff022d21f7f2e4e9372ece95.zh: [APT28](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0007) 利用其他受害者的系统作为代理来中继命令流量，例如使用被攻陷的格鲁吉亚军方邮件服务器作为跳板来针对北约受害者。该组织还使用了一种充当代理的工具，即使在受害者位于路由器后面的情况下也能实现C2（命令与控制）通信。[APT28](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0007) 还曾使用一台机器来中继并隐藏[CHOPSTICK](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0023)与其服务器之间的通信。(Citation: FireEye APT28)(Citation: Bitdefender APT28 Dec 2015)(Citation: DOJ GRU Indictment Jul 2018)

ba4b1dc695c2cbca34472d4308cc4fc00ccd6fb3.source_text: [APT28](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0007) has routed traffic over [Tor](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0183) and VPN servers to obfuscate their activities.(Citation: TrendMicro Pawn Storm Dec 2020)
ba4b1dc695c2cbca34472d4308cc4fc00ccd6fb3.zh: [APT28](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0007) 已通过 [Tor](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0183) 和 VPN 服务器路由流量，以掩盖其活动。(Citation: TrendMicro Pawn Storm Dec 2020)

c871856230d5345146e0e9d49ea2fbb987d657b9.source_text: [APT28](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0007) has downloaded additional files, including by using a first-stage downloader to contact the C2 server to obtain the second-stage implant.(Citation: Bitdefender APT28 Dec 2015)(Citation: Unit 42 Playbook Dec 2017)(Citation: Accenture SNAKEMACKEREL Nov 2018)(Citation: TrendMicro Pawn Storm Dec 2020)(Citation: Cybersecurity Advisory GRU Brute Force Campaign July 2021)
c871856230d5345146e0e9d49ea2fbb987d657b9.zh: [APT28](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0007) 已下载额外文件，包括通过第一阶段下载器联系命令与控制（C2）服务器以获取第二阶段有效载荷。(Citation: Bitdefender APT28 Dec 2015)(Citation: Unit 42 Playbook Dec 2017)(Citation: Accenture SNAKEMACKEREL Nov 2018)(Citation: TrendMicro Pawn Storm Dec 2020)(Citation: Cybersecurity Advisory GRU Brute Force Campaign July 2021)

350ff5ac7f8699042e7576fe050198cd0cdfcdf9.source_text: Later implants used by [APT28](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0007), such as [CHOPSTICK](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0023), use a blend of HTTP, HTTPS, and other legitimate channels for C2, depending on module configuration.(Citation: FireEye APT28)(Citation: Cybersecurity Advisory GRU Brute Force Campaign July 2021)
350ff5ac7f8699042e7576fe050198cd0cdfcdf9.zh: 此后由[APT28](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0007)使用的植入程序（例如[CHOPSTICK](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0023)）使用HTTP、HTTPS和其他合法信道的混合体作为C2，具体取决于模块配置。（来源：FireEye APT28）（来源：Cybersecurity Advisory GRU Brute Force Campaign July 2021）

fc9452959090d6f56894fc1ce741ca299e954619.source_text: [APT28](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0007) has used IMAP, POP3, and SMTP for a communication channel in various implants, including using self-registered Google Mail accounts and later compromised email servers of its victims.(Citation: FireEye APT28)(Citation: Cybersecurity Advisory GRU Brute Force Campaign July 2021)
fc9452959090d6f56894fc1ce741ca299e954619.zh: [APT28](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0007) 已在多种植入程序中利用 IMAP、POP3 和 SMTP 作为通信通道，包括使用自行注册的 Google Mail 账户以及随后被其受害者控制的电子邮件服务器。(Citation: FireEye APT28)(Citation: Cybersecurity Advisory GRU Brute Force Campaign July 2021)

6cd6bdda6dd9759371047d05ba7de01cfe80a575.zh: 通过可移动媒介进行通信

f5d975007a0b12996c93bbbf580676117b4ccd1f.source_text: Adversaries can perform command and control between compromised hosts on potentially disconnected networks using removable media to transfer commands from system to system.(Citation: ESET Sednit USBStealer 2014) Both systems would need to be compromised, with the likelihood that an Internet-connected system was compromised first and the second through lateral movement by [Replication Through Removable Media](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1091). Commands and files would be relayed from the disconnected system to the Internet-connected system to which the adversary has direct access.
f5d975007a0b12996c93bbbf580676117b4ccd1f.zh: 对手可以使用可移动介质在可能断开的网络中的受控主机之间执行命令与控制，从而在不同系统间传输命令。（来源：ESET Sednit USBStealer 2014）两个系统都必须已被控制，且可能性较大的是首先通过互联网连接的系统被控制，第二个系统则通过[通过可移动介质复制](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1091)进行横向移动的方式被控制。命令和文件将从断开连接的系统中继到对手可以直接访问的已连接互联网的系统中。

53cd70a67e26ce4e2894ae6c57491ac20015763d.source_text: [APT28](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0007) uses a tool that captures information from air-gapped computers via an infected USB and transfers it to network-connected computer when the USB is inserted.(Citation: Microsoft SIR Vol 19)
53cd70a67e26ce4e2894ae6c57491ac20015763d.zh: [APT28](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0007) 使用一种工具，通过受感染的 USB 从隔离网络计算机中捕获信息，并在插入 USB 时将其传输到联网计算机。（来源：Microsoft SIR Vol 19）

4ac6b31f83d16eaee2941a40c4d181219248a334.source_text: [APT28](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0007) has used Google Drive for C2.(Citation: TrendMicro Pawn Storm Dec 2020)
4ac6b31f83d16eaee2941a40c4d181219248a334.zh: [APT28](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0007) 已使用 Google Drive 进行 C2。（引用：TrendMicro Pawn Storm 2020 年 12 月）

8564141ffffaf43a81dbc3a09db3b7c31ef244c1.source_text: Adversaries may add junk data to protocols used for command and control to make detection more difficult.(Citation: FireEye SUNBURST Backdoor December 2020) By adding random or meaningless data to the protocols used for command and control, adversaries can prevent trivial methods for decoding, deciphering, or otherwise analyzing the traffic. Examples may include appending/prepending data with junk characters or writing junk characters between significant characters.
8564141ffffaf43a81dbc3a09db3b7c31ef244c1.zh: 对抗者可能会在用于命令和控制（C2）的协议中添加垃圾数据，以增加检测难度。（引用：FireEye SUNBURST 后门 2020年12月）通过在用于命令和控制的协议中添加随机或无意义的数据，对抗者可以防止使用简单方法对流量进行解码、解密或以其他方式分析。示例可能包括在数据前或数据后附加垃圾字符，或在重要字符之间写入垃圾字符。

2b2d79aa6689e3ccf827397364420652946f2499.source_text: [APT28](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0007) added "junk data" to each encoded string, preventing trivial decoding without knowledge of the junk removal algorithm. Each implant was given a "junk length" value when created, tracked by the controller software to allow seamless communication but prevent analysis of the command protocol on the wire.(Citation: FireEye APT28)
2b2d79aa6689e3ccf827397364420652946f2499.zh: [APT28](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0007)在每个编码字符串中添加了“垃圾数据”，使得在没有了解垃圾数据移除算法的情况下无法进行简单的解码。每个植入体在创建时都分配了一个“垃圾长度”值，控制器软件会跟踪该值，以实现无缝通信，同时防止对网络上的命令协议进行分析。(Citation: FireEye APT28)

af5855ffc246624c51fb827bd77180518f6dd8a8.source_text: [APT28](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0007) installed a Delphi backdoor that used a custom algorithm for C2 communications.(Citation: ESET Zebrocy May 2019)
af5855ffc246624c51fb827bd77180518f6dd8a8.zh: [APT28](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0007) 安装了一个后门程序，该后门使用定制算法进行C2通信。（引用：ESET Zebrocy May 2019）

96a033a1a165dd75d2ae21c9ab2dd25a2d7fb29d.source_text: [Malteiro](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1026) is a financially motivated criminal group that is likely based in Brazil and has been active since at least November 2019. The group operates and distributes the [Mispadu](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1122) banking trojan via a Malware-as-a-Service (MaaS) business model. [Malteiro](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1026) mainly targets victims throughout Latin America (particularly Mexico) and Europe (particularly Spain and Portugal).(Citation: SCILabs Malteiro 2021)
96a033a1a165dd75d2ae21c9ab2dd25a2d7fb29d.zh: [Malteiro](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1026) 是一个以财务动机为导向的犯罪组织，可能总部位于巴西，自至少 2019 年 11 月以来一直活跃。该组织通过“恶意软件即服务”（MaaS）商业模式运营并分发 [Mispadu](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1122) 银行木马。[Malteiro](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1026) 主要针对拉丁美洲（尤其是墨西哥）和欧洲（尤其是西班牙和葡萄牙）的受害者。(Citation: SCILabs Malteiro 2021)

81e4703944aebe6d037eb7cc1eec523cb3c1837e.source_text: [Metador](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1013) is a suspected cyber espionage group that was first reported in September 2022. [Metador](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1013) has targeted a limited number of telecommunication companies, internet service providers, and universities in the Middle East and Africa. Security researchers named the group [Metador](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1013) based on the "I am meta" string in one of the group's malware samples and the expectation of Spanish-language responses from C2 servers.(Citation: SentinelLabs Metador Sept 2022)
81e4703944aebe6d037eb7cc1eec523cb3c1837e.zh: [Metador](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1013) 是一个疑似的网络间谍组织，于2022年9月首次被报告。该组织针对中东和非洲地区数量有限的电信公司、互联网服务提供商和大学。安全研究人员根据该组织的一个恶意软件样本中出现的“I am meta”字符串以及对来自C2服务器的西班牙语响应的预期，将该组织命名为[Metador](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1013)。(引用: SentinelLabs Metador Sept 2022)

7c53c6142ebd55acb504a9490ca2a1eca9a49b1b.source_text: [Metador](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1013) has used HTTP for C2.(Citation: SentinelLabs Metador Sept 2022)
7c53c6142ebd55acb504a9490ca2a1eca9a49b1b.zh: [Metador](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1013) 曾使用 HTTP 进行 C2。(Citation: SentinelLabs Metador Sept 2022)

57358cd11cf797a5e2755526b64031ea6e325062.source_text: [Metador](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1013) has used TCP for C2.(Citation: SentinelLabs Metador Sept 2022)

4f732f3b5ef5fce6b36672ac513acdc13e4984ee.source_text: [Metador](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1013) has downloaded tools and malware onto a compromised system.(Citation: SentinelLabs Metador Sept 2022)
4f732f3b5ef5fce6b36672ac513acdc13e4984ee.zh: [Metador](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1013) 已将工具和恶意软件下载到被攻陷的系统上。(Citation: SentinelLabs Metador Sept 2022)

f2680340a0c7d621f536156ae9392629acdf2a81.source_text: [APT42](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1044) is an Iranian-sponsored threat group that conducts cyber espionage and surveillance.(Citation: Mandiant APT42-charms) The group primarily focuses on targets in the Middle East region, but has targeted a variety of industries and countries since at least 2015.(Citation: Mandiant APT42-charms) [APT42](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1044) starts cyber operations through spearphishing emails and/or the PINEFLOWER Android malware, then monitors and collects information from the compromised systems and devices.(Citation: Mandiant APT42-charms) Finally, [APT42](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1044) exfiltrates data using native features and open-source tools.(Citation: Mandiant APT42-untangling) [APT42](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1044) activities have been linked to [Magic Hound](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0059) by other commercial vendors. While there are behavior and software overlaps between [Magic Hound](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0059) and [APT42](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1044), they appear to be distinct entities and are tracked as separate entities by their originating vendor.
f2680340a0c7d621f536156ae9392629acdf2a81.zh: [APT42](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1044) 是一个由伊朗支持的威胁组织，从事网络间谍活动和监视。(Citation: Mandiant APT42-charms) 该组织主要关注中东地区的目标，但自2015年以来已针对各种行业和国家发动攻击。(Citation: Mandiant APT42-charms) [APT42](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1044) 通过鱼叉式网络钓鱼邮件和/或PINEFLOWER Android恶意软件发起网络行动，然后监控并从受损系统和设备中收集信息。(Citation: Mandiant APT42-charms) 最后，[APT42](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1044) 使用原生功能和开源工具进行数据外泄。(Citation: Mandiant APT42-untangling) 其他商业厂商已将[APT42](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1044)的活动与[Magic Hound](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0059)联系起来。尽管[Magic Hound](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0059)和[APT42](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1044)之间存在行为与软件重叠，但它们似乎是不同的实体，并由其来源厂商作为不同实体进行追踪。

9078c417f7a1a7fb94aaf53c1b5df9969571ddb3.source_text: [APT42](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1044) has encoded C2 traffic with Base64.(Citation: Mandiant APT42-untangling)
9078c417f7a1a7fb94aaf53c1b5df9969571ddb3.zh: [APT42](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1044) 使用 Base64 对 C2 流量进行了编码。（出处：Mandiant APT42-untangling）

c3c7ca7e3565114a346466257598de352a6b2578.source_text: [APT42](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1044) has used various links, such as links with typo-squatted domains, links to Dropbox files and links to fake Google sites, in spearphishing operations.(Citation: Mandiant APT42-untangling)(Citation: Mandiant APT42-charms)(Citation: TAG APT42)
c3c7ca7e3565114a346466257598de352a6b2578.zh: [APT42](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1044) 在网络钓鱼行动中使用过多种链接，例如拼写冒用的域名链接、指向 Dropbox 文件的链接以及假冒的 Google 网站链接。（引用：Mandiant APT42-untangling）（引用：Mandiant APT42-charms）（引用：TAG APT42）

dc74ba6064b7271c96f422f8b2d011a2974b14fc.source_text: [APT42](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1044) has used tools such as [NICECURL](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1192) with command and control communication taking place over HTTPS.(Citation: Mandiant APT42-untangling)
dc74ba6064b7271c96f422f8b2d011a2974b14fc.zh: [APT42](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1044) 使用过 [NICECURL](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1192) 等工具，并通过 HTTPS 进行命令与控制通信。(引用：Mandiant APT42-untangling)

b69d6971714950c12bd7c81e6685c7004861377d.source_text: [APT5](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1023) is a China-based espionage actor that has been active since at least 2007 primarily targeting the telecommunications, aerospace, and defense industries throughout the U.S., Europe, and Asia. [APT5](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1023) has displayed advanced tradecraft and significant interest in compromising networking devices and their underlying software including through the use of zero-day exploits.(Citation: NSA APT5 Citrix Threat Hunting December 2022)(Citation: Microsoft East Asia Threats September 2023)(Citation: Mandiant Pulse Secure Zero-Day April 2021)(Citation: Mandiant Pulse Secure Update May 2021)(Citation: FireEye Southeast Asia Threat Landscape March 2015)(Citation: Mandiant Advanced Persistent Threats)
b69d6971714950c12bd7c81e6685c7004861377d.zh: [APT5](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1023) 是一个源于中国的间谍活动组织，自至少2007年以来活跃，主要目标是美国、欧洲和亚洲的电信、航天和国防行业。[APT5](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1023) 展示了先进的作战技巧，并对入侵网络设备及其底层软件表现出浓厚兴趣，包括使用零日漏洞进行攻击。(Citation: NSA APT5 Citrix Threat Hunting December 2022)(Citation: Microsoft East Asia Threats September 2023)(Citation: Mandiant Pulse Secure Zero-Day April 2021)(Citation: Mandiant Pulse Secure Update May 2021)(Citation: FireEye Southeast Asia Threat Landscape March 2015)(Citation: Mandiant Advanced Persistent Threats)

75c0f26f6c0105c60ed0bea58f6cc42c7e4d1002.source_text: [Fox Kitten](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0117) is threat actor with a suspected nexus to the Iranian government that has been active since at least 2017 against entities in the Middle East, North Africa, Europe, Australia, and North America. [Fox Kitten](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0117) has targeted multiple industrial verticals including oil and gas, technology, government, defense, healthcare, manufacturing, and engineering.(Citation: ClearkSky Fox Kitten February 2020)(Citation: CrowdStrike PIONEER KITTEN August 2020)(Citation: Dragos PARISITE )(Citation: ClearSky Pay2Kitten December 2020)
75c0f26f6c0105c60ed0bea58f6cc42c7e4d1002.zh: [Fox Kitten](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0117)是一个涉嫌与伊朗政府有关联的威胁行为者，自2017年以来一直活跃，主要针对中东、北非、欧洲、澳大利亚和北美地区的实体。[Fox Kitten](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0117) targeting多个工业领域，包括石油和天然气、技术、政府、国防、医疗保健、制造业和工程。(引用：ClearkSky Fox Kitten 2020年2月)(引用：CrowdStrike PIONEER KITTEN 2020年8月)(引用：Dragos PARISITE )(引用：ClearSky Pay2Kitten 2020年12月)

fa58f3daff23765ba8e6420051d6590245138c95.source_text: [Fox Kitten](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0117) has downloaded additional tools including [PsExec](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0029) directly to endpoints.(Citation: CISA AA20-259A Iran-Based Actor September 2020)
fa58f3daff23765ba8e6420051d6590245138c95.zh: [Fox Kitten](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0117) 已直接将其他工具（包括 [PsExec](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0029)）下载到端点上。(Citation: CISA AA20-259A Iran-Based Actor September 2020)

d857d5c7503b3670f841d92305d7f77c2e34788e.source_text: [Fox Kitten](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0117) has used the open source reverse proxy tools including FRPC and Go Proxy to establish connections from C2 to local servers.(Citation: CISA AA20-259A Iran-Based Actor September 2020)(Citation: ClearSky Pay2Kitten December 2020)(Citation: Check Point Pay2Key November 2020)
d857d5c7503b3670f841d92305d7f77c2e34788e.zh: [Fox Kitten](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0117) 使用了包括 FRPC 和 Go Proxy 在内的开源反向代理工具，建立从 C2 到本地服务器的连接。(Citation: CISA AA20-259A Iran-Based Actor September 2020)(Citation: ClearSky Pay2Kitten December 2020)(Citation: Check Point Pay2Key November 2020)

b36f062d29de6219337693dd1aa7c3fa2b931754.source_text: [Fox Kitten](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0117) has used protocol tunneling for communication and RDP activity on compromised hosts through the use of open source tools such as [ngrok](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0508) and custom tool SSHMinion.(Citation: CrowdStrike PIONEER KITTEN August 2020)(Citation: CISA AA20-259A Iran-Based Actor September 2020)(Citation: ClearSky Pay2Kitten December 2020)
b36f062d29de6219337693dd1aa7c3fa2b931754.zh: [狐狸幼崽](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0117) 使用协议隧道技术以及开源工具如 [ngrok](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0508) 和定制工具 SSHMinion 在失陷主机上进行通信和远程桌面协议（RDP）活动。(引用：CrowdStrike PIONEER KITTEN 2020年8月)(引用：CISA AA20-259A 伊朗背景行为者 2020年9月)(引用：ClearSky Pay2Kitten 2020年12月)

928fbf9abe0e03a5a8f78a4532e6a5cdc95cb5ac.source_text: [Fox Kitten](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0117) has used Amazon Web Services to host C2.(Citation: ClearSky Pay2Kitten December 2020)
928fbf9abe0e03a5a8f78a4532e6a5cdc95cb5ac.zh: [Fox Kitten](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0117) 曾使用 Amazon Web Services 托管 C2。（引用：ClearSky Pay2Kitten 2020年12月）

9b3d5cc5f20db31f1454dc46615cb0d886ca66dd.source_text: [RTM](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0048) is a cybercriminal group that has been active since at least 2015 and is primarily interested in users of remote banking systems in Russia and neighboring countries. The group uses a Trojan by the same name ([RTM](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0148)). (Citation: ESET RTM Feb 2017)
9b3d5cc5f20db31f1454dc46615cb0d886ca66dd.zh: [RTM](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0048) 是一个网络犯罪组织，自至少2015年以来一直活跃，主要目标是俄罗斯及邻近国家的远程银行系统用户。该组织使用同名木马（[RTM](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0148)）。（来源：ESET RTM Feb 2017）

3b4d52dc7ffa08de3f41425e0d55572a8bb5b38e.source_text: [RTM](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0048) has used a modified version of TeamViewer and Remote Utilities for remote access.(Citation: Group IB RTM August 2019)
3b4d52dc7ffa08de3f41425e0d55572a8bb5b38e.zh: [RTM](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0048) 曾使用修改版的 TeamViewer 和 Remote Utilities 进行远程访问。(Citation: Group IB RTM August 2019)

7c0568d8c91dd6e44d4d9df7c93b46463122fa95.source_text: [RTM](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0048) has used an RSS feed on Livejournal to update a list of encrypted C2 server names.(Citation: ESET RTM Feb 2017)
7c0568d8c91dd6e44d4d9df7c93b46463122fa95.zh: [RTM](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0048) 曾使用 LiveJournal 上的一个 RSS 源来更新加密 C2 服务器名称的列表。(Citation: ESET RTM Feb 2017)

9ddfc224a6cc377657fe435de0ba4b19036da49f.source_text: [APT12](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0005) is a threat group that has been attributed to China. The group has targeted a variety of victims including but not limited to media outlets, high-tech companies, and multiple governments.(Citation: Meyers Numbered Panda)
9ddfc224a6cc377657fe435de0ba4b19036da49f.zh: [APT12](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0005) 是一个被归因于中国的威胁组织。该组织针对多种受害者，包括但不限于媒体机构、高科技公司以及多个政府。(Citation: Meyers Numbered Panda)

df9ce3afc63bfde15a89db37b828fcb26cdda430.source_text: [APT12](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0005) has used blogs and WordPress for C2 infrastructure.(Citation: Meyers Numbered Panda)
df9ce3afc63bfde15a89db37b828fcb26cdda430.zh: [APT12](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0005) 使用博客和 WordPress 作为 C2 基础设施。(引用：Meyers Numbered Panda)

caa8b7c61454d1cb704b220d3d4d7af8913d83bc.source_text: Adversaries may perform calculations on addresses returned in DNS results to determine which port and IP address to use for command and control, rather than relying on a predetermined port number or the actual returned IP address. A IP and/or port number calculation can be used to bypass egress filtering on a C2 channel.(Citation: Meyers Numbered Panda) One implementation of [DNS Calculation](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1568/003) is to take the first three octets of an IP address in a DNS response and use those values to calculate the port for command and control traffic.(Citation: Meyers Numbered Panda)(Citation: Moran 2014)(Citation: Rapid7G20Espionage)
caa8b7c61454d1cb704b220d3d4d7af8913d83bc.zh: 攻击者可以对 DNS 结果中返回的地址执行计算，以确定用于命令与控制（C2）的端口和 IP 地址，而不是依赖预定义的端口号或直接返回的 IP 地址。IP 和/或端口号的计算可用于绕过 C2 通道的出口过滤。(Citation: Meyers Numbered Panda) [DNS 计算](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1568/003) 的一种实现方式是：获取 DNS 响应中 IP 地址的前三个八位组，并使用这些值计算用于命令与控制流量的端口。(Citation: Meyers Numbered Panda)(Citation: Moran 2014)(Citation: Rapid7G20Espionage)

debf31f997051b34795f73f93c988b1ac84f4685.source_text: [APT12](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0005) has used multiple variants of [DNS Calculation](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1568/003) including multiplying the first two octets of an IP address and adding the third octet to that value in order to get a resulting command and control port.(Citation: Meyers Numbered Panda)
debf31f997051b34795f73f93c988b1ac84f4685.zh: [APT12](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0005) 已使用 [DNS 计算](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1568/003) 的多种变体，包括将 IP 地址的前两个八位组相乘，并将第三个八位组加到该值上，从而得到一个用于命令和控制服务的端口。(Citation: Meyers Numbered Panda)

0ed0ae53e695309b13cc45d30b71081bea248224.source_text: [APT-C-36](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0099) is a suspected South American threat group that has engaged in espionage and financially motivated operations since at least 2018. [APT-C-36](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0099) has targeted government institutions and entities in the financial, energy, and professional manufacturing sectors across Colombia and other Latin American countries.(Citation: QiAnXin APT-C-36 Feb2019)(Citation: Kaspersky BlindEagle AUG 2024)(Citation: Check Point Blind Eagle MAR 2025)(Citation: Recorded Future TAG-144 AUG 2025)
0ed0ae53e695309b13cc45d30b71081bea248224.zh: [APT-C-36](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0099) 是一个涉嫌来自南美的威胁组织，自至少2018年以来一直从事情报搜集活动和以经济利益为动机的行动。该组织针对哥伦比亚及其他拉丁美洲国家的政府机构以及金融、能源和专业制造领域的实体进行了攻击。(Citation: QiAnXin APT-C-36 Feb2019)(Citation: Kaspersky BlindEagle AUG 2024)(Citation: Check Point Blind Eagle MAR 2025)(Citation: Recorded Future TAG-144 AUG 2025)

2052543d07595928b55f69f441d485ce482dba5f.source_text: [APT-C-36](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0099) has downloaded binary data from a specified domain after the malicious document is opened.(Citation: QiAnXin APT-C-36 Feb2019)
2052543d07595928b55f69f441d485ce482dba5f.zh: [APT-C-36](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0099) 在恶意文档被打开后，从指定域名下载了二进制数据。（引用：QiAnXin APT-C-36 Feb2019）

4dfb6d1f6b0fdc7178f038c2102b1518b1e521fa.source_text: [APT-C-36](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0099) has used DDNS services such as DuckDNS, noip[.]com, and con-ip[.]com to redirect victims to sites or repositories hosting malware implants.(Citation: Kaspersky BlindEagle AUG 2024)(Citation: Check Point Blind Eagle MAR 2025)(Citation: LevelBlue Blind Eagle Proton66 JUN 2025)(Citation: Recorded Future TAG-144 AUG 2025)(Citation: Zscaler BlindEagle DEC 2025)
4dfb6d1f6b0fdc7178f038c2102b1518b1e521fa.zh: [APT-C-36](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0099) 曾使用 DuckDNS、noip[.]com 和 con-ip[.]com 等 DDNS 服务将受害者重定向到托管恶意软件植入物的站点或代码仓库。(Citation: Kaspersky BlindEagle AUG 2024)(Citation: Check Point Blind Eagle MAR 2025)(Citation: LevelBlue Blind Eagle Proton66 JUN 2025)(Citation: Recorded Future TAG-144 AUG 2025)(Citation: Zscaler BlindEagle DEC 2025)

bed75de46bbd34a1686ddc7f314273cad508c5c6.source_text: [APT-C-36](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0099) has used port 4050 for C2 communications.(Citation: QiAnXin APT-C-36 Feb2019)
bed75de46bbd34a1686ddc7f314273cad508c5c6.zh: [APT-C-36](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0099) 已使用端口 4050 进行 C2 通信。(引用：QiAnXin APT-C-36 Feb2019)

676036488b7dd817e372bb5eab448741ee23c510.source_text: [Scarlet Mimic](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0029) is a threat group that has targeted minority rights activists. This group has not been directly linked to a government source, but the group's motivations appear to overlap with those of the Chinese government. While there is some overlap between IP addresses used by [Scarlet Mimic](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0029) and [Putter Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0024), it has not been concluded that the groups are the same. (Citation: Scarlet Mimic Jan 2016)
676036488b7dd817e372bb5eab448741ee23c510.zh: [Scarlet Mimic](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0029) 是一个针对少数群体权利活动人士的威胁组织。该组织尚未被直接关联到任何政府来源，但其动机似乎与中华人民共和国政府的动机存在重叠。虽然 [Scarlet Mimic](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0029) 使用的 IP 地址与 [Putter Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0024) 使用的 IP 地址有一定程度的重叠，但尚无法得出这两个组织是同一实体的结论。(Citation: Scarlet Mimic Jan 2016)

2604e3d721dab7e0bcce967192307354abbe852e.source_text: [Winnti Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0044) is a threat group with Chinese origins that has been active since at least 2010. The group has heavily targeted the gaming industry, but it has also expanded the scope of its targeting.(Citation: Kaspersky Winnti April 2013)(Citation: Kaspersky Winnti June 2015)(Citation: Novetta Winnti April 2015) Some reporting suggests a number of other groups, including [Axiom](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0001), [APT17](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0025), and [Ke3chang](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0004), are closely linked to [Winnti Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0044).(Citation: 401 TRG Winnti Umbrella May 2018)
2604e3d721dab7e0bcce967192307354abbe852e.zh: [Winnti Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0044) 是一个起源于中国、自至少2010年以来一直活跃的网络威胁组织。该组织主要 targeting 游戏行业，但其目标范围已扩大。(Citation: Kaspersky Winnti April 2013)(Citation: Kaspersky Winnti June 2015)(Citation: Novetta Winnti April 2015) 一些报告指出，包括 [Axiom](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0001)、[APT17](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0025) 和 [Ke3chang](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0004) 在内的其他多个组织与 [Winnti Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0044) 关系密切。(Citation: 401 TRG Winnti Umbrella May 2018)

41de611ed147082a852222653426faddf043bfe9.source_text: [Winnti Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0044) has downloaded an auxiliary program named ff.exe to infected machines.(Citation: Kaspersky Winnti April 2013)
41de611ed147082a852222653426faddf043bfe9.zh: [Winnti Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0044) 已将名为 ff.exe 的辅助程序下载到受感染的计算机上。(Citation: Kaspersky Winnti April 2013)

6636419c0c5a6884cf74ba74d826bf4f22e5171a.source_text: [Tonto Team](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0131) is a suspected Chinese state-sponsored cyber espionage threat group that has primarily targeted South Korea, Japan, Taiwan, and the United States since at least 2009; by 2020 they expanded operations to include other Asian as well as Eastern European countries. [Tonto Team](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0131) has targeted government, military, energy, mining, financial, education, healthcare, and technology organizations, including through the Heartbeat Campaign (2009-2012) and Operation Bitter Biscuit (2017).(Citation: Kaspersky CactusPete Aug 2020)(Citation: ESET Exchange Mar 2021)(Citation: FireEye Chinese Espionage October 2019)(Citation: ARS Technica China Hack SK April 2017)(Citation: Trend Micro HeartBeat Campaign January 2013)(Citation: Talos Bisonal 10 Years March 2020)
6636419c0c5a6884cf74ba74d826bf4f22e5171a.zh: [Tonto Team](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0131) 是一个疑似由中国国家支持的、主要针对韩国、日本、台湾和美国的网络间谍威胁组织，自至少2009年以来活跃；到2020年，其行动范围扩展到其他亚洲以及东欧国家。[Tonto Team](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0131) 针对政府、军事、能源、采矿、金融、教育、医疗和技术等领域的组织进行攻击，其中包括通过 Heartbeat 活动（2009-2012年）和 Operation Bitter Biscuit 活动（2017年）。(Citation: Kaspersky CactusPete Aug 2020)(Citation: ESET Exchange Mar 2021)(Citation: FireEye Chinese Espionage October 2019)(Citation: ARS Technica China Hack SK April 2017)(Citation: Trend Micro HeartBeat Campaign January 2013)(Citation: Talos Bisonal 10 Years March 2020)

45c25f8b87295fc5e9d7a299eed68d1d2c410c07.source_text: [Tonto Team](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0131) has routed their traffic through an external server in order to obfuscate their location.(Citation: TrendMicro Tonto Team October 2020)
45c25f8b87295fc5e9d7a299eed68d1d2c410c07.zh: [Tonto Team](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0131) 已将其流量路由到外部服务器，以掩盖其位置。(Citation: TrendMicro Tonto Team October 2020)

2804ac113b2ddb093e27ae09e6095bdb753dc4f4.source_text: [Tonto Team](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0131) has downloaded malicious DLLs which served as a [ShadowPad](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0596) loader.(Citation: ESET Exchange Mar 2021)
2804ac113b2ddb093e27ae09e6095bdb753dc4f4.zh: [Tonto Team](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0131) 已下载了恶意 DLL，这些 DLL 作为 [ShadowPad](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0596) 的加载器。（引用：ESET Exchange 2021年3月）

5ed829a792d5742f996fd1ab83aa355921317161.source_text: [GOLD SOUTHFIELD](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0115) is a financially motivated threat group active since at least 2018 that operates the [REvil](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0496) Ransomware-as-a Service (RaaS). [GOLD SOUTHFIELD](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0115) provides backend infrastructure for affiliates recruited on underground forums to perpetrate high value deployments. By early 2020, [GOLD SOUTHFIELD](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0115) started capitalizing on the new trend of stealing data and further extorting the victim to pay for their data to not get publicly leaked.(Citation: Secureworks REvil September 2019)(Citation: Secureworks GandCrab and REvil September 2019)(Citation: Secureworks GOLD SOUTHFIELD)(Citation: CrowdStrike Evolution of Pinchy Spider July 2021)
5ed829a792d5742f996fd1ab83aa355921317161.zh: [GOLD SOUTHFIELD](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0115) 是一个自2018年至少以来活跃的、以经济利益为动机的威胁组织，运营着 [REvil](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0496) 勒索软件即服务（RaaS）。[GOLD SOUTHFIELD](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0115) 为在地下论坛招募的分销商提供后端基础设施，使其能够执行高价值攻击。到2020年初，[GOLD SOUTHFIELD](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0115) 开始利用窃取数据并进一步勒索受害者以防止其数据被公开泄露的新趋势。（引用：Secureworks REvil 2019年9月）（引用：Secureworks GandCrab和REvil 2019年9月）（引用：Secureworks GOLD SOUTHFIELD）（引用：CrowdStrike Pinchy Spider演变 2021年7月）

79387deea5157356b97b1a2415e139cc812c8d45.source_text: [GOLD SOUTHFIELD](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0115) has used the cloud-based remote management and monitoring tool "ConnectWise Control" to deploy [REvil](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0496).(Citation: Tetra Defense Sodinokibi March 2020)
79387deea5157356b97b1a2415e139cc812c8d45.zh: [GOLD SOUTHFIELD](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0115) 已使用基于云端的远程管理和监控工具“ConnectWise Control”部署了[REvil](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0496)。(Citation: Tetra Defense Sodinokibi March 2020)

b1483ac3d361ab9ad08367829a1ec684cc95df09.source_text: [Lazarus Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0032) is a North Korean state-sponsored cyber threat group attributed to the Reconnaissance General Bureau (RGB). (Citation: US-CERT HIDDEN COBRA June 2017) (Citation: Treasury North Korean Cyber Groups September 2019) [Lazarus Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0032) has been active since at least 2009 and is reportedly responsible for the November 2014 destructive wiper attack on Sony Pictures Entertainment, identified by Novetta as part of Operation Blockbuster. Malware used by [Lazarus Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0032) correlates to other reported campaigns, including Operation Flame, Operation 1Mission, Operation Troy, DarkSeoul, and Ten Days of Rain.(Citation: Novetta Blockbuster) North Korea’s cyber operations have shown a consistent pattern of adaptation, forming and reorganizing units as national priorities shift. These units frequently share personnel, infrastructure, malware, and tradecraft, making it difficult to attribute specific operations with high confidence. Public reporting often uses “Lazarus Group” as an umbrella term for multiple North Korean cyber operators conducting espionage, destructive attacks, and financially motivated campaigns.(Citation: Mandiant DPRK Laz Org Breakdown 2022)(Citation: Mandiant DPRK Groups 2023)(Citation: JPCert Blog Laz Subgroups 2025)
b1483ac3d361ab9ad08367829a1ec684cc95df09.zh: [Lazarus 组织](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0032) 是一个由朝鲜国家支持的网络安全威胁组织，被归因于 reconnaissance General Bureau (RGB)。(引用：US-CERT HIDDEN COBRA 2017年6月)(引用：美国财政部《朝鲜网络组织》2019年9月)[Lazarus 组织](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0032) 自至少2009年以来一直活跃，据报道对2014年11月针对索尼影视娱乐公司的破坏性擦除攻击负有责任，该攻击被 Novetta 认定为 Operation Blockbuster 的一部分。(Citation: Novetta Blockbuster)[Lazarus 组织](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0032) 使用的恶意软件与其他报告的活动相关，包括 Operation Flame、Operation 1Mission、Operation Troy、DarkSeoul 和 Ten Days of Rain。(引用：Novetta Blockbuster) 朝鲜的网络行动显示出一致的适应模式，根据国家优先事项的变化，组建和重组单位。这些单位经常共享人员、基础设施、恶意软件和战术技巧，使得高置信度地将特定行动归因于某个实体变得困难。公共报告通常使用 “Lazarus Group” 作为多个进行间谍活动、破坏性攻击以及以经济利益为目的的朝鲜网络操作者的统称。(引用：Mandiant DPRK Laz Org Breakdown 2022)(引用：Mandiant DPRK Groups 2023)(引用：JPCert Blog Laz Subgroups 2025)

c278b8c7a97e8c1b946c58267fb0d778eb0fc298.source_text: [Lazarus Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0032) malware also uses a unique form of communication encryption known as FakeTLS that mimics TLS but uses a different encryption method, potentially evading SSL traffic inspection/decryption.(Citation: Novetta Blockbuster)(Citation: Novetta Blockbuster Destructive Malware)(Citation: McAfee Lazarus Resurfaces Feb 2018)(Citation: McAfee-GhostSecret-fixurl)
c278b8c7a97e8c1b946c58267fb0d778eb0fc298.zh: [Lazarus Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0032) 的恶意软件还使用了一种名为 FakeTLS 的独特通信加密形式，它模仿 TLS 但采用不同的加密方法，可能绕过 SSL 流量检查/解密。(Citation: Novetta Blockbuster)(Citation: Novetta Blockbuster Destructive Malware)(Citation: McAfee Lazarus Resurfaces Feb 2018)(Citation: McAfee-GhostSecret-fixurl)

1c1d2fb188d1fa3469620a6cec4adc3fc7b3db3a.source_text: [Lazarus Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0032) has downloaded files, malware, and tools from its C2 onto a compromised host.(Citation: Novetta Blockbuster)(Citation: Novetta Blockbuster Destructive Malware)(Citation: Novetta Blockbuster Loaders)(Citation: SentinelOne Lazarus macOS July 2020)(Citation: TrendMicro macOS Dacls May 2020)(Citation: Kaspersky ThreatNeedle Feb 2021)(Citation: Google TAG Lazarus Jan 2021)(Citation: Lazarus APT January 2022)(Citation: Qualys LolZarus)(Citation: ESET Twitter Ida Pro Nov 2021)
1c1d2fb188d1fa3469620a6cec4adc3fc7b3db3a.zh: [Lazarus 组织](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0032)已将其C2上的文件、恶意软件和工具下载到受感染的主机上。(Citation: Novetta Blockbuster)(Citation: Novetta Blockbuster Destructive Malware)(Citation: Novetta Blockbuster Loaders)(Citation: SentinelOne Lazarus macOS July 2020)(Citation: TrendMicro macOS Dacls May 2020)(Citation: Kaspersky ThreatNeedle Feb 2021)(Citation: Google TAG Lazarus Jan 2021)(Citation: Lazarus APT January 2022)(Citation: Qualys LolZarus)(Citation: ESET Twitter Ida Pro Nov 2021)

28b0bd447b8243f2cbb770f6a0314a00330a254a.source_text: [Lazarus Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0032) has used multiple proxies to obfuscate network traffic from victims.(Citation: US-CERT FALLCHILL Nov 2017)(Citation: TrendMicro macOS Dacls May 2020)
28b0bd447b8243f2cbb770f6a0314a00330a254a.zh: [Lazarus Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0032) 使用多个代理来混淆受害者的网络流量。(Citation: US-CERT FALLCHILL Nov 2017)(Citation: TrendMicro macOS Dacls May 2020)

9b5ae7f53cc8ed1a9e09f06477bda5917fff3a08.source_text: [Lazarus Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0032) has used multi-stage malware components that inject later stages into separate processes.(Citation: Lazarus APT January 2022)
9b5ae7f53cc8ed1a9e09f06477bda5917fff3a08.zh: [Lazarus Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0032) 已使用多阶段恶意软件组件，将后续阶段注入到不同的进程中。(Citation: Lazarus APT January 2022)

b1d19a423669d253f4bff5b1f9458bc20bc0c53a.source_text: Several [Lazarus Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0032) malware families encrypt C2 traffic using custom code that uses XOR with an ADD operation and XOR with a SUB operation. Another [Lazarus Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0032) malware sample XORs C2 traffic. Other [Lazarus Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0032) malware uses Caracachs encryption to encrypt C2 payloads. [Lazarus Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0032) has also used AES to encrypt C2 traffic.(Citation: Novetta Blockbuster)(Citation: Novetta Blockbuster Destructive Malware)(Citation: McAfee Lazarus Resurfaces Feb 2018)(Citation: McAfee GhostSecret)
b1d19a423669d253f4bff5b1f9458bc20bc0c53a.zh: 多个[Lazarus Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0032)恶意软件家族使用自定义代码对C2流量进行加密，这些自定义代码采用XOR与ADD运算结合以及XOR与SUB运算结合的方式。另一个[Lazarus Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0032)的恶意软件样本对C2流量进行XOR加密。其他[Lazarus Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0032)恶意软件使用Caracachs加密来加密C2载荷。[Lazarus Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0032)还曾使用AES对C2流量进行加密。(引用：Novetta Blockbuster)(引用：Novetta Blockbuster Destructive Malware)(引用：McAfee Lazarus Resurfaces Feb 2018)(引用：McAfee GhostSecret)

0331527fbbc6bacba05bac26620293dae1931f18.source_text: [Lazarus Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0032) has used GitHub as C2, pulling hosted image payloads then committing command execution output to files in specific directories.(Citation: Lazarus APT January 2022)
0331527fbbc6bacba05bac26620293dae1931f18.zh: [拉撒路组织](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0032) 曾使用 GitHub 作为 C2，拉取托管的镜像载荷，然后将命令执行输出提交到特定目录中的文件。(Citation: Lazarus APT January 2022)

7442304c84c9ced70f2bbff9054dddea6c0126f5.source_text: [Lazarus Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0032) has conducted C2 over HTTP and HTTPS.(Citation: McAfee Lazarus Resurfaces Feb 2018)(Citation: SentinelOne Lazarus macOS July 2020)(Citation: TrendMicro macOS Dacls May 2020)(Citation: Lazarus APT January 2022)(Citation: Qualys LolZarus)(Citation: ESET Twitter Ida Pro Nov 2021)
7442304c84c9ced70f2bbff9054dddea6c0126f5.zh: [Lazarus Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0032) 已使用 HTTP 和 HTTPS 进行命令与控制（C2）活动。（引用：McAfee Lazarus Resurfaces Feb 2018）（引用：SentinelOne Lazarus macOS July 2020）（引用：TrendMicro macOS Dacls May 2020）（引用：Lazarus APT January 2022）（引用：Qualys LolZarus）（引用：ESET Twitter Ida Pro Nov 2021）

63b7b79a22d177cc4bbc4b27cacddfc8983cc5ad.source_text: Some [Lazarus Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0032) malware uses a list of ordered port numbers to choose a port for C2 traffic, creating port-protocol mismatches.(Citation: Novetta Blockbuster)(Citation: Novetta Blockbuster RATs)
63b7b79a22d177cc4bbc4b27cacddfc8983cc5ad.zh: 某些[ Lazarus Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0032)恶意软件使用有序端口号列表来选择用于C2流量的端口，从而造成端口-协议不匹配的情况。(参考来源：Novetta Blockbuster)(参考来源：Novetta Blockbuster RATs)

d9683b652f7fcd4bafa2a7cff04ebc85537036e2.source_text: A [Lazarus Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0032) malware sample encodes data with base64.(Citation: McAfee Lazarus Resurfaces Feb 2018)
d9683b652f7fcd4bafa2a7cff04ebc85537036e2.zh: [Lazarus Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0032) 的一个恶意软件样本使用 Base64 对数据进行编码。（来源：McAfee Lazarus Resurfaces Feb 2018）

14c71657ab5f391c1b0f2871dbff3743fa85d393.source_text: [Lazarus Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0032) has used a compromised router to serve as a proxy between a victim network's corporate and restricted segments.(Citation: Kaspersky ThreatNeedle Feb 2021)
14c71657ab5f391c1b0f2871dbff3743fa85d393.zh: [ Lazarus Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0032) 曾利用被攻陷的路由器作为代理，在受害者网络的内部和受限网段之间建立通信。(Citation: Kaspersky ThreatNeedle Feb 2021)

0611eb609ffcbbcb47bdd0f00c8f206cbfbd9fbb.source_text: [Lazarus Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0032) malware SierraAlfa sends data to one of the hard-coded C2 servers chosen at random, and if the transmission fails, chooses a new C2 server to attempt the transmission again.(Citation: Novetta Blockbuster)(Citation: Novetta Blockbuster RATs)
0611eb609ffcbbcb47bdd0f00c8f206cbfbd9fbb.zh: [Lazarus Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0032) 的恶意软件 SierraAlfa 将数据发送到一个随机选择的硬编码 C2 服务器；如果传输失败，则选择一个新的 C2 服务器再次尝试传输。(Citation: Novetta Blockbuster)(Citation: Novetta Blockbuster RATs)

d977e1654b4385e2d576b4b782970eae5c4d0be7.source_text: [INC Ransom](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1032) is a ransomware and data extortion threat group associated with the deployment of [INC Ransomware](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1139) that has been active since at least July 2023. [INC Ransom](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1032) has targeted organizations worldwide most commonly in the industrial, healthcare, and education sectors in the US and Europe.(Citation: Bleeping Computer INC Ransomware March 2024)(Citation: Cybereason INC Ransomware November 2023)(Citation: Secureworks GOLD IONIC April 2024)(Citation: SentinelOne INC Ransomware)
d977e1654b4385e2d576b4b782970eae5c4d0be7.zh: [INC Ransom](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1032) 是一个勒索软件和数据勒索威胁团伙，与部署 [INC Ransomware](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1139) 有关，自至少 2023 年 7 月起活跃。[INC Ransom](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1032) 主要针对全球范围内的组织，最常见的是美国及欧洲的工业、医疗和教育部门。(Citation: Bleeping Computer INC Ransomware March 2024)(Citation: Cybereason INC Ransomware November 2023)(Citation: Secureworks GOLD IONIC April 2024)(Citation: SentinelOne INC Ransomware)

a2ed77ce8367c2e50996f7a2b61281ba3d2cb81a.source_text: [INC Ransom](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1032) has used valid accounts over RDP to connect to targeted systems.(Citation: Huntress INC Ransom Group August 2023)
a2ed77ce8367c2e50996f7a2b61281ba3d2cb81a.zh: [INC Ransom](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1032) 使用有效的账户通过 RDP 连接至目标系统。(Citation: Huntress INC Ransom Group August 2023)

33ef225204f0bb3d3cca04d723ace65bb6ce065c.source_text: [INC Ransom](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1032) has used AnyDesk and PuTTY on compromised systems.(Citation: Huntress INC Ransom Group August 2023)(Citation: SOCRadar INC Ransom January 2024)(Citation: Huntress INC Ransomware May 2024)(Citation: SentinelOne INC Ransomware)
33ef225204f0bb3d3cca04d723ace65bb6ce065c.zh: [INC Ransom](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1032) 在受损系统上使用 AnyDesk 和 PuTTY。（Citation: Huntress INC Ransom Group August 2023）（Citation: SOCRadar INC Ransom January 2024）（Citation: Huntress INC Ransomware May 2024）（Citation: SentinelOne INC Ransomware）

b763d0c8b819206be25d940caa44685c8435b01d.source_text: [INC Ransom](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1032) has downloaded tools to compromised servers including Advanced IP Scanner. (Citation: Huntress INC Ransom Group August 2023)(Citation: Huntress INC Ransomware May 2024)
b763d0c8b819206be25d940caa44685c8435b01d.zh: [INC Ransom](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1032) 已下载工具到被入侵的服务器，包括 Advanced IP Scanner。（来源：Huntress INC Ransom Group August 2023）（来源：Huntress INC Ransomware May 2024）

f594f616dfcbb4f1cbb4f646f25572165a32b9bf.source_text: [Earth Lusca](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1006) is a suspected China-based cyber espionage group that has been active since at least April 2019. [Earth Lusca](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1006) has targeted organizations in Australia, China, Hong Kong, Mongolia, Nepal, the Philippines, Taiwan, Thailand, Vietnam, the United Arab Emirates, Nigeria, Germany, France, and the United States. Targets included government institutions, news media outlets, gambling companies, educational institutions, COVID-19 research organizations, telecommunications companies, religious movements banned in China, and cryptocurrency trading platforms; security researchers assess some [Earth Lusca](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1006) operations may be financially motivated.(Citation: TrendMicro EarthLusca 2022) [Earth Lusca](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1006) has used malware commonly used by other Chinese threat groups, including [APT41](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0096) and the [Winnti Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0044) cluster, however security researchers assess [Earth Lusca](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1006)'s techniques and infrastructure are separate.(Citation: TrendMicro EarthLusca 2022)
f594f616dfcbb4f1cbb4f646f25572165a32b9bf.zh: [Earth Lusca](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1006) 是一个疑似基于中国的网络间谍组织，自至少2019年4月以来一直活跃。[Earth Lusca](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1006) 针对了澳大利亚、中国、香港、蒙古、尼泊尔、菲律宾、台湾、泰国、越南、阿拉伯联合酋长国、尼日利亚、德国、法国和美国的组织。目标包括政府机构、新闻媒体、赌博公司、教育机构、COVID-19研究机构、电信公司、在中国被取缔的宗教运动以及加密货币交易平台；安全研究人员评估 [Earth Lusca](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1006) 的一些操作可能是出于经济动机。(Citation: TrendMicro EarthLusca 2022) [Earth Lusca](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1006) 使用了其他中国威胁团体常用的恶意软件，包括 [APT41](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0096) 和 [Winnti Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0044) 集群，然而安全研究人员评估 [Earth Lusca](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1006) 的技术和基础设施是独立的。(Citation: TrendMicro EarthLusca 2022)

2ad86919a48f5ecdeb56e6d80a614825717091c2.source_text: [Earth Lusca](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1006) adopted Cloudflare as a proxy for compromised servers.(Citation: TrendMicro EarthLusca 2022)
2ad86919a48f5ecdeb56e6d80a614825717091c2.zh: [Earth Lusca](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1006) 采用 Cloudflare 作为被入侵服务器的代理。（来源：TrendMicro EarthLusca 2022）

398d8b70b592a521ee43f457f8a2de36d4dd4415.source_text: [FIN4](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0085) is a financially-motivated threat group that has targeted confidential information related to the public financial market, particularly regarding healthcare and pharmaceutical companies, since at least 2013.(Citation: FireEye Hacking FIN4 Dec 2014)(Citation: FireEye FIN4 Stealing Insider NOV 2014) [FIN4](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0085) is unique in that they do not infect victims with typical persistent malware, but rather they focus on capturing credentials authorized to access email and other non-public correspondence.(Citation: FireEye Hacking FIN4 Dec 2014)(Citation: FireEye Hacking FIN4 Video Dec 2014)
398d8b70b592a521ee43f457f8a2de36d4dd4415.zh: [FIN4](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0085)是一个以财务为动机的威胁组织，自2013年以来一直针对与公共金融市场相关的机密信息，特别是涉及医疗保健和制药公司的信息。（引用：FireEye Hacking FIN4 Dec 2014）（引用：FireEye FIN4 Stealing Insider NOV 2014）[FIN4](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0085)的独特之处在于，他们不会通过典型持久性恶意软件感染受害者，而是专注于捕获用于访问电子邮件和其他非公开通信的凭据。（引用：FireEye Hacking FIN4 Dec 2014）（引用：FireEye Hacking FIN4 Video Dec 2014）

6c025040255f917320d8d43ac2de516cefbb9250.source_text: [FIN4](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0085) has used [Tor](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0183) to log in to victims' email accounts.(Citation: FireEye Hacking FIN4 Dec 2014)
6c025040255f917320d8d43ac2de516cefbb9250.zh: [FIN4](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0085) 已使用 [Tor](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0183) 登录受害者的电子邮件账户。(Citation: FireEye Hacking FIN4 Dec 2014)

6607c6300051abee87c4e2e7d840be5f62aa7cca.source_text: [FIN4](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0085) has used HTTP POST requests to transmit data.(Citation: FireEye Hacking FIN4 Dec 2014)(Citation: FireEye Hacking FIN4 Video Dec 2014)
6607c6300051abee87c4e2e7d840be5f62aa7cca.zh: [FIN4](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0085) 已使用 HTTP POST 请求来传输数据。(Citation: FireEye Hacking FIN4 Dec 2014)(Citation: FireEye Hacking FIN4 Video Dec 2014)

fc85aae62dae2d6a5f40b774a8374f3ee01676e1.source_text: [Silence](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0091) is a financially motivated threat actor targeting financial institutions in different countries. The group was first seen in June 2016. Their main targets reside in Russia, Ukraine, Belarus, Azerbaijan, Poland and Kazakhstan. They compromised various banking systems, including the Russian Central Bank's Automated Workstation Client, ATMs, and card processing.(Citation: Cyber Forensicator Silence Jan 2019)(Citation: SecureList Silence Nov 2017)
fc85aae62dae2d6a5f40b774a8374f3ee01676e1.zh: [Silence](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0091) 是一个以经济利益为动机的威胁行为体，针对多个国家的金融机构。该组织首次出现在2016年6月。他们的主要目标位于俄罗斯、乌克兰、白俄罗斯、阿塞拜疆、波兰和哈萨克斯坦。他们攻陷了多种银行系统，包括俄罗斯中央银行的自动化工作站客户端、ATM（自动柜员机）以及卡片处理系统。（Citation: Cyber Forensicator Silence Jan 2019）（Citation: SecureList Silence Nov 2017）

19407bbc31d0147d660cc619e64375a357cd9232.source_text: [Silence](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0091) has used port 444 when sending data about the system from the client to the server.(Citation: Group IB Silence Sept 2018)
19407bbc31d0147d660cc619e64375a357cd9232.zh: [Silence](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0091) 在将系统数据从客户端发送到服务器时使用了端口 444。(引用：Group IB Silence Sept 2018)

5c4dcd5316b312b9c7ae53dd26d512f237a3aeb3.source_text: [Silence](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0091) has used ProxyBot, which allows the attacker to redirect traffic from the current node to the backconnect server via Sock4\Socks5.(Citation: Group IB Silence Sept 2018)
5c4dcd5316b312b9c7ae53dd26d512f237a3aeb3.zh: [Silence](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0091) 已使用 ProxyBot，该工具允许攻击者通过 Sock4/Socks5 将当前节点的流量重定向到回连服务器。（Citation: Group IB Silence Sept 2018）

4e3596c74849ac71c4d5a566386b33235b68ffc9.source_text: [Silence](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0091) has downloaded additional modules and malware to victim’s machines.(Citation: Group IB Silence Sept 2018)
4e3596c74849ac71c4d5a566386b33235b68ffc9.zh: [Silence](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0091) 已将额外的模块和恶意软件下载到受害者的计算机上。（来源：Group IB Silence 2018年9月）

c5ec031b4b5c20c0fe0f368e9287e23009dc1605.source_text: [Sowbug](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0054) is a threat group that has conducted targeted attacks against organizations in South America and Southeast Asia, particularly government entities, since at least 2015. (Citation: Symantec Sowbug Nov 2017)
c5ec031b4b5c20c0fe0f368e9287e23009dc1605.zh: [Sowbug](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0054) 是一个威胁组织，自2015年以来针对南美和东南亚地区的组织（尤其是政府机构）实施了定向攻击。（引用：Symantec Sowbug Nov 2017）

100582eca05cd609159250615ef15b8d9efb813d.source_text: [Threat Group-1314](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0028) is an unattributed threat group that has used compromised credentials to log into a victim's remote access infrastructure. (Citation: Dell TG-1314)
100582eca05cd609159250615ef15b8d9efb813d.zh: [威胁组织-1314](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0028) 是一个未归因的威胁组织，该组织曾使用被盗的凭据登录受害者的远程访问基础设施。（来源：Dell TG-1314）

830d179866eaeb33f3dd705379f4ede2c7f5b829.source_text: [Thrip](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0076) is an espionage group that has targeted satellite communications, telecoms, and defense contractor companies in the U.S. and Southeast Asia. The group uses custom malware as well as "living off the land" techniques. (Citation: Symantec Thrip June 2018)
830d179866eaeb33f3dd705379f4ede2c7f5b829.zh: [Thrip](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0076) 是一个情报间谍组织，针对美国及东南亚的卫星通信、电信公司和国防承包商进行了目标攻击。该组织使用定制恶意软件以及“就地取材”（living off the land）技术。（来源：Symantec Thrip June 2018）

018292986ed14c8575c53fc434620d5fc2e13ead.source_text: [Thrip](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0076) used a cloud-based remote access software called LogMeIn for their attacks.(Citation: Symantec Thrip June 2018)
018292986ed14c8575c53fc434620d5fc2e13ead.zh: [Thrip](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0076) 在其攻击活动中使用了一款名为 LogMeIn 的云远程访问软件。（出处：Symantec 2018年6月关于 Thrip 的报告）

c193e9ad7d1d143006449bd9af69138cc20199b9.source_text: [APT16](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0023) is a China-based threat group that has launched spearphishing campaigns targeting Japanese and Taiwanese organizations. (Citation: FireEye EPS Awakens Part 2)
c193e9ad7d1d143006449bd9af69138cc20199b9.zh: [APT16](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0023) 是一个基于中国的威胁组织，曾针对日本和台湾的组织发起鱼叉式网络钓鱼活动。（来源：FireEye EPS Awakens Part 2）

60b871da5df3cc4b076b82e4547c9990e83f49ce.source_text: [LAPSUS$](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1004) is cyber criminal threat group that has been active since at least mid-2021. [LAPSUS$](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1004) specializes in large-scale social engineering and extortion operations, including destructive attacks without the use of ransomware. The group has targeted organizations globally, including in the government, manufacturing, higher education, energy, healthcare, technology, telecommunications, and media sectors.(Citation: BBC LAPSUS Apr 2022)(Citation: MSTIC DEV-0537 Mar 2022)(Citation: UNIT 42 LAPSUS Mar 2022)
60b871da5df3cc4b076b82e4547c9990e83f49ce.zh: [LAPSUS$](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1004) 是一个网络犯罪威胁组织，自至少2021年中起活跃。[LAPSUS$](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1004) 专注于大规模的社会工程学和勒索行动，包括不使用勒索软件的破坏性攻击。该组织的目标涵盖全球的组织，涉及政府、制造业、高等教育、能源、医疗、科技、电信和媒体等行业。(引用：BBC LAPSUS Apr 2022)(引用：MSTIC DEV-0537 Mar 2022)(引用：UNIT 42 LAPSUS Mar 2022)

3781bbec76ac01f8b181dcd4de01b63cfd30cd7f.source_text: [LAPSUS$](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1004) has leverage NordVPN for its egress points when targeting intended victims.(Citation: MSTIC DEV-0537 Mar 2022)
3781bbec76ac01f8b181dcd4de01b63cfd30cd7f.zh: [LAPSUS$](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1004)在针对目标受害者时使用NordVPN作为其出口节点。(Citation: MSTIC DEV-0537 Mar 2022)

fafeddc86d07974fee92b6e512cd092f1c7efdb1.source_text: [BlackOasis](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0063) is a Middle Eastern threat group that is believed to be a customer of Gamma Group. The group has shown interest in prominent figures in the United Nations, as well as opposition bloggers, activists, regional news correspondents, and think tanks.
