(Citation: Securelist BlackOasis Oct 2017) (Citation: Securelist APT Trends Q2 2017) A group known by Microsoft as [NEODYMIUM](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0055) is reportedly associated closely with [BlackOasis](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0063) operations, but evidence that the group names are aliases has not been identified. (Citation: CyberScoop BlackOasis Oct 2017)
fafeddc86d07974fee92b6e512cd092f1c7efdb1.zh: [BlackOasis](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0063) 是一个中东威胁组织，被认为是 Gamma Group 的客户。该组织对联合国中的知名人物、反对派博客作者、活动人士、地区新闻记者和智库表现出兴趣。（出处：Securelist BlackOasis Oct 2017）（出处：Securelist APT Trends Q2 2017）微软称的 [NEODYMIUM](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0055) 据报道与 [BlackOasis](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0063) 的操作密切关联，但尚未发现两者名称为同义词的证据。（出处：CyberScoop BlackOasis Oct 2017）

66da936cf4298a6c87237cc92c7d7dcc31c9ddce.source_text: [UNC2452](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0118) is a suspected Russian state-sponsored threat group responsible for the 2020 SolarWinds software supply chain intrusion.(Citation: FireEye SUNBURST Backdoor December 2020) Victims of this campaign include government, consulting, technology, telecom, and other organizations in North America, Europe, Asia, and the Middle East.(Citation: FireEye SUNBURST Backdoor December 2020) The group also compromised at least one think tank by late 2019.(Citation: Volexity SolarWinds)
66da936cf4298a6c87237cc92c7d7dcc31c9ddce.zh: [UNC2452](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0118) 是一个被怀疑为俄罗斯国家支持的黑客组织，该组织对2020年SolarWinds软件供应链攻击负责。（引用：FireEye SUNBURST后门程序 2020年12月）遭受此次活动影响的受害者包括北美、欧洲、亚洲和中东的政府、咨询、技术、电信和其他组织。（引用：FireEye SUNBURST后门程序 2020年12月）到2019年底，该组织还入侵了至少一个智库。（引用：Volexity SolarWinds）

62467d14ee211be8eb242edd688711fe0761e354.source_text: [Cobalt Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0080) is a financially motivated threat group that has primarily targeted financial institutions since at least 2016. The group has conducted intrusions to steal money via targeting ATM systems, card processing, payment systems and SWIFT systems. [Cobalt Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0080) has mainly targeted banks in Eastern Europe, Central Asia, and Southeast Asia. One of the alleged leaders was arrested in Spain in early 2018, but the group still appears to be active. The group has been known to target organizations in order to use their access to then compromise additional victims.(Citation: Talos Cobalt Group July 2018)(Citation: PTSecurity Cobalt Group Aug 2017)(Citation: PTSecurity Cobalt Dec 2016)(Citation: Group IB Cobalt Aug 2017)(Citation: Proofpoint Cobalt June 2017)(Citation: RiskIQ Cobalt Nov 2017)(Citation: RiskIQ Cobalt Jan 2018) Reporting indicates there may be links between [Cobalt Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0080) and both the malware [Carbanak](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0030) and the group [Carbanak](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0008).(Citation: Europol Cobalt Mar 2018)
62467d14ee211be8eb242edd688711fe0761e354.zh: [Cobalt 组织](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0080)是一个以牟利为目的的威胁组织，自2016年以来主要针对金融机构。该组织实施入侵活动，通过针对自动取款机（ATM）系统、银行卡处理系统、支付系统及SWIFT系统进行攻击以窃取资金。[Cobalt 组织](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0080)主要瞄准东欧、中亚和东南亚地区的银行。其中一名被指认为领导成员的人于2018年初在西班牙被捕，但该组织似乎仍在活跃。已知该组织会利用已获取的组织访问权限，进而损害更多受害方。（来源：Talos Cobalt Group 2018年7月）（来源：PTSecurity Cobalt Group 2017年8月）（来源：PTSecurity Cobalt 2016年12月）（来源：Group IB Cobalt 2017年8月）（来源：Proofpoint Cobalt 2017年6月）（来源：RiskIQ Cobalt 2017年11月）（来源：RiskIQ Cobalt 2018年1月）报告显示，[Cobalt 组织](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0080)可能与恶意软件 [Carbanak](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0030) 以及 [Carbanak](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0008) 组织存在关联。（来源：Europol Cobalt 2018年3月）

3b861b6d2d98d905139e43797e220bc2442989b0.source_text: [Cobalt Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0080) has used public sites such as github.com and sendspace.com to upload files and then download them to victim computers.(Citation: PTSecurity Cobalt Group Aug 2017)(Citation: PTSecurity Cobalt Dec 2016) The group's JavaScript backdoor is also capable of downloading files.(Citation: Morphisec Cobalt Gang Oct 2018)
3b861b6d2d98d905139e43797e220bc2442989b0.zh: [Cobalt Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0080) 使用 github.com 和 sendspace.com 等公共网站上传文件，然后将这些文件下载到受感染计算机上。(Citation: PTSecurity Cobalt Group Aug 2017)(Citation: PTSecurity Cobalt Dec 2016) 该组织的 JavaScript 后门也能够下载文件。(Citation: Morphisec Cobalt Gang Oct 2018)

55b50e189ac173eb95bc2a650858aa11a589ad52.source_text: [Cobalt Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0080) has used DNS tunneling for C2.(Citation: Talos Cobalt Group July 2018)(Citation: PTSecurity Cobalt Dec 2016)(Citation: Group IB Cobalt Aug 2017)
55b50e189ac173eb95bc2a650858aa11a589ad52.zh: [Cobalt Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0080) 已使用 DNS 隧道技术进行命令与控制（C2）通信。(Citation: Talos Cobalt Group July 2018)(Citation: PTSecurity Cobalt Dec 2016)(Citation: Group IB Cobalt Aug 2017)

37fcaa4269850972237570fc1564cb1c43255bef.source_text: [Cobalt Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0080) has used HTTPS for C2.(Citation: Talos Cobalt Group July 2018)(Citation: PTSecurity Cobalt Dec 2016)(Citation: Group IB Cobalt Aug 2017)
37fcaa4269850972237570fc1564cb1c43255bef.zh: [Cobalt Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0080) 已使用 HTTPS 进行 C2 通信。(Citation: Talos Cobalt Group July 2018)(Citation: PTSecurity Cobalt Dec 2016)(Citation: Group IB Cobalt Aug 2017)

4132277b5bd5bf58a246af4c19509a8a6cf64694.source_text: [Cobalt Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0080) has used the Plink utility to create SSH tunnels.(Citation: Talos Cobalt Group July 2018)(Citation: PTSecurity Cobalt Dec 2016)(Citation: Group IB Cobalt Aug 2017)
4132277b5bd5bf58a246af4c19509a8a6cf64694.zh: [Cobalt 组织](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0080)曾使用 Plink 实用程序创建 SSH 隧道。(Citation: Talos Cobalt Group July 2018)(Citation: PTSecurity Cobalt Dec 2016)(Citation: Group IB Cobalt Aug 2017)

48b7f0a62cc58193f00434bc9a6e3115f6de6ca9.source_text: [Cobalt Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0080) has used the Plink utility to create SSH tunnels.(Citation: Group IB Cobalt Aug 2017)
48b7f0a62cc58193f00434bc9a6e3115f6de6ca9.zh: [Cobalt Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0080) 使用 Plink 实用程序创建 SSH 隧道。(Citation: Group IB Cobalt Aug 2017)

53520ed18142045495c3ce3cc5a614d6895b7466.source_text: [Cobalt Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0080) used the Ammyy Admin tool as well as TeamViewer for remote access, including to preserve remote access if a Cobalt Strike module was lost.(Citation: PTSecurity Cobalt Group Aug 2017)(Citation: PTSecurity Cobalt Dec 2016)(Citation: Group IB Cobalt Aug 2017)
53520ed18142045495c3ce3cc5a614d6895b7466.zh: [Cobalt 组](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0080)使用了 Ammyy Admin 工具以及 TeamViewer 进行远程访问，包括在 Cobalt Strike 模块丢失的情况下维持远程访问。(Citation: PTSecurity Cobalt Group Aug 2017)(Citation: PTSecurity Cobalt Dec 2016)(Citation: Group IB Cobalt Aug 2017)

f75762e9364da8102bf903af9d616fb87a228705.source_text: [CopyKittens](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0052) is an Iranian cyber espionage group that has been operating since at least 2013. It has targeted countries including Israel, Saudi Arabia, Turkey, the U.S., Jordan, and Germany. The group is responsible for the campaign known as Operation Wilted Tulip.(Citation: ClearSky CopyKittens March 2017)(Citation: ClearSky Wilted Tulip July 2017)(Citation: CopyKittens Nov 2015)
f75762e9364da8102bf903af9d616fb87a228705.zh: [CopyKittens](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0052) 是一个自至少2013年以来持续活动的伊朗网络间谍组织。该组织已对以色列、沙特阿拉伯、土耳其、美国、约旦和德国等国家实施了攻击。该组织负责开展了被称为“枯萎郁金香行动”（Operation Wilted Tulip）的行动。(Citation: ClearSky CopyKittens March 2017)(Citation: ClearSky Wilted Tulip July 2017)(Citation: CopyKittens Nov 2015)

6f018ad1c00fa1dfb9b7b6254101bf214fd5b516.source_text: [CopyKittens](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0052) has used the AirVPN service for operational activity.(Citation: Microsoft POLONIUM June 2022)
6f018ad1c00fa1dfb9b7b6254101bf214fd5b516.zh: [CopyKittens](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0052) 曾利用 AirVPN 服务开展操作活动。(Citation: Microsoft POLONIUM June 2022)

a4927f1eac77ded61fec4fc7b0bf7bd93ed4b385.source_text: [Wizard Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0102) is a Russia-based financially motivated threat group originally known for the creation and deployment of [TrickBot](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0266) since at least 2016. [Wizard Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0102) possesses a diverse arsenal of tools and has conducted ransomware campaigns against a variety of organizations, ranging from major corporations to hospitals.(Citation: CrowdStrike Ryuk January 2019)(Citation: DHS/CISA Ransomware Targeting Healthcare October 2020)(Citation: CrowdStrike Wizard Spider October 2020)
a4927f1eac77ded61fec4fc7b0bf7bd93ed4b385.zh: [Wizard Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0102) 是一个位于俄罗斯、以财务利益为动机的威胁组织，自2016年以来最初因创建和部署[TrickBot](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0266)而闻名。[Wizard Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0102) 拥有多样化的工具库，并对各类组织实施了勒索软件活动，涵盖大型公司到医疗机构等。(Citation: CrowdStrike Ryuk January 2019)(Citation: DHS/CISA Ransomware Targeting Healthcare October 2020)(Citation: CrowdStrike Wizard Spider October 2020)

cc8b6dfe9507924bca13b7fed130361392f03319.source_text: [Wizard Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0102) has used HTTP for network communications.(Citation: CrowdStrike Grim Spider May 2019)
cc8b6dfe9507924bca13b7fed130361392f03319.zh: [Wizard Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0102) 曾使用 HTTP 进行网络通信。（Citation: CrowdStrike Grim Spider May 2019）

17894d36e32fb2ebedd3b8402e5c7d8dd318e6e1.source_text: [Wizard Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0102) can transfer malicious payloads such as ransomware to compromised machines.(Citation: Mandiant FIN12 Oct 2021)
17894d36e32fb2ebedd3b8402e5c7d8dd318e6e1.zh: [Wizard Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0102) 可以将恶意有效载荷（如勒索软件）传输到已被攻陷的计算机。(Citation: Mandiant FIN12 Oct 2021)

50ebe27814194f0caf84649f9dda8d35476dbf12.source_text: [Molerats](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0021) is an Arabic-speaking, politically-motivated threat group that has been operating since 2012. The group's victims have primarily been in the Middle East, Europe, and the United States.(Citation: DustySky)(Citation: DustySky2)(Citation: Kaspersky MoleRATs April 2019)(Citation: Cybereason Molerats Dec 2020)
50ebe27814194f0caf84649f9dda8d35476dbf12.zh: [Molerats](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0021) 是一个以阿拉伯语为母语、具有政治动机的威胁组织，自 2012 年以来一直活跃。该组织的受害者主要集中在中东、欧洲和美国。(Citation: DustySky)(Citation: DustySky2)(Citation: Kaspersky MoleRATs April 2019)(Citation: Cybereason Molerats Dec 2020)

18db9110b4824df43c63d8a88e3d8ecc2e888651.source_text: [Molerats](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0021) used executables to download malicious files from different sources.(Citation: Kaspersky MoleRATs April 2019)(Citation: Unit42 Molerat Mar 2020)
18db9110b4824df43c63d8a88e3d8ecc2e888651.zh: [Molerats](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0021) 使用可执行文件从不同来源下载恶意文件。(Citation: Kaspersky MoleRATs April 2019)(Citation: Unit42 Molerat Mar 2020)

0c237d73c98ba6e0a16f046ebae3c34f673cb6a3.source_text: [Velvet Ant](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1047) is a threat actor operating since at least 2021. [Velvet Ant](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1047) is associated with complex persistence mechanisms, the targeting of network devices and appliances during operations, and the use of zero day exploits.(Citation: Sygnia VelvetAnt 2024A)(Citation: Sygnia VelvetAnt 2024B)
0c237d73c98ba6e0a16f046ebae3c34f673cb6a3.zh: [Velvet Ant](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1047) 是一个自2021年至少以来一直在活动的威胁行为者。[Velvet Ant](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1047) 与复杂的持久化机制、在操作中针对网络设备和网络设备以及利用零日漏洞有关。(Citation: Sygnia VelvetAnt 2024A)(Citation: Sygnia VelvetAnt 2024B)

b93d6d882be945c57fc990790bc0d965280c8e40.source_text: [Velvet Ant](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1047) has tunneled traffic from victims through an internal, compromised host to proxy communications to command and control nodes.(Citation: Sygnia VelvetAnt 2024A)
b93d6d882be945c57fc990790bc0d965280c8e40.zh: [Velvet Ant](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1047) 将通过内部受感染的主机对受害者进行流量隧道传输，以代理与命令和控制节点的通信。（Citation: Sygnia VelvetAnt 2024A）

5aee0faf44544bbd3921c0bf9c9902b78a0d1f0f.source_text: Adversaries may encode data to make the content of command and control traffic more difficult to detect. Command and control (C2) information can be encoded using a standard data encoding system. Use of data encoding may adhere to existing protocol specifications and includes use of ASCII, Unicode, Base64, MIME, or other binary-to-text and character encoding systems.(Citation: Wikipedia Binary-to-text Encoding) (Citation: Wikipedia Character Encoding) Some data encoding systems may also result in data compression, such as gzip.
5aee0faf44544bbd3921c0bf9c9902b78a0d1f0f.zh: 攻击者可能对数据进行编码，使命令与控制（C2）流量的内容更难以被检测。C2 信息可以使用标准的数据编码系统进行编码。数据编码的使用可能符合现有的协议规范，包括使用 ASCII、Unicode、Base64、MIME 或其他二进制到文本及字符编码系统。（来源：Wikipedia Binary-to-text Encoding）（来源：Wikipedia Character Encoding）某些数据编码系统也可能导致数据压缩，例如 gzip。

a159edeb36b49922e802abab973a6bcc9ac0966a.source_text: [Velvet Ant](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1047) sent commands to compromised F5 BIG-IP devices in an encoded format requiring a passkey before interpretation and execution.(Citation: Sygnia VelvetAnt 2024A)
a159edeb36b49922e802abab973a6bcc9ac0966a.zh: [Velvet Ant](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1047) 以编码格式向被入侵的 F5 BIG-IP 设备发送命令，在解释和执行前需要先提供密码。 (Citation: Sygnia VelvetAnt 2024A)

0599cae412602186b96478ade5076ee7d707348a.source_text: [Velvet Ant](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1047) has used random high number ports for [PlugX](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0013) listeners on victim devices.(Citation: Sygnia VelvetAnt 2024A)
0599cae412602186b96478ade5076ee7d707348a.zh: [Velvet Ant](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1047) 曾在受害者设备上使用随机高位端口运行 [PlugX](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0013) 监听器。（出处：Sygnia VelvetAnt 2024A）

bf3a5f1c0f390fb6dd310d09c91f919436f73d42.source_text: [Velvet Ant](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1047) has used a reverse SSH shell to securely communicate with victim devices.(Citation: Sygnia VelvetAnt 2024A)
bf3a5f1c0f390fb6dd310d09c91f919436f73d42.zh: [Velvet Ant](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1047) 曾使用反向 SSH shell 与受害设备安全地进行通信。(Citation: Sygnia VelvetAnt 2024A)

51927dea67934d21165ba3bc6ddcb7b5d7a78b9f.source_text: [Velvet Ant](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1047) has used reverse SSH tunnels to communicate to victim devices.(Citation: Sygnia VelvetAnt 2024A)
51927dea67934d21165ba3bc6ddcb7b5d7a78b9f.zh: [Velvet Ant](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1047) 已使用反向SSH隧道与受害者设备进行通信。(Citation: Sygnia VelvetAnt 2024A)

2192163db8f441cf246846e911aa8ee9c74dfec5.source_text: [Transparent Tribe](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0134) is a suspected Pakistan-based threat group that has been active since at least 2013, primarily targeting diplomatic, defense, and research organizations in India and Afghanistan.(Citation: Proofpoint Operation Transparent Tribe March 2016)(Citation: Kaspersky Transparent Tribe August 2020)(Citation: Talos Transparent Tribe May 2021)
2192163db8f441cf246846e911aa8ee9c74dfec5.zh: [Transparent Tribe](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0134) 是一个疑似位于巴基斯坦的威胁组织，自至少2013年以来一直活跃，主要针对印度和阿富汗的外交、国防和研究机构。(Citation: Proofpoint Operation Transparent Tribe March 2016)(Citation: Kaspersky Transparent Tribe August 2020)(Citation: Talos Transparent Tribe May 2021)

8184f623c1bccb91cd5a2283116205ebd237bd36.source_text: [Transparent Tribe](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0134) has used dynamic DNS services to set up C2.(Citation: Proofpoint Operation Transparent Tribe March 2016)
8184f623c1bccb91cd5a2283116205ebd237bd36.zh: [Transparent Tribe](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0134) 曾利用动态 DNS 服务来搭建命令与控制（C2）基础设施。（引用：Proofpoint Operation Transparent Tribe March 2016）

8fe56bda4f0afd854e152c078b51eaaf24d258af.source_text: [IndigoZebra](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0136) is a suspected Chinese cyber espionage group that has been targeting Central Asian governments since at least 2014.(Citation: HackerNews IndigoZebra July 2021)(Citation: Checkpoint IndigoZebra July 2021)(Citation: Securelist APT Trends Q2 2017)
8fe56bda4f0afd854e152c078b51eaaf24d258af.zh: [IndigoZebra](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0136) 是一个涉嫌来自中国的网络间谍组织，自 2014 年以来一直针对中亚各国政府。(Citation: HackerNews IndigoZebra July 2021)(Citation: Checkpoint IndigoZebra July 2021)(Citation: Securelist APT Trends Q2 2017)

0a366a651eeff4ac0c3c01a27b6b75f67b3daa3f.source_text: [IndigoZebra](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0136) has downloaded additional files and tools from its C2 server.(Citation: Checkpoint IndigoZebra July 2021)
0a366a651eeff4ac0c3c01a27b6b75f67b3daa3f.zh: [IndigoZebra](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0136) 已从其中控服务器下载了额外的文件和工具。(引用：Checkpoint IndigoZebra 2021年7月)

2409a56b81339267169b93bac2be2aeed1c5cca8.source_text: [Moonstone Sleet](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1036) is a North Korean-linked threat actor executing both financially motivated attacks and espionage operations. The group previously overlapped significantly with another North Korean-linked entity, [Lazarus Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0032), but has differentiated its tradecraft since 2023. [Moonstone Sleet](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1036) is notable for creating fake companies and personas to interact with victim entities, as well as developing unique malware such as a variant delivered via a fully functioning game.(Citation: Microsoft Moonstone Sleet 2024)
2409a56b81339267169b93bac2be2aeed1c5cca8.zh: [Moonstone Sleet](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1036) 是一个与朝鲜有关联的威胁行为者，执行以经济利益为动机的攻击以及间谍活动。该组织此前与另一个与朝鲜有关联的组织 [Lazarus Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0032) 高度重叠，但自2023年以来已分化出其独特的战术手法。[Moonstone Sleet](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1036) 的特点包括创建虚假公司和身份以与被攻击实体进行交互，以及开发独特的恶意软件，例如通过一个功能完整的游戏传播的变种。（引用：Microsoft Moonstone Sleet 2024）

9a5802dcd4798d661456ed84d25f4bd9384ac825.source_text: [Moonstone Sleet](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1036) used curl to connect to adversary-controlled infrastructure and retrieve additional payloads.(Citation: Microsoft Moonstone Sleet 2024)
9a5802dcd4798d661456ed84d25f4bd9384ac825.zh: [Moonstone Sleet](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1036) 使用 curl 连接到由攻击者控制的设施，以检索其他载荷。(引用：Microsoft Moonstone Sleet 2024)

ccf51c4fb897ba5937e75ff40b980236326ac21c.source_text: [Moonstone Sleet](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1036) retrieved a final stage payload from command and control infrastructure during initial installation on victim systems.(Citation: Microsoft Moonstone Sleet 2024)
ccf51c4fb897ba5937e75ff40b980236326ac21c.zh: [Moonstone Sleet](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1036) 在受害者系统初始安装期间从命令与控制（C2）基础设施检索了最终阶段的有效载荷。(Citation: Microsoft Moonstone Sleet 2024)

e851d4019472a2f1fd1a1475dfd8c8db4cb294a9.source_text: [Inception](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0100) is a cyber espionage group active since at least 2014. The group has targeted multiple industries and governmental entities primarily in Russia, but has also been active in the United States and throughout Europe, Asia, Africa, and the Middle East.(Citation: Unit 42 Inception November 2018)(Citation: Symantec Inception Framework March 2018)(Citation: Kaspersky Cloud Atlas December 2014)
e851d4019472a2f1fd1a1475dfd8c8db4cb294a9.zh: [Inception](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0100) 是一个自至少2014年以来活跃的网络间谍组织。该组织主要针对俄罗斯的多行业和政府实体，但也曾在美国、欧洲、亚洲、非洲和中东地区活动。(Citation: Unit 42 Inception November 2018)(Citation: Symantec Inception Framework March 2018)(Citation: Kaspersky Cloud Atlas December 2014)

edc9a67f9da4284a902b74a57a2885671447fa2f.source_text: [Inception](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0100) has incorporated at least five different cloud service providers into their C2 infrastructure including CloudMe.(Citation: Kaspersky Cloud Atlas December 2014)(Citation: Symantec Inception Framework March 2018)
edc9a67f9da4284a902b74a57a2885671447fa2f.zh: [Inception](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0100) 至少在其C2基础设施中纳入了五种不同的云服务提供商，包括CloudMe。（来源：卡巴斯基《云图谱》2014年12月）（来源：赛门铁克《Inception框架》2018年3月）

b6c7343b5c3159695efc4c5955fbdef8f4015308.source_text: [Inception](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0100) used chains of compromised routers to proxy C2 communications between them and cloud service providers.(Citation: Symantec Inception Framework March 2018)
b6c7343b5c3159695efc4c5955fbdef8f4015308.zh: [Inception](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0100) 使用一系列被入侵的路由器作为代理，在其中间与云服务提供商之间转发C2通信。(Citation: Symantec Inception Framework March 2018)

be1048cfb753f20eb84da29a6bcac1ecd60902b7.source_text: [Inception](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0100) has used HTTP, HTTPS, and WebDav in network communications.(Citation: Kaspersky Cloud Atlas December 2014)(Citation: Unit 42 Inception November 2018)
be1048cfb753f20eb84da29a6bcac1ecd60902b7.zh: [Inception](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0100) 曾在网络通信中使用 HTTP、HTTPS 和 WebDav。（引用：卡巴斯基云图谱 2014年12月）（引用：Unit 42 Inception 2018年11月）

ed966880d6f28c028f2fd54ffcec4ce8af79c9f4.source_text: [Inception](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0100) has encrypted network communications with AES.(Citation: Kaspersky Cloud Atlas December 2014)
ed966880d6f28c028f2fd54ffcec4ce8af79c9f4.zh: [Inception](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0100) 使用 AES 对网络通信进行加密。（来源：卡巴斯基云图谱 2014年12月）

a7be8b59c4f9db0fc8798b8ad8addf5323fa8088.source_text: [Honeybee](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0072) is a campaign led by an unknown actor that targets humanitarian aid organizations and has been active in Vietnam, Singapore, Argentina, Japan, Indonesia, and Canada. It has been an active operation since August of 2017 and as recently as February 2018. (Citation: McAfee Honeybee)
a7be8b59c4f9db0fc8798b8ad8addf5323fa8088.zh: [Honeybee](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0072) 是由一个未知行为者主导的针对人道主义援助组织的活动，已在越南、新加坡、阿根廷、日本、印度尼西亚和加拿大展开。该活动自2017年8月以来一直活跃，直至最近2018年2月仍可见其踪迹。（来源：McAfee Honeybee）

33a7d4b07b74282047ca8e6ab0af0fce5044b44c.source_text: [VOID MANTICORE](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1055) is a threat group assessed to operate on behalf of Iran’s Ministry of Intelligence and Security (MOIS).(Citation: Check Point VOID MANTICORE Handala Hack March 2026) Active since at least mid-2022, VOID MANTICORE has targeted government entities, critical infrastructure, and private sector organizations across Albania, Israel, and the United States.(Citation: Check Point VOID MANTICORE Handala Hack March 2026)(Citation: Palo Alto VOID MANTICORE Iran Cyber Threats March 2026) [VOID MANTICORE](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1055) conducts destructive cyber operations, combining wiper attacks with hack-and-leak campaigns. The group has operated under multiple public-facing personas, including [HomeLand Justice](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0038) in operations against Albania, Karma and Karma Below in campaigns targeting Israeli organizations, and Handala Hack, its current primary persona, which has claimed activity against Israeli and U.S. entities, including a March 2026 attack against Stryker Corporation.(Citation: Check Point VOID MANTICORE Handala Hack March 2026)(Citation: DOJ FBI Handala Hack March 2026) [VOID MANTICORE](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1055) has been observed collaborating with Scarred Manticore, which has been linked to initial access operations preceding VOID MANTICORE’s activity.(Citation: Domain Tools Handala Hack Karma Homeland Justice MOIS April 2026)
33a7d4b07b74282047ca8e6ab0af0fce5044b44c.zh: [VOID MANTICORE](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1055)是一个被评估为服务于伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队下属的伊斯兰革命卫队情报与安全部（MOIS）的情报组织。其自2022年中期以来活跃，针对阿尔巴尼亚、以色列和美国政府和关键基础设施以及私营部门组织实施了多起网络攻击活动。该组织通过破坏性网络行动将擦除软件攻击与黑客窃取并发布数据相结合。此外，他们还使用多个公开身份进行操作，包括对阿尔巴尼亚进行攻击时使用的 [HomeLand Justice](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0038)，以“Karma”和“Karma Below”作为主要针对以色列组织的身份，并且目前主要使用的身份是声称针对以色列和美国实体活动的Handala Hack（其中包括一起发生在2026年3月袭击Stryker公司的攻击）。在部分案例中，还发现其与Scarred Manticore有合作行为，后者可能与初始接入阶段相关，且这一关联已被证实发生在[Domain Tools Handala Hack Karma Homeland Justice MOIS April 2026]报告中所述的相关时间段内。

bf2262ba9ff71ad024037a5cd747cf90e5935797.source_text: [VOID MANTICORE](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1055) has utilized Telegram API for C2.(Citation: DOJ FBI Handala Hack March 2026)(Citation: FBI IC3 Flash VOID MANTICORE Handala Hack March 2026)
bf2262ba9ff71ad024037a5cd747cf90e5935797.zh: [VOID MANTICORE](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1055) 已利用 Telegram API 进行 C2。（引用：DOJ FBI Handala Hack March 2026）（引用：FBI IC3 Flash VOID MANTICORE Handala Hack March 2026）

95b3f0e303e895b7955b7519ff82c7b88b544f36.source_text: [VOID MANTICORE](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1055) has installed NetBird on victim devices to create a mesh network that facilitated control of several victim devices at once.(Citation: Check Point VOID MANTICORE Handala Hack March 2026)
95b3f0e303e895b7955b7519ff82c7b88b544f36.zh: [VOID MANTICORE](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1055) 在受害者设备上安装了 NetBird，以构建一个网状网络，从而能够同时控制多个受害者设备。（来源：Check Point VOID MANTICORE Handala Hack March 2026）

7255b58f856b43a4b5af1e80b61443b719d934bd.source_text: [VOID MANTICORE](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1055) has deployed additional payloads from dedicated C2 servers.(Citation: Check Point VOID MANTICORE Handala Hack March 2026)(Citation: DOJ FBI Handala Hack March 2026)(Citation: FBI IC3 Flash VOID MANTICORE Handala Hack March 2026) [VOID MANTICORE](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1055) has also downloaded legitimate tools and software from publicly available services.(Citation: Check Point VOID MANTICORE Handala Hack March 2026) [VOID MANTICORE](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1055) had utilized VeraCrypt a legitimate disk encrypting utility that was downloaded directly from the website.(Citation: Check Point VOID MANTICORE Handala Hack March 2026)
7255b58f856b43a4b5af1e80b61443b719d934bd.zh: [VOID MANTICORE](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1055) 已从专用的 C2 服务器部署额外的载荷。(Citation: Check Point VOID MANTICORE Handala Hack March 2026)(Citation: DOJ FBI Handala Hack March 2026)(Citation: FBI IC3 Flash VOID MANTICORE Handala Hack March 2026) [VOID MANTICORE](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1055) 还从公开可用的服务中下载了合法的工具和软件。(Citation: Check Point VOID MANTICORE Handala Hack March 2026) [VOID MANTICORE](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1055) 曾使用 VeraCrypt，这是一种直接从网站下载的合法磁盘加密工具。(Citation: Check Point VOID MANTICORE Handala Hack March 2026)

d39abeb4518f45672ffdb92c8721f7dffcd6440e.source_text: [VOID MANTICORE](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1055) has used tunneling tools to facilitate destructive attacks on compromised devices.(Citation: Check Point VOID MANTICORE Handala Hack March 2026)
d39abeb4518f45672ffdb92c8721f7dffcd6440e.zh: [VOID MANTICORE](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1055) 已使用隧道工具来促成对被入侵设备的破坏性攻击。(Citation: Check Point VOID MANTICORE Handala Hack March 2026)

8884ceb0926ff3b6a02cac982502856a46f7a98d.source_text: [VOID MANTICORE](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1055) has utilized HTTPS for communication to C2 domains.(Citation: FBI IC3 Flash VOID MANTICORE Handala Hack March 2026)
8884ceb0926ff3b6a02cac982502856a46f7a98d.zh: [VOID MANTICORE](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1055) 曾利用 HTTPS 与 C2 域名进行通信。（Citation: FBI IC3 Flash VOID MANTICORE Handala Hack March 2026）

205c53a55383d4383fa5509c1ae923c11277602b.source_text: [Play](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1040) is a ransomware group that has been active since at least 2022 deploying [Playcrypt](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1162) ransomware against the business, government, critical infrastructure, healthcare, and media sectors in North America, South America, and Europe. [Play](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1040) actors employ a double-extortion model, encrypting systems after exfiltrating data, and are presumed by security researchers to operate as a closed group.(Citation: CISA Play Ransomware Advisory December 2023)(Citation: Trend Micro Ransomware Spotlight Play July 2023)
205c53a55383d4383fa5509c1ae923c11277602b.zh: [Play](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1040)是一个自至少2022年以来活跃的黑客组织，针对北美、南美和欧洲的商业、政府、关键基础设施、医疗保健和媒体部门部署了[Playcrypt](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1162)勒索软件。[Play](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1040)的行动者采用双重勒索模式，在窃取数据后对系统进行加密，安全研究人员认为其作为一个封闭的团体运作。(Citation: CISA Play Ransomware Advisory December 2023)(Citation: Trend Micro Ransomware Spotlight Play July 2023)

1ef746cae3b22c5bd1dffb2e66288c1095f5c169.source_text: [Play](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1040) has used [Cobalt Strike](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0154) to download files to compromised machines.(Citation: Trend Micro Ransomware Spotlight Play July 2023)
1ef746cae3b22c5bd1dffb2e66288c1095f5c169.zh: [Play](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1040) 使用 [Cobalt Strike](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0154) 将文件下载到受感染的计算机中。(Citation: Trend Micro Ransomware Spotlight Play July 2023)

1ecbce9f09031f20c7dde7be274bb352a41fd533.source_text: [PROMETHIUM](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0056) is an activity group focused on espionage that has been active since at least 2012. The group has conducted operations globally with a heavy emphasis on Turkish targets. [PROMETHIUM](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0056) has demonstrated similarity to another activity group called [NEODYMIUM](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0055) due to overlapping victim and campaign characteristics.(Citation: Microsoft NEODYMIUM Dec 2016)(Citation: Microsoft SIR Vol 21)(Citation: Talos Promethium June 2020)
1ecbce9f09031f20c7dde7be274bb352a41fd533.zh: [PROMETHIUM](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0056) 是一个以间谍活动为焦点的活动组织，自2012年以来一直活跃。该组织在全球范围内开展行动，重点针对土耳其目标。[PROMETHIUM](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0056) 与另一个名为 [NEODYMIUM](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0055) 的活动组织表现出相似性，这源于它们在受害者和战役特征上的重叠。(引用：Microsoft NEODYMIUM Dec 2016)(引用：Microsoft SIR Vol 21)(引用：Talos Promethium June 2020)

d04dd5a76fa103d77e10532eb32238e7d9e60532.source_text: [PROMETHIUM](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0056) has used a script that configures the knockd service and firewall to only accept C2 connections from systems that use a specified sequence of knock ports.(Citation: Bitdefender StrongPity June 2020)
d04dd5a76fa103d77e10532eb32238e7d9e60532.zh: [PROMETHIUM](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0056) 使用了一个脚本，该脚本配置 knockd 服务和防火墙，仅允许来自使用特定序列敲门端口的系统的 C2 连接。（引用：Bitdefender StrongPity June 2020）

62cde30c6629dade717fa6cbf73ee79efd54b2bd.source_text: [APT30](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0013) is a threat group suspected to be associated with the Chinese government. While [Naikon](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0019) shares some characteristics with [APT30](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0013), the two groups do not appear to be exact matches.(Citation: FireEye APT30)(Citation: Baumgartner Golovkin Naikon 2015)
62cde30c6629dade717fa6cbf73ee79efd54b2bd.zh: [APT30](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0013) 是一个被认为与中国政府有关联的攻击组织。虽然 [Naikon](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0019) 与 [APT30](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0013) 有一些相似之处，但这两个组织似乎并不完全相同。(Citation: FireEye APT30)(Citation: Baumgartner Golovkin Naikon 2015)

7072a4921e1de912ba75b6163ba18f0651a010ca.source_text: [HEXANE](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1001) is a cyber espionage threat group that has targeted oil & gas, telecommunications, aviation, and internet service provider organizations since at least 2017. Targeted companies have been located in the Middle East and Africa, including Israel, Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Morocco, and Tunisia. [HEXANE](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1001)'s TTPs appear similar to [APT33](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0064) and [OilRig](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0049) but due to differences in victims and tools it is tracked as a separate entity.(Citation: Dragos Hexane)(Citation: Kaspersky Lyceum October 2021)(Citation: ClearSky Siamesekitten August 2021)(Citation: Accenture Lyceum Targets November 2021)
7072a4921e1de912ba75b6163ba18f0651a010ca.zh: [HEXANE](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1001) 是一个自至少2017年以来针对石油和天然气、电信、航空及互联网服务提供商组织的网络间谍威胁组织。目标企业位于中东和非洲地区，包括以色列、沙特阿拉伯、科威特、摩洛哥和突尼斯。[HEXANE](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1001) 的战术、技术和程序（TTPs）看起来与 [APT33](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0064) 和 [OilRig](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0049) 类似，但由于受害者对象和所使用的工具存在差异，它被作为独立实体进行跟踪。(Citation: Dragos Hexane)(Citation: Kaspersky Lyceum October 2021)(Citation: ClearSky Siamesekitten August 2021)(Citation: Accenture Lyceum Targets November 2021)

63da30c3c2489ba1e2f47862b7f65523f753dbcd.source_text: [HEXANE](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1001) has used cloud services, including OneDrive, for C2.(Citation: Microsoft POLONIUM June 2022)
63da30c3c2489ba1e2f47862b7f65523f753dbcd.zh: [HEXANE](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1001) 曾使用包括 OneDrive 在内的云服务进行 C2。（引用：Microsoft POLONIUM 2022年6月）

40ea8fd9b5a676b54cb7deec7f0630fef993f718.source_text: [HEXANE](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1001) has downloaded additional payloads and malicious scripts onto a compromised host.(Citation: Kaspersky Lyceum October 2021)
40ea8fd9b5a676b54cb7deec7f0630fef993f718.zh: [HEXANE](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1001) 已将其他有效载荷和恶意脚本下载到已受感染的宿主机上。(Citation: Kaspersky Lyceum October 2021)

e269dbfac6538a3854193e5a741916c187dc4cb5.source_text: [DragonOK](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0017) is a threat group that has targeted Japanese organizations with phishing emails. Due to overlapping TTPs, including similar custom tools, [DragonOK](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0017) is thought to have a direct or indirect relationship with the threat group [Moafee](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0002). (Citation: Operation Quantum Entanglement) It is known to use a variety of malware, including Sysget/HelloBridge, PlugX, PoisonIvy, FormerFirstRat, NFlog, and NewCT. (Citation: New DragonOK)
e269dbfac6538a3854193e5a741916c187dc4cb5.zh: [DragonOK](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0017) 是一个针对日本组织进行钓鱼邮件攻击的攻击者。由于拥有重叠的攻击战术、技术和过程（TTPs），包括使用类似的定制工具，被认为与 [Moafee](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0002) 威胁组织存在直接或间接关系。（参考：Operation Quantum Entanglement）已知该组织使用了多种恶意软件，包括 Sysget/HelloBridge、PlugX、PoisonIvy、FormerFirstRat、NFlog 和 NewCT。（参考：New DragonOK）

3e45457bb1c7c926cdec343b2046a5304546a9e8.source_text: [Daggerfly](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1034) is a People's Republic of China-linked APT entity active since at least 2012. [Daggerfly](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1034) has targeted individuals, government and NGO entities, and telecommunication companies in Asia and Africa. [Daggerfly](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1034) is associated with exclusive use of [MgBot](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1146) malware and is noted for several potential supply chain infection campaigns.(Citation: Symantec Daggerfly 2023)(Citation: ESET EvasivePanda 2023)(Citation: Symantec Daggerfly 2024)(Citation: ESET EvasivePanda 2024)
3e45457bb1c7c926cdec343b2046a5304546a9e8.zh: [Daggerfly](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1034) 是一个至少自2012年以来活跃、与中华人民共和国有关联的APT实体。[Daggerfly](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1034) 针对亚洲和非洲的个人、政府和非政府组织实体以及电信公司发动攻击。[Daggerfly](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1034) 被关联到专一使用 [MgBot](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1146) 恶意软件，并因其多项潜在的供应链感染活动而受到关注。(Citation: Symantec Daggerfly 2023)(Citation: ESET EvasivePanda 2023)(Citation: Symantec Daggerfly 2024)(Citation: ESET EvasivePanda 2024)

7895ad0d8673c9e3150e0577e00c2eed88f32efb.source_text: [Daggerfly](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1034) uses HTTP for command and control communication.(Citation: ESET EvasivePanda 2024)
7895ad0d8673c9e3150e0577e00c2eed88f32efb.zh: [Daggerfly](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1034) 使用 HTTP 进行命令和控制通信。（出处：ESET EvasivePanda 2024）

f032369de376a59f9dfe7e357c98f03acd08c2a3.source_text: [Daggerfly](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1034) has used PowerShell and [BITSAdmin](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0190) to retrieve follow-on payloads from external locations for execution on victim machines.(Citation: Symantec Daggerfly 2023)
f032369de376a59f9dfe7e357c98f03acd08c2a3.zh: [Daggerfly](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1034) 曾使用 PowerShell 和 [BITSAdmin](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0190) 从外部位置检索后续有效载荷，以便在受害计算机上执行。（引用：Symantec Daggerfly 2023）

d10295023a9cb8586b3203f14abe9a89d468613c.source_text: [Rancor](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0075) is a threat group that has led targeted campaigns against the South East Asia region. [Rancor](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0075) uses politically-motivated lures to entice victims to open malicious documents. (Citation: Rancor Unit42 June 2018)
d10295023a9cb8586b3203f14abe9a89d468613c.zh: [Rancor](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0075) 是一个针对东南亚地区开展定向活动的威胁组织。[Rancor](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0075) 利用政治动机的诱饵，诱导受害者打开恶意文档。（来源：Rancor Unit42 2018年6月）

ed94462e7c4bbbe6719403dfd7299a8a032c6346.source_text: [Rancor](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0075) has used HTTP for C2.(Citation: Rancor Unit42 June 2018)
ed94462e7c4bbbe6719403dfd7299a8a032c6346.zh: [Rancor](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0075) 曾使用 HTTP 进行 C2。(Citation: Rancor Unit42 June 2018)

1072062e5e82acada6ed92410e926c35c9466035.source_text: [Rancor](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0075) has downloaded additional malware, including by using [certutil](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0160).(Citation: Rancor Unit42 June 2018)
1072062e5e82acada6ed92410e926c35c9466035.zh: [Rancor](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0075) 已下载其他恶意软件，包括通过 [certutil](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0160)。（来源：Rancor Unit42 2018年6月）

96d93a057d1609b7ef902e760a3e4af156ee8166.source_text: [WIRTE](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0090) is a cyberespionage actor, believed to be a subgroup of the Hamas-affiliated Gaza Cybergang, that has been active since at least August 2018. [WIRTE](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0090) has targeted diplomatic, financial, military, legal, and technology organizations across the Middle East, North Africa, and in Europe to gather intelligence. [WIRTE](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0090) has remained persistently active despite the ongoing Israel-Hamas conflict and has expanded their operations to include wiper malware attacks against Israeli targets.(Citation: Lab52 WIRTE Apr 2019)(Citation: Kaspersky WIRTE November 2021)(Citation: Check Point Wirte NOV 2024)(Citation: Palo Alto Ashen Lepus DEC 2025)
96d93a057d1609b7ef902e760a3e4af156ee8166.zh: [WIRTE](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0090) 是一个网络间谍组织，被认为是与哈马斯有关联的加沙网络犯罪团伙的一个子群，自至少2018年8月起一直活跃。[WIRTE](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0090) 针对中东、北非和欧洲地区的外交、金融、军事、法律和科技组织进行情报收集。(Citation: Lab52 WIRTE Apr 2019)(Citation: Kaspersky WIRTE November 2021)(Citation: Check Point Wirte NOV 2024)(Citation: Palo Alto Ashen Lepus DEC 2025)

b1e47665d114e3bb82b7350000c8f1c8b6e3c136.source_text: [WIRTE](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0090) has used HTTPS over ports 2083 and 2087 for C2.(Citation: Kaspersky WIRTE November 2021)
b1e47665d114e3bb82b7350000c8f1c8b6e3c136.zh: [WIRTE](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0090) 已使用端口 2083 和 2087 上的 HTTPS 进行 C2。（引用：Kaspersky WIRTE November 2021）

2eb8f37c99ab1bf0aac8eb69ae02697850e204ab.source_text: [WIRTE](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0090) has used HTTP for network communication.(Citation: Lab52 WIRTE Apr 2019)
2eb8f37c99ab1bf0aac8eb69ae02697850e204ab.zh: [WIRTE](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0090) 已使用 HTTP 进行网络通信。（来源：Lab52 WIRTE，2019年4月）

2eb0f51b5ae67b52bc0a80922b3d85c2d901923f.source_text: [WIRTE](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0090) has downloaded PowerShell code from the C2 server to be executed.(Citation: Lab52 WIRTE Apr 2019)
2eb0f51b5ae67b52bc0a80922b3d85c2d901923f.zh: [WIRTE](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0090) 已从 C2 服务器下载 PowerShell 代码以便执行。(Citation: Lab52 WIRTE Apr 2019)

2f3fc75611b9a4ab844ac7060ccb6b861b874118.source_text: [PLATINUM](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0068) is an activity group that has targeted victims since at least 2009. The group has focused on targets associated with governments and related organizations in South and Southeast Asia. (Citation: Microsoft PLATINUM April 2016)
2f3fc75611b9a4ab844ac7060ccb6b861b874118.zh: [PLATINUM](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0068)是一个自至少2009年起针对受害者的活动组织。该组织重点针对南亚和东南亚与政府及相关组织有关联的目标。（引用：Microsoft PLATINUM 2016年4月）

b23ec7b06bbbfa7fbf66bbffc5c4c34c0397849b.source_text: [PLATINUM](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0068) has transferred files using the Intel® Active Management Technology (AMT) Serial-over-LAN (SOL) channel.(Citation: Microsoft PLATINUM June 2017)
b23ec7b06bbbfa7fbf66bbffc5c4c34c0397849b.zh: [PLATINUM](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0068) 通过 Intel® Active Management Technology (AMT) 的串行局域网（SOL）通道传输了文件。（引用：Microsoft PLATINUM June 2017）

7729cca5ad10c7f80238afa529087ec60b41bbaa.source_text: [PLATINUM](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0068) has used the Intel® Active Management Technology (AMT) Serial-over-LAN (SOL) channel for command and control.(Citation: Microsoft PLATINUM June 2017)
7729cca5ad10c7f80238afa529087ec60b41bbaa.zh: [PLATINUM](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0068) 曾使用 Intel® Active Management Technology (AMT) 串行过局域网（SOL）通道进行命令与控制。（引用：Microsoft PLATINUM 2017年6月）

ca8b367b0f30cfedc2d9ad9de2a59cf4aeb00f5a.source_text: [Magic Hound](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0059) is an Iranian-sponsored threat group that conducts long term, resource-intensive cyber espionage operations, likely on behalf of the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps. They have targeted European, U.S., and Middle Eastern government and military personnel, academics, journalists, and organizations such as the World Health Organization (WHO), via complex social engineering campaigns since at least 2014.(Citation: FireEye APT35 2018)(Citation: ClearSky Kittens Back 3 August 2020)(Citation: Certfa Charming Kitten January 2021)(Citation: Secureworks COBALT ILLUSION Threat Profile)(Citation: Proofpoint TA453 July2021)
ca8b367b0f30cfedc2d9ad9de2a59cf4aeb00f5a.zh: [魔法猎犬](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0059) 是一个伊朗赞助的威胁组织，开展长期、资源密集型的网络间谍活动，可能代表伊斯兰革命卫队。自2014年以来，他们通过复杂的社交工程活动针对欧洲、美国和东欧政府及军方人员、学术界人士、记者以及世界卫生组织（WHO）等组织。

11b7fd9c730e9ab0361961d3b92c7e0a3a0c4b71.source_text: [Magic Hound](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0059) has used Plink to tunnel RDP over SSH.(Citation: DFIR Phosphorus November 2021)
11b7fd9c730e9ab0361961d3b92c7e0a3a0c4b71.zh: [Magic Hound](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0059) 已使用 Plink 通过 SSH 隧道传输 RDP。（来源：DFIR Phosphorus 2021年11月）

d67bb7286cf51e66045420a342b35203efd76ee3.source_text: [Magic Hound](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0059) malware has used IRC for C2.(Citation: Unit 42 Magic Hound Feb 2017)(Citation: DFIR Phosphorus November 2021)
d67bb7286cf51e66045420a342b35203efd76ee3.zh: [Magic Hound](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0059) 恶意软件使用 IRC 进行命令与控制（C2）。（引用：Unit 42 Magic Hound，2017年2月）（引用：DFIR Phosphorus，2021年11月）

33e9c25fc1025a8cc4a82987dd5ea82f965e7f48.source_text: [Magic Hound](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0059) has used HTTP for C2.(Citation: Unit 42 Magic Hound Feb 2017)(Citation: DFIR Report APT35 ProxyShell March 2022)(Citation: DFIR Phosphorus November 2021)
33e9c25fc1025a8cc4a82987dd5ea82f965e7f48.zh: [Magic Hound](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0059) 已使用 HTTP 进行命令与控制（C2）通信。(Citation: Unit 42 Magic Hound Feb 2017)(Citation: DFIR Report APT35 ProxyShell March 2022)(Citation: DFIR Phosphorus November 2021)

582c87abe9f049f5828b57d45fca730cdd5073c5.source_text: [Magic Hound](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0059) has downloaded additional code and files from servers onto victims.(Citation: Unit 42 Magic Hound Feb 2017)(Citation: DFIR Report APT35 ProxyShell March 2022)(Citation: DFIR Phosphorus November 2021)(Citation: Microsoft Iranian Threat Actor Trends November 2021)
582c87abe9f049f5828b57d45fca730cdd5073c5.zh: [Magic Hound](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0059) 已从服务器下载额外的代码和文件到受害者机器上。(Citation: Unit 42 Magic Hound Feb 2017)(Citation: DFIR Report APT35 ProxyShell March 2022)(Citation: DFIR Phosphorus November 2021)(Citation: Microsoft Iranian Threat Actor Trends November 2021)

0ba6e029f56acecfed6e61cc9b13772b6742647a.source_text: [Magic Hound](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0059) has used an encrypted http proxy in C2 communications.(Citation: DFIR Phosphorus November 2021)
0ba6e029f56acecfed6e61cc9b13772b6742647a.zh: [Magic Hound](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0059) 在C2通信中使用了加密的HTTP代理。（出处：DFIR Phosphorus 2021年11月）

1ce5711a16e6dcb368783f299d1a8b85b2f8bd9d.source_text: [Magic Hound](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0059) malware can use a SOAP Web service to communicate with its C2 server.(Citation: Unit 42 Magic Hound Feb 2017)
1ce5711a16e6dcb368783f299d1a8b85b2f8bd9d.zh: [Magic Hound](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0059) 恶意软件可以使用 SOAP Web 服务与 C2 服务器进行通信。（引用：Unit 42 Magic Hound 2017 年 2 月）

f202ca90562df3880d237128b732c62ed55d942a.source_text: [Magic Hound](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0059) malware has communicated with its C2 server over TCP ports 4443 and 10151 using HTTP.(Citation: Unit 42 Magic Hound Feb 2017)(Citation: DFIR Phosphorus November 2021)
f202ca90562df3880d237128b732c62ed55d942a.zh: [Magic Hound](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0059) 恶意软件已通过 TCP 端口 4443 和 10151 使用 HTTP 与其 C2 服务器进行通信。(Citation: Unit 42 Magic Hound Feb 2017)(Citation: DFIR Phosphorus November 2021)

2eac89d0036ba453c3a83f865ca9974fb614c88e.source_text: [Magic Hound](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0059) has used Fast Reverse Proxy (FRP) for RDP traffic.(Citation: DFIR Phosphorus November 2021)
2eac89d0036ba453c3a83f865ca9974fb614c88e.zh: [Magic Hound](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0059) 使用 Fast Reverse Proxy (FRP) 进行 RDP 流量传输。(Citation: DFIR Phosphorus November 2021)

49698f0273ecc4ed11028c8d618a27422fb302be.source_text: [Ajax Security Team](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0130) is a group that has been active since at least 2010 and believed to be operating out of Iran. By 2014 [Ajax Security Team](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0130) transitioned from website defacement operations to malware-based cyber espionage campaigns targeting the US defense industrial base and Iranian users of anti-censorship technologies.(Citation: FireEye Operation Saffron Rose 2013)
49698f0273ecc4ed11028c8d618a27422fb302be.zh: [Ajax Security Team](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0130) 是一个自至少 2010 年以来活跃的组织，被认为在伊朗运营。到 2014 年，[Ajax Security Team](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0130) 从网站篡改行动转向针对美国国防工业基础以及使用反审查技术用户的基于恶意软件的网络间谍活动。(Citation: FireEye Operation Saffron Rose 2013)

3cda28c388b97eabc987e6eab5a035f60a2a3264.source_text: [Ajax Security Team](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0130) has used Wrapper/Gholee, custom-developed malware, which downloaded additional malware to the infected system.(Citation: Check Point Rocket Kitten)
3cda28c388b97eabc987e6eab5a035f60a2a3264.zh: [Ajax Security Team](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0130) 使用过 Wrapper/Gholee，这是一种自定义开发的恶意软件，用于向受感染系统下载其他恶意软件。（来源：Check Point Rocket Kitten）

40411b812d3c10be573c583c084925a56d98480b.source_text: [Threat Group-3390](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0027) is a Chinese threat group that has extensively used strategic Web compromises to target victims.(Citation: Dell TG-3390) The group has been active since at least 2010 and has targeted organizations in the aerospace, government, defense, technology, energy, manufacturing and gambling/betting sectors.(Citation: SecureWorks BRONZE UNION June 2017)(Citation: Securelist LuckyMouse June 2018)(Citation: Trend Micro DRBControl February 2020)
40411b812d3c10be573c583c084925a56d98480b.zh: [威胁组织-3390](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0027)是一个中国威胁组织，已广泛使用战略性网络入侵手段针对受害者。(Citation: Dell TG-3390) 该组织自至少2010年以来一直活跃，并针对航空航天、政府、国防、科技、能源、制造以及博彩/下注行业的组织。(Citation: SecureWorks BRONZE UNION June 2017)(Citation: Securelist LuckyMouse June 2018)(Citation: Trend Micro DRBControl February 2020)

66b0d0e8274b620f6a243a6f72bb3af196559dc2.source_text: [Threat Group-3390](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0027) has downloaded additional malware and tools, including through the use of `certutil`, onto a compromised host .(Citation: Dell TG-3390)(Citation: Trend Micro DRBControl February 2020)
66b0d0e8274b620f6a243a6f72bb3af196559dc2.zh: [威胁组织-3390](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0027) 已通过使用 `certutil` 等方式在受攻击主机上下载了其他恶意软件和工具。(Citation: Dell TG-3390)(Citation: Trend Micro DRBControl February 2020)

f6728678731f37cd4e085b07f2d04ad3a3349355.source_text: [Threat Group-3390](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0027) malware has used HTTP for C2.(Citation: Securelist LuckyMouse June 2018)
f6728678731f37cd4e085b07f2d04ad3a3349355.zh: [威胁团体-3390](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0027) 的恶意软件已使用 HTTP 进行命令与控制通信。(引用: Securelist LuckyMouse June 2018)

3d055e73deae5e19e9fe100176801d3aa9a87157.source_text: [APT33](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0064) is a suspected Iranian threat group that has carried out operations since at least 2013. The group has targeted organizations across multiple industries in the United States, Saudi Arabia, and South Korea, with a particular interest in the aviation and energy sectors.(Citation: FireEye APT33 Sept 2017)(Citation: FireEye APT33 Webinar Sept 2017)
3d055e73deae5e19e9fe100176801d3aa9a87157.zh: [APT33](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0064) 是一个涉嫌来自伊朗的威胁组织，自至少 2013 年以来一直开展行动。该组织针对美国、沙特阿拉伯和韩国的多个行业的组织，尤其对航空和能源领域感兴趣。(Citation: FireEye APT33 Sept 2017)(Citation: FireEye APT33 Webinar Sept 2017)

8458a5f6137d168e8b39ac0448f0d6a7d2cb6d79.source_text: [APT33](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0064) has downloaded additional files and programs from its C2 server.(Citation: Symantec Elfin Mar 2019)(Citation: Microsoft Holmium June 2020)
8458a5f6137d168e8b39ac0448f0d6a7d2cb6d79.zh: [APT33](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0064) 已从其中控服务器下载了其他文件和程序。(Citation: Symantec Elfin Mar 2019)(Citation: Microsoft Holmium June 2020)

0c84432c826ea55c09b92653794a15b014cc7153.source_text: [APT33](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0064) has used HTTP for command and control.(Citation: Symantec Elfin Mar 2019)
0c84432c826ea55c09b92653794a15b014cc7153.zh: [APT33](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0064) 已使用 HTTP 进行命令与控制。(引用: Symantec Elfin Mar 2019)

b2e416ac1b288285791f231de68435c0c0baceba.source_text: [APT33](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0064) has used AES for encryption of command and control traffic.(Citation: FireEye APT33 Guardrail)
b2e416ac1b288285791f231de68435c0c0baceba.zh: [APT33](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0064) 曾使用 AES 对命令和控制流量进行加密。（引用：FireEye APT33 Guardrail）

1f2905d54846644016072c2845a47bb20df2e2bb.source_text: [APT33](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0064) has used base64 to encode command and control traffic.(Citation: FireEye APT33 Guardrail)
1f2905d54846644016072c2845a47bb20df2e2bb.zh: [APT33](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0064) 使用 Base64 对命令和控制流量进行编码。(Citation: FireEye APT33 Guardrail)

eb00f1924f9bdc054bd4657dcb24b5147e80cf0d.source_text: [APT33](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0064) has used HTTP over TCP ports 808 and 880 for command and control.(Citation: Symantec Elfin Mar 2019)
eb00f1924f9bdc054bd4657dcb24b5147e80cf0d.zh: [APT33](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0064) 已使用 TCP 端口 808 和 880 上的 HTTP 进行命令与控制。(Citation: Symantec Elfin Mar 2019)

57c0b52bca2b9aa8e07282606ae6bd6a0cf9fb9c.source_text: [FIN10](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0051) is a financially motivated threat group that has targeted organizations in North America since at least 2013 through 2016. The group uses stolen data exfiltrated from victims to extort organizations. (Citation: FireEye FIN10 June 2017)
57c0b52bca2b9aa8e07282606ae6bd6a0cf9fb9c.zh: [FIN10](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0051) 是一个以牟利为目的的威胁组织，自至少2013年至2016年期间，一直针对北美的组织进行攻击。该组织利用从受害者处窃取并外泄的数据对组织进行勒索。（来源：FireEye FIN10 June 2017）

f5599eb4b1f49ed6bf9b43751714e11bf9ae744e.source_text: [FIN8](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0061) is a financially motivated threat group that has been active since at least January 2016, and known for targeting organizations in the hospitality, retail, entertainment, insurance, technology, chemical, and financial sectors. In June 2021, security researchers detected [FIN8](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0061) switching from targeting point-of-sale (POS) devices to distributing a number of ransomware variants.(Citation: FireEye Obfuscation June 2017)(Citation: FireEye Fin8 May 2016)(Citation: Bitdefender Sardonic Aug 2021)(Citation: Symantec FIN8 Jul 2023)
f5599eb4b1f49ed6bf9b43751714e11bf9ae744e.zh: [FIN8](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0061) 是一个至少自2016年1月以来活跃的经济动机威胁组织，以针对酒店、零售、娱乐、保险、技术、化学和金融领域的组织而闻名。2021年6月，安全研究人员发现[FIN8](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0061)从针对销售点(POS)设备转向分发多种勒索软件变体。(Citation: FireEye Obfuscation June 2017)(Citation: FireEye Fin8 May 2016)(Citation: Bitdefender Sardonic Aug 2021)(Citation: Symantec FIN8 Jul 2023)

8f37047e56f9c91f63122b6721dc46d687742eb1.source_text: [FIN8](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0061) has used sslip.io, a free IP to domain mapping service that also makes SSL certificate generation easier for traffic encryption, as part of their command and control.(Citation: Bitdefender FIN8 July 2021)
8f37047e56f9c91f63122b6721dc46d687742eb1.zh: [FIN8](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0061) 使用了 `sslip.io`，这是一个免费的 IP 到域名映射服务，同时也简化了流量加密的 SSL 证书生成过程，将其作为其命令与控制（C2）的一部分。（出处：Bitdefender FIN8 2021年7月）

a6a5369f25bbbb4a14de2d3357c7db63f4446ec9.source_text: [FIN8](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0061) has used HTTPS for command and control.(Citation: Bitdefender FIN8 July 2021)
a6a5369f25bbbb4a14de2d3357c7db63f4446ec9.zh: [FIN8](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0061) 已使用 HTTPS 进行命令与控制。(Citation: Bitdefender FIN8 July 2021)

817b9439e08563bc24f89fb5944dba9856059da1.source_text: [FIN8](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0061) has used remote code execution to download subsequent payloads.(Citation: FireEye Fin8 May 2016)(Citation: Bitdefender FIN8 July 2021)
817b9439e08563bc24f89fb5944dba9856059da1.zh: [FIN8](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0061) 已利用远程代码执行下载后续的有效载荷。(Citation: FireEye Fin8 May 2016)(Citation: Bitdefender FIN8 July 2021)

2350793e51c633dab86678bd95e5727e492aaf5c.source_text: [FIN8](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0061) has used the Plink utility to tunnel RDP back to C2 infrastructure.(Citation: FireEye Know Your Enemy FIN8 Aug 2016)
2350793e51c633dab86678bd95e5727e492aaf5c.zh: [FIN8](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0061) 已使用 Plink 实用程序将 RDP 隧道传输至 C2 基础设施。（引用：FireEye Know Your Enemy FIN8 Aug 2016）

7b5f0ae01ead2f0ea8cf7d0441a870c92f278190.source_text: [FIN13](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1016) is a financially motivated cyber threat group that has targeted the financial, retail, and hospitality industries in Mexico and Latin America, as early as 2016. [FIN13](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1016) achieves its objectives by stealing intellectual property, financial data, mergers and acquisition information, or PII.(Citation: Mandiant FIN13 Aug 2022)(Citation: Sygnia Elephant Beetle Jan 2022)
7b5f0ae01ead2f0ea8cf7d0441a870c92f278190.zh: [FIN13](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1016)是一个以经济利益为动机的网络威胁组织，最早于2016年就针对墨西哥和拉丁美洲的金融、零售和 Hospitality 行业进行了攻击。[FIN13](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1016)通过窃取知识产权、财务数据、并购信息或个人身份信息（PII）来实现其目标。(Citation: Mandiant FIN13 Aug 2022)(Citation: Sygnia Elephant Beetle Jan 2022)

dc813e749a7e5d46f9dda9f4a973d3c06372e2c4.source_text: [FIN13](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1016) has utilized web shells and Java tools for tunneling capabilities to and from compromised assets.(Citation: Sygnia Elephant Beetle Jan 2022)
dc813e749a7e5d46f9dda9f4a973d3c06372e2c4.zh: [FIN13](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1016) 利用 Web Shell 和 Java 工具实现与已沦陷资产之间的隧道连接能力。(Citation: Sygnia Elephant Beetle Jan 2022)

20f2de92270e66e44044d02ed2a379302d4bae6e.source_text: [FIN13](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1016) has utilized a proxy tool to communicate between compromised assets.(Citation: Sygnia Elephant Beetle Jan 2022)
20f2de92270e66e44044d02ed2a379302d4bae6e.zh: [FIN13](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1016) 已使用代理工具在受感染的资产之间进行通信。（引用：Sygnia Elephant Beetle 2022年1月）

9cbc87aa1a2d0aa65c3d2c3b1f1cee6d38889549.source_text: [FIN13](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1016) has downloaded additional tools and malware to compromised systems.(Citation: Mandiant FIN13 Aug 2022)(Citation: Sygnia Elephant Beetle Jan 2022)
9cbc87aa1a2d0aa65c3d2c3b1f1cee6d38889549.zh: [FIN13](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1016) 已将其他工具和恶意软件下载到被攻陷的系统上。（来源：Mandiant FIN13 Aug 2022）（来源：Sygnia Elephant Beetle Jan 2022）

60abbdd35953e634b98fd8051d97681e936c0948.source_text: [FIN13](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1016) has used HTTP requests to chain multiple web shells and to contact actor-controlled C2 servers prior to exfiltrating stolen data.(Citation: Mandiant FIN13 Aug 2022)(Citation: Sygnia Elephant Beetle Jan 2022)
60abbdd35953e634b98fd8051d97681e936c0948.zh: [FIN13](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1016) 曾使用 HTTP 请求来链接多个 Web Shell，并联系由攻击者控制的 C2 服务器，随后窃取了敏感数据。(Citation: Mandiant FIN13 Aug 2022)(Citation: Sygnia Elephant Beetle Jan 2022)

bf73b0f02b2a20e55b51ccaf6495cce4a4107413.source_text: [APT19](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0073) is a Chinese-based threat group that has targeted a variety of industries, including defense, finance, energy, pharmaceutical, telecommunications, high tech, education, manufacturing, and legal services. In 2017, a phishing campaign was used to target seven law and investment firms. (Citation: FireEye APT19) Some analysts track [APT19](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0073) and [Deep Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0009) as the same group, but it is unclear from open source information if the groups are the same. (Citation: ICIT China's Espionage Jul 2016) (Citation: FireEye APT Groups) (Citation: Unit 42 C0d0so0 Jan 2016)
bf73b0f02b2a20e55b51ccaf6495cce4a4107413.zh: [APT19](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0073) 是一个基于中国的威胁组织，针对多种行业发动了攻击，包括国防、金融、能源、制药、电信、高科技、教育、制造业和法律服务。2017年，一次网络钓鱼活动针对七家法律和投资公司发动了攻击。(Citation: FireEye APT19) 一些分析师将 [APT19](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0073) 和 [Deep Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0009) 视为同一组织，但从公开来源信息尚不清楚这两个组织是否为同一实体。(Citation: ICIT China's Espionage Jul 2016) (Citation: FireEye APT Groups) (Citation: Unit 42 C0d0so0 Jan 2016)

d96d0caa500650452a0b2315828da0a219b6deb4.source_text: [APT19](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0073) used HTTP for C2 communications. [APT19](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0073) also used an HTTP malware variant to communicate over HTTP for C2.(Citation: FireEye APT19)(Citation: Unit 42 C0d0so0 Jan 2016)
d96d0caa500650452a0b2315828da0a219b6deb4.zh: [APT19](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0073) 使用 HTTP 进行 C2 通信。[APT19](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0073) 还使用了一种基于 HTTP 的恶意软件变体来通过 HTTP 进行 C2 通信。（Citation: FireEye APT19）（Citation: Unit 42 C0d0so0 Jan 2016）

d17c759809340220cbfef382d9ad2af7b666943b.source_text: An [APT19](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0073) HTTP malware variant used Base64 to encode communications to the C2 server.(Citation: Unit 42 C0d0so0 Jan 2016)
d17c759809340220cbfef382d9ad2af7b666943b.zh: 一个 [APT19](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0073) 的 HTTP 恶意软件变体使用 Base64 编码与 C2 服务器进行通信。(Citation: Unit 42 C0d0so0 Jan 2016)

89d490a85788b4c9a5b31729d4a32daaa8ad10de.source_text: [PittyTiger](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0011) is a threat group believed to operate out of China that uses multiple different types of malware to maintain command and control.(Citation: Bizeul 2014)(Citation: Villeneuve 2014)
89d490a85788b4c9a5b31729d4a32daaa8ad10de.zh: [PittyTiger](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0011) 是一个被认为在中国活动的威胁组织，它使用多种不同类型的恶意软件来维持命令与控制。（引用：Bizeul 2014）（引用：Villeneuve 2014）

7febae3030bc26fe3ca019729849e703c15c3d1d.source_text: [Nomadic Octopus](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0133) is a Russian-speaking cyber espionage threat group that has primarily targeted Central Asia, including local governments, diplomatic missions, and individuals, since at least 2014. [Nomadic Octopus](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0133) has been observed conducting campaigns involving Android and Windows malware, mainly using the Delphi programming language, and building custom variants.(Citation: Security Affairs DustSquad Oct 2018)(Citation: Securelist Octopus Oct 2018)(Citation: ESET Nomadic Octopus 2018)
7febae3030bc26fe3ca019729849e703c15c3d1d.zh: [游荡章鱼](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0133)是一个讲俄语的网络间谍威胁组织，自2014年以来主要针对中亚地区，包括当地政府、外交使团和个人。[游荡章鱼](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0133)被观察到进行过涉及Android和Windows恶意软件的活动，主要使用Delphi编程语言，并构建自定义变体。(Citation: Security Affairs DustSquad Oct 2018)(Citation: Securelist Octopus Oct 2018)(Citation: ESET Nomadic Octopus 2018)

38594c2936bab59c48199d38e435306cd0cbc6ec.source_text: [Nomadic Octopus](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0133) has used malicious macros to download additional files to the victim's machine.(Citation: ESET Nomadic Octopus 2018)
38594c2936bab59c48199d38e435306cd0cbc6ec.zh: [Nomadic Octopus](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0133) 已使用恶意宏将其他文件下载到受害者计算机。(Citation: ESET Nomadic Octopus 2018)

df6a660f438a724ea8d15f5dd7c29ec7ec90fe0b.source_text: [TeamPCP](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1056) is a financially-motivated, cloud-native threat group that has been active since at least September 2025. Initially focused on ransomware and cryptocurrency theft, [TeamPCP](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1056) shifted in early 2026 to systematic, worm-driven credential theft and software supply chain attacks targeting Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) workflows. [TeamPCP](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1056) has monetized access through extortion and through partnerships with ransomware actors including Vect and CipherForce.(Citation: Wiz TeamPCP Profile MAY 2026)(Citation: Wiz Trivy Compromise MAR 2026)(Citation: Aqua Security Trivy Compromise MAR 2026)(Citation: Aqua Security Blog Trivy Compromise APR 2026)(Citation: Palo Alto TeamPCP MAR 2026)(Citation: Trend Micro TeamPCP MAY 2026)
df6a660f438a724ea8d15f5dd7c29ec7ec90fe0b.zh: [TeamPCP](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1056) 是一个以牟利为目的、云原生的威胁组织，自 2025 年 9 月起至今一直保持活跃。最初，[TeamPCP](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1056) 专注于勒索软件和加密货币盗窃；在 2026 年初，其转向系统性的蠕虫驱动凭据窃取以及针对持续集成和持续交付 (CI/CD) 工作流的软件供应链攻击。(Citation: Wiz TeamPCP Profile MAY 2026)(Citation: Wiz Trivy Compromise MAR 2026)(Citation: Aqua Security Trivy Compromise MAR 2026)(Citation: Aqua Security Blog Trivy Compromise APR 2026)(Citation: Palo Alto TeamPCP MAR 2026)(Citation: Trend Micro TeamPCP MAY 2026)

355204773cb45734f98fba9174e72e0bbac5f33f.source_text: [TeamPCP](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1056) has modified legitimate software binaries to retrieve secondary payloads from C2.(Citation: Wiz TeamPCP KICS MAR 2026)(Citation: Aikido TeamPCP Telnyx MAR 2026)
355204773cb45734f98fba9174e72e0bbac5f33f.zh: [TeamPCP](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1056) 修改了合法软件二进制文件，以便从 C2 获取次要有效载荷。(Citation: Wiz TeamPCP KICS MAR 2026)(Citation: Aikido TeamPCP Telnyx MAR 2026)

b2f55bdb4329ada2f2c05bf53d92f51974db0375.source_text: [ShinyHunters](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1057) is a cyber criminal collective that has been active since at least 2019 operating under the ShinyCorp persona. [ShinyHunters](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1057) has targeted multiple industries and geographic regions gathering legitimate credentials and personally identifiable information (PII) for resale or extortion of victims. [ShinyHunters](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1057) has been associated with the broader collective called The Community, also known as The Com whose members have also included [Scattered Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1015) and [LAPSUS$](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1004). Public reporting has mentioned a variety of names for operations [ShinyHunters](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1057) members have reportedly conducted with members of other groups, including “Scattered Lapsus Hunters,” “Scattered Lapsus Shiny Hunters,” and “SLSH.”(Citation: ElecticIQ Buyukkaya_ShinyHunters_Sept2025)(Citation: SOCRadar_ShinyHunters_Mar2024)(Citation: Unit42KelleyVaya_BlingLibra_Aug2024)(Citation: Intel471_SH_Aug2021)(Citation: FBI_SHLMS_May2026)(Citation: Google_SHOracle_Jun2026)(Citation: Mandiant_SHDataTheft_Jan2026)(Citation: Google Salesforce JUN 2025)
b2f55bdb4329ada2f2c05bf53d92f51974db0375.zh: [ShinyHunters](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1057) 是一个自至少2019年以来活跃的网络犯罪组织，以ShinyCorp的身份进行活动。[ShinyHunters](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1057) 针对多个行业和地理区域，收集合法凭证和个人身份信息（PII），用于转售或勒索受害者。[ShinyHunters](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1057) 与一个更广泛的集体“The Community”（也被称为The Com）有关联，其成员还包括 [Scattered Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1015) 和 [LAPSUS$](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1004)。公开报道中提到，[ShinyHunters](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1057) 的成员与其他团体成员合作执行了多种操作，包括“Scattered Lapsus Hunters”、“Scattered Lapsus Shiny Hunters”以及“SLSH”。(Citation: ElecticIQ Buyukkaya_ShinyHunters_Sept2025)(Citation: SOCRadar_ShinyHunters_Mar2024)(Citation: Unit42KelleyVaya_BlingLibra_Aug2024)(Citation: Intel471_SH_Aug2021)(Citation: FBI_SHLMS_May2026)(Citation: Google_SHOracle_Jun2026)(Citation: Mandiant_SHDataTheft_Jan2026)(Citation: Google Salesforce JUN 2025)

87fec6c688118b79dd8ece0d8d4d931f9a22d89e.source_text: [ShinyHunters](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1057) has established a connection between the staging host and the C2 using SSH.(Citation: Google_SHOracle_Jun2026)
87fec6c688118b79dd8ece0d8d4d931f9a22d89e.zh: [ShinyHunters](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1057) 使用 SSH 建立了与 C2 之间的 staging host 连接。（来源：Google_SHOracle_Jun2026）

00db7e941b4d4661e351dd032c29066eac6acc8c.source_text: [ShinyHunters](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1057) has deployed custom scripts to targeted systems from customized MeshAgents in their staging environment.(Citation: Google_SHOracle_Jun2026)
00db7e941b4d4661e351dd032c29066eac6acc8c.zh: [ShinyHunters](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1057) 在其暂存环境中从定制的 MeshAgent 向目标系统部署了自定义脚本。(引用：Google_SHOracle_Jun2026)

6b38b86b2870f8c2891a73aeb443a670e15dad37.source_text: [ShinyHunters](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1057) has used MeshCentral and [ConnectWise](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0591) to gain initial access, to run administrative command queries and to deploy the custom lateral movement and defacement script [victim_abbreviation]_fanout.sh.(Citation: Google_SHOracle_Jun2026)(Citation: ElecticIQ Buyukkaya_ShinyHunters_Sept2025)
6b38b86b2870f8c2891a73aeb443a670e15dad37.zh: [ShinyHunters](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1057) 已使用 MeshCentral 和 [ConnectWise](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0591) 来获取初始访问权限、运行管理命令查询以及部署自定义的横向移动和篡改脚本 [victim_abbreviation]_fanout.sh。（引用：Google_SHOracle_Jun2026）（引用：ElecticIQ Buyukkaya_ShinyHunters_Sept2025）

874cc049ce0022fb5c1459b5a900d2710861198f.source_text: [ShinyHunters](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1057) has used [Tor](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0183) to host their DLS.(Citation: FBI_SHLMS_May2026)
874cc049ce0022fb5c1459b5a900d2710861198f.zh: [ShinyHunters](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1057) 已使用 [Tor](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0183) 托管其 DLS。(Citation: FBI_SHLMS_May2026)

c73e7b9fa5b9ae995fad8b577d607226afdebca0.source_text: [ALLANITE](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1000) is a suspected Russian cyber espionage group, that has primarily targeted the electric utility sector within the United States and United Kingdom. The group's tactics and techniques are reportedly similar to [Dragonfly](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0035), although [ALLANITE](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1000)s technical capabilities have not exhibited disruptive or destructive abilities. It has been suggested that the group maintains a presence in ICS for the purpose of gaining understanding of processes and to maintain persistence. (Citation: Dragos)
c73e7b9fa5b9ae995fad8b577d607226afdebca0.zh: [ALLANITE](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1000)是一个疑似俄罗斯网络间谍组织，主要针对美国和英国电力公用事业部门。据报告，该组织的战术和技术与[Dragonfly](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0035)类似，尽管[ALLANITE](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1000)的技术能力尚未表现出破坏性或毁灭性特征。有观点认为，该组织在工业控制系统（ICS）中保持存在，目的是了解相关流程并维持持久性。（参考来源：Dragos）

80210ceca220fb77492e685321c43478319fad6d.source_text: The [CyberAv3ngers](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1027) are a suspected Iranian Government Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC)-affiliated APT group. The [CyberAv3ngers](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1027) have been known to be active since at least 2020, with disputed and false claims of critical infrastructure compromises in Israel.(Citation: CISA AA23-335A IRGC-Affiliated December 2023) In 2023, the [CyberAv3ngers](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1027) engaged in a global targeting and hacking of the Unitronics [Programmable Logic Controller (PLC)](https://attack.mitre.org/assets/A0003) with [Human-Machine Interface (HMI)](https://attack.mitre.org/assets/A0002). This PLC can be found in multiple sectors, including water and wastewater, energy, food and beverage manufacturing, and healthcare. The most notable feature of this attack was the defacement of the devices user interface.(Citation: CISA AA23-335A IRGC-Affiliated December 2023)
80210ceca220fb77492e685321c43478319fad6d.zh: [CyberAv3ngers](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1027) 是一个被怀疑隶属于伊朗政府伊斯兰革命卫队（IRGC）的APT组织。已知 [CyberAv3ngers](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1027) 至少自2020年以来一直活跃，并对在以色列对关键基础设施造成破坏提出了争议性和虚假指控。(Citation: CISA AA23-335A IRGC-Affiliated December 2023) 2023年，[CyberAv3ngers](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1027) 对Unitronics [可编程逻辑控制器 (PLC)](https://attack.mitre.org/assets/A0003) 及其 [人机界面 (HMI)](https://attack.mitre.org/assets/A0002) 进行了全球范围的定位与黑客攻击。这种PLC可应用于多个行业，包括供水和废水处理、能源、食品饮料制造以及医疗保健。此次攻击最显著的特点是对其设备用户界面的篡改。(Citation: CISA AA23-335A IRGC-Affiliated December 2023)

f593a11c4519239bc8dc5aa3ea916cfed8e4122c.source_text: [Bouncing Golf](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0097) is a cyberespionage campaign targeting Middle Eastern countries.(Citation: Trend Micro Bouncing Golf 2019)
f593a11c4519239bc8dc5aa3ea916cfed8e4122c.zh: [Bouncing Golf](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0097) 是一项针对中东国家的网络间谍活动。(Citation: Trend Micro Bouncing Golf 2019)

37d3da37ad5a77c89ad2cb3f94f7fda517b0f450.source_text: [UNC788](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1029) is a group of hackers from Iran that has targeted people in the Middle East.(Citation: Meta Adversarial Threat Report 2022)
37d3da37ad5a77c89ad2cb3f94f7fda517b0f450.zh: [UNC788](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1029) 是一个来自伊朗的黑客组织，目标是中东地区的人员。(Citation: Meta Adversarial Threat Report 2022)
